-- The whole game lives in a fullscreen panel; the 3D world behind it is never seen.
function GM:HUDShouldDraw(name) return false end
function GM:HUDDrawTargetID() end
function GM:HUDDrawPickupHistory() end
function GM:DrawDeathNotice() end
function GM:PlayerBindPress(ply, bind, pressed)
	-- block movement, chat-free keys etc. while the menu is up; Escape still opens GMod's own menu

	return true
end

	AN.UpdateScale()
	AN.UI.Start()
end

	"core/cl_imgsizes.lua", "core/cl_wraplayout.lua", "screens/cl_gamewrap.lua", "core/cl_util.lua", "core/cl_lang.lua", "core/cl_save.lua", "core/sh_progress.lua", "screens/cl_profil.lua", "core/cl_voicelist.lua", "core/cl_audio.lua", "core/cl_orncaps.lua", "core/cl_deco.lua", "core/cl_ui.lua", "core/cl_games.lua", "core/cl_minigame.lua", "core/cl_timeline.lua", "core/cl_flash.lua",
	"lang/da.lua", "lang/en.lua", "lang/subs.lua",
	"screens/cl_main.lua", "screens/cl_kalender.lua", "screens/cl_pyntekasse.lua",
	"screens/cl_saesoner.lua", "screens/cl_scrapbog.lua", "screens/cl_indstillinger.lua", "screens/cl_classic.lua", "screens/cl_tv2.lua", "screens/cl_classicopts.lua", "core/cl_versus.lua", "core/cl_split.lua", "core/cl_summer.lua",
}
for _, f in ipairs(clientFiles) do AddCSLuaFile(f) end

local gameFiles = file.Find(GM.FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/*.lua", "LUA")
for _, f in ipairs(gameFiles or {}) do AddCSLuaFile("games/" .. f) end
local dataFiles = file.Find(GM.FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/*.lua", "LUA")
for _, f in ipairs(dataFiles or {}) do AddCSLuaFile("games/data/" .. f) end

include("shared.lua")
include("core/sh_progress.lua")
include("core/sv_save.lua")
include("core/sv_versus.lua")

-- Send the gamemode's own content (materials, sounds, fonts) to clients on a server.
local function addContent(dir)
	local files, dirs = file.Find("gamemodes/" .. GM.FolderName .. "/content/" .. dir .. "/*", "GAME")
	for _, f in ipairs(files or {}) do resource.AddSingleFile(dir .. "/" .. f) end
	for _, d in ipairs(dirs or {}) do addContent(dir .. "/" .. d) end
end
addContent("materials/alletidersnisse")
addContent("sound/alletidersnisse")
addContent("resource/fonts")

-- The game is played entirely in a fullscreen 2D menu, so the player just idles in the map.
function GM:PlayerLoadout(ply) return true end

function GM:PlayerSpawn(ply)
	player_manager.SetPlayerClass(ply, "player_default")
	ply:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_NONE)
	ply:SetNoDraw(true)
	ply:DrawShadow(false)
	ply:Freeze(true)
end

function GM:PlayerShouldTakeDamage() return false end
function GM:CanPlayerSuicide() return false end

	help_badetid = "Mig og Gyldengrød er kommet i baljen. Når vi dukker op af vandet, så skal du dukke os ned under vandet igen ved at klikke på os med musen. Jo hurtigere du gør det, jo flere point får du. Øv.",
	help_bertramsen = "Du skal styre Bertramsen, den tosse, rundt i Rigsarkivet. Der ligger pebernødder over det hele. Dem skal Bertramsen have samlet op. Alle sammen. Men pas på, at han ikke bliver fanget af en af de der damer, der jagter ham. For så mister du et liv. Prøv at samle hvidløget op og se, hvad der sker.",
	help_bibliotekandis = "Altså hør her. Kandis skal gribe bøgerne, ikke? Du styrer hende med piltasterne. Hun skal gribe alle de røde bøger. Og hvis hun misser en, så mister du et liv. Men pas på med de grønne bøger, for hvis hun kommer til at gribe en grøn, så giver hun sig til at læse i den, og så mister du også et liv. Du har tre liv, og når alle tre er væk, så er spillet slut. Trutlut!",
	help_biblioteksraes = "Okay, det her, det er for sejt. Du skal styre mig med musen, når jeg flyver gennem biblioteket på et kartotekskort. Jo længere jeg flyver, jo hurtigere går det. Men du skal styre mig udenom bogreolerne, for hvis jeg rammer en af dem, så sidder jeg på gulvet med hovedpine. Og så er spillet slut.",
	help_dansespil = "Du skal få mig til at danse på samme måde som elverpigen, ikke? Hvis hun for eksempel bevæger venstre arm, så skal du trykke på min venstre arm. Hvis hun nikker, så skal du trykke på min nisseknold, osv. osv. Spillet slutter, når jeg har lavet et forkert dansetrin, eller tiden er løbet ud.",
	help_denroedehane = "Du skal skynde dig at slukke ilden, inden den får for godt fat. Du sprøjter vand på ilden ved at klikke på den. Jo hurtigere du klikker, jo flere point får du.",
	help_flyttepakning = "Du skal sørge for, at de rigtige ting kommer ned i de rigtige kasser. Du hiver bare fat i en af tingene, når den kommer ned foroven, og hiver den over i den rigtige kasse. Hvis du rammer forkert, mister du et liv. Men det gør du altså også, hvis en af tingene ryger af samlebåndet forneden, så det er bare med at skynde sig.",
	help_fodaftryk = "Okay, hør så her. Der er fire brikker, og hver af dem har fodspor i forskellige farver på. Du skal få fodspor og farver til at passe sammen. Brikkerne skal også samles i en firkant, og... Nej, nej, nej. Det lyder altså meget, meget mere besværligt, end det er. Prøv det bare. Du skal bruge musen til at samle brikkerne op, og du drejer dem med mellemrumstasten.",
	help_fotoskubber = "Du kan vælge enten at spille med et billede eller med tal, og du kan vælge mellem et spil med 8 brikker eller med 15 brikker. Når du har valgt, hvilket spil du vil spille, så klikker du på Start. For at flytte brikkerne skal du klikke på en af brikkerne, der er ud for det tomme felt. Den brik, du klikker på, rykker ind i det tomme felt, og du bliver bare ved, indtil det hele passer sammen. Nemt, ikke?",
	help_gaaseflyvning = "Okay, nissehjælper. Du styrer gåsen med musen. Du skal styre den frem og tilbage ved at bevæge musen. Du får gåsen til at flyve op ved at trykke på museknappen. Så basker den med vingerne og flyver opad. Saml så meget julepynt op som overhovedet muligt, men pas på skyerne.",
	help_hop = "Du skal styre mig. Jeg hopper med piletast op, og med venstre og højre piletast styrer du, i hvilken retning jeg skal løbe. Jeg skal løbe rundt på hylderne og samle al risengrøden op. Og når jeg har spist al risengrøden, så er det tid til at finde tryllebogen. Held og lykke!",
	help_huskespillet = "I huskespillet skal du finde alle de brikker, der hører sammen. Du vender brikkerne ved at klikke på dem med musen, og når du finder to ens brikker, så får du point, og de bliver liggende med billedsiden opad. Og hør lige her, her er altså et godt tip: Du scorer supermange point, hvis du finder flere par i træk.",
	help_kaalhovedskydning = "Du skal styre mig med piletasterne og skyde det kæmpe kålhoved. Du skyder med kontroltasten, der sidder nederst til venstre på dit tastatur. Når du skyder kålhovedet, deler det sig i mindre dele. Når du har skudt al kålen, går du videre til næste runde. Men pas på ikke at blive ramt af kål, for så mister du et liv. Når du har mistet tre liv, så er spillet slut.",
	help_kiks = "Kan du ikke hjælpe mig med at narre en masse kiks fra Gyldengrød? Det er meget nemt. Nu skal du bare høre. Du skal bare klikke på kikserullen, når Gyldengrød ser væk. Men pas på. Hvis han fanger dig, så er spillet slut.",
	help_labyrint = "Okay, du gør sådan her. Når du har klikket på den store grønne knap, så kommer der en rød cirkel omkring musepilen. Nu skal du samle alle de grønne dimser så hurtigt som overhovedet muligt. Tiden tæller hurtigt ned, men hver gang du samler en grøn dims op, så får du lidt mere tid. Men pas på væggene. Hvis du støder ind i dem, så kortslutter det hele.",
	help_pebergroed = "Det er faktisk meget nemt. Når spillet starter, bliver grøden blandet, og så bliver der puttet peber i én af de 12 tallerkener. Kan du undgå at finde grøden med peber i? Hvis du spiser alle 11 tallerkener grød uden peber i, så er du for sej.",
	help_puslespil = "Der er fire forskellige puslespil, som du kan prøve. Vælg bare et af dem og tryk på start. Du tager fat i en brik ved at klikke på den. Du kan dreje den ved at trykke på mellemrumstasten og lægge den ned igen ved at klikke på musen igen. Hvis to brikker passer sammen, så klikker de sammen til et stykke. Og hvis du ikke lige kan huske, hvordan puslespillet skal se ud, så skal du bare køre musepilen ned over billedet i nederste venstre hjørne.",
	help_pyntekasse = "Du skal bruge musen. Klik på to stykker julepynt for at få dem til at bytte plads. Når der er tre stykker ens julepynt på linjen, så forsvinder de. Prøv at se, hvor mange du kan få væk på én gang. Men pas på. Hvis tiden løber ud, så er det slut.",
	help_rotter = "Du har rotter på loftet, og du skal få dem væk ved at slå til dem med en kølle. Når du klikker på musen, så svinger du køllen, og du skal time det helt rigtigt, så rotten flyver rigtig, rigtig langt væk.",
	help_rumtur = "Okay, okay. Så er der lige rumkamp. Okay? Du skyder med kontroltasten, der sidder nederst til venstre på dit tastatur, og du styrer med piletasterne. Hvis du trykker pilen ned, så kommer der et skjold om rumskibet. Og hvis du er fanget, så kan du trykke på mellemrumstasten. Så bliver du lige zappet et andet sted hen. Du skal skyde dødsasteroiderne i små stykker. Men pas på, at du ikke bliver ramt. Tredje gang, du bliver ramt, er spillet slut. Men prøv lige at høre: Nogle gange er der altså nisserubiner fra planeten Julius i asteroiderne. Sørg for at samle dem op.",
	help_rumtur_incomplete = "Okay, okay, så er der lige rumkamp, okay?",
	help_saettekasse = "Kan du sætte de rigtige bogstaver sammen i sættekassen? Du skal finde ud af, hvad det er for et ord, der skal stå deroppe og sætte bogstaverne i den rigtige rækkefølge. Du bruger musen til at tage fat i bogstaverne, men pas på. Bogstaverne er levende, og hvis du ikke skynder dig, så løber de deres vej.",
	help_sneboldkamp = "Så gælder det bare om at ramme alle sammen, både børn og hunde. Den røde pil viser, hvor hårdt jeg kaster, og i hvilken retning. Du kan styre pilen med musen. Når du klikker, kaster jeg, og læg lige mærke til vindretningen. Jo mere modvind, jo hårdere skal jeg kaste. Hvis du rammer, får du en ny snebold. Jeg har kun fem snebolde fra start, så sørg for at ramme. Når der ikke er flere snebolde, så er spillet slut.",
	heop_intro = "Nej, nej, nej, nej, nej. Tryllebogen er blevet væk. Kan du ikke lige hoppe ned og finde den til mig?",
	hop_intro = "Nej, nej, nej, nej, nej. Tryllebogen er blevet væk. Kan du ikke lige hoppe ned og finde den til mig?",
	huskespillet_bonus01 = "Hold da helt juleferie! Hvor er du god til at huske?",
	huskespillet_intro = "Hvad var det lige, jeg skulle huske? Nå ja! Ej, nu glemte jeg det igen. Måske er du bedre til at huske.",
	huskespillet_levelslut = "Jep, flot klaret, du. Så klik på kassen for at fortsætte.",
	instillinger_rollover = "Er din computer på internettet, skal du lige slå det til herinde.",
	jepsaadanskaldetgoeres = "Jep, sådan skal det gøres.",
	julekalender_forkert_01 = "Ups, det var vist ikke den rigtige låge, hva'?",
	julekalender_forkert_02 = "Hov, hov, hov, hov. Det er ikke den rigtige dato.",
	julekalender_forkert_03 = "Hvad? Prøver du at snyde?",
	julekalender_forkert_04 = "Kan du så holde op! Du må ikke åbne den låge i dag.",
	kaalhovedskydning_intro = "Dengang jeg var i det vilde vesten, der mødte jeg Billy the Kid, men jeg har altså også mødt Kæmpekålen.",
	kaduklipdetsam = "Kan du klippe det sammen?",
	kiks_intro = "Jeg elsker altså kiks, kan du ikke? Er det næsten lige så godt som risengrød? Men altså, kun næsten.",
	klikpaajultv2dk = "Klik på jul.tv2.dk",
	labyrint_intro = "Psst, vi skal lige lave et nummer med ham der, Andersen. Er du ikke lige den, der piller dimsen ud af hans computer?",
	luk_rollover = "Hov, hov, pas på. Det er her, du lukker spillet.",
	misterliv_01 = "Au, da mistede du vist nok lidt liv.",
	misterliv_01_alternate = "Au, der mistede du et liv.",
	misterliv_01_alternate_b = "Au! Der mistede du et liv.",
	misterliv_02 = "Hvad er du ude på at slå mig ihjel?",
	misterliv_03 = "Nå, der døde man vist, hva'?",
	misterliv_04 = "Åh, okay, der døde vi så.",
	misterliv_05 = "Jeps, der sluttede det liv.",
	ogrisengroed = "Og gang i den, med rabalder og risengrød!",
	pebergroed_intro = "Altså, der er noget, jeg ikke forstår. Når man nu har noget så fantastisk som risengrød, hvad får så nogen til at putte peber i den?",
	pebergroed_pebergroed_01 = "Føj, føj, føj! Der er jo peber i!",
	pebergroed_pebergroed_02 = "Ad! Jeg HADER peber.",
	pebergroed_pebergroed_03 = "Blæh.",
	pebergroed_pebergroed_04 = "Pffft, aargh!",
	pebergroed_pebergroed_05 = "BØÅÆÆ!",
	pebergroed_risengroed_01 = "Mmmmmmm!",
	pebergroed_risengroed_02 = "Ah, risengrød.",
	pebergroed_risengroed_03 = "Ej, hvor smager det godt.",
	pebergroed_risengroed_04 = "Amen, amen, amen, amen.",
	puslespil_intro = "Puslespil. Jeg keder mig allerede. Men Kandis er altså helt vild med det. Og her er så i hvert fald nogle stykker, som du kan hygge dig med.",
	puslespil_passer01 = "Jeps, de passer som fod i handske.",
	puslespil_passer02 = "Jada, så sidder de sammen.",
	puslespil_passer03 = "Flot. De passer sammen.",
	pyntekasse_bonus01 = "Åh mand, det var point, du lige fik der, hva'?",
	pyntekasse_bonus02 = "Sikke mange point, du lige lavede der.",
	pyntekasse_bonus03 = "Jep, fedt træk.",
	pyntekasse_intro = "Det er lige godt for galt. Der er gået helt kludder i frøken Brahes julepyntekasse. Kan du hjælpe hende med at få orden i den?",
	pyrusrulle_rollover_alternativ = "Og det her, det er selvfølgelig Pyrusrullen. Det er her, du kan finde de spil, du allerede har spillet.",
	rotter_ikkeramt01 = "Nej, nej, nej, nej. Du skal være lidt mere præcis.",
	rotter_intro = "Prøv lige at høre. Jeg har en gåde. Hvordan får man en rotte til at flyve?",
	rotter_ramt01 = "Perfekt! Se, hvor den flyver, den grimme rotte!",
	rotter_ramt02 = "Prøv lige at se!",
	rumtur_intro = "Mit navn er Lyn. Pyrus Lyn. Og hvad? Jeg vil da bare være den sejeste rumhelt.",
	saettekasse_intro = "Der er altså sket noget meget mystisk med sættekassen. Alle bogstaverne er blevet levende.",
	scrapbog_rollover = "I scrapbogen kan du se mange sjove billeder.",
	scrapbog_start = "Ja, det er så min scrapbog. Du må gerne se billederne igennem, bare du ikke laver uorden i dem, for så bliver Kandis godt nok sur.",
	skattekiste_01 = "Her bliver alle de ting, du vinder, samlet. Prøv at se, hvor meget du kan vinde.",
	skattekiste_02 = "Yes! Yes, yes, yes, mand. Et juletræ. Så skal der pyntes op.",
	skattekiste_rollover = "Det her er din skattekiste, hvor alle de fede ting, du vinder, bliver samlet.",
	skidt_01 = "Ej, nej, nej. Åh nej.",
	skidt_02 = "Hey, hvad er der gang i?",
	skidt_03 = "Hvad er det lige, du tror, du laver?",
	skidt_04 = "Nej, nej, nej.",
	skidt_05 = "Hov!",
	skidt_06 = "Kom nu!",
	skidt_07 = "Så sid der og pas på!",
	skidt_08 = "Pas dog på!",
	skidt_09 = "Hallo? Det er mig, du styrer.",
	skidt_10 = "Ups!",
	skidt_11 = "Det var vist ikke så godt.",
	skidt_12 = "Ups igen, det var da slet slet ikke så godt.",
	skidt_13 = "Hoppsan, hoppsan, hoppsan, prøv lige igen, du.",
	skidt_14 = "Ja, kom nu. Prøv igen.",
	sneboldkamp_intro = "December betyder jul, jul betyder sne, og sne betyder sneboldkamp!",
	start_first = "Equilibismus, non-katechismus, anno reversum, BOOM! Ja, man skal øve sig, hvis man skal klare sig på nisseversitetet. Men hallo og lige et øjeblik. Du er da vist ny her, hva'? Nå, men det er altså mig, der er Pyrus, og velkommen til dig. Lad nu bare, som om du er hjemme, kig dig lidt omkring, og pil ved alt. Det er derfor, det er her.",
	start_igen_01 = "Nå, der er du jo igen. Velkommen tilbage. Man smider lige sutterne den her gang, ikke?",
	start_igen_02 = "Hej med dig. Ja, du kender jo selv vejen.",
}
AN.Subs.en = {
	aaaarhja = "Aww yeah.",
	aarhhvad = "Aww, what?",
	andersen_intro = "Poor, poor Andersen. Every time he gets a whack on the nut, he goes back to being a child. And we can't have that, can we?",
	arkivraes_intro = "Here we go again. Me and Kandis have to find some documents for Miss Brahe, but those silly humans are trying to find the documents too. And if they spot us, we're in real trouble.",
	badetid_intro = "Yuck! Yuck! I hate baths, and they're not Gyldengrød's favourite thing either, but Kandis insists we have a bath.",
	bertramsen_intro = "Like I always say, humans are a bit dim. Take that Bertramsen. He's being chased around the archive by ladies.",
	bibliotekandis_intro = "We need some books here. Books. Comics are way cooler than books. But Kandis can take care of that.",
	bibliotekandis_misterliv01 = "No, you have to catch the red books. All of them.",
	biblioteksraes_intro = "Woooooah, did you see me fly there, eh?",
	dansespil_intro = "I love dancing, so how about a spin?",
	denroedehane_intro = "Hello hello, and just a moment, the house is on fire, and who said old houses can't catch fire?",
	dobbeltportion = "That one's a double portion with an extra knob of butter.",
	dobbeltportion02 = "Double portion with an extra knob of butter.",
	flotklaretdu = "Yep, well done, you.",
	flyttepakning_intro = "This is totally unreal. Everything has to be packed into boxes. Will you give me a hand?",
	fodaftryk_intro = "Some nisser have walked right across the paper in the National Archives. I wonder who it could be?",
	fotoskubber_intro = "Oh no, the pictures are all mixed up. Can you sort them out?",
	gaaseflyvning_intro = "How about a flight over the Swedish forests on the back of a goose, eh? Yeah, it's super cool, right?",
	gameover_01 = "Well, there are no lives left. The game's over, old friend.",
	gameover_02 = "Time ran out. Too bad, too bad, too bad. It's just game over.",
	gameover_03 = "So the game's over. But try again. I bet you can do better.",
	gameover_04 = "Hey, old friend. See you in the National Archives, if you're lucky.",
	gameover_05 = "Zero! Not a single grain of rice pudding for you, old friend. That was just too poor.",
	godt_01 = "Oh yeah, man! Cool!",
	godt_02 = "Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!",
	godt_03 = "Yes, that one gets you a double portion with an extra knob of butter.",
	godt_04 = "I love you!",
	godt_05 = "That's it, old friend.",
	godt_06 = "Wow, wow, wow, wow, wow, that's just the best ever.",
	godt_07 = "You were just so good there.",
	godt_08 = "So cool!",
	godt_09 = "Awesome!",
	help_andersen = "You have to make sure Andersen doesn't get whacked on the head. Every time a club pops up next to Andersen, click on it with the mouse. If you're too slow, Andersen gets one right on the noggin. He starts out 40 years old. The first time he gets whacked, he becomes 30. The next time 20, and then 10. When he's 0, the game is over.",
	help_arkivraes = "Okay, you steer us around the National Archives with the arrow keys. You have to find all the documents as fast as you possibly can. You can see where they are on the map. But watch out that you don't bump into Miss Brahe, Andersen or Bertramsen, who are running around in there too. If you get caught, you lose a life. But listen here: if you press the space bar, you spill oil on the floor, and they slip in it. The game is over when you've lost all three lives.",
	help_badetid = "Me and Gyldengrød have ended up in the tub. When we pop up out of the water, you have to dunk us back under by clicking on us with the mouse. The faster you do it, the more points you get. Ugh.",
	help_bertramsen = "You steer Bertramsen, the silly man, around the National Archives. There are pebernødder everywhere. Bertramsen has to pick them all up. Every single one. But watch out that he doesn't get caught by one of those ladies chasing him, because then you lose a life. Try picking up the garlic and see what happens.",
	help_bibliotekandis = "Now listen. Kandis has to catch the books, right? You steer her with the arrow keys. She has to catch all the red books. If she misses one, you lose a life. But watch out for the green books, because if she catches a green one, she starts reading it, and then you lose a life too. You have three lives, and when all three are gone, the game is over. Toot toot!",
	help_biblioteksraes = "Okay, this one is way too cool. You steer me with the mouse while I fly through the library on an index card. The longer I fly, the faster it goes. But you have to steer me around the bookshelves, because if I hit one of them, I end up on the floor with a headache. And then the game is over.",
	help_dansespil = "You have to make me dance the same way as the elf girl, right? If she moves her left arm, for example, you click my left arm. If she nods, you click my nisse head, and so on and so on. The game ends when I make a wrong dance step or the time runs out.",
	help_denroedehane = "You have to put out the fire quickly before it takes hold. You spray water on the fire by clicking on it. The faster you click, the more points you get.",
	help_flyttepakning = "You have to make sure the right things go into the right boxes. Just grab one of the things when it comes down from above, and drag it over to the right box. If you pick the wrong one, you lose a life. But you also do if one of the things falls off the conveyor belt at the bottom, so you'd better hurry.",
	help_fodaftryk = "Okay, now listen. There are four pieces, and each of them has footprints in different colours. You have to make the footprints and the colours match. The pieces also have to make a square, and... No, no, no. It sounds much, much harder than it is. Just try it. Use the mouse to pick up the pieces, and turn them with the space bar.",
	help_fotoskubber = "You can choose to play with a picture or with numbers, and you can choose between a game with 8 pieces or with 15 pieces. When you've chosen which game to play, click Start. To move the pieces, click one of the pieces next to the empty square. The piece you click moves into the empty square, and you just keep going until everything fits. Easy, right?",
	help_gaaseflyvning = "Okay, nisse helper. You steer the goose with the mouse. Move the mouse to steer it back and forth. You make the goose fly up by pressing the mouse button. Then it flaps its wings and flies upwards. Collect as many Christmas decorations as you possibly can, but watch out for the clouds.",
	help_hop = "You steer me. I jump with the up arrow, and with the left and right arrows you choose which way I run. I have to run around on the shelves and pick up all the rice pudding. And when I've eaten all the rice pudding, it's time to find the magic book. Good luck!",
	help_huskespillet = "In the memory game you have to find all the pieces that belong together. Turn the pieces over by clicking on them with the mouse, and when you find two matching pieces, you get points and they stay face up. And listen here, here's a good tip: you score loads of points if you find several pairs in a row.",
	help_kaalhovedskydning = "You steer me with the arrow keys and shoot the giant cabbage. You shoot with the Ctrl key, at the bottom left of your keyboard. When you shoot the cabbage, it splits into smaller pieces. When you've shot all the cabbage, you move on to the next round. But be careful not to get hit by cabbage, because then you lose a life. When you've lost three lives, the game is over.",
	help_kiks = "Can you help me sneak a lot of biscuits from Gyldengrød? It's really easy. Now listen. Just click the biscuit packet when Gyldengrød looks away. But watch out. If he catches you, the game is over.",
	help_labyrint = "Okay, here's what you do. When you've clicked the big green button, a red circle appears around the mouse pointer. Now collect all the green gadgets as fast as you possibly can. The time counts down fast, but every time you pick up a green gadget, you get a bit more time. But watch out for the walls. If you bump into them, everything short-circuits.",
	help_pebergroed = "It's actually really easy. When the game starts, the porridge gets mixed up, and pepper is put in one of the 12 bowls. Can you avoid the porridge with pepper in it? If you eat all 11 bowls of porridge without pepper, you're way too cool.",
	help_puslespil = "There are four different jigsaw puzzles you can try. Just pick one of them and press Start. You pick up a piece by clicking on it. You can turn it by pressing the space bar, and put it down again by clicking the mouse again. If two pieces fit together, they click together into one piece. And if you can't remember what the puzzle should look like, just move the mouse pointer over the picture in the bottom left corner.",
	help_pyntekasse = "You use the mouse. Click two decorations to make them swap places. When there are three matching decorations in a line, they disappear. See how many you can clear at once. But watch out. If the time runs out, it's over.",
	help_rotter = "You've got rats in the loft, and you have to get rid of them by hitting them with a club. When you click the mouse, you swing the club, and you have to time it just right so the rat flies really, really far away.",
	help_rumtur = "Okay, okay. Time for a space battle. Okay? You shoot with the Ctrl key, at the bottom left of your keyboard, and you steer with the arrow keys. If you press the down arrow, a shield appears around the spaceship. And if you're trapped, you can press the space bar, and you get zapped somewhere else. You have to blast the deadly asteroids into little pieces. But watch out that you don't get hit. The third time you get hit, the game is over. But listen: sometimes there are nisse rubies from the planet Julius inside the asteroids. Make sure you collect them.",
	help_rumtur_incomplete = "Okay, okay, time for a space battle, okay?",
	help_saettekasse = "Can you put the right letters together in the type case? You have to work out which word should be up there and put the letters in the right order. Use the mouse to grab the letters, but watch out. The letters are alive, and if you don't hurry, they run away.",
	help_sneboldkamp = "It's all about hitting everyone, both kids and dogs. The red arrow shows how hard I throw and in which direction. You steer the arrow with the mouse. -- Pyrus' voice and the menu music, working like the original sound modules.
--   AN.Speak(id)      plays one of the lines for that id (random if there are several),
--                     stopping whatever Pyrus was saying (like pyrusspeak.stopAllSound + playSound)
--   AN.StopSpeech()
--   AN.SoundMode()    0 = all on, 1 = music off, 2 = everything muted (the original Lyd button)
AN = AN or {}
AN.Audio = AN.Audio or {}
local A = AN.Audio

function AN.SoundMode() return (AN.Save and AN.Save.Get("soundmode")) or 0 end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Voice
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
A.speechId = nil
A.speechCh = nil
A.speechReq = 0

function AN.StopSpeech()
	A.queue = nil
	A.speechLoading = false
	A.speechReq = A.speechReq + 1
	if IsValid(A.speechCh) then A.speechCh:Stop() end
	A.speechCh = nil
	A.speechId = nil
end

function AN.Speak(id, onlyIfQuiet)
	id = string.lower(id)
	local list = AN.VoiceList and AN.VoiceList[id]
	if not list then return end
	if onlyIfQuiet and AN.IsSpeaking() then return end
	AN.StopSpeech()
	if AN.SoundMode() == 2 then return end
	local file = list[math.random(#list)]
	local vol = (AN.Save.Get("vol_voice") or 100) / 100
	if vol <= 0 then return end
	local req = A.speechReq
	A.speechId = id
	A.speechLoading = true
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/voice/" .. file .. ".mp3", "noplay", function(ch)
		if req == A.speechReq then A.speechLoading = false end
		if not IsValid(ch) then return end
		if req ~= A.speechReq then ch:Stop() return end   -- something else was said meanwhile
		ch:SetVolume(vol)
		ch:Play()
		A.speechCh = ch
	end)
	if AN.ShowSubtitle then AN.ShowSubtitle(file) end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Subtitles: what the line says, at the bottom of the screen while it plays (setting "subs").
-- The texts are in AN.Subs[lang][file] (lang/subs.lua), written down from the original recordings.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AN.Subs = AN.Subs or { da = {}, en = {} }
function AN.SubText(file)
	local lang = AN.LangCode and AN.LangCode() or "da"
	local t = AN.Subs[lang] and AN.Subs[lang][file]
	if (not t or t == "") and lang ~= "da" then t = AN.Subs.da[file] end
	return t
end
function AN.ShowSubtitle(file)
	A.sub = { file = file, t = RealTime() }
end
function AN.DrawSubtitle()
	local s = A.sub
	if not s or not AN.Save.Get("subs") then return end
	local txt = AN.SubText(s.file)
	if not txt or txt == "" then return end
	-- shown while the line plays (and a moment after); at most 12 s if the sound never starts
	local playing = A.speechLoading or (IsValid(A.speechCh) and A.speechCh:GetState() == GMOD_CHANNEL_PLAYING)
	if playing then s.last = RealTime() end
	local since = RealTime() - (s.last or s.t)
	if since > 0.6 or RealTime() - s.t > 30 then return end
	local a = math.Clamp((0.6 - since) / 0.3, 0, 1)
	local maxw = math.min(1300, AN.VW - 160)
	local lines = AN.Wrap(txt, "bold", 30, maxw)
	local w = 0
	for _, l in ipairs(lines) do w = math.max(w, AN.TextSize(l, "bold", 30)) end
	local h = #lines * 40 + 24
	local x, y = AN.VW / 2 - w / 2 - 28, AN.VH - (AN.OY or 0) - 70 - h
	AN.Box(x, y, w + 56, h, Color(0, 0, 0, 170 * a), 14)
	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do
		AN.Text(l, "bold", 30, AN.VW / 2, y + 12 + (i - 1) * 40 + 20, Color(255, 255, 255, 255 * a), 1, 1)
	end
end

-- say several lines one after the other (e.g. a game's intro, then how it is played)
function AN.SpeakChain(ids)
	AN.Speak(ids[1])
	local rest = {}
	for i = 2, #ids do rest[#rest + 1] = ids[i] end
	A.queue = #rest > 0 and rest or nil
end

-- is Pyrus saying something, or about to (a chain still has lines left)?
function AN.VoiceBusy()
	return A.speechLoading or AN.IsSpeaking() or (A.queue ~= nil)
end

function AN.IsSpeaking(id)
	if not IsValid(A.speechCh) then return false end
	if A.speechCh:GetState() ~= GMOD_CHANNEL_PLAYING then return false end
	return id == nil or A.speechId == string.lower(id)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Music: one of the three songs, a new random one each time it ends
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local SONGS = { "sig_ikke_mere", "glad_i_bad", "drillerigtighed" }
A.musicCh = nil
A.musicWanted = false

-- a season's screens play its song over and over: the summer "Glad i bad" (the bath song),
-- Halloween "Drillerigtighed"
local function summerNow()
	local scr, name = AN.UI and AN.UI.screen, AN.UI and AN.UI.screenName or ""
	local SU = AN.Summer
	if not SU or not SU.SEASONS then return false end
	if scr and scr.season and SU.SEASONS[scr.season] then return SU.SEASONS[scr.season].song end
	local n = scr and scr.n or 0
	if (name == "sgame" or n > 100) and SU.BY[n] then return SU.SEASONS[SU.SeasonOf(n)].song end
	if name == "sgame" or n > 100 then return "glad_i_bad" end
	return false
end
A.summer = false
local function playSong()
	A.summer = summerNow()
	local song = A.summer or SONGS[math.random(#SONGS)]
	A.loadingSong = true
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/music/" .. song .. ".mp3", "noplay", function(ch)
		A.loadingSong = false
		if not IsValid(ch) then return end
		if not A.musicWanted or AN.SoundMode() ~= 0 then ch:Stop() return end
		ch:SetVolume((AN.Save.Get("vol_music") or 70) / 100 * 0.6)
		ch:Play()
		A.musicCh = ch
	end)
end

function AN.MusicOn()
	A.musicWanted = true
end

function AN.MusicOff()
	A.musicWanted = false
	if IsValid(A.musicCh) then A.musicCh:Stop() end
	A.musicCh = nil
end

hook.Add("Think", "AN_SpeechQueue", function()
	if not A.queue or A.speechLoading or AN.IsSpeaking() then return end
	local nxt = table.remove(A.queue, 1)
	if #A.queue == 0 then A.queue = nil end
	local q = A.queue
	AN.Speak(nxt)
	A.queue = q
end)

hook.Add("Think", "AN_Music", function()
	local want = A.musicWanted and AN.SoundMode() == 0
	if not want then
		if IsValid(A.musicCh) then A.musicCh:Stop() A.musicCh = nil end
		return
	end
	if A.loadingSong then return end
	if not IsValid(A.musicCh) or A.musicCh:GetState() == GMOD_CHANNEL_STOPPED then
		playSong()
	else
		A.musicCh:SetVolume((AN.Save.Get("vol_music") or 70) / 100 * 0.6)
		-- into or out of the summer: change the song
		if summerNow() ~= A.summer then A.musicCh:Stop() A.musicCh = nil end
	end
	-- mute everything in mode 2
	if IsValid(A.speechCh) and AN.SoundMode() == 2 then A.speechCh:Stop() end
end)

-- the Lyd button cycles: all on -> music off -> mute -> all on
function AN.CycleSoundMode()
	local m = (AN.SoundMode() + 1) % 3
	AN.Save.Set("soundmode", m)
	if m == 2 then AN.StopSpeech() end
end

-- Christmas decorations: the original fir branches, with the original ornaments hanging
-- from them on a thread that is wound around a twig of the branch.
AN = AN or {}
AN.Deco = AN.Deco or {}
local D = AN.Deco

-- points on a twig of each branch picture (fraction of width, height), unflipped
local TWIGS = {
	["ui/br_plain.png"]   = { { 0.25, 0.47 }, { 0.45, 0.39 }, { 0.62, 0.36 }, { 0.80, 0.24 } },
	["ui/br_baubles.png"] = { { 0.13, 0.36 }, { 0.30, 0.27 }, { 0.45, 0.31 } },
	["ui/br_heart.png"]   = { { 0.25, 0.61 }, { 0.45, 0.53 }, { 0.88, 0.11 } },
}
local THREAD = Color(240, 226, 190)

local function imgFlip(path, x, y, w, h, alpha, col)
	local m = AN.Mat(path)
	col = col or color_white
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, alpha or 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(m)
	surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(AN.PX(x), AN.SY(y), AN.SX(w), AN.SX(h), 1, 0, 0, 1)
end

-- draws a branch (with a soft shadow) and returns a function giving its twig points
function D.Branch(path, x, y, w, flip)
	local h = w * AN.Ratio(path)
	if flip then
		imgFlip(path, x + 6, y + 12, w, h, 70, Color(0, 0, 0))
		imgFlip(path, x, y, w, h)
	else
		AN.Img(path, x + 6, y + 12, w, h, 70, Color(0, 0, 0))
		AN.Img(path, x, y, w, h)
	end
	local pts = TWIGS[path] or {}
	return function(i)
		local p = pts[i]
		if not p then return nil end
		local fx = flip and (1 - p[1]) or p[1]
		return x + fx * w, y + p[2] * h
	end
end

local function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, thick)
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a or 255)
	local a, b, c, d = AN.PX(x1), AN.SY(y1), AN.PX(x2), AN.SY(y2)
	thick = math.max(1, math.floor((thick or 2) * AN.S + 0.5))
	for o = 0, thick - 1 do
		surface.DrawLine(a + o, b, c + o, d)
	end
end

-- an ornament hanging from a twig point: the thread is wound around the twig a few times,
-- then hangs straight down to the ornament's own hanger. maxBottom keeps it clear of content.
function D.Hang(px, py, len, id, w, maxBottom)
	if not px then return end
	local p = "wrap/orn_" .. id .. ".png"
	local h = w * AN.Ratio(p)
	if maxBottom then len = math.min(len, maxBottom - py - h) end
	if len < 8 then return end
	-- the ornament hangs by its own cap, right under the thread
	local cap = AN.OrnCap and AN.OrnCap[id] or { 0.5, 0 }
	local ox, oy = px - cap[1] * w, py + len - cap[2] * h - 1
	-- shadow of thread + ornament
	line(px + 3, py + 6, px + 3, py + len + 6, Color(0, 0, 0, 60), 2)
	AN.Img(p, ox + 5, oy + 9, w, h, 70, Color(0, 0, 0))
	-- thread
	line(px, py + 2, px, py + len + 3, THREAD, 2)
	-- wound around the twig: a few short slanted turns
	for i = 0, 2 do
		local yy = py - 5 + i * 4
		line(px - 6, yy + 3, px + 6, yy - 2, THREAD, 2)
	end
	line(px - 6, py + 6, px + 1, py + 9, THREAD, 2)
	AN.Img(p, ox, oy, w, h)
end

-- hang from twig i of a branch drawn with D.Branch
function D.HangAt(t, i, len, id, w, maxBottom)
	local px, py = t(i)
	D.Hang(px, py, len, id, w, maxBottom)
end

-- wide screens: garland in the room on the sides (outside the content)
function D.SideGarland()
	local VW = AN.VW
	local t = D.Branch("ui/br_heart.png", -150, 300, 420)
	D.HangAt(t, 2, 120, "kugle5", 42)
	D.HangAt(t, 3, 60, "stok0", 26)
	t = D.Branch("ui/br_baubles.png", VW - 250, 300, 360)
	D.HangAt(t, 2, 150, "kugle4", 38)
	t = D.Branch("ui/br_baubles.png", -120, 700, 400, true)
	D.HangAt(t, 2, 70, "hjerte0", 40)
	t = D.Branch("ui/br_heart.png", VW - 300, 760, 380, true)
	D.HangAt(t, 2, 80, "star0", 48)
end

-- the menu screens: a garland along the top between the left column and the corner buttons,
-- and a branch in the bottom right corner
function D.MenuGarland()
	local VW = AN.VW
	local x0, x1 = 560, VW - 300
	local maxBottom = 140
	local i = 0
	local orns = { "kugle4", "star0", "kugle1", "hjerte0", "kugle5", "stok0", "kugle4", "star0" }
	local k = 0
	local x = x0
	while x + 380 <= VW - 230 do
		local path = (i % 2 == 0) and "ui/br_plain.png" or "ui/br_baubles.png"
		local w = (i % 2 == 0) and 380 or 340
		local flip = (i % 3 == 1)
		local y = (i % 2 == 0) and -46 or -70
		local t = D.Branch(path, x, y, w, flip)
		for j = 1, 2 do
			local px, py = t(j + (i % 2))
			if px and px < x1 and px > x0 - 40 then
				k = k + 1
				local id = orns[(k - 1) % #orns + 1]
				D.Hang(px, py, 30 + (k * 17) % 40, id, id == "stok0" and 22 or (id == "star0" and 40 or 30), maxBottom)
			end
		end
		x = x + w - 70
		i = i + 1
	end
	D.Branch("ui/br_heart.png", VW - 330, 1080 - 150, 380, true)
end

-- A small Flash player for symbols exported by flash_export.py. Like Flash, every sprite instance
-- has its own frame counter, playing state, labels and display list; sprite children are their own
-- instances that keep running while they stay on the same depth. Frame scripts are given by the
-- game as Lua functions (FL.SetActions). Drawing goes through the minigame stage (TL.Pic / TL.Text).
--   local c = FL.New("g01sg", "pigeBamse")    -- by export name or character id
--   FL.Tick(c)                                 -- once per Flash frame
--   FL.Draw(c, matrix)                         -- stage matrix {a,b,c,d,tx,ty}
--   FL.GotoAndStop(c, "walk"), FL.Child(c, "side"), FL.Bounds(c, matrix), FL.HitTest(a, ma, b, mb)
AN = AN or {}
AN.FL = AN.FL or {}
local FL = AN.FL
local TL = AN.TL

FL.actions = FL.actions or {}   -- [lib][cid][frame] = function(clip)
FL.ImgSwap = FL.ImgSwap or {}
FL.LoadHidden = FL.LoadHidden or {}
FL.WrapDyn = FL.WrapDyn or {}
local function MG_S(v) return AN.MG.S(v) end

local function libOf(lib) return AN.FLib[lib] end

local function resolveId(lib, ref)
	if type(ref) == "number" then return ref end
	local L = libOf(lib)
	return L and L.exports[string.lower(ref)]
end
FL.Resolve = resolveId

-- frame scripts: FL.SetActions("g01sg", "pigeBamse" or cid, { [1] = function(c) FL.Stop(c) end, ... })
function FL.SetActions(lib, ref, frames)
	local id = resolveId(lib, ref)
	if not id then return end
	FL.actions[lib] = FL.actions[lib] or {}
	FL.actions[lib][id] = frames
end

local function frameList(def, f)
	local fr = def[4][f]
	local guard = 0
	while type(fr) == "number" and guard < 10000 do
		fr = def[4][fr]
		guard = guard + 1
	end
	return fr or {}
end

-- a new instance of a sprite (or button / shape) character
function FL.New(lib, ref, parent, name)
	local id = resolveId(lib, ref)
	local L = libOf(lib)
	local def = L and id and L.chars[id]
	local c = {
		lib = lib, id = id, def = def, kind = def and def[1] or "none",
		frame = 1, playing = true, vars = {}, kids = {}, parent = parent, name = name,
		visible = true,
	}
	-- FL.LoadHidden[lib][cid]: clips whose onClipEvent(load) sets _visible = false (every time they
	-- are placed again)
	if FL.LoadHidden[lib] and id and FL.LoadHidden[lib][id] then c.visible = false end
	if c.kind == "spr" then
		c.nframes = def[2]
		FL.Rebuild(c)
		FL.RunActions(c)
	else
		c.playing = false
	end
	return c
end

function FL.RunActions(c)
	local a = FL.actions[c.lib] and FL.actions[c.lib][c.id]
	local fn = a and a[c.frame]
	if fn then fn(c) end
	-- sounds started on this frame
	local snd = c.def and c.def[5] and c.def[5][c.frame]
	if snd and FL.OnSound then
		for _, s in ipairs(snd) do FL.OnSound(c, s) end
	end
end

-- (re)create the child instances for the current frame: kept while the instance stays, new ones
-- start at their frame 1
function FL.Rebuild(c)
	if c.kind ~= "spr" then return end
	local items = frameList(c.def, c.frame)
	local keep = {}
	local L = libOf(c.lib)
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		local inst, cid = it[3], it[2]
		local ch = L.chars[cid]
		if ch and (ch[1] == "spr" or ch[1] == "btn") then
			keep[inst] = true
			if not c.kids[inst] then
				local k = FL.New(c.lib, cid, c, it.nm)
				c.kids[inst] = k
				k.fresh = true
			end
			c.kids[inst].name = it.nm
		end
	end
	for inst in pairs(c.kids) do
		if not keep[inst] then c.kids[inst] = nil end
	end
end

local function labelFrame(c, target)
	if type(target) == "number" then return target end
	local f = c.def and c.def[3] and c.def[3][string.lower(target)]
	return f
end

function FL.Goto(c, target, play)
	if c.kind ~= "spr" then return end
	local f = labelFrame(c, target)
	if not f then return end
	f = math.Clamp(math.floor(f), 1, c.nframes)
	c.playing = play and true or false
	if f ~= c.frame then
		c.frame = f
		FL.Rebuild(c)
		FL.RunActions(c)
	end
end
function FL.GotoAndStop(c, t) FL.Goto(c, t, false) end
function FL.GotoAndPlay(c, t) FL.Goto(c, t, true) end
function FL.Stop(c) c.playing = false end
function FL.Play(c) c.playing = true end
function FL.NextFrame(c) FL.Goto(c, math.min(c.frame + 1, c.nframes or 1), false) end
function FL.PrevFrame(c) FL.Goto(c, math.max(c.frame - 1, 1), false) end

-- one Flash frame: advance this clip, then its children (new children wait a frame)
function FL.Tick(c)
	if c.kind ~= "spr" then return end
	if c.playing and c.nframes > 1 then
		local f = c.frame + 1
		if f > c.nframes then f = 1 end
		c.frame = f
		FL.Rebuild(c)
		FL.RunActions(c)
	elseif c.playing and c.nframes == 1 then
		-- a one-frame clip that is "playing" runs its frame actions every frame in Flash
	end
	for _, k in pairs(c.kids) do
		if k.fresh then k.fresh = nil else FL.Tick(k) end
	end
end

-- the child instance with an instance name, in the current frame
function FL.Child(c, name)
	if not c or c.kind ~= "spr" then return nil end
	name = string.lower(name)
	for _, it in ipairs(frameList(c.def, c.frame)) do
		if it.nm and string.lower(it.nm) == name then return c.kids[it[3]] end
	end
	return nil
end

local function mul(P, C) return TL.Mul(P, C) end
local function itemM(it) return { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] } end

-- draw a clip with the stage matrix M; alpha and colour multipliers go down the tree
function FL.Draw(c, M, alpha, col)
	if not c or not c.visible then return end
	alpha = (alpha or 1) * (c.alpha or 1)   -- c.alpha: a script's _alpha (0..1)
	-- c.drawFn: the game draws this clip itself (e.g. a movie loaded into it), at its place in the depth order
	if c.drawFn then c.drawFn(M, alpha, col) return end
	if c.col then
		-- c.col: a script's Color object (setRGB = { 0, 0, 0, r, g, b }); the parents' transform goes on top
		local x = c.col
		if col then
			col = { col[1] * x[1], col[2] * x[2], col[3] * x[3], col[1] * x[4] + (col[4] or 0), col[2] * x[5] + (col[5] or 0), col[3] * x[6] + (col[6] or 0) }
		else
			col = x
		end
	end
	if c.kind == "spr" then
		local L = libOf(c.lib)
		local items = frameList(c.def, c.frame)
		local maskUntil = nil
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if maskUntil and it[1] > maskUntil then
				FL.PopClip()
				maskUntil = nil
			end
			if it.cd then
				-- a mask: the items up to its clip depth are clipped to its bounding box (masks here are rectangles)
				local mk = c.kids[it[3]]
				local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.ItemBounds(c, L, it, mul(M, (mk and mk.mat) or itemM(it)))
				if maskUntil then FL.PopClip() end
				FL.PushClip(x0, y0, x1, y1)
				maskUntil = it.cd
			else
				local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
				local m = mul(M, (kid and kid.mat) or itemM(it))   -- kid.mat: a script moved the clip (_x, _y, _rotation, _xscale)
				local a, cc = alpha, col
				if it.cx then
					-- colour transforms combine like Flash: x * mul + add, the parent's applied after the child's
					local x = it.cx
					a = alpha * x[4]
					local pm1, pm2, pm3 = col and col[1] or 1, col and col[2] or 1, col and col[3] or 1
					local pa1, pa2, pa3 = col and col[4] or 0, col and col[5] or 0, col and col[6] or 0
					cc = { pm1 * x[1], pm2 * x[2], pm3 * x[3], pm1 * (x[5] or 0) + pa1, pm2 * (x[6] or 0) + pa2, pm3 * (x[7] or 0) + pa3 }
				end
				if a > 0.004 then FL.DrawChar(c, L, it, m, a, cc) end
			end
		end
		if maskUntil then FL.PopClip() end
		-- clips a script made at run time (attachMovie / duplicateMovieClip): { c = clip, m = matrix }, drawn on top
		if c.extra then
			for _, e in ipairs(c.extra) do FL.Draw(e.c, mul(M, e.m), alpha * (e.a or 1), e.col or col) end
		end
	elseif c.kind == "btn" then
		local L = libOf(c.lib)
		for _, it in ipairs(c.def[2]) do
			FL.DrawChar(c, L, it, mul(M, itemM(it)), alpha, col)
		end
	end
end

-- a text colour through a colour transform
local function txtCol(r, g, b, col)
	if not col then return Color(r, g, b) end
	return Color(math.Clamp(r * col[1] + (col[4] or 0), 0, 255), math.Clamp(g * col[2] + (col[5] or 0), 0, 255), math.Clamp(b * col[3] + (col[6] or 0), 0, 255))
end

local function picCol(path, x, y, w, h, m, a, col)
	if col then
		-- tinted (colour transform: the multiplier, plus the added colour as it shows on white)
		local r = math.Clamp(col[1] + (col[4] or 0) / 255, 0, 1)
		local g = math.Clamp(col[2] + (col[5] or 0) / 255, 0, 1)
		local b = math.Clamp(col[3] + (col[6] or 0) / 255, 0, 1)
		if math.abs(r - 1) > 0.01 or math.abs(g - 1) > 0.01 or math.abs(b - 1) > 0.01 then
			FL.tint = { r, g, b }
		end
	end
	TL.Pic(path, x, y, w, h, m, a)
	FL.tint = nil
end

function FL.DrawChar(c, L, it, m, a, col)
	local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
	if not ch then return end
	local kind = ch[1]
	if kind == "img" then
		-- a picture with text in it can have a version per language: FL.ImgSwap[path][lang] = path
		local path = ch[2]
		local sw = FL.ImgSwap[path]
		if sw and sw[AN.LangCode()] then path = sw[AN.LangCode()] end
		picCol(path, ch[3], ch[4], ch[5], ch[6], m, a, col)
	elseif kind == "tiles" then
		for _, t in ipairs(ch[2]) do picCol(t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5], m, a, col) end
	elseif kind == "morph" then
		local r = it.r or 0
		local best, bk
		for k, v in pairs(ch[2]) do
			if not best or math.abs(k - r) < math.abs(bk - r) then best, bk = v, k end
		end
		if best and best[1] == "img" then picCol(best[2], best[3], best[4], best[5], best[6], m, a, col) end
	elseif kind == "spr" or kind == "btn" then
		local k = c.kids[it[3]]
		if k then FL.Draw(k, m, a, col) end
	elseif kind == "text" then
		local str = (FL.TextHook and FL.TextHook(ch[2])) or AN.L(ch[2])
		local tcol = txtCol(ch[6], ch[7], ch[8], col)
		local lines = string.Explode("\n", str)
		local lh = ch[10] or ch[5]
		for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
			local ly = ch[4] + (i - (#lines + 1) / 2) * lh
			local lx = ch[12] == 0 and ch[9] or ch[3]
			local px, py = TL.Apply(m, lx, ly)
			-- a translation (or our wider font) is made smaller to fit the original's width
			local ow = 2 * (ch[3] - ch[9])
			local maxW = ow > 4 and ow * 1.06 * math.sqrt(m[1] * m[1] + m[2] * m[2]) or nil
			TL.Text(line, "title", ch[5], px, py, m, tcol, a, maxW, ch[12] == 0)
		end
	elseif kind == "dyn" then
		local v = FL.VarValue(c, ch[2])
		if v == nil then v = ch[12] end
		v = tostring(v or "")
		if v ~= "" then
			local s = math.sqrt(m[1] * m[1] + m[2] * m[2])
			local al = ch[8]
			local ax = al == 1 and (ch[3] + ch[5] - 2) or (al == 2 and (ch[3] + ch[5] / 2) or (ch[3] + 2))
			-- one line: in the middle of the box; a box made for several lines: the first line at its top
			local lineH = ch[7] * 1.2
			local ay = ch[6] > lineH * 2 and (ch[4] + 2 + lineH / 2) or (ch[4] + ch[6] / 2)
			local lm = { m[1] / s, m[2] / s, m[3] / s, m[4] / s, 0, 0 }
			-- several lines (\n or \r in the text): one under the other
			local lines = string.Explode("\n", (string.gsub(v, "\r\n?", "\n")))
			-- FL.WrapDyn[lib]: a box made for several lines wraps its words, like Flash's word wrap
			if FL.WrapDyn[c.lib] and ch[6] > lineH * 2 then
				lines = AN.Wrap(table.concat(lines, "\n"), FL.DynFace or "title", MG_S(ch[7] * s), MG_S((ch[5] - 4) * s))
			end
			-- (a field with several lines wraps in Flash: here a line too wide for the box is made smaller)
			local maxW = (#lines > 1 or ch[6] > lineH * 2) and (ch[5] - 4) * s or nil
			for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
				local px, py = TL.Apply(m, ax, ay + (i - 1) * lineH)
				TL.Text(line, FL.DynFace or "title", ch[7] * s, px, py, lm, txtCol(ch[9], ch[10], ch[11], col), a, maxW, al == 0 or (al == 1 and "right"))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- a text field's variable: looked up on the clip that holds the field (Flash timeline variables)
function FL.VarValue(c, var)
	if var == "" then return nil end
	if string.sub(var, 1, 3) == "@L:" then return AN.L(string.sub(var, 4)) end
	local name = string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var
	local lname = string.lower(name)
	local cur = c
	if string.find(var, "_parent.", 1, true) then cur = c.parent or c end
	for k, v in pairs(cur.vars) do
		if string.lower(k) == lname then return v end
	end
	if FL.VarHook then return FL.VarHook(c, var) end
	return nil
end

-- bounding box of a clip through matrix M: x0, y0, x1, y1 (nil when empty)
function FL.Bounds(c, M, ignoreVisible)
	if not c then return nil end
	if not ignoreVisible and not c.visible then return nil end
	local x0, y0, x1, y1
	local function add(px, py)
		if not x0 then x0, y0, x1, y1 = px, py, px, py return end
		if px < x0 then x0 = px end
		if py < y0 then y0 = py end
		if px > x1 then x1 = px end
		if py > y1 then y1 = py end
	end
	local function rect(m, r)
		for _, p in ipairs({ { r[1], r[2] }, { r[1] + r[3], r[2] }, { r[1], r[2] + r[4] }, { r[1] + r[3], r[2] + r[4] } }) do
			add(TL.Apply(m, p[1], p[2]))
		end
	end
	local L = libOf(c.lib)
	local items = c.kind == "spr" and frameList(c.def, c.frame) or (c.kind == "btn" and c.def[2] or {})
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		if not it.cd then
			local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
			local m = mul(M, (kid and kid.mat) or itemM(it))
			local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
			if ch then
				local kind = ch[1]
				if kind == "img" then rect(m, { ch[3], ch[4], ch[5], ch[6] })
				elseif kind == "tiles" then
					for _, t in ipairs(ch[2]) do rect(m, { t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5] }) end
				elseif kind == "morph" then
					for _, v in pairs(ch[2]) do if v[1] == "img" then rect(m, { v[3], v[4], v[5], v[6] }) break end end
				elseif kind == "dyn" then rect(m, { ch[3], ch[4], ch[5], ch[6] })
				elseif kind == "spr" or kind == "btn" then
					local k = c.kids[it[3]]
					if k then
						local a, b, cc, d = FL.Bounds(k, m, true)
						if a then add(a, b) add(cc, d) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- a button with only a hit area (nothing drawn): its hit area
	if not x0 and c.kind == "btn" and c.def and c.def[3] then
		local b = c.def[3]
		rect(M, { b[1], b[2], b[3] - b[1], b[4] - b[2] })
	end
	return x0, y0, x1, y1
end

-- the exact hit test: is the stage point (x, y) on the clip drawn with matrix M? Buttons use their
-- hit area (a pixel mask from the exporter); sprites test their children, topmost first; pictures
-- count with their box.
local B64 = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789+/"
local B64V = {}
for i = 1, 64 do B64V[string.byte(B64, i)] = i - 1 end
local function hitRows(h)
	if h.rows then return h.rows end
	local rows = {}
	for line in string.gmatch(h[3] .. "|", "([^|]*)|") do
		local r = {}
		for i = 1, #line - 1, 2 do r[#r + 1] = B64V[string.byte(line, i)] * 64 + B64V[string.byte(line, i + 1)] end
		rows[#rows + 1] = r
	end
	h.rows = rows
	return rows
end
local function invApply(m, x, y)
	local det = m[1] * m[4] - m[2] * m[3]
	if math.abs(det) < 1e-9 then return nil end
	x, y = x - m[5], y - m[6]
	return (m[4] * x - m[3] * y) / det, (-m[2] * x + m[1] * y) / det
end
function FL.HitPoint(c, M, x, y)
	if not c then return false end
	if c.kind == "btn" then
		local b, h = c.def[3], c.def[4]
		local lx, ly = invApply(M, x, y)
		if not lx or not b then return false end
		if lx < b[1] or lx > b[3] or ly < b[2] or ly > b[4] then return false end
		if not h then return true end
		local rows = hitRows(h)
		local px, py = math.floor((lx - b[1]) * 2), math.floor((ly - b[2]) * 2)
		local r = rows[py + 1]
		if not r then return false end
		for i = 1, #r - 1, 2 do
			if px >= r[i] and px < r[i + 1] then return true end
		end
		return false
	elseif c.kind == "spr" then
		if not c.visible then return false end
		local L = libOf(c.lib)
		local items = frameList(c.def, c.frame)
		for i = #items, 1, -1 do
			local it = items[i]
			if not it.cd then
				local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
				local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
				local m = mul(M, (kid and kid.mat) or itemM(it))
				if ch and (ch[1] == "spr" or ch[1] == "btn") and kid then
					if FL.HitPoint(kid, m, x, y) then return true end
				elseif ch then
					local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.ItemBounds(c, L, it, m)
					if x0 and x >= x0 and x <= x1 and y >= y0 and y <= y1 then return true end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- for UI.Button: a hit function testing a clip (stage matrix M) under the mouse
function FL.HitFn(c, M)
	return function(vx, vy)
		local MG = AN.MG
		return FL.HitPoint(c, M, (vx - MG.x0) / MG.k, (vy - MG.y0) / MG.k)
	end
end

function FL.HitTest(a, ma, b, mb)
	local ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1 = FL.Bounds(a, ma, true)
	local bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = FL.Bounds(b, mb, true)
	if not ax0 or not bx0 then return false end
	return ax0 <= bx1 and bx0 <= ax1 and ay0 <= by1 and by0 <= ay1
end

-- the matrix of a named child inside c (for hit tests on parts like a "hitbox")
function FL.ChildMatrix(c, name, M)
	name = string.lower(name)
	for _, it in ipairs(frameList(c.def, c.frame)) do
		if it.nm and string.lower(it.nm) == name then
			local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
			return mul(M, (kid and kid.mat) or itemM(it)), kid
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the display list of a clip's current frame, and the stage box of the first item with one of the
-- given characters (e.g. an unnamed button inside a clip): x0, y0, x1, y1
function FL.Items(c) return c and c.kind == "spr" and frameList(c.def, c.frame) or {} end
function FL.CharItem(c, M, cids)
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
		if cids[it[2]] then
			local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
			if kid then return kid, mul(M, kid.mat or itemM(it)) end
		end
	end
	return nil
end
function FL.CharBounds(c, M, cids)
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
		if cids[it[2]] then
			local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
			local m = mul(M, (kid and kid.mat) or itemM(it))
			if kid then return FL.Bounds(kid, m, true) end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function FL.Label(c, f)
	for k, v in pairs(c.def[3] or {}) do if v == (f or c.frame) then return k end end
end

-- the bounding box (stage coordinates) of one display list item drawn with matrix m
function FL.ItemBounds(c, L, it, m)
	local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
	if not ch then return nil end
	local x0, y0, x1, y1
	local function add(px, py)
		if not x0 then x0, y0, x1, y1 = px, py, px, py return end
		x0, y0, x1, y1 = math.min(x0, px), math.min(y0, py), math.max(x1, px), math.max(y1, py)
	end
	local function rect(r)
		for _, p in ipairs({ { r[1], r[2] }, { r[1] + r[3], r[2] }, { r[1], r[2] + r[4] }, { r[1] + r[3], r[2] + r[4] } }) do
			add(TL.Apply(m, p[1], p[2]))
		end
	end
	local kind = ch[1]
	if kind == "img" then rect({ ch[3], ch[4], ch[5], ch[6] })
	elseif kind == "tiles" then for _, t in ipairs(ch[2]) do rect({ t[2], t[3], t[4], t[5] }) end
	elseif kind == "morph" then for _, v in pairs(ch[2]) do if v[1] == "img" then rect({ v[3], v[4], v[5], v[6] }) break end end
	elseif kind == "spr" or kind == "btn" then
		local k = c.kids[it[3]]
		if k then return FL.Bounds(k, m, true) end
	end
	return x0, y0, x1, y1
end

-- clipping (masks) as scissor rectangles inside the minigame stage
FL.clipStack = {}
local function applyClip()
	local r = FL.clipStack[#FL.clipStack]
	local MG = AN.MG
	local bx0, by0 = AN.PX(MG.x0), AN.SY(MG.y0)
	local bx1, by1 = AN.PX(MG.x0 + MG.S(MG.sw or 0)), AN.SY(MG.y0 + MG.S(MG.sh or 0))
	if r then
		render.SetScissorRect(math.max(bx0, r[1]), math.max(by0, r[2]), math.min(bx1, r[3]), math.min(by1, r[4]), true)
	else
		render.SetScissorRect(bx0, by0, bx1, by1, true)
	end
end

function FL.PushClip(x0, y0, x1, y1)
	local MG = AN.MG
	local r
	if not x0 then
		r = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	else
		r = { AN.PX(MG.X(x0)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y0)), AN.PX(MG.X(x1)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y1)) }
	end
	local top = FL.clipStack[#FL.clipStack]
	if top then r = { math.max(r[1], top[1]), math.max(r[2], top[2]), math.min(r[3], top[3]), math.min(r[4], top[4]) } end
	if r[3] < r[1] then r[3] = r[1] end
	if r[4] < r[2] then r[4] = r[2] end
	FL.clipStack[#FL.clipStack + 1] = r
	applyClip()
end

function FL.PopClip()
	FL.clipStack[#FL.clipStack] = nil
	applyClip()
end

-- a clip found by its instance names from c (e.g. { "game", "stage", "ball" }): its stage matrix,
-- the clip, and its box on the stage (x0, y0, x1, y1). M = c's own stage matrix (default none).
function FL.PathClip(c, names, M)
	local m = M or { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
	local k = c
	for _, nm in ipairs(names) do
		if not k then return nil end
		m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(k, nm, m)
		if not m then return nil end
	end
	if not k then return nil end
	local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(k, m, true)
	return m, k, x0, y0, x1, y1
end

-- The 24 calendar games: registry, door rules and starting/finishing a game.
AN = AN or {}
AN.Games = AN.Games or {}

-- Defaults for every door. Game files call AN.RegisterGame(n, def) to make one playable.
--   scoreType: "time" (lower is better) or "score" (higher is better)
--   goal: value that gives full 10 coins (shown on the calendar)
--   worst: value that gives 1 coin
for n = 1, 24 do
	AN.Games[n] = AN.Games[n] or { n = n, made = false, scoreType = "time", goal = 30, worst = 180 }
end

function AN.RegisterGame(n, def)
	def.n = n
	def.made = true
	def.garland = false   -- the game screen has its own decorations
	def.scoreType = def.scoreType or "time"
	AN.Games[n] = def
	-- each game gets its own screen called "game<n>"
	AN.Screens["game" .. n] = def
end

-- pebernødder 3..10 from a result, like the original: floor(3 + t * 7), where t goes
-- from 0 at the game's badScore to 1 at its coolScore
function AN.CoinsFor(n, value)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	if g.coins then return g.coins(value) end
	local t
	if g.scoreType == "time" then
		t = (g.worst - value) / (g.worst - g.goal)
	else
		t = (value - g.worst) / (g.goal - g.worst)
	end
	return math.Clamp(math.floor(3 + 7 * math.Clamp(t, 0, 1)), 3, 10)
end

function AN.FormatValue(n, value)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	if value == nil then return "—" end
	if g and g.scoreType == "time" then return AN.FormatTime(value) end
	return tostring(math.floor(value))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Doors
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function AN.IsDecember()
	return tonumber(os.date("%m")) == 12
end

function AN.Today() return tonumber(os.date("%d")) end

-- doors follow the date only in December and only with that setting on
function AN.UsesDate()
	return AN.IsDecember() and AN.Save.Get("doorRule") ~= "progress"
end

-- returns state: "done", "today", "open", "locked" and for locked a reason key + number
function AN.DoorState(n)
	if n > 24 then return "open" end
	if AN.Save.DoorDone(n) then return "done" end
	if AN.UsesDate() then
		local d = AN.Today()
		if n > d then return "locked", "cal_locked_date", n end
		if n == AN.CurrentDoor() then return "today" end
		return "open"
	end
	-- one at a time: every earlier door with a playable game must be done
	-- (doors whose game isn't made yet don't block the ones after them)
	local blocker = AN.BlockingDoor(n)
	if not blocker then
		if n == AN.CurrentDoor() then return "today" end
		return "open"
	end
	return "locked", "cal_locked_prev", blocker
end

function AN.BlockingDoor(n)
	for i = n - 1, 1, -1 do
		if AN.Games[i].made and not AN.Save.DoorDone(i) then return i end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the door to highlight: today's date in December (if not done) or the first open, unfinished door
function AN.CurrentDoor()
	if AN.UsesDate() then
		local d = math.min(AN.Today(), 24)
		if not AN.Save.DoorDone(d) then return d end
		for i = 1, d do
			if not AN.Save.DoorDone(i) then return i end
		end
		return nil
	end
	-- the first open door with a playable game, else the first open door
	local firstOpen
	for i = 1, 24 do
		if not AN.Save.DoorDone(i) and not AN.BlockingDoor(i) then
			if AN.Games[i].made then return i end
			firstOpen = firstOpen or i
		end
	end
	return firstOpen
end

function AN.DaysToEve()
	local now = os.time()
	local y = tonumber(os.date("%Y"))
	local eve = os.time({ year = y, month = 12, day = 24, hour = 0 })
	local today = os.time({ year = y, month = tonumber(os.date("%m")), day = AN.Today(), hour = 0 })
	if today > eve then eve = os.time({ year = y + 1, month = 12, day = 24, hour = 0 }) end
	return math.floor((eve - today) / 86400 + 0.5)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Start / finish
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function AN.StartGame(n)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	if not g or not g.made then return false end
	AN.UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", keepVoice = true })
	return true
end

-- called by a game when the player finishes. value = seconds or points.
-- opts.hint = true when the player used a hint (marked on the highscore list)
-- a game with levels: one level done, with the points it gave (the level's own highscore list)
-- opts.total: the game's score so far, saved at once as this run's result (so the levels already
-- done count even if the game is left before the end)
AN.CurRun = AN.CurRun or {}
function AN.LevelScore(n, level, value, opts)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	if not g or not value then return end
	local lower = g.scoreType == "time"
	local hint = (opts and opts.hint) or AN.HintUsed[n] or nil
	AN.Save.LevelScore(n, level, value, lower, hint)
	if opts and opts.total then
		local run = AN.CurRun[n]
		if not run then
			run = { id = AN.Save.NewId() }
			AN.CurRun[n] = run
		end
		run.total, run.hint = opts.total, run.hint or hint
		AN.Save.RunProgress(n, opts.total, lower, run.hint, run.id)
	end
end

-- a new run of a game (the game screen opened, or "play again" inside the game)
function AN.NewRun(n) AN.CurRun[n] = nil AN.HintUsed[n] = nil end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Hints. A game that has one defines G:Hint(cost) (does the hint and takes the cost off its own
-- score or adds it to its time; returns false if there was nothing to show) and can define
-- G:CanHint() (false while there is nothing to help with, e.g. before the start or after the end).
-- One use costs 5 % of the door's top score (G.goal), or 5 seconds where the score is a time;
-- G.hintCost overrides it. Every result of a run where a hint was used gets the hint mark.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AN.HintUsed = AN.HintUsed or {}

function AN.HintsOn() return AN.Save.Get("hints") ~= false end

function AN.HintCost(n)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	if not g then return 0 end
	if g.hintCost then return g.hintCost end
	if g.scoreType == "time" then return 5 end
	return math.max(1, math.Round((g.goal or 0) * 0.05))
end

-- the hint text for the button: "Hint: -25 points" / "Hint: +5 seconds"
function AN.HintLabel(n)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	local c = AN.HintCost(n)
	if g and g.scoreType == "time" then return AN.L("hint_cost_time", c) end
	if g and g.hintUnit then return AN.L(g.hintUnit, c) end
	return AN.L("hint_cost_pts", c)
end

function AN.CanHint(n)
	local scr = AN.UI.screen
	if not AN.HintsOn() or not scr or not scr.Hint or AN.UI.screenName ~= "game" .. n then return false end
	if scr.CanHint and not scr:CanHint() then return false end
	return true
end

function AN.UseHint(n)
	if not AN.CanHint(n) then
		AN.Sound("click")
		return false
	end
	local scr = AN.UI.screen
	if scr:Hint(AN.HintCost(n)) == false then return false end
	AN.HintUsed[n] = true
	local run = AN.CurRun[n]
	if run then run.hint = true end
	AN.Sound("triangel")
	return true
end

function AN.FinishGame(n, value, opts)
	if n > 100 and AN.Summer then return AN.Summer.Finish(n, value, opts) end
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	local lower = g.scoreType == "time"
	local hint = opts and opts.hint or nil
	local run = AN.CurRun[n]
	AN.CurRun[n] = nil
	if (run and run.hint) or AN.HintUsed[n] then hint = true end
	AN.HintUsed[n] = nil
	local isRecord, res, id = AN.Save.Finish(n, value, lower, AN.CoinsFor(n, value), hint, run and run.id)
	AN.ScoreTabSel[n] = 0   -- the result screen shows the whole game's list, with this result marked
	AN.UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "over", res = res, value = value, record = isRecord, entry = id })
end

-- console: an_play <door>  starts any made game directly (for testing)
concommand.Add("an_play", function(ply, cmd, args)
	local n = tonumber(args[1] or "")
	if n and AN.Games[n] and AN.Games[n].made then AN.StartGame(n) end
end)

-- The tabs above a highscore list, for games with levels: "Total" (the whole game) and one level at a
-- time ("< Level 3 >"). Shown by itself whenever the game has levels. Returns the chosen level
-- (0 = the whole game) and the height used (0 when there are no levels).
AN.ScoreTabSel = AN.ScoreTabSel or {}
AN.ScoreTabLast = AN.ScoreTabLast or {}
function AN.ScoreTabs(n, x, y, w, k, ink, id)
	local count = AN.Save.LevelCount(n)
	if count <= 0 then return 0, 0 end
	local sel = math.min(AN.ScoreTabSel[n] or 0, count)
	local cur = sel > 0 and sel or math.Clamp(AN.ScoreTabLast[n] or 1, 1, count)
	local h, gap = 30 * k, 6 * k
	local size = math.floor(16 * k)
	local cream = Color(255, 241, 207)
	local function pill(bid, bx, bw, label, on, enabled, fn)
		local hot = enabled and AN.UI.Button(bid, bx, y, bw, h, fn, { silent = true })
		local a = on and 255 or (hot and 60 or 28)
		AN.Box(bx, y, bw, h, Color(ink.r, ink.g, ink.b, enabled and a or 12), 8 * k)
		AN.Text(label, "black", size, bx + bw / 2, y + h / 2, on and cream or Color(ink.r, ink.g, ink.b, enabled and 255 or 90), 1, 1)
	end
	local function choose(l)
		AN.ScoreTabSel[n] = l
		if l > 0 then AN.ScoreTabLast[n] = l end
	end
	local tw = math.max(AN.TextSize(AN.L("hs_total"), "black", size) + 24 * k, 80 * k)
	pill(id .. "_tot", x, tw, AN.L("hs_total"), sel == 0, true, function() choose(0) end)
	local aw = 30 * k
	local lx = x + tw + gap
	local lw = w - tw - gap - 2 * (aw + gap)
	pill(id .. "_prev", lx, aw, "<", false, cur > 1, function() choose(math.max(1, cur - 1)) end)
	pill(id .. "_lvl", lx + aw + gap, lw, AN.L("hs_level", cur), sel > 0, true, function() choose(cur) end)
	pill(id .. "_next", lx + aw + gap + lw + gap, aw, ">", false, cur < count, function() choose(math.min(count, cur + 1)) end)
	return sel, h + 10 * k
end

-- Language: every string in the game lives in lang/da.lua and lang/en.lua.
-- AN.L("key", ...) returns the text in the chosen language, formatted with string.format.
AN = AN or {}
AN.Lang = AN.Lang or {}
local base = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/"
AN.Lang.da = include(base .. "lang/da.lua")
AN.Lang.en = include(base .. "lang/en.lua")
include(base .. "lang/subs.lua")

function AN.LangCode()
	local l = AN.Save and AN.Save.Get("lang") or "da"
	if not AN.Lang[l] then l = "da" end
	return l
end

function AN.L(key, ...)
	local t = AN.Lang[AN.LangCode()]
	local s = t[key] or AN.Lang.da[key] or key
	if select("#", ...) > 0 then
		local ok, out = pcall(string.format, s, ...)
		if ok then return out end
	end
	return s
end

function AN.GameName(n)
	if n > 100 and AN.Summer then return AN.Summer.Name(n) end
	return AN.L(string.format("game_%02d", n))
end
