-- Shared helpers for the minigames.
-- Each original game had a fixed Flash stage (e.g. 770 x 440). We keep the game's own
-- coordinates and scale the stage to fill the screen height, centred. Anything outside
-- the stage (ultrawide sides) shows the blurred loft.
AN = AN or {}
AN.MG = AN.MG or {}
local MG = AN.MG
local C = AN.Col

-- The game screen (design A): a wooden header bar with the game's logo, door and the
-- sound / close buttons, the game itself in a wooden frame at its original shape, and a
-- paper panel on the right with how to play, the highscores and the next ornament.
-- The game's own picture is clipped to its frame, so the original artwork never shows a
-- cut edge, whatever the screen shape. Everything is placed from the screen's centre.
local PANEL_W, GAP, PAD = 470, 36, 22
local L = {}
MG.Layout = L

local function wood(x, y, w, h)
	AN.ImgCover("ui/woodboard.png", x, y, w, h)
	AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, Color(60, 20, 4, 170), 0, 3)
end

function MG.SideGarland() AN.Deco.SideGarland() end

-- set up the stage for this frame and draw everything around it. sw, sh = original stage size
function MG.Stage(sw, sh)
	MG.sw, MG.sh = sw, sh
	if AN.UI.screen and (AN.UI.screen.n or 0) > 100 and AN.Summer then return AN.Summer.Stage(sw, sh) end
	-- (from the screen's name: a game may use its own "n" for something else, like door 14's board size)
	local n = tonumber(string.match(AN.UI.screenName or "", "^game(%d+)$") or "") or (AN.UI.screen and AN.UI.screen.n) or 1
	local VW = AN.VW
	local top, bottom = 172, 1046
	local withPanel = VW >= 1500
	local fh = bottom - top
	local sH = fh - 2 * PAD
	local sW = sH * sw / sh
	local maxw = VW - 80 - (withPanel and (PANEL_W + GAP) or 0)
	if sW + 2 * PAD > maxw then sW = maxw - 2 * PAD; sH = sW * sh / sw end
	local group = sW + 2 * PAD + (withPanel and (GAP + PANEL_W) or 0)
	local gx = (VW - group) / 2
	local fy = top + (fh - (sH + 2 * PAD)) / 2
	L.n, L.gx, L.group, L.fy, L.sW, L.sH, L.withPanel = n, gx, group, fy, sW, sH, withPanel
	L.px = gx + sW + 2 * PAD + GAP

	MG.k = sW / sw
	MG.x0 = gx + PAD
	MG.y0 = fy + PAD

	-- room behind, darkened
	AN.UI.Background("sub")
	AN.Box(0, -(AN.OY or 0), VW, AN.VH or 1080, Color(20, 8, 2, 120))

	-- header bar
	wood(gx, 34, group, 110)
	if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
		AN.ImgFit(string.format("titles/%02d.png", n), gx + 22, 40, 220, 98)
	else
		AN.TextFit(AN.GameName(n), "title", 44, gx + 132, 89 + 3, 220, C.shadow, 1, 1)
		AN.TextFit(AN.GameName(n), "title", 44, gx + 132, 89, 220, C.white, 1, 1)
	end
	AN.Text(AN.L("cal_door", n) .. "  ·  " .. AN.Upper(AN.GameName(n)), "black", 20, gx + 262, 60, C.gold)
	local g = AN.UI.screen
	local status = g and g.Status and g:Status() or AN.L("desc_" .. string.format("%02d", n))
	AN.TextFit(status, "bold", 22, gx + 262, 90, math.max(200, (gx + group / 2 - 150) - (gx + 262)), C.cream)

	-- frame
	wood(gx, fy, sW + 2 * PAD, sH + 2 * PAD)
	AN.Box(gx + PAD - 4, fy + PAD - 4, sW + 8, sH + 8, Color(74, 31, 7))

	if withPanel then MG.Panel(n, L.px, fy, PANEL_W, sH + 2 * PAD) end

	-- the game draws itself inside its frame only
	AN.Box(MG.x0, MG.y0, sW, sH, Color(0, 0, 0))
	render.SetScissorRect(AN.PX(MG.x0), AN.SY(MG.y0), AN.PX(MG.x0 + sW), AN.SY(MG.y0 + sH), true)
end

-- the paper panel next to the game
function MG.Panel(n, x, y, w, h)
	local INK = Color(59, 26, 8)
	local RED = Color(138, 42, 10)
	AN.Box(x + 4, y + 14, w, h, Color(0, 0, 0, 90), 22)
	AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(248, 234, 208), 22)
	AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, Color(226, 201, 155), 22, 3)
	local cx, cy, cw = x + 26, y + 24, w - 52
	AN.Text(AN.L("mg_howto"), "title", 32, cx, cy, RED)
	cy = cy + 52
	cy = cy + AN.TextWrap(AN.L("how_" .. string.format("%02d", n)), "bold", 18, cx, cy, cw, INK, 25) + 12
	local keys = AN.Lang[AN.LangCode()]["keys_" .. string.format("%02d", n)] or AN.Lang.da["keys_" .. string.format("%02d", n)] or {}
	if AN.HintsOn() and AN.UI.screen and AN.UI.screen.Hint then
		keys = table.Copy(keys)
		local g = AN.Games[n]
		keys[#keys + 1] = { "H", AN.L(g and g.scoreType == "time" and "hint_key_time" or "hint_key") }
	end
	for _, kv in ipairs(keys) do
		local kw = AN.TextSize(kv[1], "black", 16) + 18
		AN.Box(cx, cy, kw, 28, INK, 6)
		AN.Text(kv[1], "black", 16, cx + 9, cy + 4, C.cream)
		AN.Text(kv[2], "bold", 17, cx + kw + 10, cy + 4, INK)
		cy = cy + 36
	end
	-- a free tip (just advice: no cost, no mark)
	local tip = AN.Lang[AN.LangCode()]["tip_" .. string.format("%02d", n)]
	if tip then
		cy = cy + 2
		local tw = AN.TextSize(AN.L("mg_tip"), "black", 18)
		AN.Text(AN.L("mg_tip"), "black", 18, cx, cy, RED)
		cy = cy + AN.TextWrap(tip, "bold", 17, cx, cy + 26, cw, INK, 23) + 34
	end
	cy = cy + 6
	for dx = 0, cw - 8, 14 do AN.Box(cx + dx, cy, 8, 2, Color(216, 185, 138)) end
	cy = cy + 16

	-- highscores (everyone on this server)
	AN.Text(AN.L("wrap_hiscore"), "title", 28, cx, cy, RED)
	cy = cy + 46
	local level, th = AN.ScoreTabs(n, cx, cy, cw, 1, INK, "mg_tab")
	cy = cy + th
	local list = AN.Save.Scores(n, level)
	local me = AN.Save.MySid()
	local rowsRoom = math.floor((y + h - 120 - cy) / 44)
	if #list == 0 then
		cy = cy + AN.TextWrap(AN.L("wrap_noscores"), "bold", 17, cx, cy, cw, INK, 24)
	end
	for i = 1, math.min(#list, 5, rowsRoom) do
		local e = list[i]
		local mine = e.sid == me
		AN.Box(cx, cy, cw, 38, mine and C.gold or Color(59, 26, 8, 18), 10)
		AN.Text(tostring(i), "black", 18, cx + 14, cy + 8, Color(138, 58, 16))
		local vs = AN.FormatValue(n, e.v)
		AN.Text(vs, "black", 18, cx + 50, cy + 8, INK)
		local vx = cx + 50 + AN.TextSize(vs, "black", 18)
		if e.h then AN.HintMark(vx + 14, cy + 19, 10) end
		local nx = vx + (e.h and 32 or 14)
		AN.TextEllipsis(e.name or "?", "bold", 17, cx + cw - 14, cy + 9, cx + cw - 14 - nx, Color(122, 90, 58), 2)
		cy = cy + 44
	end

	-- the next ornament and the pebernødder towards it
	local nxt = AN.Save.NextReward()
	local coins = AN.Save.Coins()
	local by = y + h - 104
	AN.Box(cx - 6, by, cw + 12, 86, Color(59, 26, 8, 20), 14)
	AN.ImgFit(nxt.img, cx + 4, by + 10, 40, 66)
	AN.Text(AN.L("box_next"), "black", 18, cx + 58, by + 12, INK)
	local nuts = math.min(nxt.price, 20)
	for i = 0, nuts - 1 do
		AN.Img("wrap/coin_on.png", cx + 58 + (i % 10) * 26, by + 40 + math.floor(i / 10) * 20, 24, 20, i < coins and 255 or 70)
	end
	AN.Text(coins .. "/" .. nxt.price, "black", 22, cx + cw, by + 30, Color(138, 58, 16), 2)
end

-- after the game has drawn: stop clipping, then the decorations and the buttons on top
function MG.Chrome(n)
	render.SetScissorRect(0, 0, 0, 0, false)
	if (n or 0) > 100 and AN.Summer then return AN.Summer.Chrome(n) end
	local gx, group, fy = L.gx, L.group, L.fy
	local VW = AN.VW
	-- garland over the middle of the header, ornaments wound onto its twigs, hanging in the gap above the frame
	local D = AN.Deco
	local mx = gx + group / 2 - 120
	local maxBottom = fy - 8
	-- (the plain branch: the bauble branch has baubles painted on that would hang over the game)
	local t = D.Branch("ui/br_plain.png", mx, -36, 420)
	D.HangAt(t, 1, 70, "kugle5", 30, maxBottom)
	D.HangAt(t, 3, 50, "kugle1", 30, maxBottom)
	t = D.Branch("ui/br_plain.png", mx + 380, -10, 330, true)
	D.HangAt(t, 2, 60, "star0", 44, maxBottom)
	D.HangAt(t, 4, 40, "kugle4", 30, maxBottom)
	if L.withPanel then
		t = D.Branch("ui/br_plain.png", L.px + PANEL_W - 250, fy - 92, 330)
		D.HangAt(t, 4, 12, "hjerte0", 40)
	end
	D.Branch("ui/br_plain.png", gx - 120, 1080 - 70, 420)
	if VW > 2200 then MG.SideGarland() end

	-- sound + close (back to the game's start board)
	local bx = gx + group - 196
	local mode = AN.SoundMode()
	local hotL = AN.UI.Button("mg_sound", bx, 48, 82, 82, function() AN.CycleSoundMode() end)
	AN.Img("ui/lyd.png", bx + (hotL and -3 or 0), 48 + (hotL and -3 or 0), hotL and 88 or 82, hotL and 88 or 82, mode == 2 and 120 or 255)
	if mode > 0 then
		surface.SetDrawColor(mode == 2 and Color(200, 32, 45) or Color(255, 215, 106))
		local a, b = AN.PX(bx + 14), AN.SY(48 + 68)
		local c, d = AN.PX(bx + 68), AN.SY(48 + 14)
		for o = -2, 2 do surface.DrawLine(a + o, b, c + o, d) end
	end
	if hotL then
		local tip = mode == 0 and AN.L("snd_all") or (mode == 1 and AN.L("snd_nomusic") or AN.L("snd_mute"))
		AN.Text(tip, "black", 18, bx + 41, 150, C.cream, 1)
	end
	-- the hint button (a light bulb), for games that have a hint
	local g = AN.UI.screen
	if g and g.Hint and AN.HintsOn() then
		local hx = bx - 92
		local can = AN.CanHint(n)
		local hotH = AN.UI.Button("mg_hint", hx, 48, 82, 82, function() AN.UseHint(n) end, { silent = true })
		local lift = hotH and can
		AN.Img("ui/hint.png", hx + (lift and -3 or 0), 48 + (lift and -3 or 0), lift and 88 or 82, lift and 88 or 82, can and 255 or 110)
		if AN.HintUsed[n] then AN.HintMark(hx + 74, 56, 10) end
		if hotH then
			AN.Text(can and AN.HintLabel(n) or AN.L("hint_none"), "black", 18, hx + 41, 150, C.cream, 1)
		end
	end
	local qx = bx + 92
	local hotQ = AN.UI.Button("mg_quit", qx, 48, 82, 82, function()
		-- levels already done (and saved): the run ends with their score, pebernødder and all
		local run = AN.CurRun and AN.CurRun[n]
		local scr = AN.UI.screen
		if run and run.total and scr and not scr.finished then
			scr.finished = true
			if scr.StopLoops then scr:StopLoops() end
			AN.FinishGame(n, run.total)
			return
		end
		AN.UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true })
	end,
		{ voice = { "luk_rollover", 45 / 25 } })
	AN.Img("ui/luk.png", qx + (hotQ and -3 or 0), 48 + (hotQ and -3 or 0), hotQ and 88 or 82, hotQ and 88 or 82)
end

function MG.X(x) return MG.x0 + x * MG.k end
function MG.Y(y) return MG.y0 + y * MG.k end
function MG.S(v) return v * MG.k end

-- mouse in stage coordinates
function MG.Mouse()
	return (AN.UI.mx - MG.x0) / MG.k, (AN.UI.my - MG.y0) / MG.k
end

-- draw an image placed in stage coordinates
function MG.Img(path, x, y, w, h, alpha)
	AN.Img(path, MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), h and MG.S(h) or nil, alpha)
end

-- The game's own background, placed in stage coordinates, and continued out to the
-- screen edges on wider screens by stretching its outermost pixel columns/rows
-- (no blur, no loft: the game's own wood/wall just continues).
function MG.Backdrop(path, x, y, w, h)
	local m = AN.Mat(path)
	local sx, sy = AN.PX(MG.X(x)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y))
	local sw, sh = AN.SX(MG.S(w)), AN.SX(MG.S(h))
	local SW, SH = ScrW(), ScrH()
	local e = 2 / math.max(1, m:Width())       -- two source pixels
	local ev = 2 / math.max(1, m:Height())
	surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(m)
	surface.DrawTexturedRect(sx, sy, sw, sh)
	if sx > 0 then surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(0, sy, sx + 1, sh, 0, 0, e, 1) end
	if sx + sw < SW then surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(sx + sw - 1, sy, SW - sx - sw + 1, sh, 1 - e, 0, 1, 1) end
	if sy > 0 then surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(0, 0, SW, sy + 1, 0, 0, 1, ev) end
	if sy + sh < SH then surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(0, sy + sh - 1, SW, SH - sy - sh + 1, 0, 1 - ev, 1, 1) end
end

-- floating score text ("+40", "-6") that rises and fades
MG.pops = {}
function MG.ResetPops() MG.pops = {} end
function MG.Pop(text, good, x, y)
	MG.pops[#MG.pops + 1] = { text = text, good = good, x = x, y = y, t0 = RealTime() }
end
function MG.DrawPops()
	local now = RealTime()
	for i = #MG.pops, 1, -1 do
		local p = MG.pops[i]
		local t = (now - p.t0) / 1.3
		if t >= 1 then
			table.remove(MG.pops, i)
		else
			local a = 255 * math.min(1, (1 - t) * 2.5)
			local y = p.y - 40 * t
			local col = p.good and Color(255, 236, 120) or Color(255, 110, 90)
			local size = math.floor(MG.S(16) + 0.5)
			AN.Text(p.text, "title", size, MG.X(p.x) + 3, MG.Y(y) + 3, Color(40, 12, 2), 1, 1, a)
			AN.Text(p.text, "title", size, MG.X(p.x), MG.Y(y), col, 1, 1, a)
		end
	end
end

-- game sound from sound/alletidersnisse/<folder>/<name>.mp3
function MG.Sound(folder, name, vol)
	local v = (AN.Save.Get("vol_fx") or 85) / 100 * (vol or 1)
	if v <= 0 or AN.SoundMode() == 2 then return end
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/" .. folder .. "/" .. name .. ".mp3", "noplay", function(ch)
		if IsValid(ch) then ch:SetVolume(v) ch:Play() end
	end)
end

-- H uses a hint in the game being played
local hWas = false
hook.Add("Think", "AN_HintKey", function()
	local down = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_H)
	if down and not hWas then
		local scr = AN.UI.screen
		local name = AN.UI.screenName or ""
		local n = tonumber(string.match(name, "^game(%d+)$") or "")
		if n and scr and scr.Hint and AN.HintsOn() and not vgui.GetKeyboardFocus() then AN.UseHint(n) end
	end
	hWas = down
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing for hints, in stage coordinates (so they scale with the game): a pulsing ring, an
-- arrow, a highlighted box, a label. Each has a dark edge so it shows on any background.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
MG.HINT_GOLD = Color(255, 214, 64)
MG.HINT_GOOD = Color(70, 220, 90)
MG.HINT_BAD = Color(235, 50, 50)
local DARK = Color(40, 12, 2)

local function poly(pts, col, a)
	local p = {}
	for i, v in ipairs(pts) do p[i] = { x = AN.PX(MG.X(v[1])), y = AN.SY(MG.Y(v[2])) } end
	draw.NoTexture()
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, (col.a or 255) * (a or 1))
	surface.DrawPoly(p)
end
function MG.HintPulse() return 0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(RealTime() * 8) end

-- a thick ring around (x, y)
function MG.HintRing(x, y, r, col, a, thick)
	col = col or MG.HINT_GOLD
	a = (a or 1) * MG.HintPulse()
	thick = thick or math.max(3, r * 0.14)
	AN.Glow(MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(r * 1.6), col, a)
	local seg = 32
	for pass = 1, 2 do
		local t = pass == 1 and thick + 3 or thick
		local c = pass == 1 and DARK or col
		for i = 0, seg - 1 do
			local a0, a1 = i / seg * math.pi * 2, (i + 1) / seg * math.pi * 2
			local r0, r1 = r - t / 2, r + t / 2
			poly({ { x + math.cos(a0) * r1, y + math.sin(a0) * r1 }, { x + math.cos(a1) * r1, y + math.sin(a1) * r1 },
				{ x + math.cos(a1) * r0, y + math.sin(a1) * r0 }, { x + math.cos(a0) * r0, y + math.sin(a0) * r0 } }, c, a)
		end
	end
end

-- an arrow from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2)
function MG.HintArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, a, w)
	col = col or MG.HINT_GOLD
	a = (a or 1) * MG.HintPulse()
	w = w or 8
	local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
	local len = math.max(1, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
	local ux, uy = dx / len, dy / len
	local nx, ny = -uy, ux
	local head = math.min(len * 0.6, w * 3)
	for pass = 1, 2 do
		local e = pass == 1 and 2 or 0
		local c = pass == 1 and DARK or col
		local hx, hy = x2 - ux * head, y2 - uy * head
		local hw = w / 2 + e
		poly({ { x1 + nx * hw - ux * e, y1 + ny * hw - uy * e }, { hx + nx * hw, hy + ny * hw }, { hx - nx * hw, hy - ny * hw }, { x1 - nx * hw - ux * e, y1 - ny * hw - uy * e } }, c, a)
		local bw = w * 1.6 + e * 1.5
		poly({ { x2 + ux * e * 1.5, y2 + uy * e * 1.5 }, { hx - nx * bw - ux * e, hy - ny * bw - uy * e }, { hx + nx * bw - ux * e, hy + ny * bw - uy * e } }, c, a)
	end
end

-- a highlighted rectangle
function MG.HintBox(x, y, w, h, col, a, thick)
	col = col or MG.HINT_GOLD
	a = (a or 1) * MG.HintPulse()
	thick = thick or 4
	AN.Box(MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 60 * a))
	AN.Outline(MG.X(x) - 2, MG.Y(y) - 2, MG.S(w) + 4, MG.S(h) + 4, Color(DARK.r, DARK.g, DARK.b, 255 * a), 6, MG.S(thick) + 3)
	AN.Outline(MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, 255 * a), 6, MG.S(thick))
end

-- a short label with a dark edge
function MG.HintText(txt, x, y, col, size, a)
	col = col or MG.HINT_GOLD
	a = a or 1
	local sz = math.floor(MG.S(size or 18) + 0.5)
	for _, o in ipairs({ { -2, 0 }, { 2, 0 }, { 0, -2 }, { 0, 2 }, { 2, 2 } }) do
		AN.Text(txt, "title", sz, MG.X(x) + o[1], MG.Y(y) + o[2], DARK, 1, 1, 255 * a)
	end
	AN.Text(txt, "title", sz, MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), col, 1, 1, 255 * a)
end

-- a plain thick line (no head), for drawn paths
function MG.HintLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, col, a, w)
	col = col or MG.HINT_GOLD
	a = (a or 1) * MG.HintPulse()
	w = w or 6
	local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
	local len = math.max(0.001, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
	local nx, ny = -dy / len, dx / len
	for pass = 1, 2 do
		local hw = w / 2 + (pass == 1 and 2 or 0)
		local ex, ey = dx / len * (pass == 1 and 2 or 1), dy / len * (pass == 1 and 2 or 1)
		poly({ { x1 + nx * hw - ex, y1 + ny * hw - ey }, { x2 + nx * hw + ex, y2 + ny * hw + ey }, { x2 - nx * hw + ex, y2 - ny * hw + ey }, { x1 - nx * hw - ex, y1 - ny * hw - ey } }, pass == 1 and DARK or col, a)
	end
end

-- Saving, client side.
--  * Settings (language, volume, look ...) are personal: data/alletidersnisse/save.json on the
--    player's own PC.
--  * Progress (doors, pebernødder, ornaments, the tree) and the highscore lists are kept by the
--    server per Steam ID (core/sv_save.lua). The client keeps a mirror and applies the same rules
--    at once (core/sh_progress.lua), and the server sends its copy back after every change.
--  * A save from before progress moved to the server is handed over the first time the player
--    joins their own game (single-player or a listen server they host).
AN = AN or {}
AN.Save = AN.Save or {}
local Save = AN.Save
local P = AN.Prog

local PATH_DIR = "alletidersnisse"
local PATH = PATH_DIR .. "/save.json"

-- ornament drawn with its hanging point at (x, y). sc = size scale (1 = original size)
function AN.DrawOrnament(id, x, y, sc, alpha)
	local def = AN.OrnamentById[id]
	if not def then return end
	local r = AN.WrapPos["orn_" .. id]
	AN.Img(def.img, x + r[1] * sc, y + r[2] * sc, r[3] * sc, r[4] * sc, alpha)
end
function AN.OrnamentRect(id, sc)
	local r = AN.WrapPos["orn_" .. id]
	return r[1] * sc, r[2] * sc, r[3] * sc, r[4] * sc
end
AN.ORN_TREE_SCALE = 3.0   -- ornament size on the big tree (tree frame units)

local function defaultSettings()
	return {
		lang = "da", look = "modern", doorRule = "date", hidden = true, subs = true,
		vol_music = 70, vol_fx = 85, vol_voice = 100,
		blur = true, vs = "race", share = true, soundmode = 0, firsttime = true,
	}
end

local localFile = { settings = defaultSettings() }   -- what is in save.json
local prog = P.New()                                  -- the mirror of the server's copy
local hs = {}                                         -- ["4"] = { lower = true, list = { ... } }
Save.synced = false

local function legacyOf(t)
	-- the progress part of an old save.json (before saving moved to the server)
	if not istable(t) or t.migrated then return nil end
	local d = { coins = t.coins, rewardIndex = t.rewardIndex, doors = t.doors, scores = t.scores, inv = t.inv, opened = t.opened, tree = t.tree }
	-- the first test version used made-up ornament names
	if (t.v or 1) < 2 then
		local map = { red = "kugle4", green = "kugle5", blue = "kugle1", purple = "kugle11", heart = "hjerte0", cane = "stok0",
			drum = "tromme0", flag = "flag0", silver = "kugle9", gold = "kugle10", star = "star0" }
		local inv = {}
		for k, v in pairs(d.inv or {}) do if map[k] then inv[map[k]] = (inv[map[k]] or 0) + v end end
		d.inv = inv
		for _, o in ipairs(d.tree or {}) do o.id = map[o.id] or o.id end
	end
	d = P.Fix(d)
	if not P.HasProgress(d) then return nil end
	return d
end

function Save.Load()
	localFile = { settings = defaultSettings() }
	if file.Exists(PATH, "DATA") then
		local t = util.JSONToTable(file.Read(PATH, "DATA") or "")
		if istable(t) then
			for k, v in pairs(t) do
				if k == "settings" and istable(v) then
					for sk, sv in pairs(v) do localFile.settings[sk] = sv end
				else
					localFile[k] = v
				end
			end
		end
	end
	prog = P.New()
	Save.Hello()
end

function Save.Write()
	if not file.IsDir(PATH_DIR, "DATA") then file.CreateDir(PATH_DIR) end
	file.Write(PATH, util.TableToJSON(localFile, true))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- talking to the server
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function sendTable(t)
	local s = util.Compress(util.TableToJSON(t)) or ""
	net.WriteUInt(#s, 32)
	net.WriteData(s, #s)
end

local function readTable()
	local len = net.ReadUInt(32)
	if len <= 0 then return nil end
	local s = util.Decompress(net.ReadData(len) or "")
	if not s then return nil end
	return util.JSONToTable(s)
end

function Save.Hello()
	local legacy = legacyOf(localFile)
	if legacy then
		-- which doors count time (lower is better), for sorting the old results
		legacy.lower = {}
		for n = 1, 24 do
			if AN.Games and AN.Games[n] and AN.Games[n].scoreType == "time" then legacy.lower[tostring(n)] = true end
		end
	end
	net.Start("an_hello")
	net.WriteBool(legacy ~= nil)
	if legacy then sendTable(legacy) end
	net.SendToServer()
end

local function send(act, a)
	net.Start("an_act")
	net.WriteString(act)
	sendTable(a or {})
	net.SendToServer()
end

net.Receive("an_prog", function()
	Save.sid = net.ReadString()
	local t = readTable()
	if istable(t) then
		prog = P.Fix(t)
		Save.synced = true
	end
end)

net.Receive("an_imported", function()
	-- the old progress now lives on the server; keep only the settings here
	localFile = { settings = localFile.settings, migrated = true }
	Save.Write()
end)

net.Receive("an_hs", function()
	local all = net.ReadBool()
	local t = readTable() or {}
	if all then hs = {} end
	for k, v in pairs(t) do
		if istable(v) then
			v.list = istable(v.list) and v.list or {}
			hs[tostring(k)] = v
		end
	end
end)

-- profiles and the player list (answers arrive later; screens read them from AN.Profiles)
AN.Profiles = AN.Profiles or {}
AN.PlayerList = AN.PlayerList or nil
function Save.RequestProfile(sid)
	net.Start("an_prof")
	net.WriteString(sid)
	net.SendToServer()
end
function Save.RequestPlayers()
	net.Start("an_players")
	net.SendToServer()
end
net.Receive("an_prof", function()
	local t = readTable()
	if istable(t) and t.sid then
		t.tree = istable(t.tree) and t.tree or {}
		local best = {}
		for k, v in pairs(istable(t.best) and t.best or {}) do best[tostring(k)] = v end
		t.best = best
		t.got = RealTime()
		AN.Profiles[t.sid] = t
	end
end)
net.Receive("an_players", function()
	local t = readTable()
	if istable(t) then AN.PlayerList = t end
end)

-- my own id on the server's lists (the host of a local game may be "local")
function Save.MySid()
	return Save.sid or (IsValid(LocalPlayer()) and LocalPlayer():SteamID64()) or "local"
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the API the screens use
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Save.Data() return localFile end

-- settings
function Save.Get(key) return localFile.settings[key] end
function Save.Set(key, value)
	localFile.settings[key] = value
	Save.Write()
end

-- start over (your own progress on this server)
function Save.Reset()
	P.Apply(prog, "reset")
	send("reset")
end

function Save.Coins() return prog.coins end

function Save.Door(n) return prog.doors[tostring(n)] end
function Save.DoorDone(n)
	local d = prog.doors[tostring(n)]
	return d and d.done or false
end
function Save.DoneCount() return P.DoneCount(prog) end

-- a finished game: your progress and the shared highscore list. returns isRecord, reward, entry id
function Save.NewId()
	return Save.MySid() .. ":" .. os.time() .. ":" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
end

function Save.Finish(n, value, lower, won, hint, runId)
	local id = runId or Save.NewId()
	local a = { n = n, v = value, lower = lower, won = won, h = hint or nil, id = id, t = os.time() }
	local isRecord, res = P.Apply(prog, "result", a)
	-- shown at once on our own list; the server's list replaces it a moment later
	local key = tostring(n)
	hs[key] = hs[key] or { lower = lower, list = {} }
	local name = IsValid(LocalPlayer()) and LocalPlayer():Nick() or "?"
	P.InsertScore(hs[key].list, { sid = Save.MySid(), name = name, v = value, t = os.time(), h = hint or nil, id = id }, lower)
	send("result", a)
	return isRecord, res, id
end

function Save.Opened(n) return prog.opened[tostring(n)] == true end
function Save.SetOpened(n, open)
	P.SetOpened(prog, n, open)
	send("open", { n = n, open = open ~= false })
end

-- the shared highscore list for a game (everyone on this server); with a level: that level's list
local function hsKey(n, l)
	if l and l > 0 then return n .. ":L" .. l end
	return tostring(n)
end
function Save.Scores(n, level)
	local d = hs[hsKey(n, level)]
	return d and d.list or {}
end

-- the running score of a game with levels, saved after every level (replaced by later saves and by
-- the final result with the same id)
function Save.RunProgress(n, value, lower, hint, id)
	local a = { n = n, v = value, lower = lower, h = hint or nil, id = id, t = os.time() }
	P.Apply(prog, "run", a)
	local key = tostring(n)
	hs[key] = hs[key] or { lower = lower, list = {} }
	local name = IsValid(LocalPlayer()) and LocalPlayer():Nick() or "?"
	P.InsertScore(hs[key].list, { sid = Save.MySid(), name = name, v = value, t = os.time(), h = hint or nil, id = id }, lower)
	send("run", a)
end

-- a finished level of a game with levels: its score goes on that level's own list
function Save.LevelScore(n, level, value, lower, hint)
	local id = Save.MySid() .. ":" .. os.time() .. ":" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
	local key = hsKey(n, level)
	hs[key] = hs[key] or { lower = lower, list = {} }
	local name = IsValid(LocalPlayer()) and LocalPlayer():Nick() or "?"
	P.InsertScore(hs[key].list, { sid = Save.MySid(), name = name, v = value, t = os.time(), h = hint or nil, id = id }, lower)
	send("lvl", { n = n, l = level, v = value, lower = lower, h = hint or nil, id = id })
	return id
end

-- how many level tabs a game's lists have: the levels the game has, and any level with results
function Save.LevelCount(n)
	local c = AN.Games and AN.Games[n] and AN.Games[n].levels or 0
	local pre = tostring(n) .. ":L"
	for k, d in pairs(hs) do
		if string.sub(k, 1, #pre) == pre and #(d.list or {}) > 0 then
			local l = tonumber(string.sub(k, #pre + 1))
			if l and l > c then c = l end
		end
	end
	return c
end

-- your own results for a game
function Save.MyScores(n) return prog.scores[tostring(n)] or {} end

-- inventory / tree
function Save.Inv() return prog.inv end
function Save.InvCount()
	local c = 0
	for _, v in pairs(prog.inv) do c = c + v end
	return c
end
function Save.OwnedCount() return P.OwnedCount(prog) end
function Save.NextReward() return P.NextReward(prog) end
function Save.Tree() return prog.tree end

function Save.PlaceOrnament(id, x, y)
	if not P.PlaceOrnament(prog, id, x, y) then return false end
	send("place", { id = id, x = x, y = y })
	return true
end

function Save.MoveOrnament(i, x, y)
	P.MoveOrnament(prog, i, x, y)
	send("move", { i = i, x = x, y = y })
end

function Save.RemoveOrnament(i)
	P.RemoveOrnament(prog, i)
	send("remove", { i = i })
end

-- Duel split screen: for the games played with the keyboard, both players play at the same time,
-- side by side. Player 1 (left) uses W A S D, player 2 (right) the arrow keys. Two copies of the
-- game run at once; while one copy runs it gets its own player's keys (the game still asks for the
-- arrow keys, Ctrl and Space as always), its own half of the screen and its own random numbers.
-- Only player 1's copy makes sound (two copies would play every sound twice).
-- The games played with the mouse stay as turns (cl_versus.lua).
AN = AN or {}
local UI, MG, C = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.Col
local VS = AN.VS
local SP = {}
VS.Split = SP

-- the doors that are played split screen
SP.GAMES = { [101] = true, [102] = true, [103] = true, [105] = true, [201] = true, [202] = true, [203] = true, [204] = true, [1] = true, [2] = true, [9] = true, [12] = true, [14] = true, [16] = true, [19] = true }
function SP.Can(n) return SP.GAMES[n] == true and AN.Games[n] and AN.Games[n].made end

-- the keys: what the game asks for -> the keys of each player that count as it
local FIRE1, FIRE2 = { KEY_LCONTROL, KEY_F }, { KEY_RCONTROL, KEY_PAD_0 }
local ACT1, ACT2 = { KEY_SPACE }, { KEY_ENTER, KEY_PAD_ENTER }
SP.KEYS = {
	{
		[KEY_UP] = { KEY_W }, [KEY_DOWN] = { KEY_S }, [KEY_LEFT] = { KEY_A }, [KEY_RIGHT] = { KEY_D },
		[KEY_LCONTROL] = FIRE1, [KEY_RCONTROL] = FIRE1, [KEY_C] = FIRE1,
		[KEY_SPACE] = ACT1, [KEY_ENTER] = ACT1, [KEY_E] = { KEY_E },
	},
	{
		[KEY_UP] = { KEY_UP }, [KEY_DOWN] = { KEY_DOWN }, [KEY_LEFT] = { KEY_LEFT }, [KEY_RIGHT] = { KEY_RIGHT },
		[KEY_LCONTROL] = FIRE2, [KEY_RCONTROL] = FIRE2, [KEY_C] = FIRE2,
		[KEY_SPACE] = ACT2, [KEY_ENTER] = ACT2, [KEY_E] = { KEY_RSHIFT },
	},
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- running one copy: everything shared is switched over to it, and back afterwards
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function noop() end
local function with(p, fn, ...)
	local inst = p.inst
	local realKey, realPop = input.IsKeyDown, MG.pops
	local realStage, realChrome = MG.Stage, MG.Chrome
	local realButton = UI.Button
	local realPlay, realSpeak, realSound, realMG = sound.PlayFile, AN.Speak, AN.Sound, MG.Sound
	local map = SP.KEYS[p.i]
	input.IsKeyDown = function(k)
		local keys = map[k]
		if not keys then return false end
		for _, kk in ipairs(keys) do if realKey(kk) then return true end end
		return false
	end
	MG.pops = p.pops
	-- the stage is this player's half
	local st = p.stage
	MG.x0, MG.y0, MG.k, MG.sw, MG.sh = st.x0, st.y0, st.k, st.sw, st.sh
	MG.Stage = function(sw, sh)
		MG.x0, MG.y0, MG.k, MG.sw, MG.sh = st.x0, st.y0, st.k, sw, sh
		AN.Box(st.x0, st.y0, sw * st.k, sh * st.k, Color(0, 0, 0))
		render.SetScissorRect(AN.PX(st.x0), AN.SY(st.y0), AN.PX(st.x0 + sw * st.k), AN.SY(st.y0 + sh * st.k), true)
	end
	MG.Chrome = function() render.SetScissorRect(0, 0, 0, 0, false) end
	-- the copies' buttons have their own names (the same button in both halves)
	UI.Button = function(id, ...) return realButton("sp" .. p.i .. "_" .. tostring(id), ...) end
	if p.i == 2 then
		sound.PlayFile, AN.Speak, AN.Sound, MG.Sound = noop, noop, noop, noop
	end
	if inst.MakeCurrent then inst:MakeCurrent() end
	SP.cur = p
	math.randomseed(p.rng)
	local ok, err = pcall(fn, inst, ...)
	p.rng = math.random(1, 2000000000)
	SP.cur = nil
	input.IsKeyDown, MG.pops = realKey, realPop
	MG.Stage, MG.Chrome, UI.Button = realStage, realChrome, realButton
	sound.PlayFile, AN.Speak, AN.Sound, MG.Sound = realPlay, realSpeak, realSound, realMG
	if not ok then ErrorNoHalt("[Alletiders Nisse] split " .. p.i .. ": " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") end
end

-- while a copy finishes: its result is kept here, nothing is saved, no result board
if not SP.finishGame then SP.finishGame = AN.FinishGame end
function AN.FinishGame(n, value, opts)
	local p = SP.cur
	if p and SP.on then
		if p.value == nil then
			p.value = value
			p.doneAt = RealTime()
			if p.i == 1 then p.hint = (opts and opts.hint) or nil end
		end
		return
	end
	return SP.finishGame(n, value, opts)
end
if not SP.levelScore then SP.levelScore = AN.LevelScore end
function AN.LevelScore(...)
	if SP.on then return end
	return SP.levelScore(...)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local S = { garland = false }
AN.Screens.vssplit = S

function SP.Start(n, seed)
	UI.Open("vssplit", { n = n, seed = seed })
end

function S:Open(args)
	local n = args.n
	self.n = n
	local G = AN.Games[n]
	self.lower = G.scoreType == "time"
	SP.on = true
	AN.NewRun(n)
	self.players = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local inst = setmetatable({}, { __index = G })
		local p = { i = i, inst = inst, pops = {}, rng = args.seed or 1, stage = { x0 = 0, y0 = 0, k = 1, sw = 800, sh = 600 } }
		self.players[i] = p
		self:Place()
		with(p, function(g) math.randomseed(args.seed or 1) g:Open({ n = n }) end)
	end
	-- each copy knows the other one (Skubbespil: one puzzle choice and one shuffle for both)
	self.players[1].inst.partner = self.players[2].inst
	self.players[2].inst.partner = self.players[1].inst
	self.endAt = nil
end

function S:Close()
	for _, p in ipairs(self.players or {}) do
		with(p, function(g)
			if g.StopLoops then g:StopLoops() end
			if g.Close then g:Close() end
		end)
	end
	self.players = nil
	SP.on = false
	AN.NewRun(self.n)
end

-- the two halves: each game at its own shape, as big as fits
local TOP, BOTTOM, GAP = 150, 930, 40
function S:Place()
	-- (the stage size: what the game asked for last, or 800 x 600 before it has drawn)
	for i, p in ipairs(self.players) do
		local sw, sh = p.stage.sw, p.stage.sh
		local hw = (AN.VW - 3 * GAP) / 2
		local hh = BOTTOM - TOP
		local k = math.min(hw / sw, hh / sh)
		local w, h = sw * k, sh * k
		local cx = GAP + (i - 1) * (hw + GAP) + hw / 2
		p.stage.k = k
		p.stage.x0 = cx - w / 2
		p.stage.y0 = TOP + (hh - h) / 2
	end
end

function S:Think(dt)
	if not self.players then return end
	for i = 2, 1, -1 do
		local p = self.players[i]
		if p.value == nil then with(p, function(g) if g.Think then g:Think(dt) end end) end
	end
	local a, b = self.players[1], self.players[2]
	-- a time: the first one done has won (the other one's clock has already passed it)
	if not self.endAt then
		if (a.value ~= nil and b.value ~= nil) or (self.lower and (a.value ~= nil or b.value ~= nil)) then
			self.endAt = RealTime() + 1.5
		end
	elseif RealTime() >= self.endAt then
		self:End()
	end
end

function S:End()
	local n = self.n
	local d = VS.duel
	local a, b = self.players[1], self.players[2]
	if d and d.n == n then
		d.res = { a.value, b.value }
		d.state = "result"
	end
	-- player 1's result is saved as usual
	local value, hint = a.value, a.hint
	VS.leaving = true
	UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true })
	VS.leaving = false
	if value ~= nil and n > 100 and AN.Summer then
		AN.Summer.SaveOnly(n, value)
	elseif value ~= nil then
		local g = AN.Games[n]
		AN.Save.Finish(n, value, g.scoreType == "time", AN.CoinsFor(n, value), hint, nil)
	end
end

local CREAM = Color(255, 241, 207)
function S:Paint()
	local n = self.n
	if n > 100 and AN.Summer then
		AN.Summer.Background(AN.Summer.SeasonOf(n), 150)
	else
		AN.UI.Background("sub")
		AN.Box(0, -(AN.OY or 0), AN.VW, AN.VH or 1080, Color(20, 8, 2, 150))
	end
	if not self.players then return end
	-- the stage sizes the games asked for
	for _, p in ipairs(self.players) do
		p.stage.sw, p.stage.sh = p.lastSW or p.stage.sw, p.lastSH or p.stage.sh
	end
	self:Place()
	AN.Text(AN.L("vs_duel") .. ": " .. AN.GameName(n), "title", 44, AN.VW / 2, 52, CREAM, 1, 1)
	local d = VS.duel
	for i, p in ipairs(self.players) do
		local st = p.stage
		local w, h = st.sw * st.k, st.sh * st.k
		-- frame
		AN.ImgCover("ui/woodboard.png", st.x0 - 16, st.y0 - 16, w + 32, h + 32)
		AN.Box(st.x0 - 4, st.y0 - 4, w + 8, h + 8, Color(74, 31, 7))
		-- the name and the keys above, the score below
		local name = d and d.names and d.names[i] or AN.L("vs_p" .. i)
		AN.TextFit(name, "black", 26, st.x0, st.y0 - 46, w * 0.5, C.gold)
		AN.TextFit(AN.L("vs_keys" .. i), "bold", 18, st.x0 + w, st.y0 - 42, w * 0.5, CREAM, 2)
		with(p, function(g)
			g:Paint()
			p.lastSW, p.lastSH = MG.sw, MG.sh
		end)
		render.SetScissorRect(0, 0, 0, 0, false)
		local status = p.inst.Status and p.inst:Status() or ""
		AN.TextFit(status, "bold", 22, st.x0 + w / 2, st.y0 + h + 34, w, CREAM, 1, 1)
		-- done: the half goes dark with the result
		if p.value ~= nil then
			local t = math.Clamp((RealTime() - p.doneAt) / 0.4, 0, 1)
			AN.Box(st.x0, st.y0, w, h, Color(10, 4, 0, 170 * t))
			AN.Text(AN.L("vs_done", AN.FormatValue(n, p.value)), "title", 40, st.x0 + w / 2, st.y0 + h / 2, Color(255, 215, 106, 255 * t), 1, 1)
		end
	end
	-- Luk: stop the duel
	local qx = AN.VW - 30 - 82
	local hot = UI.Button("sp_quit", qx, 14, 82, 82, function()
		VS.duel = nil
		VS.leaving = true
		UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true })
		VS.leaving = false
	end)
	AN.Img("ui/luk.png", qx + (hot and -3 or 0), 14 + (hot and -3 or 0), hot and 88 or 82, hot and 88 or 82)
end

function SU.Made(n) return AN.Games[n] and AN.Games[n].made end
function SU.Key(n, d) return n * 10 + (d or SU.Diff()) end
function SU.Diff() return math.Clamp(tonumber(AN.Save.Get("sdiff")) or 2, 1, 3) end
function SU.SetDiff(d) AN.Save.Set("sdiff", d) end
function SU.Name(n) return AN.L("su_" .. (SU.BY[n] and SU.BY[n].key or "?")) end

-- the best result of a game on a difficulty, and whether its trophy is won
function SU.Best(n, d)
	local x = AN.Save.Door(SU.Key(n, d))
	return x and x.best
end
function SU.HasTrophy(n, d)
	local g, b = SU.BY[n], SU.Best(n, d)
	return g and b ~= nil and b >= g.goals[d]
end
function SU.TrophyCount(season)
	season = season or "summer"
	local c, tot = 0, 0
	for _, g in ipairs(SU.GAMES) do
		if g.season == season then
			tot = tot + 3
			for d = 1, 3 do if SU.HasTrophy(g.n, d) then c = c + 1 end end
		end
	end
	return c, tot
end

-- saving a result (no pebernødder in the summer: trophies instead)
local function save(n, value, opts)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	local lower = g.scoreType == "time"
	local run = AN.CurRun[n]
	AN.CurRun[n] = nil
	local hint = (opts and opts.hint) or (run and run.hint) or AN.HintUsed[n] or nil
	AN.HintUsed[n] = nil
	local d = SU.Diff()
	local had = SU.HasTrophy(n, d)
	local isRecord, _, id = AN.Save.Finish(SU.Key(n, d), value, lower, 0, hint, run and run.id)
	return isRecord, id, (not had) and SU.HasTrophy(n, d)
end
function SU.SaveOnly(n, value) save(n, value) end
function SU.Finish(n, value, opts)
	local isRecord, id, trophy = save(n, value, opts)
	UI.Open("sgame", { n = n, state = "over", value = value, record = isRecord, entry = id, trophy = trophy })
end

local B = { s = 1, x0 = 0, y0 = 0 }
local function place()
	local s = math.max(AN.VW / 1920, AN.VH / 1080)
	B.s = s
	B.x0 = (AN.VW - 1920 * s) / 2
	B.y0 = 1080 + AN.OY - 1080 * s
end
local function BX(x) return B.x0 + x * B.s end
local function BY(y) return B.y0 + y * B.s end

-- an image, optionally mirrored
local function img(path, x, y, w, h, flip, alpha)
	surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, alpha or 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(path))
	local u0, u1 = 0, 1
	if flip then u0, u1 = 1, 0 end
	surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(AN.PX(x), AN.SY(y), AN.SX(w), AN.SX(h), u0, 0, u1, 1)
end

-- the season's picture with the two in it (a little bob, like they're breathing)
function SU.Background(season, dim)
	local S = SU.SEASONS[season] or SU.SEASONS.summer
	place()
	AN.Img(S.bg, B.x0, B.y0, 1920 * B.s, 1080 * B.s)
	local t = RealTime()
	for i, c in ipairs(S.chars) do
		local ch = c.h * B.s * c.sh
		local cw = ch * c.w / c.h
		img(c.img, BX(c.x), BY(c.y) - ch + math.sin(t * c.bob + i) * 2 * B.s, cw, ch, c.flip)
	end
	if dim then AN.Box(0, -AN.OY, AN.VW, AN.VH, Color(S.dim.r, S.dim.g, S.dim.b, dim)) end
end

-- a summer game's board: how to play, the difficulty, the highscores; and the result after
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local W = { garland = false }
AN.Screens.sgame = W

function W:Open(args)
	self.n = args.n or 101
	self.state = args.state or "start"
	self.value, self.record, self.entry, self.trophy = args.value, args.record, args.entry, args.trophy
	self.openedAt = RealTime()
	if self.state == "over" and self.trophy then AN.Sound("triangel") end
end

local function scoreList(n, d, x, y, w, rows, entry)
	local list = AN.Save.Scores(SU.Key(n, d))
	AN.Text(AN.L("su_scores", AN.L("su_diff" .. d)), "black", 22, x, y, INK)
	y = y + 40
	if #list == 0 then
		AN.TextWrap(AN.L("su_noscores"), "bold", 20, x, y, w, Color(INK.r, INK.g, INK.b, 160), 28)
		return
	end
	for i = 1, math.min(rows, #list) do
		local e = list[i]
		local yy = y + (i - 1) * 38
		local mine = entry and e.id == entry
		if mine then AN.Box(x - 10, yy - 4, w + 20, 36, Color(255, 196, 64, 90), 10) end
		AN.Text(i .. ".", "black", 20, x + 28, yy + 14, INK, 2, 1)
		AN.TextFit(e.name or "?", "bold", 20, x + 40, yy + 14, w - 160, INK, nil, 1)
		AN.Text(AN.FormatValue(n, e.v), "black", 20, x + w, yy + 14, SEA, 2, 1)
	end
end

local function cupRow(n, x, y)
	for d = 1, 3 do
		local has = SU.HasTrophy(n, d)
		AN.Img("sommer/cup_" .. (has and CUPS[d] or "empty") .. ".png", x + (d - 1) * 60, y, 46, 55, has and 255 or 130)
	end
end

function W:Paint()
	local n = self.n
	local season = SU.SeasonOf(n)
	SU.Theme(season)
	SU.Background(season, 110)
	local w, h = 1300, 780
	local x, y = AN.VW / 2 - w / 2, 540 - h / 2 + 20
	SU.Panel(x, y, w, h)
	-- header
	AN.Box(x, y, w, 110, SEA, 28)
	AN.Box(x, y + 60, w, 50, SEA)
	AN.TextShadow(SU.Name(n), "title", 60, x + 50, y + 22, C.white, TITLE, 4)
	cupRow(n, x + w - 250, y + 28)
	local d = SU.Diff()
	local lx, lw = x + 50, 640
	if self.state == "over" then
		-- the result
		local t = RealTime() - self.openedAt
		AN.Text(AN.L("su_result"), "black", 26, lx, y + 150, INK)
		AN.Text(AN.FormatValue(n, self.value or 0), "title", 110, lx, y + 190, SEA)
		local yy = y + 330
		if self.record then
			AN.Text(AN.L("su_record"), "title", 36, lx, yy, Color(200, 60, 40))
			yy = yy + 56
		end
		if self.trophy then
			local k = math.Clamp(t / 0.6, 0, 1)
			local s = 1 + 0.25 * math.sin(math.min(t, 1.2) * 8) * (1 - math.min(t / 1.2, 1))
			AN.Glow(lx + 60, yy + 70, 120, SUN, 0.8 * k)
			AN.Img("sommer/cup_" .. CUPS[d] .. ".png", lx + 60 - 50 * s, yy + 70 - 60 * s, 100 * s, 120 * s, 255 * k)
			AN.TextWrap(AN.L("su_trophy_won", AN.L("su_cup" .. d)), "title", 30, lx + 140, yy + 30, 460, INK, 38)
		else
			local g = SU.BY[n]
			if g and not SU.HasTrophy(n, d) then
				AN.TextWrap(AN.L("su_trophy_goal", g.goals[d], AN.L("su_cup" .. d)), "bold", 22, lx, yy, 560, INK, 30)
			end
		end
		SU.Button("su_again", AN.L("su_again"), lx, y + h - 110, 280, 72, function() UI.Open("game" .. n, { n = n }) end, 32)
		SU.Button("su_board", AN.L("vs_back"), lx + 300, y + h - 110, 240, 72, function() UI.Open("sgame", { n = n, quiet = true }) end, 30)
	else
		-- how to play
		AN.TextWrap(AN.L("su_how_" .. SU.BY[n].key), "bold", 23, lx, y + 145, lw - 20, INK, 33)
		-- a game with two modes: pick the mode (each has its own lists and trophies)
		local modes = SU.BY[n].modes
		if modes then
			for i, m in ipairs(modes) do
				pill("su_m" .. i, AN.L("su_mode_" .. SU.BY[m].key), lx + (i - 1) * 300, y + 366, 288, 50, m == n, function()
					self.n = m
				end)
			end
		end
		-- difficulty
		AN.Text(AN.L("su_diff"), "black", 22, lx, y + 430, INK)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			pill("su_d" .. i, AN.L("su_diff" .. i), lx + (i - 1) * 200, y + 466, 186, 52, d == i, function() SU.SetDiff(i) end)
		end
		AN.TextWrap(AN.L("su_diffinfo_" .. SU.BY[n].key .. d), "bold", 18, lx, y + 532, lw - 20, SEA, 26)
		SU.Button("su_start", AN.L("su_play"), lx, y + h - 120, 300, 80, function() UI.Open("game" .. n, { n = n }) end, 40)
		-- (Kapløb and Duel above the play button, inside the left column)
		if AN.VS then AN.VS.BoardButtons(n, lx, y + h - 196, 1) end
	end
	-- right: the highscores of the chosen difficulty
	local rx, rw = x + 760, w - 760 - 50
	AN.Box(rx - 24, y + 135, rw + 48, h - 135 - 30, Color(SEA.r, SEA.g, SEA.b, 20), 22)
	scoreList(n, d, rx, y + 160, rw, 12, self.state == "over" and self.entry or nil)
	-- close: back to the beach
	UI.CornerButtons(function() UI.Open(SU.SEASONS[season].screen) end)
end

-- Plays back an original Flash timeline exported by timeline_export.py (stage coordinates, drawn
-- through the minigame stage). Pictures, texts in the player's language, dynamic text fields, and
-- "slots" the game code draws itself (anything a script moves or animates).
AN = AN or {}
AN.TL = AN.TL or {}
local TL = AN.TL
local MG = AN.MG

-- the draw colour for a picture: white (or the Flash player's tint) with the alpha
function TL.SetColor(alpha)
	local t = AN.FL and AN.FL.tint
	if t then
		surface.SetDrawColor(255 * t[1], 255 * t[2], 255 * t[3], 255 * (alpha or 1))
	else
		surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 255 * (alpha or 1))
	end
end

-- a picture placed by a matrix without rotation (a, d may be negative = mirrored), optionally clipped
-- to a stage rectangle
function TL.Pic(path, x, y, w, h, m, alpha, clip, uv)
	local a, b, c, d, tx, ty = m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5], m[6]
	local x0, x1 = a * x + tx, a * (x + w) + tx
	local y0, y1 = d * y + ty, d * (y + h) + ty
	local u0, u1, v0, v1 = 0, 1, 0, 1
	if uv then u0, v0, u1, v1 = uv[1], uv[2], uv[3], uv[4] end
	if x1 < x0 then x0, x1 = x1, x0; u0, u1 = u1, u0 end
	if y1 < y0 then y0, y1 = y1, y0; v0, v1 = v1, v0 end
	if clip then
		local cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1 = clip[1], clip[2], clip[3], clip[4]
		if x1 <= cx0 or x0 >= cx1 or y1 <= cy0 or y0 >= cy1 then return end
		local W, H = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
		local nx0, nx1 = math.max(x0, cx0), math.min(x1, cx1)
		local ny0, ny1 = math.max(y0, cy0), math.min(y1, cy1)
		local du, dv = u1 - u0, v1 - v0
		u0, u1 = u0 + du * (nx0 - x0) / W, u0 + du * (nx1 - x0) / W
		v0, v1 = v0 + dv * (ny0 - y0) / H, v0 + dv * (ny1 - y0) / H
		x0, x1, y0, y1 = nx0, nx1, ny0, ny1
	end
	if math.abs(b) > 0.001 or math.abs(c) > 0.001 then
		-- turned (or skewed / mirrored and turned): the four corners through the matrix (no clipping)
		uv = uv or { 0, 0, 1, 1 }
		local function pt(px, py, u, v)
			return { x = AN.PX(MG.X(a * px + c * py + tx)), y = AN.SY(MG.Y(b * px + d * py + ty)), u = u, v = v }
		end
		local ua, va, ub, vb = uv[1], uv[2], uv[3], uv[4]
		local p = { pt(x, y, ua, va), pt(x + w, y, ub, va), pt(x + w, y + h, ub, vb), pt(x, y + h, ua, vb) }
		if a * d - b * c < 0 then p = { p[4], p[3], p[2], p[1] } end
		TL.SetColor(alpha)
		surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(path))
		surface.DrawPoly(p)
		return
	end
	if math.abs(b) > 0.001 or math.abs(c) > 0.001 then
		-- turned: draw around the middle (no clipping)
		local mx, my = (x + w / 2), (y + h / 2)
		local cx, cy = a * mx + c * my + tx, b * mx + d * my + ty
		local sx, sy = math.sqrt(a * a + b * b), math.sqrt(c * c + d * d)
		TL.SetColor(alpha)
		surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(path))
		surface.DrawTexturedRectRotated(AN.PX(MG.X(cx)), AN.SY(MG.Y(cy)), AN.SX(MG.S(w * sx)), AN.SX(MG.S(h * sy)), -math.deg(math.atan2(b, a)))
		return
	end
	TL.SetColor(alpha)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(path))
	local px, py = AN.PX(MG.X(x0)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y0))
	surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(px, py, AN.PX(MG.X(x1)) - px, AN.SY(MG.Y(y1)) - py, u0, v0, u1, v1)
end

-- text centred on a stage point, turned and scaled by a matrix (like a Flash text placement)
function TL.Text(str, face, em, cx, cy, m, col, alpha, maxW, leftAnchor)
	local a, b = m and m[1] or 1, m and m[2] or 0
	local s = math.sqrt(a * a + b * b)
	local ang = math.deg(math.atan2(b, a))
	local f = AN.Font(face, math.max(6, math.floor(MG.S(em))))
	surface.SetFont(f)
	local tw, th = surface.GetTextSize(str)
	-- a translation that is longer than the original is made smaller to fit
	if maxW then
		local lim = AN.SX(MG.S(maxW))
		if tw * s > lim then s = lim / tw end
	end
	local sx, sy = AN.PX(MG.X(cx)), AN.SY(MG.Y(cy))
	surface.SetTextColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, 255 * (alpha or 1))
	local ax = leftAnchor == "right" and tw or (leftAnchor and 0 or tw / 2)
	if math.abs(ang) < 0.05 and math.abs(s - 1) < 0.01 then
		surface.SetTextPos(math.floor(sx - ax), math.floor(sy - th / 2))
		surface.DrawText(str)
		return
	end
	local mt = Matrix()
	mt:Translate(Vector(sx, sy, 0))
	mt:Rotate(Angle(0, ang, 0))
	mt:Scale(Vector(s, s, 1))
	-- (the panel's clipping is tested before the matrix: text left of / above the origin would be cut off)
	local was = DisableClipping(true)
	cam.PushModelMatrix(mt, true)
	surface.SetTextPos(math.floor(-ax), math.floor(-th / 2))
	surface.DrawText(str)
	cam.PopModelMatrix()
	DisableClipping(was)
end

local function apply(m, x, y)
	return m[1] * x + m[3] * y + m[5], m[2] * x + m[4] * y + m[6]
end
TL.Apply = apply

-- draw one frame. hooks.slot(name, m, alpha), hooks.value(var) -> string, hooks.text(key) -> string (optional)
-- parent: an optional matrix the whole timeline is placed with (a sprite inside the stage)
function TL.Mul(P, C)
	return { P[1] * C[1] + P[3] * C[2], P[2] * C[1] + P[4] * C[2], P[1] * C[3] + P[3] * C[4], P[2] * C[3] + P[4] * C[4],
		P[1] * C[5] + P[3] * C[6] + P[5], P[2] * C[5] + P[4] * C[6] + P[6] }
end

function TL.Draw(tl, frame, hooks, parent)
	local items = tl.frames[frame]
	if not items then return end
	hooks = hooks or {}
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		local key = it[1]
		local m = { it[2], it[3], it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7] }
		if parent then m = TL.Mul(parent, m) end
		local alpha = it[8]
		local clip = it[9] and { it[9], it[10], it[11], it[12] } or nil
		if clip and parent then clip = { clip[1] * parent[1] + parent[5], clip[2] * parent[4] + parent[6], clip[3] * parent[1] + parent[5], clip[4] * parent[4] + parent[6] } end
		if alpha > 0.004 then
			if string.sub(key, 1, 5) == "slot:" then
				if hooks.slot then hooks.slot(string.sub(key, 6), m, alpha) end
			else
				local ch = tl.chars[key]
				if ch and hooks.item then hooks.item(key, m, ch) end
				if ch then
					local kind = ch[1]
					if kind == "img" then
						TL.Pic(ch[2], ch[3], ch[4], ch[5], ch[6], m, alpha, clip)
					elseif kind == "text" then
						local str = hooks.text and hooks.text(ch[2]) or AN.L(ch[2])
						local col = Color(ch[6], ch[7], ch[8])
						if (ch[11] or 1) > 1 or string.find(str, "\n", 1, true) then
							-- several lines: spaced like the original, left aligned or centred
							local lines = string.Explode("\n", str)
							local lh = ch[10] or ch[5]
							for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
								local ly = ch[4] + (i - (#lines + 1) / 2) * lh
								local lx = ch[12] == 0 and ch[9] or ch[3]
								local px, py = apply(m, lx, ly)
								TL.Text(line, "title", ch[5], px, py, m, col, alpha, (MG.sw or 400) - 10, ch[12] == 0)
							end
						else
							local cx, cy = apply(m, ch[3], ch[4])
							TL.Text(str, "title", ch[5], cx, cy, m, col, alpha, (MG.sw or 400) - 10)
						end
					elseif kind == "dyn" then
						local v = hooks.value and hooks.value(ch[2])
						if v and v ~= "" then
							-- the text box (x, y, w, h), font size, align (0 left, 1 right, 2 centre)
							local s = math.sqrt(m[1] * m[1] + m[2] * m[2])
							local al = ch[8]
							local ax = al == 1 and (ch[3] + ch[5] - 2) or (al == 2 and (ch[3] + ch[5] / 2) or (ch[3] + 2))
							local px, py = apply(m, ax, ch[4] + 2)
							local f = AN.Font("title", math.max(6, math.floor(MG.S(ch[7] * s))))
							surface.SetFont(f)
							local tw = surface.GetTextSize(v)
							local sx = AN.PX(MG.X(px))
							if al == 1 then sx = sx - tw elseif al == 2 then sx = sx - tw / 2 end
							surface.SetTextColor(ch[9], ch[10], ch[11], 255 * alpha)
							surface.SetTextPos(math.floor(sx), math.floor(AN.SY(MG.Y(py))))
							surface.DrawText(v)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- one frame of an animation exported with "trim" (anim_export.py), origin at (ox, oy) in stage
-- coordinates, scaled by k (default 1)
function TL.Cell(group, idx, ox, oy, alpha, k)
	local fr = group.frames[idx]
	if not fr then return end
	k = k or 1
	local at = group.atlases[fr[1]]
	local sc = group.scale
	TL.SetColor(alpha)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(at[1]))
	local x, y = ox + fr[6] * k, oy + fr[7] * k
	local px, py = AN.PX(MG.X(x)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y))
	local px1, py1 = AN.PX(MG.X(x + fr[4] / sc * k)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y + fr[5] / sc * k))
	surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(px, py, px1 - px, py1 - py, fr[2] / at[2], fr[3] / at[3], (fr[2] + fr[4]) / at[2], (fr[3] + fr[5]) / at[3])
end

-- the same, placed by a matrix (mirrored / scaled)
function TL.CellM(group, idx, m, alpha, clip)
	local fr = group.frames[idx]
	if not fr then return end
	local at = group.atlases[fr[1]]
	local sc = group.scale
	TL.Pic(at[1], fr[6], fr[7], fr[4] / sc, fr[5] / sc, m, alpha, clip,
		{ fr[2] / at[2], fr[3] / at[3], (fr[2] + fr[4]) / at[2], (fr[3] + fr[5]) / at[3] })
end

-- the texts that belong to an animation frame (drawn by the game, in the player's language)
function TL.CellTexts(group, anim, f, ox, oy, alpha, col, k)
	local t = group.texts and group.texts[anim] and group.texts[anim][f]
	if not t then return end
	k = k or 1
	for _, x in ipairs(t) do
		local m = { x[4] * k, x[5] * k, x[6] * k, x[7] * k, 0, 0 }
		TL.Text(AN.L(x[1]), "title", x[8], ox + x[2] * k, oy + x[3] * k, m, col or Color(102, 0, 51), (alpha or 1) * x[9])
	end
end

-- Fullscreen UI: one root panel, immediate-mode buttons, screen manager and
-- the shared "Menu B" chrome (blurred loft, dark left side, back pill, corner buttons).
AN = AN or {}
AN.UI = AN.UI or {}
AN.Screens = AN.Screens or {}
local UI = AN.UI
local C = AN.Col

UI.regions = {}
UI.hot = nil
UI.mx, UI.my = 0, 0
UI.screen = nil
UI.screenName = nil
UI.fade = 0
UI.time = 0

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Screen manager
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.Open(name, args)
	if name == "gamewrap" and args and (args.n or 0) > 100 then name = "sgame" end
	local scr = AN.Screens[name]
	if not scr then
		ErrorNoHalt("[Alletiders Nisse] unknown screen " .. tostring(name) .. "\n")
		return
	end
	if UI.screen and UI.screen.Close then UI.screen:Close() end
	if not (args and args.keepVoice) then AN.StopSpeech() end
	UI.screenName = name
	UI.screen = scr
	-- a game screen opening starts a new run of that game
	local gn = tonumber(string.match(name, "^game(%d+)$") or "")
	if gn and AN.NewRun then AN.NewRun(gn) end
	UI.openedAt = RealTime()
	UI.fade = 1
	UI.drag = nil
	if scr.Open then scr:Open(args or {}) end
end

function UI.Start()
	if IsValid(UI.root) then UI.root:Remove() end
	local p = vgui.Create("DPanel")
	p:SetPos(0, 0)
	p:SetSize(ScrW(), ScrH())
	p:MakePopup()
	p:SetKeyboardInputEnabled(false)
	p:SetMouseInputEnabled(true)
	p.Paint = function(self, w, h) UI.Frame(w, h) end
	p.OnMousePressed = function(self, code) UI.MousePressed(code) end
	p.OnMouseReleased = function(self, code) UI.MouseReleased(code) end
	p.OnMouseWheeled = function(self, d)
		if UI.screen and UI.screen.Wheel then UI.screen:Wheel(d) end
	end
	AN.MusicOn()
	p.Think = function(self)
		if self:GetWide() ~= ScrW() or self:GetTall() ~= ScrH() then
			self:SetSize(ScrW(), ScrH())
			AN.UpdateScale()
		end
		if UI.screen and UI.screen.Think then UI.screen:Think(FrameTime()) end
	end
	UI.root = p
	UI.Open("main")
	-- the original greeting: a special line the very first time, another one after that
	if not UI.greeted then
		UI.greeted = true
		if AN.Save.Get("firsttime") ~= false then
			AN.Speak("start_first")
			AN.Save.Set("firsttime", false)
		else
			AN.Speak("start_igen")
		end
	end
end

-- a player's Steam avatar (a real vgui panel on top of the screen), square, virtual coords
function UI.Avatar(sid, x, y, size)
	UI.avatars = UI.avatars or {}
	local p = UI.avatars[sid]
	if not IsValid(p) and IsValid(UI.root) then
		p = vgui.Create("AvatarImage", UI.root)
		local ply
		for _, pl in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
			if pl:SteamID64() == sid then ply = pl end
		end
		if sid == AN.Save.MySid() then ply = LocalPlayer() end
		if ply then p:SetPlayer(ply, 184) elseif sid ~= "local" then p:SetSteamID(sid, 184) end
		p:SetMouseInputEnabled(false)
		UI.avatars[sid] = p
	end
	if not IsValid(p) then return end
	UI.avatarUsed[sid] = true
	p:SetVisible(true)
	p:SetPos(AN.PX(x), AN.SY(y))
	p:SetSize(AN.SX(size), AN.SX(size))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Frame + input
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function UI.Frame(w, h)
	UI.time = RealTime()
	local cx, cy = input.GetCursorPos()
	UI.mx = cx / AN.S - AN.OX
	UI.my = cy / AN.S - AN.OY
	UI.regions = {}
	UI.avatarUsed = {}

	surface.SetDrawColor(20, 10, 4, 255)
	surface.DrawRect(0, 0, w, h)

	if UI.screen and UI.screen.Paint then
		local ok, err = pcall(UI.screen.Paint, UI.screen)
		if not ok then
			ErrorNoHalt("[Alletiders Nisse] " .. tostring(err) .. "\n")
			draw.SimpleText(tostring(err), "DermaDefault", 10, 10, Color(255, 120, 120))
		end
		-- the menu screens get a garland of the original branches along the top
		if UI.screen.garland ~= false and AN.Deco then
			local ok2, err2 = pcall(AN.Deco.MenuGarland)
			if not ok2 then ErrorNoHalt("[Alletiders Nisse] " .. tostring(err2) .. "\n") end
		end
	end

	-- subtitles for what Pyrus says
	if AN.DrawSubtitle then
		local ok3, err3 = pcall(AN.DrawSubtitle)
		if not ok3 then ErrorNoHalt("[Alletiders Nisse] " .. tostring(err3) .. "\n") end
	end

	-- versus: invitations, the lobby, 3-2-1, the live scores, the results
	if AN.DrawVersus then
		local ok4, err4 = pcall(AN.DrawVersus)
		if not ok4 then ErrorNoHalt("[Alletiders Nisse] " .. tostring(err4) .. "\n") end
	end

	-- drag ghost drawn on top
	if UI.drag and UI.drag.draw then UI.drag.draw(UI.mx, UI.my) end

	-- Steam avatars not drawn this frame are hidden
	for sid, p in pairs(UI.avatars or {}) do
		if IsValid(p) and not UI.avatarUsed[sid] then p:SetVisible(false) end
	end

	-- the hot region is the last one (topmost) under the mouse
	local newHot
	for i = #UI.regions, 1, -1 do
		local r = UI.regions[i]
		if UI.mx >= r.x and UI.mx <= r.x + r.w and UI.my >= r.y and UI.my <= r.y + r.h and (not r.hit or r.hit(UI.mx, UI.my)) then
			newHot = r
			break
		end
	end
	local newId = newHot and newHot.id or nil
	if newId ~= UI.hot then
		local old = UI.hotRegion
		if newHot and (newHot.fn or newHot.press) and not newHot.silent then AN.Sound("over")
		elseif old and (old.fn or old.press) and not old.silent then AN.Sound("out") end
		UI.hoverStart = RealTime()
		UI.hoverVoiced = false
	end
	UI.hot = newId
	UI.hotRegion = newHot
	-- like the original: resting on some buttons makes Pyrus say something
	if newHot and newHot.voice and not UI.hoverVoiced and RealTime() - (UI.hoverStart or 0) >= newHot.voice[2] then
		UI.hoverVoiced = true
		AN.Speak(newHot.voice[1])
	end

	-- fade-in after changing screen
	if UI.fade > 0 then
		UI.fade = math.max(0, 1 - (RealTime() - UI.openedAt) / 0.25)
		surface.SetDrawColor(20, 8, 2, 255 * UI.fade)
		surface.DrawRect(0, 0, w, h)
	end
end

function UI.MousePressed(code)
	local r = UI.hotRegion
	if not r then return end
	if code == MOUSE_LEFT then
		if r.press then
			r.press(UI.mx, UI.my)
		elseif r.fn then
			if not r.silent then AN.Sound("click") end
			r.fn()
		end
	elseif code == MOUSE_RIGHT and r.right then
		r.right()
	end
end

function UI.MouseReleased(code)
	if code == MOUSE_LEFT and UI.drag then
		local d = UI.drag
		UI.drag = nil
		if d.release then d.release(UI.mx, UI.my) end
	end
end

-- start dragging: move(mx,my) called every frame by the screen through UI.drag, release(mx,my) on mouse up
function UI.BeginDrag(t) UI.drag = t end

-- register a clickable region. returns hovered
function UI.Button(id, x, y, w, h, fn, opts)
	local r = { id = id, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, fn = fn }
	if opts then
		r.silent = opts.silent
		r.press = opts.press
		r.right = opts.right
		r.voice = opts.voice
		r.hit = opts.hit      -- hit(mx, my): an exact shape test inside the rectangle (e.g. a Flash button's hit area)
	end
	UI.regions[#UI.regions + 1] = r
	return UI.hot == id
end

function UI.Hot(id) return UI.hot == id end

-- kind: "menu" (main menu, lighter), "sub" (sub screens), "box" (decoration box, more blur)
function UI.Background(kind, zoom)
	local sw, sh = ScrW(), ScrH()
	local path = "bg/" .. (kind or "sub") .. ".jpg"
	if AN.Save.Get("blur") == false then path = "bg/loft.jpg" end
	local m = AN.Mat(path)
	-- cover the whole screen (image is 16:9)
	local iw, ih = sw, sw * 9 / 16
	if ih < sh then ih = sh; iw = sh * 16 / 9 end
	zoom = zoom or 1
	iw, ih = iw * zoom, ih * zoom
	local col = 255
	if path == "bg/loft.jpg" then col = (kind == "menu") and 204 or 158 end
	surface.SetDrawColor(col, col, col, 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(m)
	-- bottom of the loft image stays at the bottom of the screen
	surface.DrawTexturedRect((sw - iw) / 2, sh - ih, iw, ih)
end

function UI.Bubble(text, rx, y, maxw, size)
	size = size or 28
	local lines = AN.Wrap(text, "bold", size, maxw - 56)
	local lw = 0
	for _, l in ipairs(lines) do lw = math.max(lw, AN.TextSize(l, "bold", size)) end
	local w = lw + 56
	local lh = size * 1.3
	local h = #lines * lh + 40
	local x = rx - w
	AN.Box(x + 4, y + 10, w, h, Color(0, 0, 0, 90), 26)

	end
	return w, h
end
alletidersnisse/gamemode/core/cl_util.lu:
-- Scaling, fonts, colours, images, drawing helpers and sounds.
-- All layout is written in a virtual 1920x1080 space (like the design canvas).
-- S is the scale to real pixels; VW is the virtual width (wider than 1920 on 21:9).
-- Things that sit on the right side of a screen add AN.R (extra width) to their x.

AN = AN or {}

AN.Col = {
	cream   = Color(255, 241, 207),
	gold    = Color(255, 215, 106),
	sand    = Color(217, 194, 154),
	wheat   = Color(233, 214, 178),
	white   = Color(255, 255, 255),
	dark    = Color(20, 8, 2),
	brown   = Color(59, 26, 8),
	red     = Color(200, 32, 45),
	redDark = Color(125, 15, 23),
	shadow  = Color(90, 29, 4),
	bad     = Color(224, 90, 90),
	badText = Color(255, 176, 168),
}

local function rgba(c, a) return Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, a) end
AN.Alpha = rgba

function AN.UpdateScale()
	local sw, sh = ScrW(), ScrH()
	AN.S = math.min(sh / 1080, sw / 1920)
	AN.VW = sw / AN.S
	AN.VH = sh / AN.S
	AN.OX = 0
	-- One layout for every screen: designed at 1920 x 1080 and scaled by height.
	-- On wider screens the extra width is split: things anchored to the screen edges
	-- (menu panel, corner buttons) stay at the edges, and the scene content is anchored
	-- to the centre with AN.C, so nothing gets pulled apart. Backgrounds fill the width.
	AN.R = math.max(0, AN.VW - 1920)    -- extra width beyond 16:9
	AN.C = AN.R / 2                     -- shift for centre-anchored content
	AN.OY = (AN.VH - 1080) / 2          -- vertical centring on 4:3 / 16:10
	AN.FontCache = AN.FontCache or {}
end
AN.UpdateScale()

hook.Add("OnScreenSizeChanged", "AN_Scale", function() AN.UpdateScale() end)

-- virtual -> screen
local function SX(v) return math.floor(v * AN.S + 0.5) end           -- sizes
local function PX(v) return math.floor((v + AN.OX) * AN.S + 0.5) end  -- x positions
local function SY(v) return math.floor((v + AN.OY) * AN.S + 0.5) end
AN.SX, AN.SY, AN.PX = SX, SY, PX

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fonts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- face: "title" (Spumoni), "bold" (Nunito ExtraBold), "black" (Nunito Black)
local faces = {
	title = "Spumoni LP",
	bold  = "Nunito ExtraBold",
	black = "Nunito Black",
}

function AN.Font(face, size)
	local key = face .. size .. ":" .. ScrH()
	local name = AN.FontCache[key]
	if name then return name end
	name = "AN_" .. face .. "_" .. size .. "_" .. ScrH()
	surface.CreateFont(name, {
		font = faces[face] or faces.bold,
		size = math.max(8, math.floor(size * AN.S + 0.5)),
		weight = 800,
		antialias = true,
		extended = true,
	})
	AN.FontCache[key] = name
	return name
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Images
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local mats = {}
function AN.Mat(path)
	local m = mats[path]
	if not m then
		m = Material("alletidersnisse/" .. path, "smooth mips")
		mats[path] = m
	end
	return m
end

-- natural aspect ratio (height / width) of a material
function AN.Ratio(path)
	local real = AN.ImgSize and AN.ImgSize[path]
	if real then return real[2] / real[1] end
	local m = AN.Mat(path)
	local w, h = m:Width(), m:Height()
	if w <= 0 then return 1 end
	return h / w
end

-- draw image by width (height from aspect) or explicit w,h
function AN.Img(path, x, y, w, h, alpha, col)
	local m = AN.Mat(path)
	h = h or w * AN.Ratio(path)
	local c = col or color_white
	surface.SetDrawColor(c.r, c.g, c.b, alpha or 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(m)
	surface.DrawTexturedRect(PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h))
	return h
end

-- image fitted inside a box, centred, keeping aspect
function AN.ImgFit(path, x, y, w, h, alpha)
	local r = AN.Ratio(path)
	local iw, ih = w, w * r
	if ih > h then ih = h; iw = h / r end
	AN.Img(path, x + (w - iw) / 2, y + (h - ih) / 2, iw, ih, alpha)
end

-- image cropped to cover a box (like object-fit: cover)
function AN.ImgCover(path, x, y, w, h, alpha)
	local m = AN.Mat(path)
	local r = AN.Ratio(path)
	local boxR = h / w
	local u0, v0, u1, v1 = 0, 0, 1, 1
	if r > boxR then
		local vis = boxR / r
		v0 = (1 - vis) / 2; v1 = 1 - v0
	else
		local vis = r / boxR
		u0 = (1 - vis) / 2; u1 = 1 - u0
	end
	surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, alpha or 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(m)
	surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h), u0, v0, u1, v1)
end

function AN.ImgRotated(path, cx, cy, w, h, deg, alpha)
	surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, alpha or 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(path))
	surface.DrawTexturedRectRotated(PX(cx), SY(cy), SX(w), SX(h), deg)
end

-- Soft "blur" for images GMod can't filter: draw the image several times
-- in a small ring with low alpha. radius in virtual px.
function AN.ImgSoft(path, x, y, w, h, radius, alpha, col)
	alpha = alpha or 255
	local n = 8
	local a = math.min(255, alpha * 0.32)
	for i = 0, n - 1 do
		local ang = i / n * math.pi * 2
		AN.Img(path, x + math.cos(ang) * radius, y + math.sin(ang) * radius, w, h, a, col)
	end
	AN.Img(path, x, y, w, h, alpha * 0.25, col)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Shapes
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function AN.Box(x, y, w, h, col, radius)
	draw.RoundedBox(SX(radius or 0), PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h), col)
end

function AN.BoxEx(x, y, w, h, col, radius, tl, tr, bl, br)
	draw.RoundedBoxEx(SX(radius or 0), PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h), col, tl, tr, bl, br)
end

-- rounded outline: border colour box, then inner fill (or the background colour)
function AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, col, radius, thick, inner)
	thick = thick or 2
	radius = radius or 0
	local sx, sy, sw, sh, t = PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h), math.max(1, SX(thick))
	if inner then
		draw.RoundedBox(SX(radius), sx, sy, sw, sh, col)
		draw.RoundedBox(math.max(0, SX(radius) - t), sx + t, sy + t, sw - t * 2, sh - t * 2, inner)
	else
		-- transparent inside: draw the four edges with rounded caps approximated
		local r = SX(radius)
		surface.SetDrawColor(col)
		surface.DrawRect(sx + r, sy, sw - r * 2, t)
		surface.DrawRect(sx + r, sy + sh - t, sw - r * 2, t)
		surface.DrawRect(sx, sy + r, t, sh - r * 2)
		surface.DrawRect(sx + sw - t, sy + r, t, sh - r * 2)
		if r > 0 then
			local seg = 10
			local function arc(cx, cy, a0)
				for i = 0, seg - 1 do
					local a1 = a0 + (i / seg) * math.pi / 2
					local a2 = a0 + ((i + 1) / seg) * math.pi / 2
					for k = 0, t - 1 do
						local rr = r - k
						surface.DrawLine(cx + math.cos(a1) * rr, cy + math.sin(a1) * rr, cx + math.cos(a2) * rr, cy + math.sin(a2) * rr)
					end
				end
			end
			arc(sx + r, sy + r, math.pi)
			arc(sx + sw - r - 1, sy + r, math.pi * 1.5)
			arc(sx + sw - r - 1, sy + sh - r - 1, 0)
			arc(sx + r, sy + sh - r - 1, math.pi * 0.5)
		end
	end
end

-- own gradient textures so the direction is certain:
-- grad_l: opaque on the left, clear on the right. grad_d: clear at the top, opaque at the bottom.
local gradL = Material("alletidersnisse/ui/grad_l.png", "smooth")
local gradD = Material("alletidersnisse/ui/grad_d.png", "smooth")

-- horizontal fade: colour at alpha a0 on the left to a1 on the right (one draw, linear alpha).
-- grad_l alpha is 1 - u, so drawing u in [0, 1 - a1/a0] with alpha a0 gives a0 -> a1.
function AN.HGrad(x, y, w, h, col, a0, a1)
	local sx, sy, sw, sh = PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h)
	if a0 == a1 then
		surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, a0)
		surface.DrawRect(sx, sy, sw, sh)
		return
	end
	local hi = math.max(a0, a1)
	local k = math.min(a0, a1) / hi
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, hi)
	surface.SetMaterial(gradL)
	if a0 > a1 then
		surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, 1 - k, 1)
	else
		surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(sx, sy, sw, sh, 1 - k, 0, 0, 1)
	end
end

-- vertical fade: alpha a0 at the top to a1 at the bottom. grad_d alpha is v.
function AN.VGrad(x, y, w, h, col, a0, a1)
	local sx, sy, sw, sh = PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h)
	if a0 == a1 then
		surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, a0)
		surface.DrawRect(sx, sy, sw, sh)
		return
	end
	local hi = math.max(a0, a1)
	local k = math.min(a0, a1) / hi
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, hi)
	surface.SetMaterial(gradD)
	if a1 > a0 then
		surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, k, 1, 1)
	else
		surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 1, 1, k)
	end
end

-- two-colour vertical gradient
function AN.VGrad2(x, y, w, h, c1, c2)
	AN.Box(x, y, w, h, c1)
	local sx, sy, sw, sh = PX(x), SY(y), SX(w), SX(h)
	surface.SetDrawColor(c2.r, c2.g, c2.b, c2.a or 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(gradD)
	surface.DrawTexturedRect(sx, sy, sw, sh)
end

-- filled circle
local circleCache = {}
function AN.Circle(cx, cy, r, col)
	local sx, sy, sr = PX(cx), SY(cy), SX(r)
	local key = sx .. ":" .. sy .. ":" .. sr
	local poly = circleCache[key]
	if not poly then
		poly = {}
		local seg = math.Clamp(math.floor(sr / 2), 16, 64)
		for i = 0, seg - 1 do
			local a = i / seg * math.pi * 2
			poly[#poly + 1] = { x = sx + math.cos(a) * sr, y = sy + math.sin(a) * sr }
		end
		circleCache[key] = poly
		if table.Count(circleCache) > 400 then circleCache = {} end
	end
	draw.NoTexture()
	surface.SetDrawColor(col)
	surface.DrawPoly(poly)
end

-- soft round glow (radial gradient texture)
function AN.Glow(cx, cy, r, col, strength)
	strength = strength or 1
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, math.Clamp((col.a or 255) * 0.55 * strength, 0, 255))
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat("ui/radial.png"))
	surface.DrawTexturedRect(PX(cx - r), SY(cy - r), SX(r * 2), SX(r * 2))
end

-- soft ellipse shadow under objects
function AN.Shadow(x, y, w, h, a)
	surface.SetDrawColor(15, 5, 0, a or 150)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat("ui/radial.png"))
	surface.DrawTexturedRect(PX(x - w * 0.15), SY(y - h * 0.3), SX(w * 1.3), SX(h * 1.6))
end

-- Text
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- align: 0 left, 1 centre, 2 right ; valign: 0 top, 1 centre
function AN.Text(str, face, size, x, y, col, align, valign, alpha)
	local f = AN.Font(face, size)
	surface.SetFont(f)
	local tw, th = surface.GetTextSize(str)
	local sx, sy = PX(x), SY(y)
	if align == 1 then sx = sx - tw / 2 elseif align == 2 then sx = sx - tw end
	if valign == 1 then sy = sy - th / 2 end
	surface.SetTextColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, alpha or col.a or 255)
	surface.SetTextPos(math.floor(sx), math.floor(sy))
	surface.DrawText(str)
	return tw / AN.S, th / AN.S
end

-- text with a hard drop shadow (like text-shadow: 0 6px 0 colour)
function AN.TextShadow(str, face, size, x, y, col, shadowCol, off, align)
	AN.Text(str, face, size, x, y + (off or 5), shadowCol, align)
	return AN.Text(str, face, size, x, y, col, align)
end

function AN.TextSize(str, face, size)
	surface.SetFont(AN.Font(face, size))
	local w, h = surface.GetTextSize(str)
	return w / AN.S, h / AN.S
end

-- word-wrap to a virtual width, returns list of lines
function AN.Wrap(str, face, size, maxw)
	surface.SetFont(AN.Font(face, size))
	local lines = {}
	for para in string.gmatch(str .. "\n", "(.-)\n") do
		local line = ""
		for word in string.gmatch(para, "%S+") do
			local test = line == "" and word or (line .. " " .. word)
			local w = surface.GetTextSize(test) / AN.S
			if w > maxw and line ~= "" then
				lines[#lines + 1] = line
				line = word
			else
				line = test
			end
		end
		lines[#lines + 1] = line
	end
	return lines
end

-- draws wrapped text, returns total height
function AN.TextWrap(str, face, size, x, y, maxw, col, lineH, align)
	local lines = AN.Wrap(str, face, size, maxw)
	lineH = lineH or size * 1.45
	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do
		local lx = x
		if align == 1 then lx = x + maxw / 2 elseif align == 2 then lx = x + maxw end
		AN.Text(l, face, size, lx, y + (i - 1) * lineH, col, align)
	end
	return #lines * lineH
end

-- text shrunk to fit a width
function AN.TextFit(str, face, size, x, y, maxw, col, align, valign)
	local s = size
	while s > 10 do
		local w = AN.TextSize(str, face, s)
		if w <= maxw then break end
		s = s - 2
	end
	return AN.Text(str, face, s, x, y, col, align, valign)
end

-- a single line cut to a width with "..." (player names)
function AN.TextEllipsis(str, face, size, x, y, maxw, col, align, valign)
	str = tostring(str or "")
	if AN.TextSize(str, face, size) > maxw then
		local n = utf8 and utf8.len(str) or #str
		while n > 1 do
			n = n - 1
			local cut = utf8 and utf8.offset and string.sub(str, 1, (utf8.offset(str, n + 1) or (#str + 1)) - 1) or string.sub(str, 1, n)
			local test = cut .. "..."
			if AN.TextSize(test, face, size) <= maxw then str = test break end
		end
	end
	return AN.Text(str, face, size, x, y, col, align, valign)
end

-- the small mark next to a result that was helped by a hint
function AN.HintMark(cx, cy, r)
	AN.Circle(cx, cy, r, Color(214, 150, 30))
	AN.Circle(cx, cy, r * 0.78, Color(255, 215, 106))
	AN.Text("?", "black", math.max(8, math.floor(r * 1.5)), cx, cy, Color(90, 40, 8), 1, 1)
end

function AN.Sound(name)
	local vol = (AN.Save and AN.Save.Get("vol_fx") or 85) / 100
	if vol <= 0 then return end
	if AN.SoundMode and AN.SoundMode() == 2 then return end
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/ui/" .. name .. ".mp3", "noplay", function(ch)
		if IsValid(ch) then ch:SetVolume(vol) ch:Play() end
	end)

function AN.FormatTime(sec)
	sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec + 0.5))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(sec / 60), sec % 60)
end

-- upper-case that also handles æ ø å é
function AN.Upper(str)
	str = string.upper(str)
	str = string.gsub(str, "æ", "Æ")
	str = string.gsub(str, "ø", "Ø")
	str = string.gsub(str, "å", "Å")
	str = string.gsub(str, "é", "É")
	return str
end
-- Versus, chosen on each game's start board:
--   Kapløb: race the other players on the server. One player invites, the others say yes, everyone
--           gets 3-2-1 and plays the same game with the same random layout, with the others' live
--           scores in a strip; at the end everyone gets the ranking. Results are saved as usual.
--   Duel:   two players on one PC take turns with the same layout; the best result wins.
--           Player 1 (the PC's own player) keeps the result as usual, player 2 is a guest.
--           The keyboard games are played split screen instead, both at once (cl_split.lua).
-- Everything here is drawn on top of whatever screen is open (AN.DrawVersus from UI.Frame).
AN = AN or {}
local UI, C = AN.UI, AN.Col
local VS = AN.VS or {}
AN.VS = VS
VS.invites = VS.invites or {}

local function lower(n) return AN.Games[n] and AN.Games[n].scoreType == "time" end
local function myName() return IsValid(LocalPlayer()) and LocalPlayer():Nick() or AN.L("vs_p1") end
local function others()
	local n = 0
	for _, p in ipairs(player.GetHumans()) do if p ~= LocalPlayer() then n = n + 1 end end
	return n
end
VS.Others = others

local function send(kind, fn)
	net.Start("an_vs")
	net.WriteString(kind)
	if fn then fn() end
	net.SendToServer()
end

-- start a game right now in the current look, with a fixed random seed
function VS.PlayNow(n, seed)
	VS.seed = seed
	if AN.Classic and AN.Classic.Active() and n <= 24 then
		UI.Open("classic", { keep = true })
		AN.Classic.cur = n
		AN.Classic.GameStart()
	else
		UI.Open("game" .. n, { n = n })
	end
end

-- back to the game's start board (quietly)
local function toBoard(n)
	UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true })
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Kapløb on the server
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function VS.Invite(n)
	VS.race = nil
	send("invite", function() net.WriteUInt(n, 8) net.WriteBool(lower(n) and true or false) end)
end
function VS.Join(id)
	VS.invites[id] = nil
	send("join", function() net.WriteUInt(id, 16) end)
end
function VS.Leave()
	local r = VS.race
	if r then send("leave", function() net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16) end) end
	VS.race = nil
end

local function readList()
	local list = {}
	for i = 1, net.ReadUInt(8) do list[i] = { sid = net.ReadString(), name = net.ReadString() } end
	return list
end

net.Receive("an_vs", function()
	local kind = net.ReadString()
	if kind == "invite" then
		local id, n, who = net.ReadUInt(16), net.ReadUInt(8), net.ReadString()
		VS.invites[id] = { id = id, n = n, who = who, t = RealTime() }
		AN.Sound("triangel")
	elseif kind == "lobby" then
		local id, n, host = net.ReadUInt(16), net.ReadUInt(8), net.ReadString()
		local list = readList()
		VS.race = VS.race and VS.race.id == id and VS.race or { id = id }
		local r = VS.race
		r.n, r.host, r.list, r.state = n, host, list, "lobby"
	elseif kind == "cancel" then
		local id = net.ReadUInt(16)
		VS.invites[id] = nil
		if VS.race and VS.race.id == id then VS.race = nil end
	elseif kind == "go" then
		local id, n, seed = net.ReadUInt(16), net.ReadUInt(8), net.ReadUInt(32)
		local list = readList()
		VS.race = { id = id, n = n, seed = seed, list = list, state = "count", goAt = RealTime() + 3,
			live = {}, done = {} }
		VS.duel = nil
	elseif kind == "live" then
		local id, sid, text = net.ReadUInt(16), net.ReadString(), net.ReadString()
		if VS.race and VS.race.id == id then VS.race.live[sid] = text end
	elseif kind == "done" then
		local id, sid, v, quit = net.ReadUInt(16), net.ReadString(), net.ReadFloat(), net.ReadBool()
		if VS.race and VS.race.id == id then VS.race.done[sid] = { v = v, quit = quit } end
	elseif kind == "result" then
		local id, n = net.ReadUInt(16), net.ReadUInt(8)
		local list = {}
		for i = 1, net.ReadUInt(8) do
			list[i] = { sid = net.ReadString(), name = net.ReadString(), v = net.ReadFloat(), quit = net.ReadBool() }
		end
		VS.result = { n = n, list = list, notSaved = VS.race and VS.race.notSaved }
		if VS.race and VS.race.id == id then VS.race = nil end
		AN.Sound("triangel")
	end
end)

-- live: what the game shows in its status line, twice a second
hook.Add("Think", "AN_VsLive", function()
	local r = VS.race
	if not r then return end
	if r.state == "count" and RealTime() >= r.goAt then
		r.state = "run"
		VS.PlayNow(r.n, r.seed)
	end
	if r.state == "run" and UI.screenName == "game" .. r.n and RealTime() >= (r.nextLive or 0) then
		r.nextLive = RealTime() + 0.5
		local g = UI.screen
		local ok, st = pcall(function() return g and g.Status and g:Status() end)
		if ok and st then send("live", function() net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16) net.WriteString(tostring(st)) end) end
	end
end)
