-- Duel on one PC
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function VS.Duel(n)
	VS.race = nil
	VS.duel = { n = n, seed = math.random(1, 2000000000), turn = 1, res = {}, names = { myName(), AN.L("vs_p2") },
		state = "ready" }
end

-- the result is saved like a normal game, but the result board is skipped
local function saveOnly(n, value, opts)
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	local run = AN.CurRun[n]
	AN.CurRun[n] = nil
	local hint = (opts and opts.hint) or (run and run.hint) or AN.HintUsed[n]
	AN.HintUsed[n] = nil
	AN.Save.Finish(n, value, g.scoreType == "time", AN.CoinsFor(n, value), hint, run and run.id)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Finishing and leaving a game while a versus is on
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if not VS.finishGame then VS.finishGame = AN.FinishGame end
function AN.FinishGame(n, value, opts)
	local r, d = VS.race, VS.duel
	if r and r.state == "run" and r.n == n and not r.finished then
		r.finished = true
		send("done", function() net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16) net.WriteFloat(value) end)
		if AN.DoorState(n) ~= "locked" then return VS.finishGame(n, value, opts) end
		r.notSaved = true
		toBoard(n)
		return
	end
	if d and d.n == n and d.state == "play" then
		d.res[d.turn] = value
		if d.turn == 1 then
			saveOnly(n, value, opts)
			d.turn = 2
			d.state = "ready"
		else
			AN.CurRun[n] = nil
			AN.HintUsed[n] = nil
			d.state = "result"
		end
		VS.leaving = true
		toBoard(n)
		VS.leaving = false
		return
	end
	return VS.finishGame(n, value, opts)
end

-- a game screen closed before the end: gave up
if not VS.uiOpen then VS.uiOpen = UI.Open end
function UI.Open(name, args)
	local was = UI.screenName
	local r, d = VS.race, VS.duel
	local playing = was and string.match(was, "^game(%d+)$")
	local nowGame = string.match(name or "", "^game(%d+)$")
	if playing and not nowGame and not VS.leaving then
		if r and r.state == "run" and not r.finished and tonumber(playing) == r.n then VS.Leave() end
		if d and d.state == "play" then VS.duel = nil end
	end
	-- a game opens with the versus' random seed (the same layout for everyone)
	if nowGame and VS.seed then
		math.randomseed(VS.seed)
	end
	if not nowGame then VS.seed = nil end
	return VS.uiOpen(name, args)
end

			-- the keyboard games: both at once, side by side
			AN.Text(AN.L("vs_split"), "black", 28, x + 30, yy, INK)
			AN.Text(d.names[1] .. ":  " .. AN.L("vs_keys1"), "bold", 21, x + 30, yy + 44, INK)
			AN.Text(d.names[2] .. ":  " .. AN.L("vs_keys2"), "bold", 21, x + 30, yy + 76, INK)
		else
			AN.Text(AN.L("vs_turn", d.names[d.turn]), "black", 30, x + 30, yy, INK)
		end
		pbtn("vs_duel_go", AN.L("vs_start"), x + 30, y + h - 86, 260, function()
			if split then
				d.state = "split"
				VS.Split.Start(n, d.seed)
				return
			end
			d.state = "play"
			VS.PlayNow(n, d.seed)
		end, true)
		pbtn("vs_duel_stop", AN.L("vs_cancel"), x + w - 30 - 220, y + h - 86, 220, function() VS.duel = nil end)
	elseif d.state == "result" then
		local w, h = 680, 330
		local x, y = panel(w, h)
		AN.Text(AN.L("vs_duel") .. ": " .. AN.GameName(n), "title", 40, x + 30, y + 24, RED)
		local a, b = d.res[1], d.res[2]
		local win
		if a == nil or b == nil then win = (a ~= nil and 1) or (b ~= nil and 2) or nil
		elseif a == b then win = nil
		elseif lower(n) then win = a < b and 1 or 2
		else win = a > b and 1 or 2 end
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local yy = y + 92 + (i - 1) * 46
			local col = win == i and RED or INK
			AN.TextFit(d.names[i], "black", 26, x + 40, yy, 360, col)
			AN.Text(value(n, d.res[i]), "black", 26, x + w - 40, yy, col, 2)
		end
		AN.Text(win and AN.L("vs_wins", d.names[win]) or AN.L("vs_draw"), "title", 34, x + w / 2, y + 210, C.redDark, 1, 1)
		pbtn("vs_duel_again", AN.L("vs_again"), x + 30, y + h - 86, 260, function() VS.Duel(n) end, true)
		pbtn("vs_duel_back", AN.L("vs_back"), x + w - 30 - 220, y + h - 86, 220, function() VS.duel = nil end)
	end
end

function AN.DrawVersus()
	local r, d = VS.race, VS.duel
	if r then
		if r.state == "lobby" then drawLobby(r)
		elseif r.state == "count" then drawCount(r)
		elseif r.state == "run" then drawStrip(r) end
	end
	if d and d.state ~= "play" then drawDuel(d) end
	if VS.result then drawResult(VS.result) end
	drawInvites()
end

-- A player's progress (doors, pebernødder, ornaments, tree) and the rules that change it.
-- Shared: the server keeps the real copy per Steam ID and saves it; the client keeps a mirror
-- and applies the same rules at once, so the game never waits for the server.
AN = AN or {}
AN.Prog = AN.Prog or {}
local P = AN.Prog

-- The 25 ornaments of the original, in the original order, with the original prices
-- (price = how many pebernødder you must collect before you get one).
AN.Ornaments = {}
local ORN = {
	{ "flag0", 10 }, { "flag1", 10 }, { "kraemmerhus0", 15 }, { "kraemmerhus1", 15 }, { "kraemmerhus2", 15 },
	{ "hjerte0", 15 }, { "hjerte1", 15 }, { "tromme0", 20 }, { "tromme1", 20 }, { "stok0", 20 }, { "stok1", 20 },
	{ "kugle1", 20 }, { "kugle4", 20 }, { "kugle5", 20 }, { "kugle11", 20 }, { "kugle2", 25 }, { "kugle3", 25 },
	{ "kugle6", 25 }, { "kugle7", 25 }, { "kugle8", 25 }, { "kugle0", 25 }, { "kugle9", 25 }, { "kugle10", 25 },
	{ "lys0", 30 }, { "star0", 40 },
}
AN.OrnamentById = {}
for i, o in ipairs(ORN) do
	local def = { index = i - 1, id = o[1], price = o[2], img = "wrap/orn_" .. o[1] .. ".png" }
	AN.Ornaments[i] = def
	AN.OrnamentById[o[1]] = def
end
-- the fixed order the original hands out ornaments in (0-based ornament indexes)
AN.RewardOrder = { 0, 1, 4, 5, 4, 2, 3, 6, 5, 4, 1, 1, 3, 7, 6, 8, 1, 8, 5, 4, 2, 9, 0, 4, 4, 7, 10, 8, 9, 12, 9, 3, 0, 0, 10, 11, 12, 14, 10, 15, 16, 13, 14, 1, 17, 11, 18, 6, 23, 0, 2, 19, 16, 17, 23, 20, 21, 22, 23, 13, 15, 19, 18, 22, 23, 23, 21, 23, 23, 20, 23, 23, 7, 23, 24 }

P.MAX_SCORES = 10

function P.New()
	return {
		v = 3,
		coins = 0,        -- pebernødder collected towards the next ornament
		rewardIndex = 0,  -- position in AN.RewardOrder (-1 = "random" from now on)
		randCount = 0,    -- ornaments handed out after the fixed order ran out
		doors = {},       -- ["4"] = { done = true, best = 41.2, plays = 3, hint = true }
		scores = {},      -- ["4"] = { { v = 41.2, t = os.time(), h = true }, ... } your own, best first
		inv = {},         -- { kugle4 = 2, ... }
		opened = {},      -- ["4"] = true: calendar doors you have opened
		tree = {},        -- { { id = "kugle4", x = 300, y = 500 }, ... } hanging point in tree-frame coords
	}
end

-- make a table read from JSON safe to use (number keys back to strings, missing fields)
function P.Fix(d)
	if not istable(d) then return P.New() end
	local base = P.New()
	for k, v in pairs(base) do
		if d[k] == nil then d[k] = v end
	end
	for _, field in ipairs({ "doors", "scores", "opened" }) do
		local fixed = {}
		for k, v in pairs(istable(d[field]) and d[field] or {}) do fixed[tostring(k)] = v end
		d[field] = fixed
	end
	-- the tree is a list
	local tree = {}
	for _, o in pairs(istable(d.tree) and d.tree or {}) do
		if istable(o) and AN.OrnamentById[o.id] then tree[#tree + 1] = { id = o.id, x = tonumber(o.x) or 0, y = tonumber(o.y) or 0 } end
	end
	d.tree = tree
	return d
end

-- has anything been played / collected at all?
function P.HasProgress(d)
	return istable(d) and (next(d.doors or {}) ~= nil or (d.coins or 0) > 0 or next(d.inv or {}) ~= nil or #(d.tree or {}) > 0)
end

function P.DoneCount(d)
	local c = 0
	for i = 1, 24 do
		local x = d.doors[tostring(i)]
		if x and x.done then c = c + 1 end
	end
	return c
end

function P.OwnedCount(d)
	local c = #d.tree
	for _, v in pairs(d.inv) do c = c + v end
	return c
end

local function better(a, b, lower)
	if lower then return a < b end
	return a > b
end

-- a finished game. returns isRecord (your own best)
local function dropId(list, id)
	if not id then return end
	for i = #list, 1, -1 do
		if list[i].id == id then table.remove(list, i) end
	end
end

-- a game with levels saves its running score after every level, so the levels already done count
-- even if the game is left or the player drops out. The run's entry is replaced by every later save
-- and by the final result.
function P.RunProgress(d, n, value, lower, hint, t, id)
	local key = tostring(n)
	local x = d.doors[key] or { plays = 0 }
	x.done = true
	if x.bestId == id then
		x.best, x.hint = value, hint or nil
	elseif x.best == nil or better(value, x.best, lower) then
		-- remember the best from before this run, so the final result can still count as a record
		x.prevBest, x.prevHint, x.bestId = x.best, x.hint, id
		x.best, x.hint = value, hint or nil
	end
	d.doors[key] = x
	local list = d.scores[key] or {}
	dropId(list, id)
	list[#list + 1] = { v = value, t = t or os.time(), h = hint or nil, id = id }
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return better(a.v, b.v, lower) end)
	while #list > P.MAX_SCORES do table.remove(list) end
	d.scores[key] = list
end

function P.RecordResult(d, n, value, lower, hint, t, id)
	local key = tostring(n)
	local x = d.doors[key] or { plays = 0 }
	if id and x.bestId == id then
		x.best, x.hint = x.prevBest, x.prevHint
	end
	x.bestId, x.prevBest, x.prevHint = nil, nil, nil
	x.done = true
	x.plays = (x.plays or 0) + 1
	local isRecord = x.best == nil or better(value, x.best, lower)
	if isRecord then
		x.best = value
		x.hint = hint or nil
	end
	d.doors[key] = x
	local list = d.scores[key] or {}
	dropId(list, id)
	list[#list + 1] = { v = value, t = t or os.time(), h = hint or nil, id = id }
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return better(a.v, b.v, lower) end)
	while #list > P.MAX_SCORES do table.remove(list) end
	d.scores[key] = list
	return isRecord
end

-- the ornament you are saving up for
function P.NextReward(d)
	local idx
	if (d.rewardIndex or 0) >= 0 then
		idx = AN.RewardOrder[(d.rewardIndex or 0) + 1]
	else
		-- the original picks at random once the fixed order has run out; here it is a fixed
		-- shuffle so the server and the player's screen agree on it
		local c = d.randCount or 0
		idx = AN.RewardOrder[(c * 37 + 11) % (#AN.RewardOrder - 1) + 1]
	end
	return AN.Ornaments[idx + 1]
end

-- the original reward: add pebernødder; when you have enough you get the next ornament.
-- returns { won, oldCoins, price, item (or nil), newPrice, coins }
function P.GiveCoins(d, won)
	won = math.Clamp(math.floor(tonumber(won) or 0), 0, 10)
	local res = { won = won, oldCoins = d.coins, price = P.NextReward(d).price }
	d.coins = d.coins + won
	local item = P.NextReward(d)
	if d.coins >= item.price then
		d.inv[item.id] = (d.inv[item.id] or 0) + 1
		d.coins = d.coins - item.price
		res.item = item
		if (d.rewardIndex or 0) >= 0 then
			d.rewardIndex = (d.rewardIndex or 0) + 1
			if d.rewardIndex >= #AN.RewardOrder then d.rewardIndex = -1 end
		else
			d.randCount = (d.randCount or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	res.newPrice = P.NextReward(d).price
	res.coins = d.coins
	return res
end

function P.SetOpened(d, n, open)
	n = tonumber(n)
	if not n or n < 1 or n > 24 then return end
	d.opened[tostring(n)] = (open ~= false) or nil
end

function P.PlaceOrnament(d, id, x, y)
	if (d.inv[id] or 0) <= 0 then return false end
	d.inv[id] = d.inv[id] - 1
	if d.inv[id] <= 0 then d.inv[id] = nil end
	d.tree[#d.tree + 1] = { id = id, x = tonumber(x) or 0, y = tonumber(y) or 0 }
	return true
end

function P.MoveOrnament(d, i, x, y)
	local o = d.tree[tonumber(i) or 0]
	if not o then return end
	o.x, o.y = tonumber(x) or o.x, tonumber(y) or o.y
end

function P.RemoveOrnament(d, i)
	i = tonumber(i) or 0
	local o = d.tree[i]
	if not o then return end
	table.remove(d.tree, i)
	d.inv[o.id] = (d.inv[o.id] or 0) + 1
end

-- apply one action (the client does it at once, the server does the same and saves it)
-- a result key: a calendar door (1-24) or a season game's list (game * 10 + difficulty, 1010-2999)
function P.ValidN(n) return n and ((n >= 1 and n <= 24) or (n >= 1010 and n <= 2999)) end

function P.Apply(d, act, a)
	a = a or {}
	if act == "result" then
		local n = tonumber(a.n)
		local v = tonumber(a.v)
		if not P.ValidN(n) or not v or v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return end
		local rec = P.RecordResult(d, n, v, a.lower == true, a.h == true, tonumber(a.t), isstring(a.id) and a.id or nil)
		if n > 24 then return rec, { won = 0, coins = d.coins } end
		local res = P.GiveCoins(d, a.won)
		return rec, res
	elseif act == "run" then
		local n = tonumber(a.n)
		local v = tonumber(a.v)
		if not P.ValidN(n) or not v or v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge or not isstring(a.id) then return end
		P.RunProgress(d, n, v, a.lower == true, a.h == true, tonumber(a.t), a.id)
	elseif act == "open" then
		P.SetOpened(d, a.n, a.open)
	elseif act == "place" then
		return P.PlaceOrnament(d, a.id, a.x, a.y)
	elseif act == "move" then
		P.MoveOrnament(d, a.i, a.x, a.y)
	elseif act == "remove" then
		P.RemoveOrnament(d, a.i)
	elseif act == "reset" then
		local fresh = P.New()
		for k in pairs(d) do d[k] = nil end
		for k, v in pairs(fresh) do d[k] = v end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The shared highscore lists (one per game, everyone on the server)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
P.HS_MAX = 10

-- entry = { sid = steamid64, name = nick, v = value, t = time, h = hint used, id = unique id }
function P.InsertScore(list, e, lower)
	if e.id then
		for i = #list, 1, -1 do
			if list[i].id == e.id then table.remove(list, i) end
		end
	end
	list[#list + 1] = e
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if a.v == b.v then return (a.t or 0) < (b.t or 0) end
		return better(a.v, b.v, lower)
	end)
	while #list > P.HS_MAX do table.remove(list) end
	return list
end

-- Server side saving: every player's progress per Steam ID, the shared highscore lists and the
-- player profiles. Stored in the server's data folder (in single-player and on a listen server
-- that is the host's own PC):
--   data/alletidersnisse/players/<steamid64>.json   { name = ..., prog = { ... } }
--   data/alletidersnisse/highscores.json            { ["4"] = { lower = true, list = { ... } } }
--     (games with levels also have a list per level: ["1:L3"] = door 1, level 3)
AN = AN or {}
local P = AN.Prog

local DIR = "alletidersnisse"
local PDIR = DIR .. "/players"
local HSPATH = DIR .. "/highscores.json"

util.AddNetworkString("an_hello")    -- C>S: I'm ready (+ my old local save, if any)
util.AddNetworkString("an_act")      -- C>S: one progress action
util.AddNetworkString("an_prog")     -- S>C: your progress
util.AddNetworkString("an_imported") -- S>C: your old local save was taken over
util.AddNetworkString("an_hs")       -- S>C: highscore lists (all, or one door)
util.AddNetworkString("an_prof")     -- C>S: ask for a profile / S>C: the profile
util.AddNetworkString("an_players")  -- C>S: ask for the player list / S>C: the list

local function ensureDirs()
	if not file.IsDir(DIR, "DATA") then file.CreateDir(DIR) end
	if not file.IsDir(PDIR, "DATA") then file.CreateDir(PDIR) end
end

local function sendTable(t)
	local s = util.Compress(util.TableToJSON(t)) or ""
	net.WriteUInt(#s, 32)
	net.WriteData(s, #s)
end

local function readTable(maxLen)
	local len = net.ReadUInt(32)
	if len <= 0 or len > (maxLen or 262144) then return nil end
	local s = util.Decompress(net.ReadData(len) or "", 1048576)
	if not s then return nil end
	return util.JSONToTable(s)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- players
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local cache = {}   -- sid -> { name, prog }

local function validSid(sid)
	return isstring(sid) and string.match(sid, "^%d+$") ~= nil and #sid < 24
end

local function playerPath(sid) return PDIR .. "/" .. sid .. ".json" end

local function loadPlayer(sid)
	if cache[sid] then return cache[sid], true end
	local exists = file.Exists(playerPath(sid), "DATA")
	local rec
	if exists then
		rec = util.JSONToTable(file.Read(playerPath(sid), "DATA") or "")
	end
	if not istable(rec) then rec = { name = "?", prog = P.New() } end
	rec.prog = P.Fix(rec.prog)
	cache[sid] = rec
	return rec, exists
end

local function savePlayer(sid)
	local rec = cache[sid]
	if not rec then return end
	ensureDirs()
	file.Write(playerPath(sid), util.TableToJSON(rec))
end

local function sidOf(ply)
	if game.SinglePlayer() or ply:IsListenServerHost() then
		-- the host of a local game; bots and offline games still get one fixed id
		local s = ply:SteamID64()
		if not validSid(s) or s == "0" then return "local" end
		return s
	end
	local s = ply:SteamID64()
	if not validSid(s) then return "bot" end
	return s
end

local function sendProg(ply)
	local sid = sidOf(ply)
	local rec = loadPlayer(sid)
	net.Start("an_prog")
	net.WriteString(sid)
	sendTable(rec.prog)
	net.Send(ply)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- highscores
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local hs = nil

local function loadHS()
	if hs then return hs end
	hs = {}
	if file.Exists(HSPATH, "DATA") then
		local t = util.JSONToTable(file.Read(HSPATH, "DATA") or "")
		if istable(t) then
			for k, v in pairs(t) do
				if istable(v) and istable(v.list) then hs[tostring(k)] = v end
			end
		end
	end
	return hs
end

local function saveHS()
	ensureDirs()
	file.Write(HSPATH, util.TableToJSON(loadHS()))
end

local function sendHS(target, n)
	local all = loadHS()
	local out = {}
	if n then out[tostring(n)] = all[tostring(n)] or { list = {} } else out = all end
	net.Start("an_hs")
	net.WriteBool(n == nil)
	sendTable(out)
	if target then net.Send(target) else net.Broadcast() end
end

local function addScore(n, e, lower)
	local all = loadHS()
	local key = tostring(n)
	local door = all[key] or { list = {} }
	door.lower = lower
	P.InsertScore(door.list, e, lower)
	all[key] = door
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- messages
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
net.Receive("an_hello", function(len, ply)
	local sid = sidOf(ply)
	local legacy = net.ReadBool() and readTable() or nil
	local rec, existed = loadPlayer(sid)
	rec.name = ply:Nick()
	local local_ = game.SinglePlayer() or ply:IsListenServerHost()
	-- the progress from before saving moved to the server: only taken over on the player's own
	-- PC (single-player / their own listen server), and only if nothing is saved here yet
	if istable(legacy) and local_ and not (existed and P.HasProgress(rec.prog)) then
		local lowerOf = istable(legacy.lower) and legacy.lower or {}
		legacy.lower = nil
		rec.prog = P.Fix(legacy)
		-- their old results go on the highscore lists too
		for key, list in pairs(rec.prog.scores) do
			local n = tonumber(key)
			local lower = lowerOf[key] == true
			if n and istable(list) then
				for i, s in ipairs(list) do
					if tonumber(s.v) then
						addScore(n, { sid = sid, name = rec.name, v = tonumber(s.v), t = tonumber(s.t) or 0, h = s.h or nil, id = sid .. ":old:" .. key .. ":" .. i }, lower)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		saveHS()
		net.Start("an_imported")
		net.Send(ply)
	end
	savePlayer(sid)
	sendProg(ply)
	sendHS(ply)
end)

net.Receive("an_act", function(len, ply)
	local act = net.ReadString()
	local a = readTable(65536) or {}
	local sid = sidOf(ply)
	local rec = loadPlayer(sid)
	rec.name = ply:Nick()
	P.Apply(rec.prog, act, a)
	if (act == "result" or act == "run") and tonumber(a.n) and tonumber(a.v) then
		addScore(tonumber(a.n), {
			sid = sid, name = rec.name, v = tonumber(a.v), t = os.time(), h = a.h == true or nil,
			id = isstring(a.id) and string.sub(a.id, 1, 64) or (sid .. ":" .. os.time()),
		}, a.lower == true)
		saveHS()
		sendHS(nil, tonumber(a.n))
	end
	if act == "lvl" and tonumber(a.n) and tonumber(a.l) and tonumber(a.v) then
		local n, l, v = math.floor(tonumber(a.n)), math.floor(tonumber(a.l)), tonumber(a.v)
		if n >= 1 and n <= 24 and l >= 1 and l <= 99 and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge then
			local key = n .. ":L" .. l
			addScore(key, {
				sid = sid, name = rec.name, v = v, t = os.time(), h = a.h == true or nil,
				id = isstring(a.id) and string.sub(a.id, 1, 64) or (sid .. ":" .. os.time()),
			}, a.lower == true)
			saveHS()
			sendHS(nil, key)
		end
		return
	end
	savePlayer(sid)
	-- the client already did the same; send the result back so the two never drift apart
	sendProg(ply)
end)

-- a profile: name, progress summary, best results and the decorated tree
local function profileOf(sid)
	local rec = loadPlayer(sid)
	local d = rec.prog
	local best = {}
	for k, x in pairs(d.doors) do
		if x.done then best[k] = { v = x.best, h = x.hint, plays = x.plays } end
	end
	local online = false
	for _, p in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
		if sidOf(p) == sid then online = true end
	end
	return {
		sid = sid, name = rec.name, online = online,
		done = P.DoneCount(d), coins = d.coins, owned = P.OwnedCount(d),
		next = P.NextReward(d).id, best = best, tree = d.tree,
	}
end

net.Receive("an_prof", function(len, ply)
	local sid = net.ReadString()
	if sid ~= "local" and not validSid(sid) then return end
	if not file.Exists(playerPath(sid), "DATA") and not cache[sid] then return end
	net.Start("an_prof")
	sendTable(profileOf(sid))
	net.Send(ply)
end)

net.Receive("an_players", function(len, ply)
	local out, seen = {}, {}
	for _, p in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
		local sid = sidOf(p)
		if not seen[sid] then
			seen[sid] = true
			local rec = loadPlayer(sid)
			out[#out + 1] = { sid = sid, name = p:Nick(), online = true, done = P.DoneCount(rec.prog) }
		end
	end
	local files = file.Find(PDIR .. "/*.json", "DATA") or {}
	for _, f in ipairs(files) do
		local sid = string.StripExtension(f)
		if not seen[sid] and #out < 200 then
			seen[sid] = true
			local rec = loadPlayer(sid)
			out[#out + 1] = { sid = sid, name = rec.name, online = false, done = P.DoneCount(rec.prog) }
		end
	end
	net.Start("an_players")
	sendTable(out)
	net.Send(ply)
end)

-- keep the remembered name up to date, and free the cache of players who left
hook.Add("PlayerDisconnected", "an_save", function(ply)
	local sid = sidOf(ply)
	savePlayer(sid)
end)
-- Versus on a server ("Kapløb"): one player invites the others to a door, everyone who joins
-- plays the same game (same random seed) at the same time, live scores are passed around, and
-- at the end everyone gets the ranking. Each player's result is saved by their own client as usual.
util.AddNetworkString("an_vs")

local races = {}
local nextId = 1

local function send(plys, kind, fn)
	net.Start("an_vs")
	net.WriteString(kind)
	if fn then fn() end
	net.Send(plys)
end

local function members(r)
	local t = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(r.players) do if IsValid(p) then t[#t + 1] = p end end
	r.players = t
	return t
end

local function writeList(r)
	local ps = members(r)
	net.WriteUInt(#ps, 8)
	for _, p in ipairs(ps) do
		net.WriteString(p:SteamID64() or "local")
		net.WriteString(p:Nick())
	end
end

local function lobby(r)
	send(members(r), "lobby", function()
		net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
		net.WriteUInt(r.n, 8)
		net.WriteString(IsValid(r.host) and r.host:SteamID64() or "")
		writeList(r)
	end)
end

local function finishCheck(r)
	if r.state ~= "run" then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(members(r)) do
		if not r.results[p] then return end
	end
	-- everyone is done: the ranking (best first; time games lower is better)
	local list = {}
	for p, res in pairs(r.results) do
		list[#list + 1] = { sid = IsValid(p) and p:SteamID64() or res.sid, name = res.name, v = res.v, quit = res.quit }
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		if a.quit ~= b.quit then return not a.quit end
		if r.lower then return a.v < b.v end
		return a.v > b.v
	end)
	local to = {}
	for p in pairs(r.results) do if IsValid(p) then to[#to + 1] = p end end
	send(to, "result", function()
		net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
		net.WriteUInt(r.n, 8)
		net.WriteUInt(#list, 8)
		for _, e in ipairs(list) do
			net.WriteString(e.sid or "")
			net.WriteString(e.name or "?")
			net.WriteFloat(e.v or 0)
			net.WriteBool(e.quit and true or false)
		end
	end)
	races[r.id] = nil
end

local function leave(r, ply, quit)
	if r.state == "lobby" then
		if ply == r.host then
			send(members(r), "cancel", function() net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16) end)
			races[r.id] = nil
			return
		end
		table.RemoveByValue(r.players, ply)
		lobby(r)
	elseif not r.results[ply] then
		r.results[ply] = { name = ply:Nick(), sid = ply:SteamID64(), v = 0, quit = true }
		send(members(r), "done", function()
			net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
			net.WriteString(ply:SteamID64() or "")
			net.WriteFloat(0)
			net.WriteBool(true)
		end)
		finishCheck(r)
	end
end

net.Receive("an_vs", function(len, ply)
	local kind = net.ReadString()
	if kind == "invite" then
		local n = net.ReadUInt(8)
		local lower = net.ReadBool()
		-- one race at a time per player
		for _, r in pairs(races) do if table.HasValue(r.players, ply) then leave(r, ply) end end
		local r = { id = nextId, n = n, lower = lower, host = ply, players = { ply }, state = "lobby", results = {},
			seed = math.random(1, 2000000000), t = CurTime() }
		nextId = nextId % 60000 + 1
		races[r.id] = r
		local others = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(player.GetHumans()) do if p ~= ply then others[#others + 1] = p end end
		send(others, "invite", function()
			net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
			net.WriteUInt(n, 8)
			net.WriteString(ply:Nick())
		end)
		lobby(r)
	else
		local id = net.ReadUInt(16)
		local r = races[id]
		if not r then return end
		if kind == "join" and r.state == "lobby" then
			if not table.HasValue(r.players, ply) then r.players[#r.players + 1] = ply end
			lobby(r)
		elseif kind == "leave" then
			leave(r, ply)
		elseif kind == "start" and ply == r.host and r.state == "lobby" then
			r.state = "run"
			send(members(r), "go", function()
				net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
				net.WriteUInt(r.n, 8)
				net.WriteUInt(r.seed, 32)
				writeList(r)
			end)
		elseif kind == "live" and r.state == "run" then
			local text = string.sub(net.ReadString(), 1, 80)
			if (r.liveAt and r.liveAt[ply] or 0) > CurTime() - 0.3 then return end
			r.liveAt = r.liveAt or {}
			r.liveAt[ply] = CurTime()
			local to = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(members(r)) do if p ~= ply then to[#to + 1] = p end end
			send(to, "live", function()
				net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
				net.WriteString(ply:SteamID64() or "")
				net.WriteString(text)
			end)
		elseif kind == "done" and r.state == "run" and not r.results[ply] then
			local v = net.ReadFloat()
			r.results[ply] = { name = ply:Nick(), sid = ply:SteamID64(), v = v, quit = false }
			send(members(r), "done", function()
				net.WriteUInt(r.id, 16)
				net.WriteString(ply:SteamID64() or "")
				net.WriteFloat(v)
				net.WriteBool(false)
			end)
			finishCheck(r)
		end
	end
end)

hook.Add("PlayerDisconnected", "AN_VsLeave", function(ply)
	for _, r in pairs(races) do
		if table.HasValue(r.players, ply) then leave(r, ply, true) end
	end
end)

-- a lobby nobody starts goes away after two minutes
timer.Create("AN_VsClean", 10, 0, function()
	for id, r in pairs(races) do
		if r.state == "lobby" and CurTime() - r.t > 120 then
			send(members(r), "cancel", function() net.WriteUInt(id, 16) end)
			races[id] = nil
		end
	end
end)

-- The classic look: the original main screen (main.swf, the loft with the 24 doors) played as it
-- was, 800 x 600 in the middle of the screen. Its frame scripts are ported to Lua below; the
-- progress (open doors, ornaments, pebernødder, scores) is the same save as the modern look.
AN = AN or {}
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/cl_fl.lua")
include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/cl_auto.lua")
include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/clpk_fl.lua")
include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/clsk_fl.lua")

local CL = AN.Classic or {}
AN.Classic = CL
local LIB = "cl"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local DOC_W, DOC_H = 800, 600
CL.FPS = 25

-- the classic look (the loft) and the jul.tv2.dk look (its own calendar) both play the games in
-- the original frame from main.swf
function CL.Look() local l = AN.Save.Get("look") return (l == "classic" or l == "tv2") and l or nil end
function CL.Active() return CL.Look() ~= nil end

-- the 800 x 600 document filling the screen height, black around it
function CL.Place()
	local k = AN.VH / DOC_H
	if DOC_W * k > AN.VW then k = AN.VW / DOC_W end
	MG.sw, MG.sh = DOC_W, DOC_H
	MG.k = k
	MG.x0 = (AN.VW - DOC_W * k) / 2
	MG.y0 = -(AN.OY or 0) + (AN.VH - DOC_H * k) / 2
end
function MG.ClassicStage()
	CL.Place()
	surface.SetDrawColor(0, 0, 0, 255)
	surface.DrawRect(0, 0, ScrW(), ScrH())
	render.SetScissorRect(AN.PX(MG.x0), AN.SY(MG.y0), AN.PX(MG.x0 + DOC_W * MG.k), AN.SY(MG.y0 + DOC_H * MG.k), true)
end
function MG.ClassicEnd() render.SetScissorRect(0, 0, 0, 0, false) end

-- the mouse in document coordinates
function CL.Mouse()
	CL.Place()
	return (UI.mx - MG.x0) / MG.k, (UI.my - MG.y0) / MG.k
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Small helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function itemM(it) return { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] } end
local function child(c, ...)
	for _, nm in ipairs({ ... }) do
		c = c and FL.Child(c, nm)
	end
	return c
end
CL.Child = child
-- a clip's own matrix inside its parent (as a script sees _x, _y, _xscale ...)
local function ownM(c)
	if c.mat then return c.mat end
	local p = c.parent
	if not p then return I end
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(p)) do
		if p.kids[it[3]] == c then return itemM(it) end
	end
	-- (a clip's own frame script runs while it is being made, before its parent lists it)
	if c.name then
		local lname = string.lower(c.name)
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(p)) do
			if it.nm and string.lower(it.nm) == lname and not p.kids[it[3]] then return itemM(it) end
		end
	end
	return I
end
CL.OwnM = ownM
local function setXY(c, x, y)
	local m = ownM(c)
	c.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], x, y }
end

-- every live clip under c (also invisible ones) with its stage matrix: fn(clip, M, visible)
local function walk(c, M, vis, fn)
	if not c then return end
	fn(c, M, vis)
	vis = vis and c.visible
	if c.kind == "spr" then
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
			local k = c.kids[it[3]]
			if k and not it.cd then walk(k, TL.Mul(M, k.mat or itemM(it)), vis, fn) end
		end
		if c.extra then
			for _, e in ipairs(c.extra) do walk(e.c, TL.Mul(M, e.m), vis, fn) end
		end
	end
end
CL.Walk = walk

-- attachMovie: a new clip on top of c's own children
function CL.Attach(c, ref, name, m, lib)
	local k = FL.New(lib or c.lib or LIB, ref, c, name)
	c.extra = c.extra or {}
	c.extra[#c.extra + 1] = { c = k, m = m or { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }, name = name }
	return k
end
function CL.Attached(c, name)
	for _, e in ipairs(c.extra or {}) do
		if e.name == name then return e.c, e end
	end
end

-- the date, like the original's decemberDate: 1 = 1 December (0 = 30 November, -1 = 29 November ...)
function CL.DecemberDate()
	local now = os.date("*t")
	local y = now.year
	if now.month < 11 then y = y - 1 end
	local dec1 = os.time({ year = y, month = 12, day = 1, hour = 0 })
	local today = os.time({ year = now.year, month = now.month, day = now.day, hour = 0 })
	return math.floor((today - dec1) / 86400 + 0.5) + 1
end

function CL.Locked(n) return AN.DoorState(n) == "locked" end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The doors (sprite 1110, named "Låge1" .. "Låge24")
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local D = {}
CL.DoorFns = D

function D.Segs(c)
	local t = {}
	for i = 1, 12 do t[i] = FL.Child(c, "s" .. i) end
	return t
end

local function refXY(c, name)
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(c, name, I)
	if not m then return nil end
	return m[5], m[6]
end

-- Initialize_Placements
function D.Init(c)
	FL.Stop(c)
	local day = tonumber(string.match(c.name or "", "(%d+)$") or "") or 1
	c.vars.day = day
	CL.doors[day] = c
	local m = ownM(c)
	c.sx = math.sqrt(m[1] * m[1] + m[2] * m[2])
	c.sy = math.sqrt(m[3] * m[3] + m[4] * m[4])
	c.X, c.Y = m[5], m[6]
	local tlx = refXY(c, "refTL")
	local trx, try = refXY(c, "refTR")
	local _, bry = refXY(c, "refBR")
	c.boxW = (trx or 60) - (tlx or 0)
	c.boxH = (bry or 60) - (try or 0)
	-- the picture behind the door
	local content = FL.Child(c, "content")
	if content then
		content.extra = nil
		local pic = CL.Attach(content, 356, "content", { 1 / c.sx, 0, 0, 1 / c.sy, 0, 0 })
		FL.GotoAndStop(pic, day + 1)
		content.visible = false
	end
	local num = FL.Child(c, "num")
	if num then num.vars.daytxt = day end
	if AN.Save.Opened(day) and not CL.Locked(day) then
		FL.GotoAndStop(c, "open")
		if content then content.visible = true end
		for _, s in pairs(D.Segs(c)) do s.visible = false end
	end
end

-- updatePos: the door flap is drawn as 12 strips of the background, bent between the reference
-- points while the door turns (frames 2 - 8)
function D.UpdatePos(c)
	local segs = D.Segs(c)
	local tlx, tly = refXY(c, "refTL")
	local trx, try = refXY(c, "refTR")
	local blx, bly = refXY(c, "refBL")
	local brx, bry = refXY(c, "refBR")
	if not trx or not tlx or not blx or not brx then
		for _, s in pairs(segs) do s.visible = false end
		return
	end
	local n = 12
	local topSlope = (try - tly) / n
	local botSlope = (bry - bly) / n
	local swidth = trx - tlx
	local xacc, yacc, ybacc = tlx, tly, bly
	for t = 1, n do
		local s = segs[t]
		if s then
			s.visible = true
			local dh = (ybacc - yacc) / c.boxH * 100 / c.sy
			s.mat = { 1.1, 0, 0, dh / 100, xacc, yacc }
			local bg = FL.Child(s, "bg")
			if bg then bg.mat = { 1, 0, 0, 1, -(c.X + (t - 1) * 5 * c.sx), -c.Y } end
		end
		xacc = xacc + swidth / n
		yacc = yacc + topSlope
		ybacc = ybacc + botSlope
	end
end

-- Pyrus' roll: a line for every day, the days not open yet say when they come
function CL.FillPyrusRoll(holder)
	if not holder then return end
	holder.extra = nil
	local h = 20.6
	local dd = CL.DecemberDate()
	for g = 1, 24 do
		local early = CL.Locked(g)
		local k = CL.Attach(holder, early and 194 or 203, "link" .. (g - 1), { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, h * (g - 1) })
		k.vars.day = g
		k.vars.txt_day = g .. "."
		if not early then
			k.vars.txt_name = AN.GameName(g)
		elseif AN.UsesDate() then
			local left = g - dd
			k.vars.txt_name = left == 1 and AN.L("cl_roll_tomorrow") or AN.L("cl_roll_days", left)
		else
			k.vars.txt_name = AN.L("cl_roll_after", AN.BlockingDoor(g) or g - 1)
		end
		-- the button on a line plays the day (its script reads "day" from the line)
		for _, kid in pairs(k.kids) do kid.vars.day = g end
	end
end

-- the date at the top
function CL.DateText()
	local dd = CL.DecemberDate()
	local y = tonumber(os.date("%Y"))
	if dd < -1 and dd > -60 then return AN.L("cl_date_wait", 1 - dd), false
	elseif dd == -1 then return AN.L("cl_date_m1"), false
	elseif dd == 0 then return AN.L("cl_date_0"), false
	elseif dd >= 1 and dd < 23 then return AN.L("cl_date_day", dd, y), true
	elseif dd == 23 then return AN.L("cl_date_23"), true
	elseif dd == 24 then return AN.L("cl_date_24"), true
	elseif dd == 25 then return AN.L("cl_date_25"), true
	elseif dd == 26 then return AN.L("cl_date_26"), true
	elseif dd >= 27 and dd <= 31 then return AN.L("cl_date_day", dd, y), true
	end
	return AN.L("cl_date_next", AN.DaysToEve()), true
end

-- the tree in the loft with the player's own ornaments (the same tree as in the modern look)
function CL.DecorateTree(tree)
	if not tree then return end
	tree.extra = nil
	-- modern tree frame (820 wide, the image at its bottom) -> the tree clip's own coordinates
	local tx, ty, tw, th = AN.TreeImageRect()
	local fx, fy = 350 / tw, 428 / th
	local items, star = {}, nil
	for _, o in ipairs(AN.Save.Tree()) do
		local x, y = -186.2 + (o.x - tx) * fx, -187.25 + (o.y - ty) * fy
		if o.id == "star0" then star = { o.id, x, y } else items[#items + 1] = { o.id, x, y } end
	end
	if star then items[#items + 1] = star end
	for i, it in ipairs(items) do
		local k = CL.Attach(tree, it[1], "item" .. (i - 1), { 1, 0, 0, 1, it[2], it[3] })
		FL.Stop(k)
	end
	-- like the original: the tree comes to the loft on 14 December
	if AN.UsesDate() and CL.DecemberDate() < 14 then tree.visible = false end
end

-- the stage matrix of a clip (from the root)
function CL.RootMatrix(c)
	local chain = {}
	local k = c
	while k and k.parent do
		chain[#chain + 1] = k
		k = k.parent
	end
	if k ~= CL.root then
		-- an attached clip: look it up in its parent's extra list
	end
	local m = I
	for i = #chain, 1, -1 do
		local kk = chain[i]
		local em
		for _, e in ipairs(kk.parent.extra or {}) do
			if e.c == kk then em = e.m end
		end
		m = TL.Mul(m, em or ownM(kk))
	end
	return m
end

function CL.MainClick(param, data)
	param = AN.Upper(param)
	if param == "PYNTEKASSE" then
		CL.ShowMovie("holderPynt", "clpk")
		CL.HideButtons()
		local pk = CL.movies.holderPynt
		if pk then FL.GotoAndPlay(pk, "splash") end
	elseif param == "SCRAPBOG" then
		CL.ShowMovie("holderSkat", "clsk")
		AN.Speak("scrapbog_start")
		CL.HideButtons()
	elseif (param == "PYNTEKASSE_CLOSE" or param == "SKATTEKISTE_CLOSE") and CL.Look() == "tv2" then
		if param == "PYNTEKASSE_CLOSE" then CL.HideMovie("holderPynt") else CL.HideMovie("holderSkat") end
		AN.StopSpeech()
		UI.Open("tv2")
	elseif param == "PYNTEKASSE_CLOSE" then
		CL.HideMovie("holderPynt")
		CL.ShowButtons()
		CL.DecorateTree(child(CL.root, "tree"))
		AN.StopSpeech()
	elseif param == "SKATTEKISTE_CLOSE" then
		AN.StopSpeech()
		local sk = CL.movies.holderSkat
		local content = sk and FL.Child(sk, "content")
		if content then FL.GotoAndStop(content, 1) end
		CL.HideMovie("holderSkat")
		CL.ShowButtons()
	elseif param == "OPTIONS" then
		-- the original settings scroll, over the loft
		CL.HideButtons()
		CL.Opt.onClose = function()
			if CL.Look() ~= "classic" then UI.Open("main") else CL.ShowButtons() end
		end
		CL.Opt.Open()
	elseif param == "MAIN_PRECLOSE" then
		local gui = child(CL.root, "GUI")
		if gui then FL.GotoAndStop(gui, "quitconfirm") end
	elseif param == "MAIN_CLOSECONFIRM" then
		FL.GotoAndStop(CL.root, "credits")
	elseif param == "MAIN_CLOSE" then
		CL.Quit()
	elseif param == "LÅGE" then
		CL.StartDoor(data)
	elseif param == "LÅGE_FORBUDT" then
		AN.Speak("julekalender_forkert")
	end
end

function CL.FillScores(list)
	local pane = child(list, "scrollPane")

		r.vars.number = t

		else

		end

		if um then um.visible = false end
	end
end

-- times like the original: mm:ss:ttt
function CL.ScoreToTime(sec)
	local ms = math.floor((sec or 0) * 1000 + 0.5)
	local m = math.floor(ms / 60000)
	local s = math.floor(ms / 1000) - m * 60
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%03d", m, s, ms - m * 60000 - s * 1000)
end

	local run = n and AN.CurRun and AN.CurRun[n]
	local scr = UI.screen
	if run and run.total and scr and not scr.finished then
		scr.finished = true
		if scr.StopLoops then scr:StopLoops() end
		AN.FinishGame(n, run.total)
		return
	end
	if scr and scr.StopLoops then scr:StopLoops() end
	CL.GameBack(false)
end

function CL.Explain(c)
	local v = c.vars
	if c.parent then c.parent.vars.explainTxt = AN.L("cl_won_more", v.price - v.showing) end

function CL.CoinStep(c)
	local v = c.vars
	v.pause = v.pause + 1
	if v.pause >= 6 then
		if v.user + v.added >= v.price and not v.shown and v.item then
			v.state = 2
			local ra = FL.Child(c, "rewardAni")
			if ra then FL.GotoAndPlay(ra, "animon") end
		elseif v.added >= v.won then
			v.state = 2
		else
			local coin = FL.Child(c, "coin" .. v.showing)
			if coin then FL.GotoAndStop(coin, "on") end
			CL.Snd("triangel")
			v.showing = v.showing + 1
			v.pause = 0
			v.added = v.added + 1
		end
	end
	CL.Explain(c)
end

-- look only: every ornament you own, in rows
function P.DisplayInventory(root)
	local owned = P.Owned()
	root.vars.txt_noPynt = noPynt(owned)
	local holder = FL.Child(root, "invholder")
	if not holder then return end
	holder.extra = nil
	local area = FL.Child(root, "scrollarea1")
	local rowW = 350
	local rowH, spacing = 90, 20
	local row, rowX, n = 0, 0, 0
	for p = 0, #AN.Ornaments - 1 do
		for _ = 1, owned[p] do
			local k = CL.Attach(holder, pyntName(p), "item" .. n)
			FL.Stop(k)
			local x0, _, x1 = FL.Bounds(k, I, true)
			local w = (x0 and (x1 - x0) or 30) + spacing
			if rowX + w > rowW then row = row + 1 rowX = 0 end
			CL.SetXY(k, rowX + w / 2, rowH / 2 + row * rowH)
			rowX = rowX + w
			n = n + 1
		end
	end
end

-- decorating: a box for each kind you own (with how many), the tree as it is saved
function P.CreatePyntItems(root)
	P.root = root
	local owned = P.Owned()
	root.vars.txt_noPynt = noPynt(owned)
	root.vars.txt_info = AN.L("cl_pk_info", P.MAX)
	local holder = FL.Child(root, "invholder")
	if not holder then return end
	holder.extra = nil
	local col, row = 0, 0
	P.items = {}
	for p = 0, #AN.Ornaments - 1 do
		if owned[p] > 0 then
			local k = CL.Attach(holder, 94, "item" .. p, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 17 + 115 * col, 13 + 105 * row })
			k.vars.id = p
			k.vars.amount = owned[p]
			FL.GotoAndStop(k, "on")
			local g = FL.Child(k, "gfx")
			if g then FL.GotoAndStop(g, p + 1) end
			P.items[p] = k
			col = col + 1
			if col >= 3 then row = row + 1 col = 0 end
		end
	end
	-- the tree as it is saved
	local tree = FL.Child(root, "tree")
	if tree then tree.extra = nil end
	P.onTree = 0
	for _, o in ipairs(AN.Save.Tree()) do
		local i = pyntIndex(o.id)
		if i then
			local x, y = P.ToTree(o.x, o.y)
			P.PutOnTree(i, x, y)
		end
	end
end
function P.Amount(i, d)
	local k = P.items and P.items[i]
	if k then k.vars.amount = (k.vars.amount or 0) + d end
end
function P.PutOnTree(i, x, y)
	local tree = FL.Child(P.root, "tree")
	if not tree then return end
	P.Amount(i, -1)
	local k = CL.Attach(tree, pyntName(i), "item" .. i, { 1, 0, 0, 1, x, y })
	FL.Stop(k)
	k.vars.id = i
	P.onTree = P.onTree + 1
	-- an ornament on the tree can be dragged again (and off the tree, back into the box)
	k.mouse = {
		press = function(t) CL.StartDrag(t) end,
		release = function(t) P.ItemReleased(t) end,
		releaseOutside = function(t) P.ItemReleased(t) end,
	}
	if pyntName(i) == "star0" then
		-- the star on top of the others
		local list = tree.extra
		table.insert(list, table.remove(list, #list))
	end
	return k
end
function P.OnTree(k)
	local tree = FL.Child(P.root, "tree")
	local hit = tree and FL.Child(tree, "hitarea")
	if not hit then return false end
	local x, y = CL.GetXY(k)
	local m = CL.RootMatrix(tree)
	local dx, dy = m[1] * x + m[3] * y + m[5], m[2] * x + m[4] * y + m[6]
	local was = hit.visible
	hit.visible = true
	local ok = FL.HitPoint(hit, TL.Mul(m, ownM(hit)), dx, dy)
	hit.visible = was
	return ok
end
function P.Remove(k)
	local tree = k.parent
	for j, e in ipairs(tree.extra or {}) do
		if e.c == k then table.remove(tree.extra, j) break end
	end
end
function P.ItemReleased(k)
	CL.StopDrag()
	if not P.OnTree(k) then
		P.Amount(k.vars.id, 1)
		P.onTree = P.onTree - 1
		P.Remove(k)
	end
end

-- the scroll bar of the box (a small scroll component of its own)
function P.ScrollInit(sb)
	local root = sb.parent
	local clip, area = FL.Child(root, "invholder"), FL.Child(root, "scrollarea1")
	if not clip or not area then return end
	local _, cy0, _, cy1 = FL.Bounds(clip, I, true)
	local _, ay0, _, ay1 = FL.Bounds(area, I, true)
	local ch, ah = (cy1 or 0) - (cy0 or 0), (ay1 or 0) - (ay0 or 0)
	local _, top = CL.GetXY(area)
	sb.vars.top = top
	sb.vars.bot = -45 + top + (ch - ah) * -1
	local box, slider = FL.Child(sb, "sliderareabox"), FL.Child(sb, "slider")
	local _, by0, _, by1 = box and FL.Bounds(box, I, true)
	local _, sy0, _, sy1 = slider and FL.Bounds(slider, I, true)
	sb.vars.max = ((by1 or 0) - (by0 or 0)) - ((sy1 or 0) - (sy0 or 0))
	if slider then CL.SetXY(slider, 0, 0) end
	local cx = CL.GetXY(clip)
	CL.SetXY(clip, cx, top)
	sb.visible = ch >= ah
end
function P.ScrollTo(sb, y)
	local slider = FL.Child(sb, "slider")
	local max = sb.vars.max or 1
	y = math.Clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, max))
	if slider then local x = CL.GetXY(slider) CL.SetXY(slider, x, y) end
	local clip = FL.Child(sb.parent, "invholder")
	if clip and max > 0 then
		local cx = CL.GetXY(clip)
		CL.SetXY(clip, cx, (sb.vars.bot - sb.vars.top) * (y / max) + sb.vars.top)
	end
end
local function sliderY(sb) local slider = FL.Child(sb, "slider") local _, y = slider and CL.GetXY(slider) return y or 0 end

if not CL.uiOpen then CL.uiOpen = UI.Open end
function UI.Open(name, args)
	if name == "gamewrap" and args and (args.n or 0) > 100 then name = "sgame" end
	if CL.Active() then
		if name == "main" or name == "kalender" then
			name = CL.Look() == "tv2" and "tv2" or "classic"
		elseif name == "gamewrap" then
			args = args or {}
			if args.state == "over" then
				CL.GameOver(args.n, args.value, args.res)
			elseif CL.inGame and CL.root then
				-- a game left with its own button: back to its start board
				CL.uiOpen("classic", { keep = true, keepVoice = args.keepVoice })
				CL.cur = args.n or CL.cur
				CL.GameBack(false)
			elseif UI.screenName ~= "classic" then
				CL.uiOpen("classic", { door = args.n })
			else
				CL.StartDoor(args.n)
			end
			return
		end
	end
	return CL.uiOpen(name, args)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Running: ticks at 25 fps, onEnterFrame handlers, buttons under the mouse
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- one Flash frame of a whole movie: frames, then every clip's onEnterFrame, then the buttons
function CL.Step(root, state)
	FL.Tick(root)
	-- clips made by attachMovie are not in a timeline: they play here
	local list, att = {}, {}
	walk(root, I, true, function(c, M, vis)
		if c.onEnter then list[#list + 1] = c end
		if c.extra then
			for _, e in ipairs(c.extra) do att[#att + 1] = e.c end
		end
	end)
	for _, k in ipairs(att) do FL.Tick(k) end
	for _, c in ipairs(list) do
		if c.onEnter then c.onEnter(c) end
	end
end

-- a clip's place in its parent: _x / _y (for attached clips, their entry in the parent's list)
function CL.SetXY(c, x, y)
	for _, e in ipairs((c.parent and c.parent.extra) or {}) do
		if e.c == c then e.m = { e.m[1], e.m[2], e.m[3], e.m[4], x, y } return end
	end
	setXY(c, x, y)
end
function CL.GetXY(c)
	for _, e in ipairs((c.parent and c.parent.extra) or {}) do
		if e.c == c then return e.m[5], e.m[6] end
	end
	local m = ownM(c)
	return m[5], m[6]
end
-- a document point in a clip's own coordinates
function CL.ToLocal(c, x, y)
	local m = CL.RootMatrix(c)
	local det = m[1] * m[4] - m[2] * m[3]
	if math.abs(det) < 1e-9 then return 0, 0 end
	x, y = x - m[5], y - m[6]
	return (m[4] * x - m[3] * y) / det, (-m[2] * x + m[1] * y) / det
end
-- startDrag: the clip follows the mouse (lock = its centre on the mouse)
function CL.StartDrag(c, lock)
	local mx, my = CL.Mouse()
	local px, py = CL.ToLocal(c.parent, mx, my)
	local x, y = CL.GetXY(c)
	CL.drag = { c = c, dx = lock and 0 or x - px, dy = lock and 0 or y - py }
	CL.DragUpdate()
end
function CL.StopDrag() CL.drag = nil end
function CL.DragUpdate()
	local d = CL.drag
	if not d or not d.c.parent then return end
	local mx, my = CL.Mouse()
	local px, py = CL.ToLocal(d.c.parent, mx, my)
	CL.SetXY(d.c, px + d.dx, py + d.dy)
end

-- the topmost button under the mouse (with a script), its matrix
function CL.ButtonAt(root, x, y)
	local found, fm
	walk(root, I, true, function(c, M, vis)
		if vis and c.visible and ((c.kind == "btn" and BH(c)) or c.mouse) and FL.HitPoint(c, M, x, y) then
			found, fm = c, M
		end
	end)
	return found, fm
end

-- rollOver / rollOut, press / release like Flash buttons
-- the handlers of a button (its script, "this" = the timeline it is on) or of a clip with its own
-- onPress / onRelease (c.mouse, "this" = the clip)
local function H(b)
	if b.mouse then return b.mouse, b end
	return BH(b) or {}, b.parent
end
function CL.Mouse4(st, x, y, down)
	CL.DragUpdate()
	local b = (x and st.root) and CL.ButtonAt(st.root, x, y) or nil
	if b ~= st.hot then
		local old = st.hot
		st.hot = b
		if old then local h, t = H(old) if h.out then h.out(t, old) end end
		if b then local h, t = H(b) if h.over then h.over(t, b) end end
	end
	if down and not st.down then
		st.down = true
		st.pressed = b
		if b then local h, t = H(b) if h.press then h.press(t, b) end end
	elseif not down and st.down then
		st.down = false
		local p = st.pressed
		st.pressed = nil
		if p then
			local h, t = H(p)
			if p == b then
				if h.release then h.release(t, p) end
			elseif h.releaseOutside then
				h.releaseOutside(t, p)
			end
		end
	end
	-- the hand over buttons (only when that changes: some games hide the cursor themselves)
	local hand = b ~= nil
	if hand ~= st.hand then
		st.hand = hand
		if IsValid(UI.root) then UI.root:SetCursor(hand and "hand" or "arrow") end
		if not hand and UI.screen and UI.screen.cursorShown ~= nil then UI.screen.cursorShown = nil end
	end
end

local ox, oy = 0, 0

-- a slider: a thin line with the radio ring as the knob
local function slider(id, x, y, w, value, fn)
	local function set(vx)
		local dx = (vx - MG.x0) / MG.k - ox
		fn(math.Clamp(math.Round((dx - x) / w * 100), 0, 100))
	end
	button(id, x - 8, y - 10, w + 16, 20, nil, { silent = true, press = function(vx)
		set(vx)
		UI.BeginDrag({ move = function(vx2) set(vx2) end, release = function() Save.Write() end })
	end })
	AN.Box(MG.X(ox + x), MG.Y(oy + y - 1.5), MG.S(w), MG.S(3), SOFT)
	AN.Box(MG.X(ox + x), MG.Y(oy + y - 1.5), MG.S(w * value / 100), MG.S(3), RED)

	oy = (1080 - 700 * k) / 2 + 48 * k
end

local function X(x) return ox + x * k end
local function Y(y) return oy + y * k end

-- the board's own edge is (-20, -15) .. (819, 614): a wooden frame around it, like the game screens
local BOARD = { -20, -15, 839, 629 }
local FRAME = 26
local function boardFrame()
	local x, y = X(BOARD[1] - FRAME), Y(BOARD[2] - FRAME)
	local w, h = (BOARD[3] + 2 * FRAME) * k, (BOARD[4] + 2 * FRAME) * k
	AN.Box(x + 6, y + 16, w, h, Color(0, 0, 0, 110), 14)
	AN.ImgCover("ui/woodboard.png", x, y, w, h)
	AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(40, 14, 2, 150))
	AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, Color(30, 10, 2, 200), 0, 3)
	AN.Outline(x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h - 6, Color(255, 200, 140, 40), 0, 2)
	AN.Box(X(BOARD[1]) - 5, Y(BOARD[2]) - 5, BOARD[3] * k + 10, BOARD[4] * k + 10, Color(74, 31, 7))
end

local function part(name, alpha, sc, img)
	local r = WP[name]
	if not r then return end
	sc = sc or 1
	local w, h = r[3] * k * sc, r[4] * k * sc
	AN.Img("wrap/" .. (img or name) .. ".png", X(r[1] + r[3] / 2) - w / 2, Y(r[2] + r[4] / 2) - h / 2, w, h, alpha)
end

-- a plank button: the original image grows a little when the mouse is over it
local function plank(id, name, fn, img, opts)
	local r = WP[name]
	local hot = UI.Button(id, X(r[1]), Y(r[2]), r[3] * k, r[4] * k, fn, opts)
	part(name, 255, hot and 1.04 or 1, img)
	return hot
end

function S:Open(args)
	self.n = args.n or 4
	self.state = args.state or "start"
	self.page = 1
	self.res = args.res
	self.value = args.value
	self.entry = args.entry
	self.t0 = RealTime()
	self.shown = 0
	self.starAt = nil
	self.saidStar = false
	if self.res then self.shown = self.res.oldCoins end
	local slug = SLUG[self.n]
	-- Pyrus introduces the game and explains it (unless he is already doing that from the calendar)
	if self.state == "start" and not args.quiet and not AN.VoiceBusy() then
		AN.SpeakChain({ slug .. "_intro", "help_" .. slug })
	end
end

function S:SetState(st)
	self.state = st
	self.page = 1
	if st == "help" then AN.Speak("help_" .. SLUG[self.n]) else AN.StopSpeech() end
end

function S:Think()
	if self.state ~= "over" or not self.res then return end
	local res = self.res
	local target = math.min(res.oldCoins + res.won, res.price)
	local want = res.oldCoins + math.floor((RealTime() - self.t0 - 0.6) / COIN_STEP) + 1
	want = math.Clamp(want, res.oldCoins, target)
	while self.shown < want do
		self.shown = self.shown + 1
		AN.Sound("triangel")
	end
	if self.shown >= target and res.item and not self.starAt then
		self.starAt = RealTime() + 0.35
	end
	if self.starAt and not self.saidStar and RealTime() >= self.starAt then
		self.saidStar = true
		AN.Speak("megetgodt")
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function closeBtn(n)
	-- the X is part of the board artwork
	UI.Button("wrap_close", X(742), Y(0), 60 * k, 60 * k, function() UI.Open("kalender", { door = n }) end,
		{ voice = { "luk_rollover", 45 / 25 } })
	if UI.Hot("wrap_close") then AN.Glow(X(772), Y(30), 44 * k, C.gold, 0.35) end
end

-- the shared highscore list: place, result (+ the hint mark), and who got it.
-- Clicking a row opens that player's profile.
local function scoreList(n, y0, entry, back)
	local x, y, w = 470, y0 or 236, 270
	local size = math.floor(20 * k)
	-- games with levels: a tab for the whole game and one for each level
	local level, th = AN.ScoreTabs(n, X(x - 6), Y(y), (w + 12) * k, k, INK, "hs_tab")
	y = y + th / k
	local list = AN.Save.Scores(n, level)
	local rows = th > 0 and 9 or 10
	if #list == 0 then
		AN.TextWrap(AN.L("wrap_noscores"), "bold", size, X(x), Y(y), w * k, INK, 22 * k)
		return
	end
	local me = AN.Save.MySid()
	for i = 1, math.min(rows, #list) do
		local e = list[i]
		local yy = Y(y + (i - 1) * 30)
		local id = "hs_row" .. i
		local hot = UI.Button(id, X(x - 6), yy - 3 * k, (w + 12) * k, 28 * k, function()
			AN.UI.Open("profil", { sid = e.sid, back = back })
		end, { silent = true })
		if entry and e.id == entry then
			AN.Box(X(x - 6), yy - 3 * k, (w + 12) * k, 28 * k, Color(255, 215, 106), 6 * k)
		elseif hot then
			AN.Box(X(x - 6), yy - 3 * k, (w + 12) * k, 28 * k, Color(INK.r, INK.g, INK.b, 28), 6 * k)
		end
		AN.Text(i .. ".", "black", size, X(x + 24), yy, INK, 2)
		local vs = AN.FormatValue(n, e.v)
		AN.Text(vs, "black", size, X(x + 36), yy, INK)
		local vx = X(x + 36) + AN.TextSize(vs, "black", size)
		if e.h then AN.HintMark(vx + 13 * k, yy + 11 * k, 9 * k) end
		local nx = vx + (e.h and 28 or 12) * k
		local col = e.sid == me and Color(138, 42, 10) or Color(INK.r, INK.g, INK.b, 200)
		AN.TextEllipsis(e.name or "?", "bold", math.floor(17 * k), X(x + w), yy + 2 * k, X(x + w) - nx, col, 2)
	end
end

function S:PaintStart()
	local n = self.n
	part("start_board")
	part("scroll")
	if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
		part("start_scrolltxt")
	else
		AN.Text(AN.L("wrap_hiscore"), "title", math.floor(34 * k), X(616), Y(104), INK, 1)
		AN.TextWrap(AN.L("wrap_hiscore_sub"), "bold", math.floor(16 * k), X(467), Y(158), 245 * k, INK, 21 * k)
	end
	scoreList(n, nil, nil, { "gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true } })
	part(string.format("logo%02d", n))
	plank("wrap_start", "btn_start", function() self:Go() end)
	plank("wrap_help", "btn_help", function() self:SetState("help") end,
		AN.LangCode() ~= "da" and "btn_help_en" or nil)
	if AN.VS then AN.VS.BoardButtons(n, X(24), Y(540), k) end
	closeBtn(n)
end

function S:PaintHelp()
	local n = self.n
	part("help_base")
	if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
		part("help_title")
	else
		AN.Text(AN.L("wrap_help"), "title", math.floor(34 * k), X(600), Y(136), INK, 1)
	end
	-- the original page; in English the same page without its text, and the text translated
	local key = string.format("help%02d_%d", n, self.page)
	local en = AN.LangCode() ~= "da" and AN.Lang[AN.LangCode()][string.format("help_%02d_%d", n, self.page)]
	if istable(en) then
		part(key .. "_notext", 255, 1, key .. "_notext")
		local blocks = AN.HelpText[n .. "_" .. self.page] or {}
		for i, b in ipairs(blocks) do
			if en[i] then
				AN.TextWrap(en[i], "bold", math.floor(15.5 * k), X(b[1]), Y(b[2]), (b[3] + 6) * k, INK, 20.5 * k)
			end
		end
	else
		part(key)
	end
	local pages = AN.HelpPages[n] or 1
	if pages > 1 then
		local function arrow(id, name, d)
			local r = WP[name]
			local ok = (d < 0 and self.page > 1) or (d > 0 and self.page < pages)
			if ok then
				UI.Button(id, X(r[1] - 8), Y(r[2] - 14), (r[3] + 16) * k, (r[4] + 28) * k, function()
					self.page = math.Clamp(self.page + d, 1, pages)
				end)
			end
			part(name, ok and 255 or 70, UI.Hot(id) and 1.15 or 1)
		end
		arrow("wrap_prev", "help_prev", -1)
		arrow("wrap_next", "help_next", 1)
	end
	part(string.format("logo%02d", n))
	plank("wrap_start", "btn_start", function() self:Go() end)
	plank("wrap_hiscore", "btn_hiscore", function() self:SetState("start") end)
	if AN.VS then AN.VS.BoardButtons(n, X(24), Y(540), k) end
	closeBtn(n)
end

-- the game's logo on the game-over board is the same artwork at 0.8 scale around (103.8, 64.15)
local function goLogo(n)
	local r = WP[string.format("go_logo%02d", n)]
	if not r then return end
	local px, py, s = 103.8, 64.15, 0.8
	AN.Img(string.format("wrap/go_logo%02d.png", n), X(px + (r[1] - px) * s), Y(py + (r[2] - py) * s), r[3] * s * k, r[4] * s * k)
end

function S:PaintOver()
	local n, res = self.n, self.res
	part("go_base")
	goLogo(n)

	-- the right half held an advert in the original: the highscore scroll goes there,
	-- with the result you just got marked
	part("scroll")
	AN.Text(AN.L("wrap_hiscore"), "title", math.floor(34 * k), X(610), Y(104), INK, 1)
	scoreList(n, 170, self.entry, { "gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true } })

	AN.Text(AN.L("wrap_won"), "bold", math.floor(17 * k), X(16), Y(160), C.white)

	-- the nut grid: 40 slots, filled up to what you have towards the next ornament
	local cr = WP.coin_on
	for i = 0, 39 do
		local col, row = i % 8, math.floor(i / 8)
		local cx, cy = REWARD.x - 104.8 + 30 * col, REWARD.y - 56 + 28 * row
		local on = i < self.shown
		local pop = 1
		if on and i >= res.oldCoins then
			local t = RealTime() - self.t0 - 0.6 - (i - res.oldCoins) * COIN_STEP
			pop = 1 + 0.35 * math.max(0, 1 - t / 0.2)
		end
		local w, h = cr[3] * k * pop, cr[4] * k * pop
		AN.Img(on and "wrap/coin_on.png" or "wrap/coin_off.png",
			X(cx + cr[1] + cr[3] / 2) - w / 2, Y(cy + cr[2] + cr[4] / 2) - h / 2, w, h)
	end

	-- messages (original wording)
	local won = res.won
	local msg
	if won < 8 then msg = AN.L("wrap_won_lt8", won)
	elseif won < 10 then msg = AN.L("wrap_won_lt10", won)
	else msg = AN.L("wrap_won_10", won) end
	local y = Y(372)
	y = y + AN.TextWrap(msg, "bold", math.floor(15 * k), X(16), y, 262 * k, C.white, 19 * k) + 4 * k
	if res.item then
		if self.starAt and RealTime() >= self.starAt then
			AN.TextWrap(AN.L("wrap_got_item"), "bold", math.floor(15 * k), X(16), y, 262 * k, C.gold, 19 * k)
		end
	else
		AN.TextWrap(AN.L("box_need", res.price - res.coins), "bold", math.floor(15 * k), X(16), y, 262 * k, C.cream, 19 * k)
	end

	-- the star with the new ornament, over the nuts
	if self.starAt and RealTime() >= self.starAt then
		local t = RealTime() - self.starAt
		local a = math.Clamp(t / 0.25, 0, 1)
		local s = t < 0.3 and (0.4 + 0.8 * (t / 0.3)) or (1.2 - 0.2 * math.min(1, (t - 0.3) / 0.25))
		local cx, cy = X(REWARD.x), Y(REWARD.y)
		AN.Glow(cx, cy, 190 * k * s, Color(255, 250, 220), 0.9 * math.max(0, 1 - t / 0.8))
		local sr = WP.star
		AN.ImgRotated("wrap/star.png", cx, cy, sr[3] * k * s, sr[4] * k * s, math.sin(t * 0.8) * 6, 255 * a)
		local ox2, oy2, ow, oh = AN.OrnamentRect(res.item.id, 2.3 * k * s)
		AN.Img(res.item.img, cx - ow / 2, cy - oh / 2, ow, oh, 255 * a)
	end

	plank("wrap_videre", "go_videre", function() UI.Open("gamewrap", { n = n, state = "start", quiet = true }) end,
		AN.LangCode() ~= "da" and "go_videre_en" or nil)
	closeBtn(n)
end

function S:Go()
	AN.Sound("click")
	UI.Open("game" .. self.n, { n = self.n })
end

function S:Paint()
	layout()
	UI.Background("sub")
	AN.Box(0, -(AN.OY or 0), AN.VW, AN.VH or 1080, Color(20, 8, 2, 120))
	self:Think()
	boardFrame()
	if self.state == "help" then self:PaintHelp()
	elseif self.state == "over" and self.res then self:PaintOver()
	else self:PaintStart() end
	if X(-60) > 300 then AN.MG.SideGarland() end
end

-- Indstillinger: four categories on the left, their settings on the right. Saved instantly.
local UI, C = AN.UI, AN.Col
local Save = AN.Save
local S = {}
AN.Screens.indstillinger = S

function S:Open(args)
	self.cat = args.cat or "game"
	self.resetArm = 0
	self.resetDone = 0
end

-- a settings card with title + description; returns y after the card, and the y for controls
local function card(x, y, w, title, sub, h)
	local lines = AN.Wrap(sub, "bold", 19, w - 56 - (h and 0 or 0))
	local textH = 34 + #lines * 26
	h = h or (24 + textH + 16 + 64 + 24)
	UI.Card(x, y, w, h)
	AN.Text(title, "black", 26, x + 28, y + 22, C.white)
	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do AN.Text(l, "bold", 19, x + 28, y + 58 + (i - 1) * 26, C.sand) end
	return y + h + 16, y + 24 + textH + 16
end

-- card with the toggle on the right side
local function toggleHeight(w, sub) return 24 + 34 + #AN.Wrap(sub, "bold", 19, w - 56 - 160) * 26 + 24 end
local function toggleCard(id, x, y, w, title, sub, value, onToggle, hmin)
	local lines = AN.Wrap(sub, "bold", 19, w - 56 - 160)
	local h = math.max(hmin or 0, 24 + 34 + #lines * 26 + 24)
	UI.Card(x, y, w, h)
	AN.Text(title, "black", 26, x + 28, y + 22, C.white)
	for i, l in ipairs(lines) do AN.Text(l, "bold", 19, x + 28, y + 58 + (i - 1) * 26, C.sand) end
	UI.Toggle(id, x + w - 140, y + h / 2 - 20, value, onToggle)
	return y + h + 16
end

function S:Paint()
	local R = AN.R
	UI.Background("sub")
	UI.Shade("settings")
	UI.BackButton("main")

	local x, y = 110, 170
	AN.Img("ui/indstillinger.png", x, y, 300)
	y = y + 300 * AN.Ratio("ui/indstillinger.png") + 26
	local cats = {
		{ "game", AN.L("set_cat_game") },
		{ "lang", AN.L("set_cat_lang") },
		{ "screen", AN.L("set_cat_screen") },
		{ "server", AN.L("set_cat_server") },
	}
	local heading
	for _, c in ipairs(cats) do
		if c[1] == self.cat then heading = c[2] end
		UI.ListItem("cat_" .. c[1], x, y, 600, 84, c[2], nil, nil, self.cat == c[1], function() self.cat = c[1] end, nil, 40)
		y = y + 94
	end

	local rx, ry, rw = 860 + AN.C, 150, 960
	AN.Text(heading or "", "title", 56, rx, ry, C.white)
	ry = ry + 90

	if self.cat == "game" then
		local ny, cy = card(rx, ry, rw, AN.L("set_look"), AN.L("set_look_sub"))
		UI.Choice("look", rx + 28, cy, rw - 56, 64,
			{ { AN.L("set_modern"), "modern" }, { AN.L("set_classic"), "classic" }, { AN.L("set_tv2"), "tv2" } },
			Save.Get("look") or "modern", function(v) Save.Set("look", v) end)
		ry = ny
		ny, cy = card(rx, ry, rw, AN.L("set_doors"), AN.L("set_doors_sub"))
		UI.Choice("doors", rx + 28, cy, rw - 56, 64,
			{ { AN.L("set_follow_date"), "date" }, { AN.L("set_next_after"), "progress" } },
			Save.Get("doorRule"), function(v) Save.Set("doorRule", v) end)
		ry = ny
		-- hidden content and hints side by side
		local hw = (rw - 16) / 2
		local th = math.max(toggleHeight(hw, AN.L("set_hidden_sub")), toggleHeight(hw, AN.L("set_hints_sub")))
		toggleCard("hidden", rx, ry, hw, AN.L("set_hidden"), AN.L("set_hidden_sub"), Save.Get("hidden"),
			function(v) Save.Set("hidden", v) end, th)
		ry = toggleCard("hints", rx + hw + 16, ry, hw, AN.L("set_hints"), AN.L("set_hints_sub"), Save.Get("hints") ~= false,
			function(v) Save.Set("hints", v) end, th)

		-- reset needs two clicks
		local lines = AN.Wrap(AN.L("set_reset_sub"), "bold", 19, rw - 56 - 260)
		local h = 24 + 34 + #lines * 26 + 24
		UI.Card(rx, ry, rw, h)
		AN.Text(AN.L("set_reset"), "black", 26, rx + 28, ry + 22, C.white)
		for i, l in ipairs(lines) do AN.Text(l, "bold", 19, rx + 28, ry + 58 + (i - 1) * 26, C.sand) end
		local armed = RealTime() - self.resetArm < 3
		local done = RealTime() - self.resetDone < 2
		local label = done and AN.L("set_reset_done") or (armed and AN.L("set_reset_confirm") or AN.L("set_reset_btn"))
		local bw = math.max(150, AN.TextSize(label, "bold", 22) + 52)
		local bx, by = rx + rw - 28 - bw, ry + h / 2 - 30
		local hot = UI.Button("reset", bx, by, bw, 60, function()
			if armed then
				Save.Reset()
				self.resetArm = 0
				self.resetDone = RealTime()
			else
				self.resetArm = RealTime()
			end
		end)
		if armed then AN.Box(bx, by, bw, 60, Color(200, 32, 45, 200), 16) end
		AN.Outline(bx, by, bw, 60, C.bad, 16, 2)
		AN.Text(label, "bold", 22, bx + bw / 2, by + 30, (armed or hot) and C.white or C.badText, 1, 1)

	elseif self.cat == "lang" then
		local ny, cy = card(rx, ry, rw, AN.L("set_language"), AN.L("set_language_sub"))
		UI.Choice("lang", rx + 28, cy, rw - 56, 64, { { "Dansk", "da" }, { "English", "en" } },
			Save.Get("lang"), function(v) Save.Set("lang", v) end)
		ry = ny
		-- subtitles with an example line
		local lines = AN.Wrap(AN.L("set_subs_sub"), "bold", 19, rw - 56 - 160)
		local h = 24 + 34 + #lines * 26 + 24 + 70
		UI.Card(rx, ry, rw, h)
		AN.Text(AN.L("set_subs"), "black", 26, rx + 28, ry + 22, C.white)
		for i, l in ipairs(lines) do AN.Text(l, "bold", 19, rx + 28, ry + 58 + (i - 1) * 26, C.sand) end
		UI.Toggle("subs", rx + rw - 140, ry + 30, Save.Get("subs"), function(v) Save.Set("subs", v) end)
		if Save.Get("subs") then
			AN.Box(rx + 28, ry + h - 24 - 58, rw - 56, 58, Color(0, 0, 0, 140), 14)
			AN.Text(AN.L("set_sub_example"), "bold", 24, rx + rw / 2, ry + h - 24 - 29, C.white, 1, 1)
		end
		ry = ry + h + 16
		-- volumes
		UI.Card(rx, ry, rw, 3 * 52 + 48)
		local vols = { { "vol_music", "set_music" }, { "vol_fx", "set_fx" }, { "vol_voice", "set_voice" } }
		for i, v in ipairs(vols) do
			local ly = ry + 24 + (i - 1) * 52
			AN.Text(AN.L(v[2]), "black", 24, rx + 28, ly + 17, C.white, 0, 1)
			local val = Save.Get(v[1]) or 0
			UI.Slider(v[1], rx + 250, ly, rw - 250 - 110, val, function(nv)
				if nv ~= Save.Get(v[1]) then Save.Data().settings[v[1]] = nv end
			end)
			AN.Text(tostring(val), "black", 24, rx + rw - 28, ly + 17, C.gold, 2, 1)
		end

	elseif self.cat == "screen" then
		ry = toggleCard("blur", rx, ry, rw, AN.L("set_blur"), AN.L("set_blur_sub"), Save.Get("blur") ~= false,
			function(v) Save.Set("blur", v) end)

	else
		ry = toggleCard("share", rx, ry, rw, AN.L("set_share"), AN.L("set_share_sub"), Save.Get("share"),
			function(v) Save.Set("share", v) end)
	end

	UI.CornerButtons()
end

-- volume sliders write to the save file once the mouse is released
function S:Think()
	if not input.IsMouseDown(MOUSE_LEFT) and self.dirty then
		Save.Write()
		self.dirty = false
	end
	if input.IsMouseDown(MOUSE_LEFT) and UI.drag then self.dirty = true end
end

-- Julekalender: the selected door on the left, the 24 doors on the right.
local UI, C = AN.UI, AN.Col
local S = {}
AN.Screens.kalender = S

function S:Open(args)
	self.sel = args.door or AN.CurrentDoor() or 1
	self.how = false
end

local function drawGameTitle(n, x, y, maxw, maxh, size)
	if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
		AN.ImgFit(string.format("titles/%02d.png", n), x, y, maxw, maxh)
	else
		AN.TextFit(AN.GameName(n), "title", size, x, y + maxh / 2 + 6, maxw, AN.Col.shadow, 0, 1)
		AN.TextFit(AN.GameName(n), "title", size, x, y + maxh / 2, maxw, AN.Col.white, 0, 1)
	end
end
AN.DrawGameTitle = drawGameTitle

function S:Paint()
	local R = AN.R
	UI.Background("sub")
	UI.Shade("sub")
	UI.BackButton("main")

	local n = self.sel
	local g = AN.Games[n]
	local state, reason, rn = AN.DoorState(n)

	-- left: the selected door
	local x, y = 110, 160
	local head
	if AN.UsesDate() and n == AN.Today() then
		head = AN.L("cal_date", AN.Today(), n)
	else
		head = AN.L("cal_door", n)
	end
	AN.Text(head, "black", 22, x, y, C.gold)

	-- the game title (Danish: the original drawn logo; English: the name in the same font)
	if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
		local mh = 200
		local r = AN.Ratio(string.format("titles/%02d.png", n))
		local w = math.min(470, mh / r)
		AN.Img(string.format("titles/%02d.png", n), x - 10, y + 40, w)
		y = y + 40 + w * r + 14
	else

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The doors, like the original calendar: each door swings open on its hinge
-- and shows what is behind it (the game's artwork, or a photo from the series
-- once the game is completed). Doors you have opened stay open.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local OPEN_TIME = 0.55
local OPEN_ANGLE = 96

function S:DoorClicked(i)
	local st = AN.DoorState(i)
	if st == "locked" then
		AN.Speak("julekalender_forkert")
		self.shake = self.shake or {}
		self.shake[i] = RealTime()
		self.sel = i
		self.how = false
		return
	end
	self.anim = self.anim or {}
	if AN.Save.Opened(i) and self.sel ~= i then
		-- an open door that isn't chosen: choose it (and leave it open), ready to play
		AN.SpeakChain({ AN.GameSlug[i] .. "_intro", "help_" .. AN.GameSlug[i] })
		self.sel = i
		self.how = false
		return
	end
	if AN.Save.Opened(i) then
		-- the chosen door, clicked again: it closes, like in the original
		AN.Save.SetOpened(i, false)
		self.anim[i] = { t = RealTime(), closing = true }
		AN.Sound("flap")
		return
	end
	AN.Save.SetOpened(i)
	self.anim[i] = { t = RealTime() }
	AN.Sound("flap")
	if self.sel ~= i or not AN.VoiceBusy() then
		local slug = AN.GameSlug[i]
		AN.SpeakChain({ slug .. "_intro", "help_" .. slug })
	end
	self.sel = i
	self.how = false
end

-- what is behind door i
local function behind(i, st, x, y, w, h)
	AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(42, 16, 4), 16)
	if st == "done" then
		local p = string.format("stills/%02d.jpg", (i - 1) % 15 + 1)
		AN.ImgCover(p, x + 4, y + 4, w - 8, h - 8)
	else
		AN.ImgFit(string.format("wrap/logo%02d.png", i), x + 6, y + 6, w - 12, h - 12)
	end
	AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, Color(20, 8, 2, 200), 16, 3)
end

-- the closed door's face
local function face(i, st, x, y, w, h, hot)
	if st == "today" then
		AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(176, 24, 34), 16)
		AN.BoxEx(x, y, w, h / 2, Color(212, 42, 53), 16, true, true, false, false)
		AN.Text(tostring(i), "title", 56, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 - 10, C.white, 1, 1)
		AN.Text(AN.L("cal_today"), "black", 14, x + w / 2, y + h - 26, C.gold, 1)
	elseif st == "locked" then
		AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(20, 8, 2, 140), 16)
		AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, Color(255, 226, 170, hot and 110 or 56), 16, 2)
		AN.Text(tostring(i), "title", 50, x + w / 2, y + h / 2, Color(255, 226, 170, 115), 1, 1)
	else
		AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(20, 8, 2, 120), 16)
		AN.Box(x, y, w, h, Color(255, 241, 207, hot and 40 or 26), 16)
		AN.Outline(x, y, w, h, Color(255, 241, 207, hot and 90 or 41), 16, 2)
		AN.Text(tostring(i), "title", 52, x + w / 2, y + h / 2, C.cream, 1, 1)
	end
end

local function quad(pts, col)
	draw.NoTexture()
	surface.SetDrawColor(col.r, col.g, col.b, col.a or 255)
	local poly = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pts) do poly[#poly + 1] = { x = AN.PX(p[1]), y = AN.SY(p[2]) } end
	surface.DrawPoly(poly)
end

-- the swinging door: a rounded rectangle (same corners as the other doors) bent into the
-- perspective of a door turning on its left hinge. fw = how wide it looks now (negative =
-- folded out to the left), grow = how much taller its free edge looks.
local function roundedDoor(cx, cy, cw, ch, fw, grow, col)
	local r = 16
	-- keep the corners round on screen however narrow the door looks while turning
	local ru = math.min(0.5, r / math.max(1, math.abs(fw)))
	local pts = {}
	local function corner(u0, v0, a0)
		for s = 0, 6 do
			local a = math.rad(a0 + s * 15)
			pts[#pts + 1] = { u0 + math.cos(a) * ru, v0 + math.sin(a) * r }
		end
	end
	-- clockwise in door space: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left
	corner(ru, r, 180)
	corner(1 - ru, r, 270)
	corner(1 - ru, ch - r, 0)
	corner(ru, ch - r, 90)
	local out = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
		local u, v = p[1], p[2]
		local top = cy - u * grow
		local bot = cy + ch + u * grow
		out[#out + 1] = { cx + u * fw, top + (bot - top) * (v / ch) }
	end
	if fw < 0 then
		local rev = {}
		for j = #out, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = out[j] end
		out = rev
	end
	quad(out, col)
end

function S:DrawDoor(i, st, cx, cy, cw, ch, hot)
	-- locked doors shake when you try them
	local sh = self.shake and self.shake[i]
	if sh and RealTime() - sh < 0.4 then
		cx = cx + math.sin((RealTime() - sh) * 60) * 5 * (1 - (RealTime() - sh) / 0.4)
	end
	if st == "today" then
		AN.Glow(cx + cw / 2, cy + ch / 2, cw * 0.75, C.gold, 0.9)
		AN.Box(cx - 4, cy - 4, cw + 8, ch + 8, C.gold, 19)
	end
	local an = self.anim and self.anim[i]
	local running = an and RealTime() - an.t < OPEN_TIME
	local opened = (AN.Save.Opened(i) or (running and an.closing)) and st ~= "locked"
	if not opened then
		face(i, st, cx, cy, cw, ch, hot)
		return
	end
	behind(i, st, cx, cy, cw, ch)
	-- the door itself, swung open on its left hinge (or swinging shut again)
	local k = an and math.Clamp((RealTime() - an.t) / OPEN_TIME, 0, 1) or 1
	k = 1 - (1 - k) * (1 - k)
	if an and an.closing then k = 1 - k end
	local a = math.rad(OPEN_ANGLE * k)
	local fw = cw * math.cos(a)
	local grow = ch * 0.14 * math.sin(a)       -- the free edge comes towards you
	if fw > 2 then
		-- front of the door, still facing us
		local col = st == "today" and Color(190, 30, 40) or Color(74, 50, 38)
		roundedDoor(cx, cy, cw, ch, fw, grow, col)
		if fw > cw * 0.55 then
			AN.Text(tostring(i), "title", math.floor(52 * fw / cw), cx + fw / 2, cy + ch / 2, C.cream, 1, 1)
		end
	else
		-- past halfway: we see the back of the door, folded out to the left
		roundedDoor(cx, cy, cw, ch, math.min(fw, -2), grow, st == "today" and Color(120, 16, 24) or Color(52, 34, 24))
	end
	-- number badge on the open door (not while the door still covers it)
	if fw < cw * 0.2 then
		AN.Box(cx + 6, cy + 6, 30, 24, Color(20, 8, 2, 200), 8)
		AN.Text(tostring(i), "black", 16, cx + 21, cy + 9, C.cream, 1)
	end
	local d = AN.Save.Door(i)
	if st == "done" and d and AN.Games[i].made and d.best then
		local txt = tostring(AN.CoinsFor(i, d.best))
		local tw = AN.TextSize(txt, "black", 15) + 30
		AN.Box(cx + cw - tw - 6, cy + ch - 30, tw, 24, Color(20, 8, 2, 200), 8)
		AN.Img("wrap/coin_on.png", cx + cw - tw + 0, cy + ch - 27, 20, 17)
		AN.Text(txt, "black", 15, cx + cw - 12, cy + ch - 27, C.gold, 2)
	end
end

-- Hovedmenu: side panel on the left, the table group (Gyldengrød, Kandis, Pyrus)

local UI, C = AN.UI, AN.Col
local S = {}

-- The tree "frame" is 820 x 980 (same as the decoration box); the tree image sits at its bottom.
AN.TREE_W, AN.TREE_H = 820, 980

function AN.TreeImageRect()
	local w = AN.TREE_W
	local h = w * AN.Ratio("ui/trae.png")
	return 0, AN.TREE_H - h, w, h
end

-- draw the tree with the saved ornaments. x,y = top-left of the frame, sc = scale
-- soft = fake blur radius (virtual px), shade = 0..255 brightness
function AN.DrawTree(x, y, sc, soft, shade, skipIndex, tree)
	local col = Color(shade or 255, shade or 255, shade or 255)
	local tx, ty, tw, th = AN.TreeImageRect()
	local function img(path, ix, iy, iw)
		local ih = iw * AN.Ratio(path)
		if soft and soft > 0 then
			AN.ImgSoft(path, x + ix * sc, y + iy * sc, iw * sc, ih * sc, soft, 255, col)
		else
			AN.Img(path, x + ix * sc, y + iy * sc, iw * sc, ih * sc, 255, col)
		end
	end
	img("ui/trae.png", tx, ty, tw)
	for i, o in ipairs(tree or AN.Save.Tree()) do
		if i ~= skipIndex then
			local def = AN.OrnamentById[o.id]
			if def then
				local rx, ry, rw = AN.OrnamentRect(o.id, AN.ORN_TREE_SCALE)
				img(def.img, o.x + rx, o.y + ry, rw)
			end
		end
	end
end
