function G:Close()
	self:StopLoops()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.gui then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:StopLoops()
	AN.FinishGame(1, self.score or 0)
end

-- the buttons of the visible dialogs (their hit rectangles through their matrices)
local function findButtons(c, M, out)
	if not c or not c.visible then return end
	local L = AN.FLib[c.lib]
	local fr = c.def[4][c.frame]
	while type(fr) == "number" do fr = c.def[4][fr] end
	for _, it in ipairs(fr or {}) do
		local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
		if ch and not it.cd then
			local m = TL.Mul(M, { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] })
			if ch[1] == "btn" then
				local r = ch[3]
				local xs, ys = {}, {}
				for _, p in ipairs({ { r[1], r[2] }, { r[3], r[2] }, { r[1], r[4] }, { r[3], r[4] } }) do
					local x, y = TL.Apply(m, p[1], p[2])
					xs[#xs + 1], ys[#ys + 1] = x, y
				end
				out[#out + 1] = { cid = it[2], x0 = math.min(unpack(xs)), y0 = math.min(unpack(ys)), x1 = math.max(unpack(xs)), y1 = math.max(unpack(ys)) }
			elseif ch[1] == "spr" then
				findButtons(c.kids[it[3]], m, out)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- the dialogs' text fields: the game's values, and the loader's texts in the player's language
local LEVEL0 = { text_life = "g01_v_life", text_time = "g01_v_time", text_score = "g01_v_score", text_welldone = "g01_v_welldone",
	text_completed = "g01_v_completed", text_totalscore = "g01_v_total", text_gameover = "g01_t_over" }

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.gui then MG.Chrome(1) return end
	local game = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if LEVEL0[name] then return AN.L(LEVEL0[name]) end
		local v = game.vars[name]
		if v ~= nil then return v end
		return nil
	end

	-- the level and everything in it, through the camera
	local ax, ay = -self.camX + self.camOffX, -self.camY + self.camOffY
	local LM = { 1, 0, 0, 1, ax, ay }
	FL.Draw(self.level, LM)
	local m = self.mons
	FL.Draw(m.clip, { 1, 0, 0, 1, ax + m.mcx, ay + m.mcy })
	for _, f in ipairs(self.fallers) do
		if not f.recordPath then FL.Draw(f.clip, { 1, 0, 0, 1, ax + f.mcx, ay + f.mcy }) end
	end
	for _, it in ipairs(self.items) do FL.Draw(it.clip, { 1, 0, 0, 1, ax + it.mcx, ay + it.mcy }) end
	for _, p in ipairs(self.pops) do
		if p.clip.frame > 1 then FL.Draw(p.clip, { 1, 0, 0, 1, ax + p.x, ay + p.y }) end
	end
	self:HintDraw(ax, ay)

	-- the dialogs, score panel and curtain
	FL.Draw(self.gui, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil

	-- the dialogs' buttons
	local btns = {}
	findButtons(self.gui, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }, btns)
	for i, b in ipairs(btns) do
		local fn
		if b.cid == 101 then
			fn = function() self:ContinueClick() end
		elseif b.cid ~= 44 and b.cid ~= 49 and b.cid ~= 61 then
			-- OK on the end boards (quitGame: the loader goes on straight away)
			fn = function() self:Finish() end
		end
		if fn then
			UI.Button("g01_btn" .. i, MG.X(b.x0), MG.Y(b.y0), MG.S(b.x1 - b.x0), MG.S(b.y1 - b.y0), fn)
		end
	end

	MG.Chrome(1)
end

-- (Duel split screen: two copies of the game run side by side; the clips' frame scripts
-- talk to the copy that is running right now)
function G:MakeCurrent() CUR = self end

AN.RegisterGame(1, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g02_bibli:
-- Låge 2: Bibliote-Kandis
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Kandis stands in the library and books come flying from the
-- four sides. A red book flashes 8 times: press the arrow key towards it before it stops and she
-- catches it (10 points). A green book must not be caught: grab towards it and she sits down to read
-- it. A missed red book or a caught green one costs a life; 3 lives. Every caught book makes the next
-- ones come sooner and flash faster. The whole original timeline (intro, the "get ready" board, the
-- catch / miss animations and the game over board) is played back with the Flash player; the game
-- logic is the original's, with the same numbers.
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g02_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 2000,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_02",
	howKey = "how_02",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 480, 290
local STEP = 1 / 25
local MS = 40
local LIB = "g02"

-- the "For sent!" disk has its text drawn in; an English one is made from it
FL.ImgSwap["g02/fl/s171.png"] = { en = "g02/fl/s171_en.png" }

local CUR
local POSE = { [1] = "grab down", [2] = "grab left", [3] = "grab up", [4] = "grab right" }
local REACT = { [1] = "react down", [2] = "react left", [3] = "react up", [4] = "react right" }
local BALL = { [1] = "ball down", [2] = "ball left", [3] = "ball up", [4] = "ball right" }
local BOWL = { [1] = "bowl down", [2] = "bowl left", [3] = "bowl up", [4] = "bowl right" }
-- the player clip's frame for a catch in each direction (grab down .. grab right)
local CATCH_FRAME = { [1] = 6, [2] = 7, [3] = 8, [4] = 9 }

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end
local function play(c) FL.Play(c) end

local function setupActions()
	local stops = {}
	for f = 1, 9 do stops[f] = stop end
	stops[25] = function(c) FL.GotoAndPlay(c, "goal") end
	stops[26] = stop
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 146, stops)                                  -- Kandis
	local s8 = {}
	for f = 1, 8 do s8[f] = stop end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 161, s8)                                     -- the book
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 168, { [2] = function() MG.Sound("ui", "point") end, [7] = stop })   -- the catch splash
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 169, { [1] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 172, { [28] = stop })                        -- "For sent!"
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 173, { [1] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[12] = stop,
		[20] = function(c) AN.Speak("gameoveringenliv") FL.Play(c) end,
		[98] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
	-- the game clip: its frame scripts call back into the game
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 179, {
		[31] = function() if CUR then CUR:InitGame() end end,
		[32] = function(c) if CUR then CUR:GameStartFrame() end stop(c) end,
		[46] = function() if CUR then CUR:ScoreIncDone() end end,
		[57] = function() if CUR then CUR:LifeLostAnim() end end,
		[112] = function() if CUR then CUR:LifeLostDone() end end,
		[114] = function() if CUR then CUR:GameOverFrame() end end,
		[154] = stop,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code (the "game" clip's scripts)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Stage() return FL.Child(self:Game(), "stage") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Stage(), name) end

function G:InitGame()
	-- initInterface / initLevel / initPlayers / initEnemies
	self.player = { delay = 100, delayCount = 100, direction = 0, score = 0, life = 3, state = "ready" }
	self.ball = { level = 1, flash = { 0, 100, 0, 100, 0, 100, 0, 100 }, alpha = 0 }
	self.ball.flashFrames = #self.ball.flash
	self:ResetBall()
	self.gameState = "running"
end

function G:ResetBall()
	local b = self.ball
	b.state = "inactive"
	b.shotDelay = 1500 - b.level * 40
	b.flashDelay = 150 - b.level / 2
	b.shotDelayCount = b.shotDelay
	b.flashDelayCount = b.flashDelay
	b.flashFramesCount = b.flashFrames
	b.oldDirection = b.direction
	repeat
		b.ballSelect = math.Round(math.random() * 5)
		b.bType = b.ballSelect >= 4 and "bowlingball" or "football"
		b.direction = math.Round(math.random() * 3 + 1)
	until b.direction ~= b.oldDirection
end

function G:SetBallAlpha(a)
	self.ball.alpha = a
	local c = self:Clip("ball")
	if c then c.alpha = a / 100 end
end

function G:DoEnemies()
	local b = self.ball
	if b.shotDelayCount < 0 then
		local mc = self:Clip("ball")
		local player = self:Clip("player1")
		if b.bType == "bowlingball" then
			FL.GotoAndStop(mc, BOWL[b.direction])
			self:Flashes(false)
			if self.player.direction == b.direction then self.gameState = "life lost" end
		else
			FL.GotoAndStop(mc, BALL[b.direction])
			self:Flashes(true, BALL[b.direction])
			if player and player.frame == CATCH_FRAME[b.direction] then
				self.gameState = "scoreInc"
				local pop = self:Clip("ballpop")
				FL.GotoAndStop(pop, BALL[b.direction])
				local anim = FL.Child(pop, "anim")
				if anim then FL.GotoAndPlay(anim, 1) end
			end
		end
	else
		b.shotDelayCount = b.shotDelayCount - MS
	end
end

-- footballFlashes / bowlingballFlashes
function G:Flashes(football, label)
	local b = self.ball
	b.flashDelayCount = b.flashDelayCount - MS
	if b.flashDelayCount < 0 then
		b.flashDelayCount = b.flashDelay
		if b.flashFramesCount > 0 then
			b.state = "active"
			self:SetBallAlpha(b.flash[b.flashFramesCount])
			b.flashFramesCount = b.flashFramesCount - 1
		elseif football then
			-- too late
			self.gameState = "life lost"
			local pop = self:Clip("ballpopbad")
			FL.GotoAndStop(pop, label)
			local anim = FL.Child(pop, "anim")
			if anim then FL.GotoAndPlay(anim, 1) end
		else
			-- the green book went by
			self:ResetBall()
		end
	end
end

function G:SetPlayerPose()
	local mc = self:Clip("player1")
	if not mc then return end
	local d = self.player.direction
	if POSE[d] then
		FL.GotoAndStop(mc, POSE[d])
	elseif self.ball.state == "active" then
		-- the original goes to frame "ball.Destination + 1", which was never set (so nothing happens).
		-- Those frames are Kandis looking towards the book; with hidden content on she does.
		if AN.Save.Get("hidden") ~= false and REACT[self.ball.direction] then
			FL.GotoAndStop(mc, REACT[self.ball.direction])
		end
	else
		FL.GotoAndStop(mc, "idle")
	end
end

function G:ICheck()
	local p = self.player
	local d = 0
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_DOWN) then d = 1
	elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then d = 2
	elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_UP) then d = 3
	elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then d = 4 end
	p.direction = d
	if d ~= 0 then
		p.delayCount = p.delay
		p.state = "grabbing"
	end
end

function G:DoPlayer()
	local p = self.player
	self:SetPlayerPose()
	if p.state == "grabbing" then
		p.delayCount = p.delayCount - MS
		if p.delayCount < 0 then p.state = "ready" end
	else
		self:ICheck()
	end
end

function G:MainLoop()
	local st = self.gameState
	local game = self:Game()
	if st == "running" then
		self:DoPlayer()
		self:DoEnemies()
	elseif st == "scoreInc" then
		self.gameState = "paused"
		self:SetBallAlpha(100)
		FL.GotoAndPlay(game, "scoreinc")
	elseif st == "life lost" then
		AN.Speak("bibliotekandis_misterliv01")
		self.gameState = "paused"
		self:SetBallAlpha(100)
		self:SetPlayerPose()
		FL.GotoAndPlay(game, "life lost")
	elseif st == "gameOver" then
		self.gameState = "paused"
		self:SetBallAlpha(0)
		FL.GotoAndPlay(game, "gameover")
	end
end

-- frame 32 ("gameStart")
function G:GameStartFrame()
	self:SetBallAlpha(0)
	if self.player then self.vars.player1life = self.player.life end
end

-- frame 46: a book caught
function G:ScoreIncDone()
	local p = self.player
	p.score = p.score + 10
	self.vars.player1score = p.score
	self.ball.level = self.ball.level + 1
	self:ResetBall()
	self.gameState = "running"
	FL.GotoAndStop(self:Game(), "gamestart")
end

-- frame 57: Kandis reads the green book, or the red book flies past her
function G:LifeLostAnim()
	self:SetBallAlpha(0)
	local mc = self:Clip("player1")
	if mc then FL.GotoAndPlay(mc, self.ball.bType == "bowlingball" and "bowling" or "goal") end
end

-- frame 112
function G:LifeLostDone()
	local p = self.player
	p.life = p.life - 1
	FL.Stop(self:Game())
	if p.life <= 0 then
		self.gameState = "gameOver"
	else
		self.vars.player1life = p.life
		self:ResetBall()
		p.state, p.direction = "ready", 0
		self.gameState = "running"
		FL.GotoAndStop(self:Game(), "gamestart")
	end
end

-- frame 114: the root goes to its game over board
function G:GameOverFrame()
	self.vars.score = self.player.score
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameover")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hint: for the next 3 books, the book is ringed clearly red (catch it) or green (leave it) as soon
-- as it starts flashing, with an arrow from Kandis towards it (the flashing makes the colour hard to see)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:CanHint() return self.gameState == "running" and self.player ~= nil end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintBooks = (self.hintBooks or 0) + 3
	self.hintBall = nil
	local p = self.player
	p.score = math.max(0, p.score - cost)
	self.vars.player1score = p.score
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 240, 120)
end
function G:HintTrack()
	-- one book used up each time a new one is set up
	local b = self.ball
	if self.hintBooks and self.hintBooks > 0 and b and b.state == "active" and self.hintBall ~= b.shotDelay .. b.direction .. b.bType then
		self.hintBall = b.shotDelay .. b.direction .. b.bType
		self.hintBooks = self.hintBooks - 1
		self.hintShow = true
	end
	if b and b.state ~= "active" then self.hintShow = false end
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintShow or self.gameState ~= "running" then return end
	local _, _, x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "stage", "ball" })
	local _, _, px0, py0, px1, py1 = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "stage", "player1" })
	if not x0 then return end
	local col = self.ball.bType == "football" and MG.HINT_BAD or MG.HINT_GOOD
	local cx, cy = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2
	local r = math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) * 0.5 + 6
	MG.HintRing(cx, cy, r, col)
	MG.HintText(AN.L(self.ball.bType == "football" and "g02_hint_catch" or "g02_hint_leave"), cx, (cy - r - 16 < 14) and (cy + r + 16) or (cy - r - 16), col, 18)
	if px0 then
		local kx, ky = (px0 + px1) / 2, (py0 + py1) / 2
		local dx, dy = cx - kx, cy - ky
		local d = math.max(1, math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy))
		if d > r + 70 then
			MG.HintArrow(kx + dx / d * 30, ky + dy / d * 30, cx - dx / d * (r + 10), cy - dy / d * (r + 10), col)
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	local p = self.player
	return AN.L("g02_status", p and p.score or 0, p and math.max(0, p.life) or 3)
end

function G:Open(args)

function G:Close()

end

function G:Step()
	FL.OnSound = function(c, id) if id == 4 then MG.Sound("g02", "buzz") end end
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	FL.OnSound = nil
	self:MainLoop()
	self:HintTrack()
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()

	end
	MG.Chrome(2)
end

alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g03_bibli:
-- Låge 3: Biblioteks Ræs
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf: Pyrus flies through the library on a card, you steer
-- him with the mouse between the falling bookshelves. Same rules as the original game clip:
-- 25 steps a second, the speed grows by 0.0142 every step (max 30), new shelves come more
-- often the faster it goes, and the points are the steps survived / 2.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/g03_pos.lua")
local P = AN.G03Pos

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 600,       -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_03",
	howKey = "how_03",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 600, 450
local SX, SY = 1.4996, 1.5086          -- the game clip's scale on the stage
local XMIN, XMAX = 20, 375
local ME_Y = 217.2
local STEP = 1 / 25
-- the shelves, in the original order (o0 .. o4); hit boxes from each clip's "hit" child
local SHELVES = {
	{ img = "o18", hit = { -0.2, -6.25, 19.033, 39.223 } },
	{ img = "o12", hit = { 1.7, 1.15, 43.911, 20.267 } },
	{ img = "o17", hit = { -0.2, -6.0, 21.474, 43.377 } },
	{ img = "o19", hit = { 1.7, 1.15, 43.911, 20.267 } },
	{ img = "o30", hit = { -4.2, -8.35, 20.589, 44.101 } },
}
local ME_HIT = { 0.5, -8.7, 21.480, 34.046 }

-- inner game coordinates -> stage
local function IX(x) return x * SX end
local function IY(y) return y * SY end

-- a picture of a clip at (x, y) in game coordinates, drawn at the clip scale 1.4
local function clip(name, x, y, alpha)
	local r = P[name]
	if not r then return end
	MG.Img("g03/" .. name .. ".png", IX(x + r[1] * 1.4), IY(y + r[2] * 1.4), IX(r[3] * 1.4), IY(r[4] * 1.4), alpha)
end

local function hitRect(x, y, h)
	-- h = centre x, centre y, w, h in clip coordinates (scale 1.4)
	return x + (h[1] - h[3] / 2) * 1.4, y + (h[2] - h[4] / 2) * 1.4, h[3] * 1.4, h[4] * 1.4
end

local function overlap(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh)
	return ax < bx + bw and bx < ax + aw and ay < by + bh and by < ay + ah
end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g03_status", self.temp or 0)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.finished = false   -- a new round (this was left over from the last one, so the sign never went away)
	self.signAt = nil
	self.temp = 0
	self.fcount = 0
	self.ncount = 0
	self.speed = 3.5
	self.actObst = 0
	self.bgY = -300
	self.state = "COUNT"
	self.slowLeft = nil
	MG.ResetPops()
	self.countStep = 0
	self.crash = 0
	self.crashId = nil
	self.acc = 0
	self.meX = 160
	self.obst = {}
	for i, s in ipairs(SHELVES) do
		self.obst[i] = { def = s, x = 0, y = -1000, active = false, dead = 0 }
	end
	MG.Sound("g03", "tuut")
end

function G:StartNewObst()
	if self.actObst < #SHELVES - 1 then
		self.actObst = self.actObst + 1
		for _, o in ipairs(self.obst) do
			if not o.active then
				o.active = true
				o.x = XMIN + math.Round(math.random() * ((XMAX - XMIN) / 20)) * 20
				o.y = -19 + math.fmod(self.bgY, 20)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

-- one step of the original game clip
function G:Step()
	if self.state == "COUNT" then
		self.countStep = self.countStep + 1
		if self.countStep >= 49 then self.state = "ON" end
		return
	end
	if self.state == "ON" then
		self.temp = math.Round(self.fcount / 2)
		self.ncount = self.ncount + 1
		if 15 - self.speed / 2 < self.ncount and self.actObst < 2 + self.speed / 8 then
			self:StartNewObst()
			self.ncount = 0
		end
		local mx, my, mw, mh = hitRect(self.meX, ME_Y, ME_HIT)
		for i, o in ipairs(self.obst) do
			if o.active then o.y = o.y + self.speed end
			if o.y > 385 then
				o.active = false
				o.y = -1000
				self.actObst = self.actObst - 1
			elseif ME_Y - 30 < o.y then
				local ox, oy, ow, oh = hitRect(o.x, o.y, o.def.hit)
				if overlap(mx, my, mw, mh, ox, oy, ow, oh) then
					self.crashId = i
					self.state = "GAMEOVER"
				end
			end
		end
		self.fcount = self.fcount + 1
		self.speed = math.min(30, self.speed + 0.0142)
		self.bgY = self.bgY + self.speed
		if self.bgY >= 0 then
			MG.Sound("g03", "peep", 0.6)
			self.bgY = self.bgY - 300
		end
	elseif self.state == "GAMEOVER" then
		self.speed = 0
		self.crash = self.crash + 1
		if self.crash == 1 then MG.Sound("g03", "hit") end
		if self.crash > 30 then
			self.state = "SIGN"
			self.signAt = RealTime()
			AN.Speak("gameover")
		end
	end
end

-- hint: 3 seconds of slow motion (the game runs at half speed)
function G:CanHint() return self.state == "ON" and not self.slowLeft end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.slowLeft = 3
	self.fcount = math.max(0, self.fcount - cost * 2)   -- the points are the steps / 2
	self.temp = math.Round(self.fcount / 2)
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 300, 380)
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if self.slowLeft then
		self.slowLeft = self.slowLeft - dt
		if self.slowLeft <= 0 or self.state ~= "ON" then self.slowLeft = nil else dt = dt * 0.5 end
	end
	-- steer: the card follows the mouse sideways (the original startDrag with locked y)
	if (self.state == "COUNT" or self.state == "ON") and MG.k and MG.sw == STAGE_W then
		local mx = MG.Mouse()
		self.meX = math.Clamp(mx / SX, XMIN + 5, XMAX - 5)
	end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
	if self.state == "SIGN" and RealTime() - self.signAt > 3.2 then self:Finish() end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(3, self.temp)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	-- the floor, scrolling
	local bgy = self.bgY
	MG.Img("g03/bg.jpg", 0, IY(bgy), IX(400), IY(300))
	MG.Img("g03/bg.jpg", 0, IY(bgy + 300), IX(400), IY(300))
	MG.Img("g03/bg.jpg", 0, IY(bgy + 600), IX(400), IY(300))

	-- shelves (the one you hit blinks red like the original "dead" frames)
	local blink = self.crash > 0 and ((self.crash - 1) % 10 >= 3 and (self.crash - 1) % 10 <= 5)
	for i, o in ipairs(self.obst) do
		if o.y > -100 then
			local name = o.def.img
			if blink and i == self.crashId then name = name .. "_hit" end
			clip(name, o.x, o.y)
		end
	end
	clip(blink and "me_hit" or "me", self.meX, ME_Y)

	-- countdown 3, 2, 1 (the original countdown clip: 49 frames)
	if self.state == "COUNT" then
		local f = self.countStep
		local name = f < 12 and "cd3" or (f < 25 and "cd2" or "cd1")
		local r = P[name]
		local k = 2.4
		MG.Img("g03/" .. name .. ".png", IX(200) + r[1] * k, IY(151.2) + r[2] * k, r[3] * k, r[4] * k)
	end

	-- points (the original "termometer" text at the bottom)
	local pr = P.points
	MG.Img("g03/points.png", 336.55 + pr[1], 413.85 + pr[2], pr[3], pr[4])
	AN.Text(tostring(self.temp), "title", math.floor(MG.S(27)), MG.X(300), MG.Y(407), C.cream)

	if self.slowLeft then
		MG.HintText(AN.L("hint_slow"), 300, 40, MG.HINT_GOLD, 26, math.min(1, self.slowLeft * 2))
	end
	MG.DrawPops()

	-- "Spil Slut!" sign
	if self.state == "SIGN" then
		local sr = P.sign
		if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
			MG.Img("g03/sign_da.png", sr[1], sr[2], sr[3], sr[4])
		else
			MG.Img("g03/sign.png", sr[1], sr[2], sr[3], sr[4])
			AN.Text(AN.L("g03_over"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(46)), MG.X(300), MG.Y(150), C.cream, 1)
			AN.Text(AN.L("g03_points"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(15)), MG.X(180), MG.Y(229), C.cream)
		end
		AN.Text(tostring(self.temp), "title", math.floor(MG.S(22)), MG.X(300), MG.Y(224), C.cream)
		if RealTime() - self.signAt > 0.8 then
			AN.Text(AN.L("g03_click"), "black", math.floor(MG.S(11)), MG.X(300), MG.Y(318), Color(255, 241, 207, 210), 1)
		end
		-- click to go on (the original "skip" button)
		UI.Button("g03_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() self:Finish() end, { silent = true })
	end

	MG.Chrome(3)
end

AN.RegisterGame(3, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g04_huske:
-- Låge 4: Huskespil ("Memory Monsters")
-- Rebuilt from the original memory.swf: same 15 monster cards, same layout rule,
-- same scoring (fast pairs give more, streaks give a bonus, a miss costs 6),
-- 10 levels from 5 to 14 pairs, and Gyldengrød watching with his original animations.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 6000,      -- the original "coolScore"
	levels = 10,
	worst = 0,        -- the original has no badScore for points games: 0 points = 3 pebernødder
	descKey = "desc_04",
	howKey = "how_04",
}

local GYLD = include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/g04_gyld.lua")

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 770, 440
local AREA = { x = 189.55, y = 9.5, w = 643.5 - 189.55, h = 392.45 - 9.5 }   -- handle1 -> handle2
local CARD_IMG = { ox = -33, oy = -42, w = 70.5, h = 89.5 }                   -- card png relative to card origin
local LAST_LEVEL = 10

-- Gyldengrød's animations (frame ranges from the original timeline, 25 fps)
local ANIMS = {
	atease     = { 16, 95 },
	nanim1     = { 97, 143 },
	nanim2     = { 146, 216 },
	nanim3     = { 220, 255 },
	take1      = { 257, 324 },
	takepoint  = { 327, 400 },
	fallasleep = { 403, 480, "snoreloop" },
	snoreloop  = { 481, 554, "snoreloop" },
	wakeup     = { 556, 608 },
	point2     = { 611, 682 },
	scratch    = { 689, 750 },
}
-- where his sprite sits on the stage (top-left and size of one packed frame)
local GY = { x = 3.9, y = 53.46, w = 233 / 1.25536, h = 351 / 1.25536 }

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Gyldengrød
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Anim(name)
	self.anim = name
	self.animFrame = ANIMS[name][1]
	self.animAcc = 0
	if name == "fallasleep" then self.sleeping = true end
end

function G:UpdateAnim(dt)
	self.animAcc = self.animAcc + dt * 25
	while self.animAcc >= 1 do
		self.animAcc = self.animAcc - 1
		self.animFrame = self.animFrame + 1
		local a = ANIMS[self.anim]
		if self.animFrame > a[2] then
			if self.anim == "atease" then
				self.animFrame = 20 + math.random(0, 69)
			else
				local nxt = a[3] or "atease"
				if self.anim == "wakeup" then self.sleeping = false end
				self:Anim(nxt)
			end
		end
	end
	-- the original "idletimer": random small animations, falls asleep when left alone
	if self.anim == "atease" and self.state == "play" then
		self.idleAcc = (self.idleAcc or 0) + dt * 25
		while self.idleAcc >= 1 do
			self.idleAcc = self.idleAcc - 1
			if math.random() > 0.995 then
				self:Anim("nanim" .. math.random(1, 3))
				break
			elseif self.sleepyTime + 15 < RealTime() and math.random() > 0.997 then
				self:Anim("fallasleep")
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:DrawGyld()
	local f = self.animFrame
	local idx = GYLD.seq[f] or 0
	local atlas = GYLD.atlases[math.floor(idx / GYLD.per) + 1]
	local cell = idx % GYLD.per
	local col, row = cell % GYLD.cols, math.floor(cell / GYLD.cols)
	local u0, v0 = col * GYLD.w / atlas[2], row * GYLD.h / atlas[3]
	local u1, v1 = (col + 1) * GYLD.w / atlas[2], (row + 1) * GYLD.h / atlas[3]
	surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(atlas[1]))
	surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(AN.PX(MG.X(GY.x)), AN.SY(MG.Y(GY.y)), AN.SX(MG.S(GY.w)), AN.SX(MG.S(GY.h)), u0, v0, u1, v1)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Game flow
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Open(args)
	self.state = "start"
	self.score = 0
	self.level = 0
	self.cards = {}
	self.sleeping = false
	self.sleepyTime = RealTime()
	self:Anim("atease")
	MG.ResetPops()
	-- the wrapper's Start button brings you here, so the game begins right away
	self:StartGame()
end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g04_status", math.max(1, self.level or 1), self.score or 0)
end

function G:StartGame()
	self.score = 0
	self.level = 0
	self.state = "play"
	self:NewLevel()
end

function G:NewLevel()
	self.level = self.level + 1
	self.levelStartScore = self.score
	local pairs = 5 + (self.level - 1)
	local n = pairs * 2
	self.pairsLeft = pairs
	self.turned = nil
	self.pressOk = true
	self.streak = 0
	self.lastPairTime = RealTime()
	self.nextLevelSign = false
	self.timers = {}

	-- pick different pictures for the pairs, then shuffle
	local pics = {}
	for i = 0, 14 do pics[#pics + 1] = i end
	for i = #pics, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i) pics[i], pics[j] = pics[j], pics[i] end
	local deck = {}
	for p = 1, pairs do
		deck[#deck + 1] = { pair = p, img = pics[p] }
		deck[#deck + 1] = { pair = p, img = pics[p] }
	end
	for i = #deck, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i) deck[i], deck[j] = deck[j], deck[i] end

	-- original layout: a loose grid with random offsets and tilt, scaled to fit the card area
	local antalx = math.floor(math.sqrt((AREA.w + 32) / (AREA.h + 4) / 0.9 * n) + 0.5)
	local antaly = math.ceil(n / antalx)
	local sc = math.min(AREA.w / antalx, AREA.h / antaly) / 100
	self.cardScale = sc
	self.cards = {}
	local k = 1
	for t = 0, antaly - 1 do
		for tt = 0, antalx - 1 do
			local c = deck[k]
			if c then
				c.hx = tt * 90 + 50 + math.random(0, 29) - 15
				c.hy = 100 * t + 50 + math.random(0, 29) - 15
				c.rot = math.random(0, 29) - 15
				c.x = AREA.x + c.hx * sc
				c.y = AREA.y + c.hy * sc
				c.face = false       -- showing the picture?
				c.flipT = nil        -- time a flip started
				c.flipTo = nil
				c.picked = 0
				c.matched = false
				self.cards[k] = c
			end
			k = k + 1
		end
	end
	-- deal-in animation
	self.dealT = RealTime()
end

function G:After(delay, fn)
	self.timers[#self.timers + 1] = { t = RealTime() + delay, fn = fn }
end

function G:Flip(c, toFace)
	c.flipT = RealTime()
	c.flipTo = toFace
end

function G:CardClicked(c)
	if not self.pressOk or c.face or c.flipT or c.matched then return end
	if self.sleeping and self.anim ~= "wakeup" then self:Anim("wakeup") end
	self:Flip(c, true)
	c.picked = c.picked + 1
	MG.Sound("g04", "turn")
	if not self.turned then
		self.turned = c
		-- Gyldengrød reacts: scratches his head if you've seen the partner a few times
		local partner
		for _, o in ipairs(self.cards) do if o ~= c and o.pair == c.pair then partner = o end end
		if not self.sleeping and self.anim == "atease" then
			if partner and partner.picked > 2 then self:Anim("scratch")
			elseif math.random() > 0.9 then self:Anim("point2") end
		end
		return
	end

	local a, b = self.turned, c
	self.turned = nil
	local mx, my = (a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2
	if a.pair ~= b.pair then
		self.pressOk = false
		self.score = self.score - 6
		MG.Pop("-6", false, mx, my)
		self.streak = 0
		self:After(0.85, function()
			MG.Sound("g04", "nomatch")
			self:Flip(a, false)
			self:Flip(b, false)
			self.lastPairTime = RealTime()
			self.pressOk = true
		end)
	else
		a.matched, b.matched = true, true
		self.streak = self.streak + 1
		-- points: faster pairs give more (original formula)
		local mod = ((RealTime() - self.lastPairTime) * 1000 + 2000) / 2000
		local pts = math.floor(10 * (5 + self.level - 1) / mod + 0.5)
		if self.streak > 1 then
			local bonus = self.streak * 10
			MG.Pop(pts .. " + " .. bonus, true, mx, my)
			AN.Speak("huskespillet_bonus01", true)
			pts = pts + bonus
		else
			MG.Pop(tostring(pts), true, mx, my)
		end
		self.score = self.score + pts
		self.sleepyTime = RealTime()
		self.pairsLeft = self.pairsLeft - 1
		if self.pairsLeft > 0 and not self.sleeping then
			if math.random() > 0.3 then self:Anim("take1") else self:Anim("takepoint") end
		end
		self:After(0.6, function()
			MG.Sound("g04", "match")
			self.lastPairTime = RealTime()
			if self.pairsLeft <= 0 then
				AN.LevelScore(4, self.level, self.score - (self.levelStartScore or 0), { total = math.max(0, self.score) })
				if self.level >= LAST_LEVEL then
					self:Finish()
				else
					self.nextLevelSign = true
					MG.Sound("g04", "level", 0.6)
					AN.Speak("huskespillet_levelslut")
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- hint: every card still face down is turned up for a second, then back
function G:CanHint()
	return self.state == "play" and self.pressOk and not self.nextLevelSign and (self.pairsLeft or 0) > 0
end
function G:Hint(cost)
	local shown = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(self.cards) do
		if not c.matched and not c.face and not c.flipT then
			self:Flip(c, true)
			shown[#shown + 1] = c
		end
	end
	if #shown == 0 then return false end
	self.pressOk = false
	self.score = self.score - cost
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 87, 340)
	MG.Sound("g04", "turn")
	self:After(1.2, function()
		for _, c in ipairs(shown) do self:Flip(c, false) end
		MG.Sound("g04", "turn")
		self:After(0.25, function()
			self.lastPairTime = self.lastPairTime + 1.45   -- the time looking doesn't count against the pair
			self.pressOk = true
		end)
	end)
end

function G:Finish()
	self.state = "done"
	AN.FinishGame(4, math.max(0, self.score))
end

function G:Think(dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
	self:UpdateAnim(dt)
	if self.timers then
		local now = RealTime()
		for i = #self.timers, 1, -1 do
			local t = self.timers[i]
			if now >= t.t then
				table.remove(self.timers, i)
				t.fn()
			end
		end
	end
	-- finish flips (0.2 s)
	for _, c in ipairs(self.cards) do
		if c.flipT and RealTime() - c.flipT >= 0.2 then
			c.face = c.flipTo
			c.flipT = nil
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Drawing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:DrawCard(c, i)
	local sc = self.cardScale
	-- flip: squash horizontally, switch face half way
	local xs = 1
	local showFace = c.face
	if c.flipT then
		local t = math.Clamp((RealTime() - c.flipT) / 0.2, 0, 1)
		xs = math.abs(math.cos(t * math.pi))
		if t >= 0.5 then showFace = c.flipTo else showFace = not c.flipTo end
		xs = math.max(xs, 0.05)
	end
	-- deal in: drop from above with a little delay per card
	local dy = 0
	local dt = RealTime() - (self.dealT or 0) - i * 0.03
	if dt < 0.35 then
		local t = math.Clamp(dt / 0.35, 0, 1)
		dy = -(1 - t) * (1 - t) * 60
		if dt < 0 then return end
	end
	local path = showFace and string.format("g04/card%02d.png", c.img) or "g04/back.png"
	local w, h = CARD_IMG.w * sc, CARD_IMG.h * sc
	-- image centre relative to the card origin, rotated with the card
	local ox, oy = (CARD_IMG.ox + CARD_IMG.w / 2) * sc, (CARD_IMG.oy + CARD_IMG.h / 2) * sc
	local a = math.rad(c.rot)
	local cx = c.x + ox * math.cos(a) - oy * math.sin(a)
	local cy = c.y + dy + ox * math.sin(a) + oy * math.cos(a)
	local hot = UI.Hot("card" .. i) and self.pressOk and not c.face and not c.flipT
	local lift = hot and 1.05 or 1
	surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 255)
	surface.SetMaterial(AN.Mat(path))
	surface.DrawTexturedRectRotated(AN.PX(MG.X(cx)), AN.SY(MG.Y(cy)), AN.SX(MG.S(w * xs * lift)), AN.SX(MG.S(h * lift)), -c.rot)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	-- board, built wide (stage x -500 .. 1300) from the original wood so ultrawide shows more of the room
	MG.Backdrop("g04/bg.jpg", -500, 0, 1800, 440)
	self:DrawGyld()

	-- HUD: level and score (original positions)
	local lvl = self.level
	AN.Text(AN.L("g04_level"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(13)), MG.X(19.5), MG.Y(343), C.cream)
	AN.Text(lvl .. " / " .. LAST_LEVEL, "title", math.floor(MG.S(13)), MG.X(87), MG.Y(343), C.white)
	AN.Text(AN.L("g04_score"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(13)), MG.X(19.5), MG.Y(372), C.cream)
	AN.Text(tostring(self.score), "title", math.floor(MG.S(13)), MG.X(87), MG.Y(372), C.white)

	if self.state == "play" or self.state == "done" then
		-- cards (register click regions first so the topmost card wins)
		local sc = self.cardScale or 1
		for i, c in ipairs(self.cards) do
			local hw, hh = 33 * sc, 42 * sc
			UI.Button("card" .. i, MG.X(c.x - hw), MG.Y(c.y - hh), MG.S(hw * 2), MG.S(hh * 2), function() self:CardClicked(c) end, { silent = true })
		end
		for i, c in ipairs(self.cards) do self:DrawCard(c, i) end
		MG.DrawPops()

		-- "Stop nu!" ends the game with the points you have
		local stopPath = AN.LangCode() == "da" and "g04/stop_da.png" or "g04/stop_en.png"
		local hot = UI.Button("stop", MG.X(313), MG.Y(362), MG.S(131), MG.S(65), function() self:Finish() end)
		local lift = hot and 3 or 0
		MG.Img(stopPath, 313, 362 - lift, 131)

		if self.nextLevelSign then
			local p = AN.LangCode() == "da" and "g04/next_da.png" or "g04/next_en.png"
			local w = 290
			local h = w * AN.Ratio(p)
			local x, y = 445, 380 - h
			local hot2 = UI.Button("next", MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), function()
				self.nextLevelSign = false
				self:NewLevel()
			end)
			if hot2 then AN.Glow(MG.X(x + w / 2), MG.Y(y + h / 2), MG.S(w * 0.7), C.gold, 0.6) end
			MG.Img(p, x, y - (hot2 and 4 or 0), w)
		end
	end

	MG.Chrome(4)
end

AN.RegisterGame(4, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g05_snupe:
-- Låge 5: Snup en Switch
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. A maze on a circuit board: click START, then steer the red
-- ring with the mouse and snatch the 8 green gadgets (each one is put at one of 4 places, chosen at
-- random every round). Each gadget gives more time; with all 8 taken, touching START again gives a
-- big time bonus and a new round. Touching any part of the board's pattern, or running out of time,
-- ends the game. The points are the milliseconds you lasted.
-- The whole original timeline is played with the Flash player; the game code is the original's,
-- with the same numbers (and the same quirks: from round 9 on a gadget takes time instead of
-- giving it, and the background goes green -> blue -> red as time runs out).
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g05_fl.lua")
include(DIR .. "g05_mask.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 50000,     -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_05",
	howKey = "how_05",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 720, 450
local STEP = 1 / 25
local MS = 40
local LIB = "g05"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }

local CUR

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the wall mask (shape 113 inside the "map" clip)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local MASK
local function mask()
	if MASK then return MASK end
	local M = AN.G05Mask
	local B = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789+/"
	local val = {}
	for i = 1, 64 do val[string.byte(B, i)] = i - 1 end
	local rows = {}
	local y = 0
	for line in string.gmatch(M.rows .. "\n", "([^\n]*)\n") do
		if y > 0 or line ~= "" or #rows > 0 then
			local runs = {}
			for i = 1, #line - 1, 2 do
				runs[#runs + 1] = val[string.byte(line, i)] * 64 + val[string.byte(line, i + 1)]
			end
			rows[#rows + 1] = runs
			y = y + 1
		end
	end
	MASK = { rows = rows, def = M }
	return MASK
end

-- is the point (in shape 113's own coordinates) on the board's pattern?
local function onWall(x, y)
	local m = mask()
	local d = m.def
	local px = math.floor((x - d.x0) / d.sx)
	local py = math.floor((y - d.y0) / d.sy)
	local r = m.rows[py + 1]
	if not r then return false end
	for i = 1, #r - 1, 2 do
		if px >= r[i] and px < r[i + 1] then return true end
		if px < r[i] then return false end
	end
	return false
end

local function inverse(m)
	local det = m[1] * m[4] - m[2] * m[3]
	if math.abs(det) < 1e-9 then return nil end
	local a, b, c, d = m[4] / det, -m[2] / det, -m[3] / det, m[1] / det
	return { a, b, c, d, -(a * m[5] + c * m[6]), -(b * m[5] + d * m[6]) }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 10, { [1] = stop })                                         -- the points' "hilite"
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 11, { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end })   -- pointsMC
	-- START (its pop-in sound is a sound stream in the clip, frames 2-10)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 127, { [2] = function() MG.Sound("g05", "start") end, [10] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 133, { [13] = stop })                                       -- the gadget splash
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 138, { [23] = stop })                                       -- a trail piece
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 140, { [1] = stop, [5] = stop, [11] = stop })               -- tick / tock
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 143, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,   -- startNewGame once everything is loaded
		[21] = function(c)
			if CUR then CUR.hideMouse = false end
			AN.Speak("GameOver")
			FL.Play(c)
		end,
		[99] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers for the game clip's children
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Game(), name) end

-- the stage matrix of the game clip
function G:GameM()
	return (FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I))
end

-- _x / _y of a child of the game clip (keeps its scale and rotation)
function G:SetPos(name, x, y)
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), name, I)
	if not k then return end
	k.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], x, y }
end

function G:SetVisible(name, v)
	local k = self:Clip(name)
	if k then k.visible = v end
end

-- the mouse in the game clip's coordinates (_xmouse / _ymouse)
function G:Mouse()
	local sx, sy = MG.Mouse()
	local inv = inverse(self:GameM())
	if not inv then return sx, sy end
	return TL.Apply(inv, sx, sy)
end

-- map.hitTest(x, y, true): the point (game coordinates) against the board's pattern
function G:MapHit(x, y)
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "map", I)
	if not m then return false end
	local inv = inverse(m)          -- shape 113 sits at the map clip's origin
	local lx, ly = TL.Apply(inv, x, y)
	return onWall(lx, ly)
end

-- clip.hitTest(x, y, true) for the small gadgets and the round START button
function G:ClipHit(name, x, y, round)
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), name, I)
	if not k or not k.visible then return false end
	local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(k, m, true)
	if not x0 then return false end
	if not round then return x >= x0 and x <= x1 and y >= y0 and y <= y1 end
	local cx, cy, rx, ry = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, (x1 - x0) / 2, (y1 - y0) / 2
	if rx <= 0 or ry <= 0 then return false end
	local dx, dy = (x - cx) / rx, (y - cy) / ry
	return dx * dx + dy * dy <= 1
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the points that pop up (pointsMC). The original made 35 of them but never showed one; with
-- hidden content on, a gadget or START shows the time it gave.
function G:InitPoints()
	self.points = {}
	self.nextPoint = 1
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y, hilite)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	if not p then
		p = { c = FL.New(LIB, 11) }
		self.points[self.nextPoint] = p
	end
	local s = math.max(55, math.min(140, val * 0.5)) / 100
	p.m = { s, 0, 0, s, x, y }
	p.c.visible = true
	FL.GotoAndPlay(p.c, 1)
	local hl = FL.Child(p.c, "hilite")
	if hl then FL.GotoAndStop(hl, hilite and "on" or "off") end
	local ani = FL.Child(p.c, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
	self.pointVal = val
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 35 + 1
end

function G:InitTrails()
	self.lastPos = nil
	self.trails = {}
	self.trailId = 1
	local m, org = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "trail_org", I)
	self.trailM = m
	for t = 1, 20 do
		local c = FL.New(LIB, 138)
		self.trails[t] = { c = c, m = m and { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5], m[6] } or I, cx = org and true }
	end
end

function G:AddTrail(x, y)
	if not self.lastPos then
		self.lastPos = { x, y }
		return
	end
	local lx, ly = self.lastPos[1], self.lastPos[2]
	local t = self.trails[self.trailId]
	-- _rotation: the angle from the new point back to the last one; _xscale: the distance + 0.5
	local dx, dy = lx - x, ly - y
	local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
	local ang = len > 0 and math.atan2(dy, dx) or 0
	local sx = (len + 0.5) / 100
	local sy = 1
	local co, si = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
	t.m = { co * sx, si * sx, -si * sy, co * sy, x, y }
	FL.GotoAndPlay(t.c, 1)
	self.trailId = self.trailId % 20 + 1
	self.lastPos = { x, y }
end

-- the background colour: green while there are 5 seconds or more left, then towards blue, then red
local GREEN, YELLOW, RED = { 10, 126, 103 }, { 36, 32, 202 }, { 255, 0, 0 }
local function cycleColour(energy)
	local a, b, f
	if energy > 50 then
		a, b, f = YELLOW, GREEN, (energy - 50) / 50
	else
		a, b, f = RED, YELLOW, energy / 50
	end
	return math.floor(a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f), math.floor(a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * f), math.floor(a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * f)
end

-- mapCol.setRGB: the background clip (a plain rectangle over the whole stage) becomes one colour.
-- It is drawn as a filled rectangle under the game clip (a tinted picture can't turn teal into red).
function G:SetBg(r, g, b)
	self.bgCol = Color(r, g, b)
end

function G:SelectCheese()
	self.active = {}
	for c = 0, 7 do
		local name = "cheese" .. c .. "_" .. math.random(0, 3)
		self.active[#self.active + 1] = name
		self:SetVisible(name, true)
	end
end

function G:Init()
	-- soundplayer.playSound("whistle_1"): that sound was never added to the game's sound module
	self.score = 0
	self:InitPoints()
	self.state = "waitforgo"
	self:SetVisible("cursor", false)
	self:SetVisible("wallhit", false)
	self:SetVisible("cheesehit", false)
	self.numCheese = 8
	self.cheeseLeft = 8
	self.subState = "cheese"
	for c = 0, 7 do
		for t = 0, 3 do self:SetVisible("cheese" .. c .. "_" .. t, false) end
	end
	self:SelectCheese()
	self:InitTrails()
end

function G:GoAreaClicked()
	FL.GotoAndStop(self:Clip("go"), "off")
	self.state = "gameon"
	self.startTime = self.now
	self:SetVisible("cursor", true)
	self.hideMouse = true
	self.lastTick = "tock"
	self.nextTick = 20
	self.totalTime = 15000
	self.level = 0
	self.roundStart = 0
	self.hintPenalty = 0
	self.hintLeft = nil
end

function G:CheeseHit(x, y)
	self:SetVisible("cheesehit", true)
	self:SetPos("cheesehit", x, y)
	FL.GotoAndPlay(self:Clip("cheesehit"), 1)
end

function G:MainLoop()
	local st = self.state
	if st == "gameon" then
		local t = self.now - self.startTime
		if t > self.totalTime then
			MG.Sound("g05", "buzz")
			self.state = "timeout"
			self.sCount = 0   -- (the original never reset this; it was 0 or nil anyway)
		end
		self.score = math.max(0, t - (self.hintPenalty or 0))
		self.vars.score = self.score
		local timeLeft = math.Round(self.totalTime - t)
		self.timeLeft = timeLeft
		local energy = math.max(0, math.min(100, 100 * (timeLeft / 5000)))
		self:SetBg(cycleColour(energy))
		local mx, my = self:Mouse()
		self:SetPos("cursor", mx, my)
		self:AddTrail(mx, my)
		if self:MapHit(mx, my) then
			MG.Sound("g05", "buzz")
			self:SetVisible("cursor", false)
			self:SetVisible("wallhit", true)
			self:SetPos("wallhit", mx, my)
			self.state = "wallhit"
			self.sCount = 0
		end
		self.nextTick = self.nextTick - 1
		if self.nextTick <= 0 then
			self.nextTick = math.ceil(math.max(4, math.min(20, timeLeft / 200)))
			self.lastTick = self.lastTick == "tick" and "tock" or "tick"
			FL.GotoAndPlay(self:Clip("soundmc"), self.lastTick)
		end
		local hidden = AN.Save.Get("hidden") ~= false
		if self.subState == "cheese" then
			for _, name in ipairs(self.active) do
				local k = self:Clip(name)
				if k and k.visible and self:ClipHit(name, mx, my) then
					MG.Sound("ui", "point")
					k.visible = false
					self:CheeseHit(mx, my)
					local bonus = 3800 - self.level * 500
					self.totalTime = self.totalTime + bonus
					if hidden then self:SetPoint(bonus, mx, my, false) end
					self.cheeseLeft = self.cheeseLeft - 1
					if self.cheeseLeft == 0 then
						self.subState = "go"
						FL.GotoAndPlay(self:Clip("go"), "on")
					end
				end
			end
		elseif self.subState == "go" then
			if self:ClipHit("go", mx, my, true) then
				FL.GotoAndStop(self:Clip("go"), "off")
				self:CheeseHit(mx, my)
				local bonus = 6000 - self.level * 500
				self.totalTime = self.totalTime + bonus
				if hidden then self:SetPoint(bonus, mx, my, true) end
				-- a round done: its time into the round's own highscore list (the original kept one
				-- list for the whole game), and the run so far is saved
				local t = math.max(0, math.floor(self.now - self.startTime - (self.hintPenalty or 0)))
				AN.LevelScore(5, self.level + 1, math.max(0, t - (self.roundStart or 0)), { total = t })
				self.roundStart = t
				self.subState = "cheese"
				self.level = self.level + 1
				self.cheeseLeft = self.numCheese
				self:SelectCheese()
			end
		end
	elseif st == "wallhit" or st == "timeout" then
		self.sCount = (self.sCount or 0) + 1
		if self.sCount > 20 then
			self.state = "game over"
			FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameover")
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	local left = (self.state == nil or self.state == "waitforgo") and 15000 or (self.timeLeft or 0)
	return AN.L("g05_status", self.score or 0, math.max(0, left) / 1000)
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.now = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.state = nil
	self.hideMouse = false
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.points, self.trails = {}, {}
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameon")
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
	self:ShowCursor(true)
end

function G:ShowCursor(show)
	local p = UI.root
	if IsValid(p) and p.SetCursor and self.cursorShown ~= show then
		p:SetCursor(show and "arrow" or "blank")
		self.cursorShown = show
	end
end

function G:Step()
	self.now = self.now + MS
	FL.OnSound = function(c, id)
		if id == 4 then MG.Sound("g05", "tick")
		elseif id == 3 then MG.Sound("g05", "tock")
		elseif id == 1 then MG.Sound("g05", "ticktock")
		elseif id == 2 then MG.Sound("g05", "buzz") end
	end
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points or {}) do if p.c.visible then FL.Tick(p.c) end end
	for _, t in ipairs(self.trails or {}) do FL.Tick(t.c) end
	FL.OnSound = nil
	self:MainLoop()
	-- the game's own pointer (mousePointerMc) follows the mouse while the mouse is hidden
	if self.hideMouse then
		local mx, my = self:Mouse()
		if mx > 0 and mx < 720 and my > 0 and my < 450 then self:SetPos("mousePointerMc", mx, my) end
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:ShowCursor(true)
	AN.FinishGame(5, math.max(0, math.floor(self.score or 0)))
end

-- hint: for 4 seconds the gadgets still to grab are ringed, with an arrow from the ring to the
-- nearest one (or to START once all 8 are taken). Costs time off the score (not off the clock).
function G:CanHint() return self.state == "gameon" end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintPenalty = (self.hintPenalty or 0) + cost
	self.hintLeft = 4
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, mx, my - 20)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintLeft then return end
	self.hintLeft = self.hintLeft - FrameTime()
	if self.hintLeft <= 0 or self.state ~= "gameon" then self.hintLeft = nil return end
	local a = math.min(1, self.hintLeft * 2)
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local best, bd
	local targets = {}
	if self.subState == "go" then
		local _, _, x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "go" })
		if x0 then targets[1] = { (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) / 2 } end
	else
		for _, name in ipairs(self.active or {}) do
			local k = self:Clip(name)
			if k and k.visible then
				local _, _, x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", name })
				if x0 then targets[#targets + 1] = { (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) / 2 + 4 } end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
		MG.HintRing(t[1], t[2], t[3] + 6, MG.HINT_GOLD, a, 3)
		local d = (t[1] - mx) ^ 2 + (t[2] - my) ^ 2
		if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = t, d end
	end
	if best and bd > (best[3] + 30) ^ 2 then
		local d = math.sqrt(bd)
		local ux, uy = (best[1] - mx) / d, (best[2] - my) / d
		MG.HintArrow(mx + ux * 14, my + uy * 14, best[1] - ux * (best[3] + 10), best[2] - uy * (best[3] + 10), MG.HINT_GOLD, a, 5)
	end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(5) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	-- the clips the script made: the points (depth 2000+) and the trail (depth 66384+), on top of the game
	if game then
		local extra = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(self.points or {}) do
			if p.c.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = p.c, m = p.m } end
		end
		-- (the copies keep trail_org's colour transform)
		for _, t in ipairs(self.trails or {}) do extra[#extra + 1] = { c = t.c, m = t.m, a = 0.629, col = { 0.512, 0.512, 0.512, 125, 125, 50 } } end
		game.extra = extra
	end
	local st = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if name == "scoretxt" then return AN.L("g05_v_score", math.floor(st.score or 0)) end
		if name == "timetxt" then
			local left = (st.state == nil or st.state == "waitforgo") and 15000 or (st.timeLeft or 0)
			return AN.L("g05_v_time", string.format("%.1f", math.Round(left / 100) / 10))
		end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	local bg = game and FL.Child(game, "bg")
	if bg then
		bg.visible = false
		local c = self.bgCol or Color(10, 126, 103)
		surface.SetDrawColor(c.r, c.g, c.b, 255)
		surface.DrawRect(AN.PX(MG.X(0)), AN.SY(MG.Y(0)), AN.SX(MG.S(STAGE_W)), AN.SX(MG.S(STAGE_H)))
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	-- the system mouse is hidden over the board while you play (the original's Mouse.hide)
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local inside = mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H
	self:ShowCursor(not (self.hideMouse and inside))
	-- START: the button inside the go clip (goAreaClicked) works until the game has started
	if self.state == "waitforgo" and game then
		local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(game, "go", I)
		local gm = self:GameM()
		local sm = TL.Mul(gm, m)
		local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(k, sm, true)
		if x0 then
			UI.Button("g05_go", MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function() self:GoAreaClicked() end, { silent = true, hit = FL.HitFn(k, sm) })
		end
	end
	-- the game over board: a click anywhere skips to the end
	if self.root.frame >= 21 and self.root.frame < 98 then
		UI.Button("g05_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(5)
end

AN.RegisterGame(5, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g06_elver:
-- Låge 6: Elverdans
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. A "Simon says" with five elves: the elves on the left
-- dance a sequence, one more step each turn, and you click the elves on the right in the same
-- order. Each right step is a point. You have 3 seconds plus 1 second per step to answer; a wrong
-- elf or too slow and the game is over (the elf you should have picked dances to show you).
-- The whole original timeline is played with the Flash player; the game code is the original's.
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g06_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 50,        -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	hintCost = 2,
	descKey = "desc_06",
	howKey = "how_06",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 480, 290
local STEP = 1 / 25
local MS = 40
local LIB = "g06"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local LIGHTS = { 115, 117, 126, 128, 130, 136, 141, 147, 161, 166 }

local CUR

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	for _, cid in ipairs(LIGHTS) do
		FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, {
			[1] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "off") end,
			[15] = function(c) if CUR then CUR:LightAniDone(c.vars.id) end FL.GotoAndStop(c, "off") end,
			[56] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:ShowRightAniDone() end end,
			[81] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:DieAniDone() end end,
		})
	end
	-- the elves blink now and then (1 in 75)
	local blink = { [2] = function(c) if math.random(0, 74) < 74 then FL.GotoAndPlay(c, "noblink") end end }
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 125, blink)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 156, blink)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 182, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,
		[10] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.hideMouse = true end end,
		[18] = function(c)
			if CUR then
				AN.Speak(CUR.gameOverSpeak or "GameOver")
				CUR.hideMouse = false
			end
			FL.Play(c)
		end,
		[92] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Game(), name) end
function G:Light(i) return self:Clip("light" .. i) end      -- the ones you click
function G:SLight(i) return self:Clip("light1" .. i) end    -- the ones that show the dance

-- the stage rectangle of a light's button (its hit area)
function G:ButtonRect(i)
	local gm = FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I)
	local lm, light = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "light" .. i, gm)
	if not light then return nil end
	local bm, btn = FL.ChildMatrix(light, "button", lm)
	if not btn or not btn.visible then return nil end
	local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(btn, bm, true)
	return x0, y0, x1, y1, FL.HitFn(btn, bm)
end

function G:SetButtons(v)
	for l = 0, 4 do
		local b = FL.Child(self:Light(l), "button")
		if b then b.visible = v end
	end
end

function G:SetScore(v)
	self.score = v
	local sb = self:Clip("statusbar")
	if sb then sb.vars.txt_score = v end
end

function G:SetArm(f)
	local timer = FL.Child(self:Clip("statusbar"), "timer")
	local arm = timer and FL.Child(timer, "arm")
	if arm then FL.GotoAndStop(arm, f) end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Init()
	for l = 0, 4 do
		local m = self:Light(l)
		if m then m.vars.id = l end
		local s = self:SLight(l)
		if s then s.vars.id = l end
	end
	self:SetButtons(false)
	self.baseTime = 3000
	self.wordTime = 1000
	self:StartNewGame()
end

function G:StartNewGame()
	self:SetScore(0)
	self.pauses = {}
	self.speech = {}
	self.curWord = -1
	self.simonState = 0
	self:SimonStartTurn()
end

function G:SimonStartTurn()
	self:SetArm(1)
	self:SetButtons(false)
	self.speech[#self.speech + 1] = math.random(0, 4)
	self.curWord = -1
	self.pauses[#self.pauses + 1] = { count = 25 }
	self.simonState = 2
	self.gameState = 1
end

function G:PlayerStartTurn()
	self:SetButtons(true)
	self.startTime = self.now
	self.levelTime = self.baseTime + self.wordTime * #self.speech
	self.error = false
	self.playerSpeech = {}
	self.playerCurWord = -1
	self.gameState = 2
end

function G:LightPressed(id)
	if self.gameState ~= 2 then return end
	if #self.playerSpeech >= #self.speech or self.error then return end
	self.playerSpeech[#self.playerSpeech + 1] = id
	self.playerCurWord = #self.playerSpeech - 1
	if id ~= self.speech[self.playerCurWord + 1] then
		self.error = true
		FL.GotoAndPlay(self:Light(id), "error")
		MG.Sound("g06", "error")
		self.gameOverSpeak = "GameOver"
		self.gameState = 3
	else
		self:LightLamp(id)
		self:SetScore(self.score + 1)
	end
end

function G:LightLamp(id)
	if self.gameState == 1 then
		FL.GotoAndPlay(self:SLight(id), "on")
	else
		FL.GotoAndPlay(self:Light(id), "on")
	end
	MG.Sound("g06", "beep" .. id)
end

function G:LightAniDone(id)
	if self.gameState == 1 then
		if self.curWord == #self.speech - 1 then self:PlayerStartTurn() end
		self.simonState = 2
	elseif self.gameState == 2 then
		if #self.playerSpeech == #self.speech then self:SimonStartTurn() end
	end
end

function G:UpdateTimer()
	local spent = (self.now - self.startTime) / self.levelTime
	if spent > 1 then
		self:SetArm(101)
		if #self.playerSpeech < #self.speech then
			self.gameState = 3
			local right = self.speech[self.playerCurWord + 2]
			FL.GotoAndPlay(self:Light(right), "showcorrect")
			MG.Sound("g06", "beep" .. right)
			self.gameOverSpeak = "GameOverTidenLoebUd"
		end
	else
		self:SetArm(1 + math.Round(spent * 100))
	end
end

-- the wrong elf has fallen: the right one (shown by the dancing elves) shows itself
function G:DieAniDone()
	local right = self.speech[self.playerCurWord + 1]
	FL.GotoAndPlay(self:SLight(right), "showcorrect")
	MG.Sound("g06", "beep" .. right)
end

function G:ShowRightAniDone()
	self:GameOver()
end

function G:GameOver()
	self.gameState = 4
	self.vars.score = self.score
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameover")
end

-- the game clip's enterFrame
function G:EnterFrame()
	if not self.pauses then return end
	if #self.pauses == 0 then
		if self.gameState == 1 then
			if self.simonState == 2 then
				self.curWord = self.curWord + 1
				self:LightLamp(self.speech[self.curWord + 1])
				self.simonState = 1
			end
		elseif self.gameState == 2 then
			self:UpdateTimer()
		end
	else
		for p = #self.pauses, 1, -1 do
			local ps = self.pauses[p]
			ps.count = ps.count - 1
			if ps.count <= 0 then
				if ps.fn then ps.fn() end
				table.remove(self.pauses, p)
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hint: the whole dance is shown again, slowly, on the elves you click (a ring and the step's
-- number, 0.8 s a step); your clock stands still meanwhile
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local HINT_STEP = 0.8
function G:CanHint() return self.gameState == 2 and not self.error and not self.hintT end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 0
	MG.Sound("g06", "beep" .. self.speech[1])
	self:SetScore(math.max(0, self.score - cost))
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 240, 40)
end
function G:HintStep(dt)
	if not self.hintT then return end
	local before = math.floor(self.hintT / HINT_STEP)
	self.hintT = self.hintT + dt
	self.startTime = self.startTime + dt * 1000    -- the clock waits
	local i = math.floor(self.hintT / HINT_STEP)
	if i ~= before and i < #self.speech then MG.Sound("g06", "beep" .. self.speech[i + 1]) end
	if self.gameState ~= 2 or i >= #self.speech then self.hintT = nil end
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintT then return end
	local i = math.floor(self.hintT / HINT_STEP) + 1
	local id = self.speech[i]
	if not id then return end
	local x0, y0, x1, y1 = self:ButtonRect(id)
	if not x0 then return end
	local cx, cy = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2
	MG.HintRing(cx, cy, math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) * 0.45, MG.HINT_GOLD)
	MG.HintText(tostring(i), cx, cy, MG.HINT_GOLD, 30)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g06_status", self.score or 0, #(self.speech or {}))
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.now = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.gameState = 0
	self.pauses = nil
	self.speech = {}
	self.hintT = nil
	MG.ResetPops()
	self.hideMouse = false
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameon")
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
	self:ShowCursor(true)
end

function G:ShowCursor(show)
	local p = UI.root
	if IsValid(p) and p.SetCursor and self.cursorShown ~= show then
		p:SetCursor(show and "arrow" or "blank")
		self.cursorShown = show
	end
end

function G:Step()
	self.now = self.now + MS
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	self:EnterFrame()
	-- the game's own pointer (mousePointerMc) follows the mouse while the mouse is hidden
	if not MG.x0 then return end
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "mousePointerMc", I)
	if k and self.hideMouse and mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H then
		k.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], mx, my }
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	self:HintStep(math.min(dt, 0.25))
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:ShowCursor(true)
	AN.FinishGame(6, self.score or 0)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(6) return end
	local st = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local inside = mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H
	self:ShowCursor(not (self.hideMouse and inside))
	-- the elves' buttons (only there while it is your turn)
	if self.gameState == 2 and self.root.frame < 18 then
		for _, l in ipairs({ 1, 2, 3, 4, 0 }) do   -- in depth order: the topmost last
			local x0, y0, x1, y1, hit = self:ButtonRect(l)
			if x0 then
				-- the box only narrows it down: the button's own hit area decides (the body parts overlap)
				UI.Button("g06_light" .. l, MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function() self:LightPressed(l) end, { silent = true, hit = hit })
			end
		end
	end
	if self.root.frame >= 18 and self.root.frame < 91 then
		UI.Button("g06_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(6)
end

AN.RegisterGame(6, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g07_gladi:
-- Låge 7: Glad i bad
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Whack-a-mole in the bath: 30 times something pops up out
-- of the water; click it before it dives again. The faster you click, the more points (10 to 26).
-- Every third hit makes them come faster and stay up for a shorter time.
-- The whole original timeline is played with the Flash player; the game code is the original's.
-- The code was written for 26 holes (and a keyboard aim on a 7 x 4 grid), but the bath only has 5:
-- the other 21 never exist, so only those 5 are used, as in the original.
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g07_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 600,       -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_07",
	howKey = "how_07",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 530, 390
local STEP = 1 / 25
local MS = 40
local LIB = "g07"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local NUM_ANIMALS = 26
local BUTTONS = { [124] = true, [139] = true }

local CUR

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end
local function snd(name) return function() MG.Sound("g07", name) end end

local function setupActions()
	FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [116] = true }   -- the figure standing in a closed hole hides itself
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 142, {
		[1] = stop, [20] = stop, [31] = stop, [53] = stop, [56] = stop, [75] = stop, [86] = stop, [108] = stop,
		[7] = snd("bag"), [62] = snd("bag"),
		[23] = snd("splash-long"), [78] = snd("splash-long"),
		[33] = function(c) local x = FL.Child(c, "cross") if x then FL.Play(x) end MG.Sound("g07", "splash-short") end,
		[88] = function(c) local x = FL.Child(c, "cross") if x then FL.Play(x) end MG.Sound("g07", "splash-short") end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 120, { [1] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 13, { [1] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 158, { [23] = stop })
	local hide = { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end }
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 14, hide)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 18, hide)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 169, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,
		[13] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.hideMouse = true end end,
		[21] = function(c)
			if CUR then
				CUR.hideMouse = false
				local p = CUR:Clip("mousePointerMc")
				if p then p.visible = false end
			end
			AN.Speak("GameOver")
			FL.Play(c)
		end,
		[97] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Game(), name) end
function G:GameM() return (FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I)) end

function G:Mouse()
	local sx, sy = MG.Mouse()
	local m = self:GameM()
	local det = m[1] * m[4] - m[2] * m[3]
	local x, y = sx - m[5], sy - m[6]
	return (m[4] * x - m[3] * y) / det, (-m[2] * x + m[1] * y) / det
end

-- the points that pop up over a hit (pointsMC / pointsMCneg, 10 of each)
function G:InitPoints()
	self.points, self.negPoints = {}, {}
	self.nextPoint, self.nextNegPoint = 1, 1
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y, hilite)
	local p, s
	if val > 0 then
		p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
		if not p then p = { c = FL.New(LIB, 18) } self.points[self.nextPoint] = p end
		self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 10 + 1
		s = math.max(55, math.min(140, val * 6.5)) / 100
	else
		p = self.negPoints[self.nextNegPoint]
		if not p then p = { c = FL.New(LIB, 14) } self.negPoints[self.nextNegPoint] = p end
		self.nextNegPoint = self.nextNegPoint % 10 + 1
		s = 1
	end
	p.m = { s, 0, 0, s, x, y }
	p.c.visible = true
	FL.GotoAndPlay(p.c, 1)
	local hl = FL.Child(p.c, "hilite")
	if hl then FL.GotoAndStop(hl, hilite and "on" or "off") end
	local ani = FL.Child(p.c, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Init()
	self.vars.score = 0
	self.level = 1
	self:InitPoints()
	self.state = "waitforgo"
	self.holes = {}
	self.lastLaunch = self.now
	self.numLaunched = 0
	self.numToLaunch = 30
	self.baseAnimInterval = 1150
	self.baseUpTime = 1300
	self.hitCount = 0
	self.hintLeft, self.hintNext = nil, nil
	self:StartLevel()
	self.initialized = true
end

function G:StartLevel()
	self.state = "gameon"
	for t = 0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1 do
		local mc = self:Clip("hole" .. t)
		if mc then
			-- holes 5..25 do not exist in the bath; the original set these fields on nothing
			self.holes[t] = { mc = mc, id = t, state = "closed", sCount = 0, upTime = 0 }
		end
	end
	self.levAnimInterval = self.baseAnimInterval - self.level * 15
	self.levUpTime = self.baseUpTime - self.level * 15
end

function G:LaunchHole(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	h.type = math.random(0, 1)
	FL.GotoAndPlay(h.mc, "open" .. h.type)
	h.state = "up"
	h.upTime = self.now
	self.numLaunched = self.numLaunched + 1
end

function G:CloseHole(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	FL.GotoAndPlay(h.mc, "down" .. h.type)
	h.state = "down"
end

function G:EndHole(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	FL.GotoAndStop(h.mc, "closed")
	h.state = "closed"
	if self.numLaunched >= self.numToLaunch then
		self.state = "gameOver"
		self.stateCount = 0
	end
end

function G:HoleClicked(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	if not h then return end
	FL.GotoAndPlay(h.mc, "hit" .. h.type)
	h.state = "hit"
	h.sCount = 0
	local dt = self.now - h.upTime
	local pts = math.Round(math.max(0, (1000 - dt) / 60) + 10)
	local hilite = false
	if pts > 22 then
		hilite = true
		if not AN.IsSpeaking("megetGodt") then AN.Speak("megetGodt") end
	elseif pts > 16 then
		hilite = true
		if not AN.IsSpeaking("Godt") then AN.Speak("Godt") end
	end
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "hole" .. id, I)
	self:SetPoint(pts, m[5], m[6] - 80, hilite)
	self.vars.score = self.vars.score + pts
	self.hitCount = self.hitCount + 1
	if self.hitCount > 2 then
		self.level = self.level + 1
		self.levAnimInterval = math.max(50, self.baseAnimInterval - self.level * 130)
		self.levUpTime = math.max(290, self.baseUpTime - self.level * 110)
		self.hitCount = 0
	end
end

function G:MainLoop()
	if not self.initialized or self.state == "waitforgo" then return end
	if self.state == "gameon" then
		local now = self.now
		if self.numLaunched < self.numToLaunch then
			if now - self.lastLaunch > self.levAnimInterval and math.random() > 0.964 then
				-- (hint: the hole shown in advance comes up next)
				local hn = self.hintNext and self.holes[self.hintNext]
				local tries = 20
				if hn and hn.state == "closed" then
					self:LaunchHole(self.hintNext)
					self.lastLaunch = now
					self.hintNext = nil
					self.hintLeft = self.hintLeft - 1
					tries = 0
				end
				-- up to 20 tries at a random hole out of 26 (only 5 exist)
				for _ = 1, tries do
					local r = math.random(0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1)
					local h = self.holes[r]
					if h and h.state == "closed" then
						self:LaunchHole(r)
						self.lastLaunch = now
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		self:HintPick()
		for t = 0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1 do
			local h = self.holes[t]
			if h and h.state ~= "closed" then
				if h.state == "up" then
					h.sCount = h.sCount + 1
					if now - h.upTime > self.levUpTime and math.random() > 0.9 then
						self:CloseHole(t)
						h.sCount = 0
					end
				elseif h.state == "down" then
					h.sCount = h.sCount + 1
					if h.sCount > 4 then self:EndHole(t) h.sCount = 0 end
				elseif h.state == "hit" then
					h.sCount = h.sCount + 1
					if h.sCount > 34 then self:EndHole(t) h.sCount = 0 end
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.state == "gameOver" then
		self.stateCount = self.stateCount + 1
		if self.stateCount == 20 then FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "gameover") end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hint: the next 3 holes to pop up glow a moment before they do (the next one is picked in advance)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:CanHint() return self.initialized and self.state == "gameon" and self.numLaunched < self.numToLaunch end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintLeft = (self.hintLeft or 0) + 3
	self.vars.score = math.max(0, self.vars.score - cost)
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 265, 60)
end
function G:HintPick()
	if not self.hintLeft or self.hintLeft <= 0 or self.numLaunched >= self.numToLaunch then self.hintNext = nil return end
	local cur = self.hintNext and self.holes[self.hintNext]
	if cur and cur.state == "closed" then return end
	local free = {}
	for t = 0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1 do
		local h = self.holes[t]
		if h and h.state == "closed" then free[#free + 1] = t end
	end
	self.hintNext = #free > 0 and free[math.random(#free)] or nil
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintNext or self.state ~= "gameon" then return end
	local m = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "hole" .. self.hintNext })
	if not m then return end
	MG.HintRing(m[5], m[6] - 30, 46, MG.HINT_GOLD)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g07_status", self.vars and self.vars.score or 0, self.numLaunched or 0, 30)
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.now = 0
	self.initialized = false
	self.numLaunched = 0
	self.hideMouse = false
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.points, self.negPoints = {}, {}
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameon")
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
	self:ShowCursor(true)
end

function G:ShowCursor(show)
	local p = UI.root
	if IsValid(p) and p.SetCursor and self.cursorShown ~= show then
		p:SetCursor(show and "arrow" or "blank")
		self.cursorShown = show
	end
end

function G:Step()
	self.now = self.now + MS
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then FL.Tick(p.c) end end
	for _, p in ipairs(self.negPoints) do if p.c.visible then FL.Tick(p.c) end end
	self:MainLoop()
	-- the game's own pointer follows the mouse while the mouse is hidden
	if self.hideMouse and MG.x0 and self:Game() then
		local mx, my = self:Mouse()
		if mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H then
			local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "mousePointerMc", I)
			if k then k.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], mx, my } end
		end
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:ShowCursor(true)
	AN.FinishGame(7, self.vars.score or 0)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(7) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	if game then
		local extra = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = p.c, m = p.m } end end
		for _, p in ipairs(self.negPoints) do if p.c.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = p.c, m = p.m } end end
		game.extra = extra
	end
	local st = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if name == "totaltxt" then return AN.L("g07_v_total", st.numLaunched or 0, 30) end
		if name == "scoretxt" then return st.initialized and st.vars.score or nil end
		if name == "fps" then return "" end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local inside = mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H
	self:ShowCursor(not (self.hideMouse and inside))
	-- the buttons inside the holes (there while something is up or diving)
	if game and self.root.frame < 21 then
		local gm = self:GameM()
		for t = 0, 4 do
			local m, hole = FL.ChildMatrix(game, "hole" .. t, gm)
			if hole then
				local btn, bm = FL.CharItem(hole, m, BUTTONS)
				local x0, y0, x1, y1
				if btn then x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(btn, bm, true) end
				if x0 then
					UI.Button("g07_hole" .. t, MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function() self:HoleClicked(t) end, { silent = true, hit = FL.HitFn(btn, bm) })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if self.root.frame >= 21 and self.root.frame < 96 then
		UI.Button("g07_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(7)
end
