alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g09_arkiv:
-- Låge 9: Arkivræs
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf: a "Rally-X" in TV 2's archive. Pyrus drives through the
-- shelves and picks up the 10 flags (one of them is a bonus flag that raises the multiplier) while
-- 3 cars hunt him. Space / Ctrl lays a smoke cloud that makes a car stuck for a while (it costs
-- fuel). Hitting a car or a rock costs a life; 3 lives. The fuel left at the end of a level is
-- counted up as a bonus. The radar shows the whole archive.
-- The whole original timeline is played with the Flash player; the game code is the original's,
-- with the same numbers and quirks:
--   * you crash into a rock already one square before you reach it (the original checks the
--     square you are driving towards),
--   * a car stuck in smoke still crashes into you,
--   * the "scared cars you can eat" part of the code (like Pac-Man's ghosts) is never used.
-- Hidden content: the game's own background music (in the file, but never played) plays during
-- the game.
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g09_fl.lua")
include(DIR .. "g09_map.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 30000,     -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_09",
	howKey = "how_09",
	levels = nil,
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 580, 400
local STEP = 1 / 25
local LIB = "g09"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local NBX, NBY = 34, 58

local CUR

-- "START SPILLET" has its text drawn in; an English one is made from it (scripts/g09_en.py)
FL.ImgSwap["g09/fl/s277.png"] = { en = "g09/fl/s277_en.png" }

-- the flag spots: 10 groups, one flag from each group (the original's map 0)
local FLAGS = {
	{ { 4, 4 }, { 8, 6 }, { 11, 9 }, { 4, 12 }, { 8, 13 } },
	{ { 30, 3 }, { 26, 6 }, { 17, 10 }, { 13, 13 }, { 17, 17 } },
	{ { 31, 5 }, { 28, 10 }, { 21, 13 }, { 31, 13 }, { 23, 18 } },
	{ { 15, 23 }, { 22, 23 }, { 16, 28 }, { 22, 29 }, { 17, 33 } },
	{ { 28, 18 }, { 32, 18 }, { 26, 23 }, { 30, 23 }, { 28, 27 } },
	{ { 4, 19 }, { 11, 19 }, { 12, 22 }, { 5, 25 }, { 8, 28 } },
	{ { 30, 32 }, { 4, 33 }, { 13, 33 }, { 22, 35 }, { 27, 36 } },
	{ { 12, 36 }, { 1, 39 }, { 7, 39 }, { 14, 41 }, { 3, 42 } },
	{ { 32, 37 }, { 24, 38 }, { 26, 42 }, { 30, 42 }, { 22, 44 } },
	{ { 9, 46 }, { 29, 49 }, { 4, 52 }, { 22, 53 }, { 29, 54 } },
}
local ROCKS = {
	{ 21, 4 }, { 10, 6 }, { 1, 13 }, { 9, 14 }, { 19, 14 }, { 7, 21 }, { 31, 27 }, { 18, 28 }, { 6, 30 }, { 27, 30 },
	{ 13, 31 }, { 26, 32 }, { 15, 38 }, { 22, 38 }, { 2, 39 }, { 29, 39 }, { 9, 43 }, { 1, 44 }, { 18, 46 }, { 28, 46 }, { 7, 52 },
}
-- the cars: start square and how they hunt (0: along the longest way to Pyrus first, 1: sideways
-- first, 2: up/down first, 3: at random)
local GHOSTS = {
	{ x = 16, y = 54, ai = 0 },
	{ x = 14, y = 54, ai = 1 },
	{ x = 18, y = 54, ai = 2 },
}

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [203] = true, [233] = true, [255] = true }   -- hit areas, the bang, corner marks
	for _, cid in ipairs({ 13, 137, 193, 197, 213, 220, 227, 234, 242, 299, 233 }) do
		FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, { [1] = stop })
	end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 233, { [9] = stop })
	-- the crash: the bang shows, and when it is over Pyrus has lost a life
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 230, {
		[1] = function(c) local h = c.parent and c.parent.parent local b = h and FL.Child(h, "bang") if b then b.visible = true end end,
		[31] = function(c)
			stop(c)
			local h = c.parent and c.parent.parent
			local b = h and FL.Child(h, "bang")
			if b then b.visible = false end
			if CUR then CUR:HeroDieAniDone() end
		end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 237, { [101] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:SmokeAniDone(c.ref) end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 243, { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 274, {
		[1] = stop,
		[26] = function(c) stop(c) AN.Speak("megetGodt") if CUR then CUR:StartFuelCount() end end,
		[75] = function() if CUR then CUR:EndLevel() end end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 279, { [1] = stop, [2] = function() MG.Sound("g09", "car_rev_up") end, [95] = function() if CUR then CUR:LevelIntroPlayed() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 287, { [1] = stop, [2] = function() MG.Sound("g09", "car_rev_up") end, [95] = function() if CUR then CUR:LevelIntroPlayed() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 311, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[8] = stop,
		[16] = function(c) AN.Speak("GameOver") FL.Play(c) end,
		[92] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Game(), name) end

-- a child's position (its _x / _y) inside its parent
local function itemPos(parent, name)
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(parent, name, I)
	return m and m[5] or 0, m and m[6] or 0
end

local function setPos(parent, name, x, y)
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(parent, name, I)
	if k then k.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], x, y } end
end

-- an attached clip: { c = clip, m = matrix, depth = n }
local function attach(list, cid, depth, x, y, sx, sy)
	local e = { c = FL.New(LIB, cid), m = { sx or 1, 0, 0, sy or sx or 1, x or 0, y or 0 }, depth = depth }
	list[#list + 1] = e
	return e
end

local function detach(list, e)
	for i = #list, 1, -1 do if list[i] == e then table.remove(list, i) end end
end

local function vec(x, y) return { x = x or 0, y = y or 0 } end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Init()
	local arena = self:Clip("arena")
	local ux, uy = itemPos(arena, "grid_upleft")
	local dx, dy = itemPos(arena, "grid_downright")
	self.gridUL, self.gridDR = vec(ux, uy), vec(dx, dy)
	self.defaultSpeed = (dx - ux) / 110 * 0.8
	self.levelSpeedIncrement = 0.05
	self.maxSpeed = 9.5
	self.flagScore = 100
	self.fuelBonusBase = 25
	self.smokeCost = 0.5
	self.engineCost = 0.01
	self.noFuelSpeedFactor = 0.9
	self:InitPoints()
	self.ISON = false
	self:CreateHero()
	self.gameState = 0
	self:StartNewGame()
end

function G:StartNewGame()
	self.score = 0
	self.lives = 3
	self.pauses = {}
	self.ISON = true
	self:StartLevel(1)
end

-- the points that pop up (5 of them, in the middle of the game window)
function G:InitPoints()
	self.points = {}
	self.nextPoint = 1
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	if not p then
		p = { c = FL.New(LIB, 243), s = 1 }
		self.points[self.nextPoint] = p
	end
	-- the scale is val * 0.5 %, 55..140; for "300 x 2" that is not a number and the scale stays
	if type(val) == "number" then p.s = math.max(55, math.min(140, val * 0.5)) / 100 end
	p.m = { p.s, 0, 0, p.s, x, y }
	p.c.visible = true
	FL.GotoAndPlay(p.c, 1)
	local hl = FL.Child(p.c, "hilite")
	if hl then FL.GotoAndStop(hl, "off") end
	local ani = FL.Child(p.c, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 5 + 1
end

function G:CreateHero()
	self.hero = {
		pos = vec(), vel = vec(), startPos = vec(), dir = -1, wannaGo = -1, speed = 0,
		normalSpeed = 0, scareSpeed = 0, speedFactor = 0.8, fuel = 0, state = 0, startDir = 0, isHero = true,
	}
end

-- the grid: 34 x 58 squares over the archive picture
function G:CreateGrid(nbRocks)
	local gs = vec((self.gridDR.x - self.gridUL.x) / NBX, (self.gridDR.y - self.gridUL.y) / NBY)
	self.gridSize = gs
	local off = vec(self.gridUL.x + gs.x / 2, self.gridUL.y + gs.y / 2)
	local rows = {}
	for line in string.gmatch(AN.G09Map, "[01]+") do rows[#rows + 1] = line end
	local grid = {}
	for gx = 0, NBX - 1 do
		grid[gx] = {}
		for gy = 0, NBY - 1 do
			local road = rows[gy + 1] and string.sub(rows[gy + 1], gx + 1, gx + 1) == "0"
			grid[gx][gy] = { id = vec(gx, gy), pos = vec(off.x + gx * gs.x, off.y + gy * gs.y), type = road and 0 or 1, moves = { 1, 1, 1, 1 }, smoking = false, state = -1 }
		end
	end
	self.grid = grid
	-- fillGrid: one flag of each group, one of them the bonus flag, and the rocks
	self.hero.startGridRef = grid[16][51]
	self.hero.startDir = 0
	local bonus = math.random(0, 9)
	for i = 0, 9 do
		local p = FLAGS[i + 1][math.random(1, #FLAGS[i + 1])]
		grid[p[1]][p[2]].type = i == bonus and 3 or 2
	end
	local rocks = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(ROCKS) do rocks[#rocks + 1] = r end
	for _ = 1, nbRocks do
		local k = math.random(1, #rocks)
		local r = table.remove(rocks, k)
		grid[r[1]][r[2]].type = 4
	end
	self:CreateGridStuff()
end

function G:CreateGridStuff()
	local grid, gs = self.grid, self.gridSize
	self.nbFood = 0
	for gx = 0, NBX - 1 do
		for gy = 0, NBY - 1 do
			local g = grid[gx][gy]
			-- moves[dir + 1]: the type of the square that way (the grid wraps round)
			g.moves[1] = grid[gx][(gy - 1) % NBY].type
			g.moves[2] = grid[(gx + 1) % NBX][gy].type
			g.moves[3] = grid[gx][(gy + 1) % NBY].type
			g.moves[4] = grid[(gx - 1) % NBX][gy].type
			if g.type == 2 or g.type == 3 or g.type == 4 then
				if g.type ~= 4 then self.nbFood = self.nbFood + 1 end
				local e = attach(self.arenaStuff, 197, 1000 + gx + gy * NBX, g.pos.x, g.pos.y, gs.x / 100, gs.y / 100)
				FL.GotoAndStop(e.c, g.type - 1)
				e.c.visible = false
				g.mc = e.c
				g.mcEntry = e
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:RemoveGridStuff()
	for gx = 0, NBX - 1 do
		for gy = 0, NBY - 1 do
			local g = self.grid[gx][gy]
			if g.mcEntry then detach(self.arenaStuff, g.mcEntry) end
		end
	end
	for s = #self.smoke, 1, -1 do
		detach(self.arenaStuff, self.smoke[s].entry)
		table.remove(self.smoke, s)
	end
end

function G:CreateGhosts(n)
	self.ghosts = {}
	for g = 0, n - 1 do
		local d = GHOSTS[g + 1]
		local e = attach(self.arenaStuff, 227 - g * 7, 20000 + g)   -- ghost0 = 227, ghost1 = 220, ghost2 = 213
		local gh = {
			id = g, mc = e.c, entry = e, pos = vec(), vel = vec(), startPos = vec(), dir = -1, wannaGo = -1,
			homeTime = 25, homeCount = 0, scaredTime = 200, scaredCount = 0, speed = 0, speedFactor = 0.8, state = 0,
			ai = d.ai, startGridRef = self.grid[d.x][d.y], startDir = 0,
		}
		gh.startPos.x, gh.startPos.y = gh.startGridRef.pos.x, gh.startGridRef.pos.y
		self.ghosts[g + 1] = gh
	end
end

function G:RemoveGhosts()
	for _, gh in ipairs(self.ghosts or {}) do detach(self.arenaStuff, gh.entry) end
end

-- the radar: a dot for each flag, Pyrus and the cars
function G:CreateRadarStuff()
	local radar = self:Clip("radar")
	local ux, uy = itemPos(radar, "grid_upleft")
	local dx, dy = itemPos(radar, "grid_downright")
	local rs = vec((dx - ux) / NBX, (dy - uy) / NBY)
	self.radarSize = rs
	self.radarOff = vec(ux + rs.x / 2, uy + rs.y / 2)
	self.radarStuff = {}
	for gx = 0, NBX - 1 do
		for gy = 0, NBY - 1 do
			local g = self.grid[gx][gy]
			if g.type == 2 or g.type == 3 then
				local e = attach(self.radarStuff, 193, 1000 + gx + gy * NBX, self.radarOff.x + gx * rs.x, self.radarOff.y + gy * rs.y, rs.x / 100, rs.y / 100)
				FL.GotoAndStop(e.c, g.type - 1)
				g.radarMc = e
			end
		end
	end
	local h = self.hero
	h.radarMc = attach(self.radarStuff, 190, 21000, self.radarOff.x + h.startGridRef.id.x * rs.x, self.radarOff.y + h.startGridRef.id.y * rs.y, rs.x / 100, rs.y / 100)
	for _, gh in ipairs(self.ghosts) do
		gh.radarMc = attach(self.radarStuff, 188, 20000 + gh.id, self.radarOff.x + gh.startGridRef.id.x * rs.x, self.radarOff.y + gh.startGridRef.id.y * rs.y, rs.x / 100, rs.y / 100)
	end
end

function G:SetRadar(obj)
	if not obj.radarMc then return end
	obj.radarMc.m[5] = self.radarOff.x + obj.gridPos.id.x * self.radarSize.x
	obj.radarMc.m[6] = self.radarOff.y + obj.gridPos.id.y * self.radarSize.y
end

function G:StartLevel(lvl)
	self.gameState = 1
	self.level = lvl
	self.arenaStuff = self.arenaStuff or {}
	self:CreateGrid(2)
	self:CreateGhosts(3)
	-- the hero's car goes on top of everything in the arena
	local h = self.hero
	if not h.entry then
		h.entry = attach(self.arenaStuff, 234, 21000)
		h.mc = h.entry.c
	end
	self:CreateRadarStuff()
	self.foodLeft = self.nbFood
	self.nbFlagsEaten = 0
	self.bonusMultiplier = 1
	h.startPos.x, h.startPos.y = h.startGridRef.pos.x, h.startGridRef.pos.y
	for gx = 0, NBX - 1 do
		for gy = 0, NBY - 1 do
			local g = self.grid[gx][gy]
			if g.type == 2 or g.type == 3 then
				g.mc.visible = true
				g.state = 1
			elseif g.type == 4 then
				g.mc.visible = true
			end
		end
	end
	self.smoke = {}
	self:InitCam()
	self:SpawnHero()
	self:SpawnGhosts()
	self:UpdateStatusbar()
	if lvl == 1 then
		FL.Play(self:Clip("startgameani"))
	else
		FL.Play(self:Clip("spawnani"))
	end
end

function G:LevelIntroPlayed()
	local anim = FL.Child(self.hero.mc, "anim")
	if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "walking") end
	self.gameState = 2
	self:StartMusic()
end

function G:EndLevel()
	self:RemoveGridStuff()
	self:RemoveGhosts()
	self:StartLevel(self.level + 1)
end

function G:InitCam()
	local cam = self:Clip("camera")
	local ux, uy = itemPos(cam, "cam_upleft")
	local dx, dy = itemPos(cam, "cam_downright")
	self.cam = { offset = vec(ux, uy), half = vec((dx - ux) / 2, (dy - uy) / 2) }
end

function G:UpdateCamera()
	local h = self.hero
	setPos(self:Game(), "arena", -h.pos.x + self.cam.offset.x + self.cam.half.x, -h.pos.y + self.cam.offset.y + self.cam.half.y)
end

function G:SetVel(o)
	o.vel.x, o.vel.y = 0, 0
	if o.dir == 0 then o.vel.y = -o.speed
	elseif o.dir == 1 then o.vel.x = o.speed
	elseif o.dir == 2 then o.vel.y = o.speed
	elseif o.dir == 3 then o.vel.x = -o.speed end
end

function G:CanWeGo(o, dir)
	if dir == -1 or dir == nil then return 1 end
	return o.gridPos.moves[dir + 1]
end

function G:CheckGridPassed(o)
	local v, p, g = o.vel, o.pos, o.gridPos.pos
	if v.x < 0 then return p.x < g.x
	elseif v.x > 0 then return p.x > g.x
	elseif v.y < 0 then return p.y < g.y
	elseif v.y > 0 then return p.y > g.y end
	return false
end

function G:AnimChangeDir(o)
	FL.GotoAndStop(o.mc, "dir" .. o.dir)
	local anim = FL.Child(o.mc, "anim")
	if o.isHero then
		if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "walking") end
	elseif o.state == 1 then
		if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "walking") end
	end
end

function G:ChangeGridPos(o, dir)
	local oldDir = o.dir
	o.dir = dir
	local gp = o.gridPos
	local dist = math.abs(o.pos.x - gp.pos.x + (o.pos.y - gp.pos.y))
	o.pos.x, o.pos.y = gp.pos.x, gp.pos.y
	o.vel.x, o.vel.y = 0, 0
	local nx, ny = gp.id.x, gp.id.y
	local w, h = self.gridDR.x - self.gridUL.x, self.gridDR.y - self.gridUL.y
	if dir == 0 then
		o.pos.y = o.pos.y - dist
		o.vel.y = -o.speed
		ny = ny - 1
		if ny < 0 then ny = NBY - 1 o.pos.y = o.pos.y + h end
	elseif dir == 1 then
		o.pos.x = o.pos.x + dist
		o.vel.x = o.speed
		nx = nx + 1
		if nx >= NBX then nx = 0 o.pos.x = o.pos.x - w end
	elseif dir == 2 then
		o.pos.y = o.pos.y + dist
		o.vel.y = o.speed
		ny = ny + 1
		if ny >= NBY then ny = 0 o.pos.y = o.pos.y - h end
	elseif dir == 3 then
		o.pos.x = o.pos.x - dist
		o.vel.x = -o.speed
		nx = nx - 1
		if nx < 0 then nx = NBX - 1 o.pos.x = o.pos.x + w end
	end
	o.gridPos = self.grid[nx][ny]
	if oldDir ~= dir then self:AnimChangeDir(o) end
	self:SetRadar(o)
end

function G:SpawnHero()
	local h = self.hero
	h.pos.x, h.pos.y = h.startPos.x, h.startPos.y
	h.gridPos = h.startGridRef
	h.dir = h.startDir
	h.normalSpeed = math.min(self.maxSpeed, (1 + self.levelSpeedIncrement * self.level) * self.defaultSpeed * h.speedFactor)
	h.scareSpeed = math.min(self.maxSpeed, h.normalSpeed * 1.3)
	h.speed = h.normalSpeed
	self:SetVel(h)
	h.fuel = 100
	h.state = 1
	FL.GotoAndStop(h.mc, "dir" .. h.dir)
	local anim = FL.Child(h.mc, "anim")
	if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "standing") end
	h.entry.m[5], h.entry.m[6] = h.pos.x, h.pos.y
	self:SetRadar(h)
	self:UpdateCamera()
end

function G:SpawnGhosts()
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do
		g.pos.x, g.pos.y = g.startPos.x, g.startPos.y
		g.gridPos = g.startGridRef
		g.dir = g.startDir
		g.speed = math.min(self.maxSpeed, (1 + self.levelSpeedIncrement * self.level) * self.defaultSpeed * g.speedFactor)
		g.vel.x, g.vel.y = 0, 0
		g.homeCount = g.homeTime
		g.state = 4
		FL.GotoAndStop(g.mc, "dir" .. g.dir)
		local anim = FL.Child(g.mc, "anim")
		if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "standing") end
		g.entry.m[5], g.entry.m[6] = g.pos.x, g.pos.y
		self:SetRadar(g)
	end
end

function G:EatFood(g)
	if g.state ~= 1 then return end
	if g.type == 3 then self.bonusMultiplier = self.bonusMultiplier + 1 end
	self.nbFlagsEaten = self.nbFlagsEaten + 1
	self.score = self.score + self.flagScore * self.nbFlagsEaten * self.bonusMultiplier
	local shown = self.flagScore * self.nbFlagsEaten
	if self.bonusMultiplier > 1 then shown = shown .. " x " .. self.bonusMultiplier end
	self:SetPoint(shown, 200, 200)
	self:UpdateStatusbar()
	g.state = 0
	g.mc.visible = false
	if g.radarMc then g.radarMc.c.visible = false end
	self.foodLeft = self.foodLeft - 1
	MG.Sound("g09", "pickup_flag")
end

function G:FireSmoke()
	MG.Sound("g09", "smoke")
	local h = self.hero
	local e = attach(self.arenaStuff, 237, 19000 + #self.smoke, h.gridPos.pos.x, h.gridPos.pos.y)
	e.c.ref = h.gridPos
	local s = { entry = e, state = 1 }
	self.smoke[#self.smoke + 1] = s
	h.gridPos.smoking = s
	h.fuel = math.max(0, h.fuel - self.smokeCost)
end

function G:SmokeAniDone(ref)
	if ref and ref.smoking then
		ref.smoking.state = 2
		ref.smoking = false
	end
end

function G:RemoveSmoke()
	for s = #self.smoke, 1, -1 do
		if self.smoke[s].state == 2 then
			detach(self.arenaStuff, self.smoke[s].entry)
			table.remove(self.smoke, s)
		end
	end
end

function G:CheckKeys()
	local h = self.hero
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then h.wannaGo = 3
	elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then h.wannaGo = 1
	elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_UP) then h.wannaGo = 0
	elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_DOWN) then h.wannaGo = 2 end
	self.wantSmoke = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE) or input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LCONTROL) or input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RCONTROL)
end

function G:UpdateHero()
	local h = self.hero
	if h.state ~= 1 then return end
	h.fuel = h.fuel - self.engineCost
	local fuelSpeed = 1
	if h.fuel < 0 then
		h.fuel = 0
		fuelSpeed = self.noFuelSpeedFactor
	end
	self:SetFuelBar(h.fuel)
	h.pos.x = h.pos.x + h.vel.x * fuelSpeed
	h.pos.y = h.pos.y + h.vel.y * fuelSpeed
	if self.wantSmoke and h.gridPos.smoking == false and h.fuel > 0 then self:FireSmoke() end
	if self:CheckGridPassed(h) then
		self:EatFood(h.gridPos)
		if self:CanWeGo(h, h.wannaGo) == 1 then h.wannaGo = h.dir end
		if self:CanWeGo(h, h.wannaGo) ~= 1 then
			self:ChangeGridPos(h, h.wannaGo)
		else
			local right, left = (h.dir + 1) % 4, (h.dir + 3) % 4
			if self:CanWeGo(h, right) ~= 1 then h.wannaGo = right
			elseif self:CanWeGo(h, left) ~= 1 then h.wannaGo = left
			else h.wannaGo = (h.dir + 2) % 4 end
			self:ChangeGridPos(h, h.wannaGo)
		end
	end
	h.entry.m[5], h.entry.m[6] = h.pos.x, h.pos.y
end

-- which way a car wants to go, best first (the original's four kinds of driver)
local function optimalDirs(ai, tx, ty)
	local o = {}
	if ai == 0 then
		if math.abs(tx) >= math.abs(ty) then
			o[1] = tx > 0 and 1 or 3
			o[2] = ty < 0 and 0 or 2
		else
			o[1] = ty < 0 and 0 or 2
			o[2] = tx > 0 and 1 or 3
		end
		o[3] = (o[2] + 2) % 4
		o[4] = (o[1] + 2) % 4
	elseif ai == 1 then
		if tx ~= 0 then
			if tx > 0 then o[1], o[4] = 1, 3 else o[1], o[4] = 3, 1 end
			if ty < 0 then o[2], o[3] = 0, 2 else o[2], o[3] = 2, 0 end
		else
			if ty < 0 then o[1], o[4] = 0, 2 else o[1], o[4] = 2, 0 end
			if math.random() < 0.5 then o[2], o[3] = 1, 3 else o[2], o[3] = 3, 1 end
		end
	elseif ai == 2 then
		if ty ~= 0 then
			if ty < 0 then o[1], o[4] = 0, 2 else o[1], o[4] = 2, 0 end
			if tx > 0 then o[2], o[3] = 1, 3 else o[2], o[3] = 3, 1 end
		else
			if tx > 0 then o[1], o[4] = 1, 3 else o[1], o[4] = 3, 1 end
			if math.random() < 0.5 then o[2], o[3] = 0, 2 else o[2], o[3] = 2, 0 end
		end
	else
		local avail = { 0, 1, 2, 3 }
		for d = 1, 4 do o[d] = table.remove(avail, math.random(1, #avail)) end
	end
	return o
end

function G:UpdateGhosts()
	if self.hero.state == 2 then return end
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do
		local anim = FL.Child(g.mc, "anim")
		if g.state == 4 then
			g.homeCount = g.homeCount - 1
			if g.homeCount <= 0 then
				self:SetVel(g)
				FL.GotoAndStop(g.mc, "dir" .. g.dir)
				anim = FL.Child(g.mc, "anim")
				if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "walking") end
				g.state = 1
			end
		elseif g.gridPos.smoking ~= false then
			if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "stuck") end
			g.state = 7
		else
			if g.state == 7 then
				if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "walking") end
				g.state = 1
			end
			g.pos.x = g.pos.x + g.vel.x
			g.pos.y = g.pos.y + g.vel.y
			if g.state == 1 and self:CheckGridPassed(g) then
				local back = (g.dir + 2) % 4
				local h = self.hero
				local o = optimalDirs(g.ai, h.gridPos.id.x - g.gridPos.id.x, h.gridPos.id.y - g.gridPos.id.y)
				-- drop the ways that are blocked (shelves and rocks); going back is the last choice
				for d = 3, 0, -1 do
					if o[d + 1] ~= nil then
						local t = self:CanWeGo(g, o[d + 1])
						if t ~= 1 and t ~= 4 then
							if o[d + 1] == back then
								table.remove(o, d + 1)
								o[#o + 1] = back
							end
						else
							table.remove(o, d + 1)
						end
					end
				end
				g.wannaGo = o[1]
				self:ChangeGridPos(g, g.wannaGo)
			end
		end
		g.entry.m[5], g.entry.m[6] = g.pos.x, g.pos.y
	end
end

-- hitarea.hitTest(hero.hitarea): the two cars' hit boxes overlap
function G:HitArea(o)
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(o.mc, "hitarea", o.entry.m)
	if not k then return nil end
	return FL.Bounds(k, m, true)
end

function G:CheckCollisions()
	local h = self.hero
	if h.state ~= 1 then return end
	local eat = false
	local ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1 = self:HitArea(h)
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do
		if (g.state == 1 or g.state == 7) and ax0 then
			local bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = self:HitArea(g)
			if bx0 and ax0 <= bx1 and bx0 <= ax1 and ay0 <= by1 and by0 <= ay1 then eat = true end
		end
	end
	if h.gridPos.type == 4 then eat = true end
	if eat then self:EatHero() end
end

function G:EatHero()
	local h = self.hero
	h.state = 2
	local anim = FL.Child(h.mc, "anim")
	if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "standing") end
	-- eatHeroPauseDone (the original turned the crash sound down to 10% right after starting it)
	if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "dying") end
	MG.Sound("g09", "car_crash", 0.1)
	AN.Speak("MisterLiv")
end

function G:HeroDieAniDone()
	self.lives = self.lives - 1
	if self.lives <= 0 then
		self:GameOver()
	else
		self:SpawnHero()
		self:SpawnGhosts()
		self:UpdateStatusbar()
		FL.Play(self:Clip("spawnani"))
		self.gameState = 1
	end
end

function G:CheckLevelCompleted()
	if self.foodLeft <= 0 then
		local anim = FL.Child(self.hero.mc, "anim")
		if anim then FL.GotoAndStop(anim, "standing") end
		FL.Play(self:Clip("lvlcompani"))
		self.gameState = 3
	end
end

-- the fuel left is counted into points (25 per unit of fuel, one unit a frame)
function G:StartFuelCount()
	self.counting = true
	self.fuelBonus = 0
	local a = self:Clip("lvlcompani")
	if a then a.vars.txtFuelBonus = 0 end
end

function G:FuelCount()
	local h = self.hero
	local add, done = 0, false
	if h.fuel >= 1 then
		add = self.fuelBonusBase
		h.fuel = h.fuel - 1
	else
		add = math.Round(self.fuelBonusBase * h.fuel)
		h.fuel = 0
		done = true
	end
	self.fuelBonus = self.fuelBonus + add
	self.score = self.score + add
	self:UpdateStatusbar()
	local a = self:Clip("lvlcompani")
	if a then a.vars.txtFuelBonus = self.fuelBonus end
	if done then
		self.counting = false
		FL.Play(a)
		-- each finished level goes on that level's high score list
		AN.LevelScore(9, self.level, self.score - (self.levelStartScore or 0), { total = self.score })
		self.levelStartScore = self.score
	end
end

function G:SetFuelBar(fuel)
	local sb = self:Clip("statusbar")
	local f = sb and FL.Child(sb, "fuel")
	if not f then return end
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(f, "bar", I)
	if not k then return end
	k.baseM = k.baseM or { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5], m[6] }
	local b = k.baseM
	-- _xscale = fuel (the bar is flipped, so it keeps its direction)
	local sx = (b[1] < 0 and -1 or 1) * fuel / 100
	k.mat = { sx, 0, 0, b[4], b[5], b[6] }
end

function G:UpdateStatusbar()
	local sb = self:Clip("statusbar")
	if not sb then return end
	sb.vars.txt_score = self.score
	sb.vars.txt_level = self.level
	local lives = FL.Child(sb, "lives")
	if lives then FL.GotoAndStop(lives, math.min(4, self.lives)) end
	self:SetFuelBar(self.hero.fuel)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hint (15 seconds): the bonus flag is ringed on the radar, the rocks are marked on it, and a "!"
-- warns over Pyrus when he drives towards a rock (you crash a square early, see above)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:CanHint() return self.gameState == 2 and self.hero and self.hero.state == 1 end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 15
	self.score = math.max(0, self.score - cost)
	self:UpdateStatusbar()
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 240, 60)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintT then return end
	self.hintT = self.hintT - FrameTime()
	if self.hintT <= 0 or self.gameState ~= 2 then self.hintT = nil return end
	local a = math.min(1, self.hintT * 2)
	local rm = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "radar" })
	local rs, ro = self.radarSize, self.radarOff
	if rm and rs and self.grid then
		for gx = 0, NBX - 1 do
			for gy = 0, NBY - 1 do
				local g = self.grid[gx][gy]
				if g.type == 3 and g.state == 1 then
					local x, y = TL.Apply(rm, ro.x + gx * rs.x, ro.y + gy * rs.y)
					MG.HintRing(x, y, 9, MG.HINT_GOLD, a, 3)
				elseif g.type == 4 then
					local x, y = TL.Apply(rm, ro.x + gx * rs.x, ro.y + gy * rs.y)
					MG.HintText("x", x, y, MG.HINT_BAD, 14, a)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- a rock straight ahead (within two squares)
	local h = self.hero
	local am = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "arena" })
	if am and h.gridPos and h.dir and h.dir >= 0 then
		local d = ({ { 0, -1 }, { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { -1, 0 } })[h.dir + 1]
		local id = h.gridPos.id
		for k = 1, 2 do
			local g = self.grid[(id.x + d[1] * k) % NBX] and self.grid[(id.x + d[1] * k) % NBX][(id.y + d[2] * k) % NBY]
			if not g or g.type == 1 then break end
			if g.type == 4 then
				local x, y = TL.Apply(am, h.pos.x, h.pos.y)
				MG.HintText("!", x, y - 34, MG.HINT_BAD, 34, a)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:GameOver()
	self.vars.score = self.score
	self:StopMusic()
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameover")
end

function G:MainLoop()
	if not self.ISON then return end
	if self.counting then self:FuelCount() end
	if self.gameState ~= 2 then return end
	if #self.pauses == 0 then
		self:CheckKeys()
		self:UpdateHero()
		self:UpdateCamera()
		self:UpdateGhosts()
		self:CheckCollisions()
		self:RemoveSmoke()
		self:CheckLevelCompleted()
	else
		for p = #self.pauses, 1, -1 do
			local ps = self.pauses[p]
			ps.count = ps.count - 1
			if ps.count <= 0 then
				if ps.fn then ps.fn() end
				table.remove(self.pauses, p)
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hidden content: the background music that was left in the file
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:StartMusic()
	if self.musicOn or AN.Save.Get("hidden") == false then return end
	if AN.SoundMode() ~= 0 then return end
	local v = (AN.Save.Get("vol_music") or 70) / 100 * 0.6
	if v <= 0 then return end
	self.musicOn = true
	local me = self
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/g09/bg_loop.mp3", "noplay noblock", function(ch)
		if not IsValid(ch) then return end
		if CUR ~= me or not me.musicOn then ch:Stop() return end
		ch:EnableLooping(true)
		ch:SetVolume(v)
		ch:Play()
		me.musicCh = ch
	end)
end

function G:StopMusic()
	self.musicOn = false
	if self.musicCh and IsValid(self.musicCh) then self.musicCh:Stop() end
	self.musicCh = nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g09_status", self.score or 0, self.level or 1, self.lives or 3)
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.level = 1
	self.lives = 3
	self.counting = false
	self.levelStartScore = 0
	self.ISON = false
	self.arenaStuff, self.radarStuff, self.points = {}, {}, {}
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameon")
end

function G:Close()
	self:StopMusic()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

function G:Step()
	FL.OnSound = function() end
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, e in ipairs(self.arenaStuff) do FL.Tick(e.c) end
	for _, e in ipairs(self.radarStuff or {}) do FL.Tick(e.c) end
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then FL.Tick(p.c) end end
	FL.OnSound = nil
	self:MainLoop()
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:StopMusic()
	AN.FinishGame(9, self.score or 0)
end

local function byDepth(a, b) return a.depth < b.depth end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(9) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	if game then
		local arena = FL.Child(game, "arena")
		if arena then
			table.sort(self.arenaStuff, byDepth)
			arena.extra = self.arenaStuff
		end
		local radar = FL.Child(game, "radar")
		if radar then radar.extra = self.radarStuff end
		local extra = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = p.c, m = p.m } end end
		game.extra = extra
	end
	local st = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if name == "txt_debug" then return "" end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	if self.root.frame >= 16 and self.root.frame < 91 then
		UI.Button("g09_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(9)
end

-- (Duel split screen: two copies of the game run side by side; the clips' frame scripts
-- talk to the copy that is running right now)
function G:MakeCurrent() CUR = self end

AN.RegisterGame(9, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g10_gaase:
-- Låge 10: Gåseflyvning
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Pyrus and Kandis ride a goose: the mouse moves it back and
-- forth, a click makes it flap up, and it sinks when you don't. Christmas ornaments float in from
-- the right (30, 40, 50 or 80 points); a thunder cloud ends the flight. Every 10 seconds they come
-- faster and more often.
-- The game is a Halloween game dressed up for Christmas: in the code the goose is the "witch", the
-- ornaments are a bat, a spider, a snake and a pumpkin, and the thunder cloud is a skull.
-- The whole original timeline is played with the Flash player; the game code is the original's,
-- with its quirks: an ornament is only caught when its left edge is inside the goose's box (the
-- other half of the test used a variable that did not exist), and each of the 35 ornaments gets
-- its kind and height once, so the same ones come round again.
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g10_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 8000,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_10",
	howKey = "how_10",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 480, 290
local STEP = 1 / 25
local MS = 40
local LIB = "g10"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }

local KINDS = {
	{ cid = 65, points = 30 },                  -- "bat"
	{ cid = 71, points = 50 },                  -- "spider"
	{ cid = 61, points = 40 },                  -- "snake"
	{ cid = 63, points = 80 },                  -- "pumpkin"
	{ cid = 69, points = 0, lethal = true },    -- "skull": the thunder cloud
}

local CUR

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end
local function idle(c) FL.GotoAndPlay(c, "idle") end

local function setupActions()
	for _, cid in ipairs({ 111, 122, 127, 132, 76, 82 }) do FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, { [1] = stop }) end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 192, { [23] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 59, { [29] = idle, [87] = idle })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 69, { [55] = idle, [137] = idle })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 77, { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 195, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,
		[14] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.hideMouse = true end end,
		[22] = function(c)
			if CUR then CUR.hideMouse = false end
			AN.Speak("GameOver")
			FL.Play(c)
		end,
		[104] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:GameM() return (FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I)) end

function G:Mouse()
	local sx, sy = MG.Mouse()
	local m = self:GameM()
	local det = m[1] * m[4] - m[2] * m[3]
	local x, y = sx - m[5], sy - m[6]
	return (m[4] * x - m[3] * y) / det, (-m[2] * x + m[1] * y) / det
end

-- the original's boxesIntersect, quirks and all
local function boxesIntersect(b1x, b1y, b1w, b1h, b2x, b2y, b2w, b2h)
	if b2x >= b1x and b2x <= b1x + b1w then
		if b2y >= b1y and b2y <= b1y + b1h then return true end
		if b2y + b2h >= b1y and b2y + b1h <= b1y + b1h then return true end
	end
	-- (the "else if" half tested b2_x + w, and w did not exist: never true)
	return false
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:InitPoints()
	self.points = {}
	self.nextPoint = 1
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y, hilite)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	if not p then p = { c = FL.New(LIB, 77) } self.points[self.nextPoint] = p end
	p.m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, x, y }
	p.c.visible = true
	FL.GotoAndPlay(p.c, 1)
	local hl = FL.Child(p.c, "hilite")
	if hl then FL.GotoAndStop(hl, hilite and "on" or "off") end
	local ani = FL.Child(p.c, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 35 + 1
end

function G:InitEnemies()
	self.maxVisible = 6
	self.inPlay = 0
	self.nbEnemies = 35
	self.nextEnemy = 1
	self.minX = 10
	self.updateCount = 0
	self.scrollSpeed = 1
	self.spawnFrames = 60
	self.enemies = {}
	for t = 1, self.nbEnemies do
		local kind = KINDS[math.Round(math.random() * 4) + 1]
		local y = math.Round(math.random() * 220) + 30
		self.enemies[t] = {
			c = FL.New(LIB, kind.cid), kind = kind, pos = { x = 1000, y = y }, visible = false,
			box = { x = -19, y = -19, xabs = 0, yabs = 0, w = 38, h = 38 },
		}
	end
end

function G:UpdateEnemies()
	self.updateCount = self.updateCount + 1
	if self.updateCount >= self.spawnFrames then
		self.updateCount = 0
		if self.inPlay < self.maxVisible then
			local e = self.enemies[self.nextEnemy]
			e.pos.x = 500
			e.visible = true
			self.nextEnemy = self.nextEnemy % self.nbEnemies + 1
			self.inPlay = self.inPlay + 1
		end
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(self.enemies) do
		if e.visible then
			e.pos.x = e.pos.x - self.scrollSpeed
			e.box.xabs = e.pos.x + e.box.x
			e.box.yabs = e.pos.y + e.box.y
			if e.pos.x <= self.minX then
				e.pos.x = -1000
				e.visible = false
				self.inPlay = self.inPlay - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:KillEnemy(e)
	e.pos.x = -1000
	e.visible = false
	self.inPlay = self.inPlay - 1
end

function G:InitWitch()
	self.witch = {
		c = FL.New(LIB, 59), pos = { x = 300, y = 100 }, vy = 0, cycle = 0, top = 45, bottom = 250,
		box = { x = -20, y = -20, w = 50, h = 50 },
	}
	self.lastPump = -10000
	local anim = FL.Child(self.witch.c, "anim")
	if anim then FL.Stop(anim) end
end

function G:BelowCeilingVal(v)
	if v >= self.witch.top then return true end
	self.witch.vy = 0
	return false
end

function G:UpdateWitch()
	local w = self.witch
	w.cycle = w.cycle + 1
	if w.cycle == 10 then
		local nv = w.vy - 1
		local ny = w.pos.y - w.vy
		if self:BelowCeilingVal(ny) and ny <= w.bottom then w.vy = nv end
		w.cycle = 0
	end
	local ny = w.pos.y - w.vy
	if self:BelowCeilingVal(ny) and ny <= w.bottom then w.pos.y = ny end
	local anim = FL.Child(w.c, "anim")
	if anim then
		if self.now - self.lastPump > 100 and anim.frame == 1 then FL.Stop(anim) else FL.Play(anim) end
	end
end

function G:PumpWitch()
	local w = self.witch
	if w and w.pos.y - 1 >= w.top then
		w.cycle = 9
		w.vy = w.vy + 2
		self.lastPump = self.now
	end
end

function G:CheckWitchCollision(b)
	local w = self.witch
	return boxesIntersect(w.pos.x + w.box.x, w.pos.y + w.box.y, w.box.w, w.box.h, b.xabs, b.yabs, b.w, b.h)
end

function G:Init()
	self:StartAmbient()
	self.vars.score = 0
	self:InitPoints()
	self:InitEnemies()
	self:InitWitch()
	if MG.x0 then self.witch.pos.x = (self:Mouse()) end
	self.state = "gameon"
	self.startTime = self.now
	self.totalTime = 10000
	self.dieCount = 0
end

function G:MainLoop()
	if self.state == "gameon" then
		self:UpdateEnemies()
		self:UpdateWitch()
		for _, e in ipairs(self.enemies) do
			if e.visible and self:CheckWitchCollision(e.box) then
				self:KillEnemy(e)
				if e.kind.lethal then
					self.state = "diecutscene"
				else
					self:SetPoint(e.kind.points, e.box.xabs, e.box.yabs, true)
					self.vars.score = self.vars.score + e.kind.points
					MG.Sound("g10", "boing")
				end
			end
		end
		if self.now - self.startTime > self.totalTime then
			-- every 10 seconds: faster, and more often
			self.scrollSpeed = self.scrollSpeed + 1
			self.spawnFrames = self.spawnFrames - 10
			self.startTime = self.now
		end
	elseif self.state == "diecutscene" then
		self:StopAmbient()
		MG.Sound("g10", "witchdie")
		FL.GotoAndPlay(self.witch.c, "badhit")
		self.state = "diecutscenerunning"
	elseif self.state == "diecutscenerunning" then
		self.dieCount = self.dieCount + 1
		if self.dieCount > 54 then
			self.state = "showing game over"
			FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameover")
		end
	end
end

-- hint (12 seconds): a red arrow at the right edge shows the height where the next thunder cloud
-- will come in, and the clouds already on their way are ringed
function G:CanHint() return self.state == "gameon" end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 12
	self.vars.score = math.max(0, self.vars.score - cost)
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 240, 60)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintT then return end
	self.hintT = self.hintT - FrameTime()
	if self.hintT <= 0 or self.state ~= "gameon" then self.hintT = nil return end
	local a = math.min(1, self.hintT * 2)
	local gm = self:GameM() or I
	for _, e in ipairs(self.enemies) do
		if e.visible and e.kind.lethal then
			local x, y = TL.Apply(gm, e.pos.x, e.pos.y)
			MG.HintRing(x, y, 30, MG.HINT_BAD, a, 4)
		end
	end
	-- the next one to come in (the enemies come in a fixed order)
	local n = self.nbEnemies
	for k = 0, n - 1 do
		local e = self.enemies[(self.nextEnemy - 1 + k) % n + 1]
		if not e.visible and e.kind.lethal then
			local x, y = TL.Apply(gm, 470, e.pos.y)
			local ex = math.min(x, STAGE_W - 8)
			MG.HintArrow(ex, y, ex - 50, y, MG.HINT_BAD, a, 10)
			MG.HintText("!", ex - 70, y, MG.HINT_BAD, 26, a)
			break
		end
	end
end

-- the background sound (a loop)
function G:StartAmbient()
	if self.ambOn or AN.SoundMode() == 2 then return end
	local v = (AN.Save.Get("vol_fx") or 85) / 100 * 0.7
	if v <= 0 then return end
	self.ambOn = true
	local me = self
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/g10/ambient.mp3", "noplay noblock", function(ch)
		if not IsValid(ch) then return end
		if CUR ~= me or not me.ambOn then ch:Stop() return end
		ch:EnableLooping(true)
		ch:SetVolume(v)
		ch:Play()
		me.ambCh = ch
	end)
end

function G:StopAmbient()
	self.ambOn = false
	if self.ambCh and IsValid(self.ambCh) then self.ambCh:Stop() end
	self.ambCh = nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g10_status", self.vars and self.vars.score or 0)
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.now = 0
	self.state = nil
	self.hideMouse = false
	self.wasDown = false
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.points, self.enemies = {}, {}
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameon")
end

function G:Close()
	self:StopAmbient()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
	self:ShowCursor(true)
end

function G:ShowCursor(show)
	local p = UI.root
	if IsValid(p) and p.SetCursor and self.cursorShown ~= show then
		p:SetCursor(show and "arrow" or "blank")
		self.cursorShown = show
	end
end

function G:Step()
	self.now = self.now + MS
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, e in ipairs(self.enemies) do FL.Tick(e.c) end
	if self.witch then FL.Tick(self.witch.c) end
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then FL.Tick(p.c) end end
	if MG.x0 and self:Game() then
		local mx, my = self:Mouse()
		-- onClipEvent(mouseMove): the goose follows the mouse sideways
		if self.witch and self.state == "gameon" and mx ~= self.lastMX then self.witch.pos.x = mx end
		self.lastMX = mx
		-- onClipEvent(mouseUp): a flap
		local down = input.IsMouseDown(MOUSE_LEFT)
		if self.wasDown and not down and self.state == "gameon" then self:PumpWitch() end
		self.wasDown = down
		-- the game's own pointer follows the mouse while the mouse is hidden
		if self.hideMouse and mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H then
			local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "mousePointerMc", I)
			if k then k.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], mx, my } end
		end
	end
	self:MainLoop()
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:StopAmbient()
	self:ShowCursor(true)
	AN.FinishGame(10, self.vars.score or 0)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(10) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	if game then
		local extra = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = p.c, m = p.m } end end
		for _, e in ipairs(self.enemies) do
			if e.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = e.c, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, e.pos.x, e.pos.y } } end
		end
		if self.witch then
			extra[#extra + 1] = { c = self.witch.c, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, self.witch.pos.x, self.witch.pos.y } }
		end
		game.extra = extra
	end
	local st = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		-- the label was meant to come from the main menu (_level0.txt_statusbarScore), which never set it
		if name == "scoretxt" then return st.state and AN.L("g10_v_score", st.vars.score) or nil end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local inside = mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H
	self:ShowCursor(not (self.hideMouse and inside))
	if self.root.frame >= 22 and self.root.frame < 103 then
		UI.Button("g10_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(10)
end

AN.RegisterGame(10, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g11_pusle:
-- Låge 11: Puslespil
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf and its four puzzle files. Pick one of four pictures (three
-- with 30 pieces, Tycho Brahe with 81), then put the jigsaw together: click a piece to pick it up,
-- click again to put it down, and turn the piece you hold with the space bar. Pieces that lie right
-- next to each other (within 20 pixels, turned the same way) click together and move as one.
-- The score is the time. The original game code is ported as it is, quirks and all:
--   * a group of 20 pieces or more never clicks onto anything when you drop it - bring the
--     smaller pieces to it instead
--   * the pause key (P) calls a timer that isn't there, so it does nothing (hidden content: on)
--   * the picture next to the menu never loaded (the thumbnails were not on the CD)
--     (hidden content: shown)
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g11_fl.lua")
local PUZZLES = { "nisserne", "bertramsen", "pyrus", "brahe" }
for _, n in ipairs(PUZZLES) do include(DIR .. "g11_" .. n .. ".lua") end

local G = {
	scoreType = "time",
	goal = 90,        -- the original coolScore (90000 ms)
	worst = 360,      -- the original badScore (360000 ms)
	descKey = "desc_11",
	howKey = "how_11",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 800, 600
local STEP = 1 / 24
local MS = 1000 / 24
local LIB = "g11"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local SIZES = { nisserne = 30, bertramsen = 30, pyrus = 30, brahe = 81 }
local SHADOW_COL = { 0, 0, 0, 71, 30, 10 }   -- MyColor.setRGB(4660746)

FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [103] = true, [171] = true }   -- the preloader and the pause screen

local CUR

local function hiddenOn() return AN.Save.Get("hidden") ~= false end

local function scoreToTime(ms)
	local min = math.floor(ms / 1000 / 60)
	local sek = math.floor(ms / 1000 - min * 60)
	local thous = math.floor(ms - min * 60000 - sek * 1000)
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%03d", min, sek, thous)
end

local function rotM(ang, x, y)
	local a = math.rad(ang * 90)
	local c, s = math.Round(math.cos(a)), math.Round(math.sin(a))
	return { c, s, -s, c, x, y }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts of the loader
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function setupActions()
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[21] = function(c)
			FL.Stop(c)
			if CUR then CUR:SelectPuzzleImage(CUR.puzzleName, CUR.puzzleSize) end
		end,
		[28] = function(c) if CUR then CUR:TimStart() end end,   -- the timer clip's onClipEvent(load)
		[29] = function(c) if CUR then CUR:LoadPuzzle() end end,  -- (it loads at once here, so no stop)
		[30] = function(c) FL.Stop(c) if CUR then CUR:InitPuzzle() end end,
		[31] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.score = CUR.timeAcc end end,
		[44] = function(c)
			AN.Speak("GameOver")
			if CUR then CUR.scoreString = scoreToTime(CUR.score or 0) end
		end,
		[168] = function(c) FL.Stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the loader: menu and timer
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:SelectPuzzleImage(name, size)
	self.puzzleName = name
	self.puzzleSize = size
	self.vars.numpiecestxt = size .. AN.L("g11_t_inpuzzle")
end

function G:TimStart()
	self.timeAcc = 0
	self.timState = "ON"
	self:TimUpdate()
end

function G:TimUpdate()
	local acc = self.timeAcc or 0
	local min = math.floor(acc / 1000 / 60)
	local sek = math.floor(acc / 1000 - min * 60)
	self.vars.min = string.format("%02d", min)
	self.vars.sek = string.format("%02d", sek)
end

function G:TimStop()
	self:TimUpdate()
	self.timState = "OFF"
end

-- hidden content: the pause the game was meant to have (P, click the screen to go on)
function G:TogglePause()
	local ps = FL.Child(self.root, "pauseScreen")
	if self.timState == "ON" then
		self:TimUpdate()
		self.timState = "PAUSED"
		if ps then ps.visible = true end
	elseif self.timState == "PAUSED" then
		self.timState = "ON"
		if ps then ps.visible = false end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the puzzle (the movie loaded into "main"): the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:LoadPuzzle()
	local main = FL.Child(self.root, "main")
	self.plib = "g11_" .. self.puzzleName
	self.pz = FL.New(self.plib, 0)
	FL.GotoAndStop(self.pz, 2)
	if main then
		main.drawFn = function(M, alpha, col) self:DrawPuzzle(M, alpha, col) end
	end
end

-- the puzzle's own mouse position (_xmouse inside main)
function G:PMouse()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "main", I) or { 1, 0, 0, 1, 386.95, 319.85 }
	return mx - m[5], my - m[6]
end

function G:InitPuzzle()
	self.DRAGGING = false
	self.GAMEON = true
	self.nbGroups = 0
	self.Group = {}
	if self.puzzleName == "brahe" then
		self.Xnum, self.Ynum, self.prefix = 9, 9, "q"
	else
		self.Xnum, self.Ynum, self.prefix = 5, 6, "p"
	end
	local Xnum, Ynum = self.Xnum, self.Ynum
	local N = Xnum * Ynum
	self.N = N
	local pp = {}
	self.pp = pp
	self.depthOf = {}
	self.atDepth = {}
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self.pz)) do
		local n = it.nm and string.match(it.nm, "^" .. self.prefix .. "(%d+)$")
		if n then
			n = tonumber(n)
			pp[n] = { Xorg = it[8], Yorg = it[9], clip = self.pz.kids[it[3]] }
		end
	end
	for t = 1, N do
		local h = FL.Child(pp[t].clip, "hilite")
		if h then h.visible = false end
		pp[t].hilite = h
		self:SetDepth(t, 1000 - t)
	end
	-- the neighbours ("nabo")
	for xt = 1, Xnum do
		for yt = 1, Ynum do
			local id = xt + Xnum * (yt - 1)
			local nb = {}
			if xt > 1 then nb[#nb + 1] = id - 1 end
			if xt < Xnum then nb[#nb + 1] = id + 1 end
			if yt < Ynum then nb[#nb + 1] = id + Xnum end
			if yt > 1 then nb[#nb + 1] = id - Xnum end
			pp[id].nabo = nb
		end
	end
	for t = 1, N do
		pp[t].X = math.random() * 500 - 250
		pp[t].Y = math.random() * 500 - 250
		pp[t].Ang = math.floor(math.random() * 3.9)
	end
	-- initShadows
	self.SHADOWSON = true
	self.ShadXoff, self.ShadYoff, self.Shadowlift = 4, 4, 3
	for t = 1, N do
		pp[t].sx, pp[t].sy, pp[t].sAng = pp[t].X + 4, pp[t].Y + 4, pp[t].Ang
	end
	self.PlaceTime = -1000
	MG.Sound("g11", "shake")
end

-- swapDepths: the clip that had the depth gets this one's old depth
function G:SetDepth(t, d)
	self.depthOf[t] = d
	self.atDepth[d] = t
end
function G:SwapDepths(t, d)
	local old = self.depthOf[t]
	local other = self.atDepth[d]
	if other == t then return end
	if other then
		self.depthOf[other] = old
		self.atDepth[old] = other
	else
		self.atDepth[old] = nil
	end
	self.depthOf[t] = d
	self.atDepth[d] = t
end

function G:IsInGroup(id)
	local res = -1
	for g = 0, #self.Group do
		local grp = self.Group[g]
		if grp then
			for _, v in ipairs(grp.id) do if v == id then res = g end end
		end
	end
	return res
end

function G:IsInGroupNumber(id, g)
	local grp = self.Group[g]
	if not grp then return false end
	for _, v in ipairs(grp.id) do if v == id then return true end end
	return false
end

function G:AddGrouptoGroup(a, b)
	local A, B = self.Group[a], self.Group[b]
	for _, v in ipairs(B.id) do A.id[#A.id + 1] = v end
	for _, v in ipairs(B.id) do
		self.pp[v].X = self.pp[v].X + self.MVecX
		self.pp[v].Y = self.pp[v].Y + self.MVecY
	end
	B.id = {}
end

function G:CheckDrop()
	local pp, dID = self.pp, self.dID
	local me = pp[dID]
	for _, nb in ipairs(me.nabo) do
		local o = pp[nb]
		if o.Ang == me.Ang and not self:IsInGroupNumber(nb, self.DRAGGROUP) and not self.FOUNDONE then
			local OrgVecX, OrgVecY = o.Xorg - me.Xorg, o.Yorg - me.Yorg
			local VecX, VecY = o.X - me.X, o.Y - me.Y
			local MVecX, MVecY = 0, 0
			local Dx, Dy
			if me.Ang == 0 then
				Dx, Dy = OrgVecX - VecX, OrgVecY - VecY
				if math.sqrt(Dx * Dx + Dy * Dy) < 20 then MVecX, MVecY = -Dx, -Dy self.FOUNDONE = true end
			elseif me.Ang == 2 then
				VecX, VecY = -VecX, -VecY
				Dx, Dy = OrgVecX - VecX, OrgVecY - VecY
				if math.sqrt(Dx * Dx + Dy * Dy) < 20 then MVecX, MVecY = Dx, Dy self.FOUNDONE = true end
			elseif me.Ang == 1 then
				VecX, VecY = VecY, -VecX
				Dx, Dy = OrgVecX - VecX, OrgVecY - VecY
				if math.sqrt(Dx * Dx + Dy * Dy) < 20 then MVecX, MVecY = Dy, -Dx self.FOUNDONE = true end
			elseif me.Ang == 3 then
				VecX, VecY = -VecY, VecX
				Dx, Dy = OrgVecX - VecX, OrgVecY - VecY
				if math.sqrt(Dx * Dx + Dy * Dy) < 20 then MVecX, MVecY = -Dy, Dx self.FOUNDONE = true end
			end
			self.MVecX, self.MVecY = MVecX, MVecY
			if self.FOUNDONE then
				MG.Sound("g11", "placegood")
				if math.random() < 0.3 and not AN.IsSpeaking("Puslespil_Passer") then
					AN.Speak("Puslespil_Passer")
				end
				local GroupID = self:IsInGroup(nb)
				if GroupID >= 0 and self.Group[GroupID].done == false then
					if self.DRAGGROUP < 0 then
						local grp = self.Group[GroupID]
						grp.id[#grp.id + 1] = dID
						me.X, me.Y = me.X + MVecX, me.Y + MVecY
					else
						self:AddGrouptoGroup(GroupID, self.DRAGGROUP)
					end
					self.Group[GroupID].done = true
				elseif GroupID < 0 then
					if self.DRAGGROUP >= 0 then
						o.X, o.Y = o.X - MVecX, o.Y - MVecY
						local grp = self.Group[self.DRAGGROUP]
						grp.id[#grp.id + 1] = nb
					else
						me.X, me.Y = me.X + MVecX, me.Y + MVecY
						self.Group[self.nbGroups] = { id = { dID, nb } }
						self.nbGroups = self.nbGroups + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for g = 0, #self.Group do
		if self.Group[g] then self.Group[g].done = false end
	end
	self:ResetShadows()
end

function G:ResetShadows()
	if not self.SHADOWSON then return end
	local pp = self.pp
	if self.DRAGGROUP < 0 then
		local p = pp[self.dID]
		p.sx, p.sy = p.X + self.ShadXoff, p.Y + self.ShadYoff
	else
		for _, v in ipairs(self.Group[self.DRAGGROUP].id) do
			pp[v].sx, pp[v].sy = pp[v].X + self.ShadXoff, pp[v].Y + self.ShadYoff
		end
	end
end

-- name: the piece number that was pressed, or "" for a click anywhere (onClipEvent mouseDown)
function G:Mclicked(name)
	if not self.GAMEON then return end
	if self.DRAGGING and name == "" then
		self.DRAGGING = false
		self.FOUNDONE = false
		if self.DRAGGROUP < 0 then
			self:CheckDrop()
			MG.Sound("g11", "placebad")
		else
			local grp = self.Group[self.DRAGGROUP]
			if #grp.id < 20 then
				for t = 1, #grp.id do
					self.dID = grp.id[t]
					self:CheckDrop()
				end
			else
				self:ResetShadows()
			end
			MG.Sound("g11", "placebad")
		end
		self.PlaceTime = self.now
		for g = 0, #self.Group do
			local grp = self.Group[g]
			if grp and #grp.id == self.N then self:GameOver() end
		end
	elseif not self.DRAGGING and name ~= "" and self.now > self.PlaceTime + 200 then
		MG.Sound("g11", "lift")
		self.DRAGGING = true
		self.dID = name
		self.DRAGGROUP = self:IsInGroup(name)
		local mx, my = self:PMouse()
		self.X1, self.Y1 = mx, my
		self.PoffX, self.PoffY = self.pp[name].X - mx, self.pp[name].Y - my
		if self.DRAGGROUP < 0 then
			self:SwapDepths(name, 1000)
		else
			for t, v in ipairs(self.Group[self.DRAGGROUP].id) do self:SwapDepths(v, 1000 - (t - 1)) end
		end
	end
end

-- hint: one loose piece puts itself in place next to a neighbour (preferably one in the biggest
-- group), turned the same way, and joins it. +5 seconds on the clock.
function G:CanHint() return self.GAMEON and not self.DRAGGING and self.timState == "ON" and self.pp ~= nil end
local function placeBy(o, me, ang)
	local ox, oy = o.Xorg - me.Xorg, o.Yorg - me.Yorg
	if ang == 0 then return o.X - ox, o.Y - oy
	elseif ang == 1 then return o.X + oy, o.Y - ox
	elseif ang == 2 then return o.X + ox, o.Y + oy
	else return o.X - oy, o.Y + ox end
end
function G:Hint(cost)
	local pp = self.pp
	-- the biggest group, and its size per piece
	local size = {}
	for g = 0, #self.Group do
		local grp = self.Group[g]
		if grp then for _, v in ipairs(grp.id) do size[v] = #grp.id end end
	end
	local best, bestScore
	for t = 1, self.N do
		if self:IsInGroup(t) < 0 then
			for _, nb in ipairs(pp[t].nabo) do
				local sc = (size[nb] or 1) + math.random() * 0.5
				if not bestScore or sc > bestScore then best, bestScore = { t, nb }, sc end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return false end
	local me, o = pp[best[1]], pp[best[2]]
	me.Ang = o.Ang
	me.sAng = o.Ang
	me.X, me.Y = placeBy(o, me, o.Ang)
	self.dID = best[1]
	self.DRAGGROUP = -1
	self.FOUNDONE = false
	self:SwapDepths(best[1], 1000)
	self:CheckDrop()
	self.hintPiece, self.hintT = best[1], 1.2
	self.timeAcc = self.timeAcc + cost * 1000
	self:TimUpdate()
	for g = 0, #self.Group do
		local grp = self.Group[g]
		if grp and #grp.id == self.N then self:GameOver() end
	end
end

function G:GameOver()
	self:TimStop()
	self.GAMEON = false
	self.DRAGGING = false
	FL.Play(self.root)
end

function G:Rotate()
	MG.Sound("g11", "rotate")
	if not self.DRAGGING then return end
	local pp = self.pp
	local me = pp[self.dID]
	if self.DRAGGROUP >= 0 then
		for _, v in ipairs(self.Group[self.DRAGGROUP].id) do
			local p = pp[v]
			local xo, yo = p.X - me.X, p.Y - me.Y
			p.X, p.Y = me.X - yo, me.Y + xo
			p.Ang = (p.Ang + 1) % 4
			p.sAng = p.Ang
			p.sx, p.sy = p.X, p.Y
		end
	else
		me.Ang = (me.Ang + 1) % 4
		me.sAng = me.Ang
	end
end

function G:Dragupdate()
	if not self.DRAGGING then return end
	local pp = self.pp
	local mx, my = self:PMouse()
	local lift = self.Shadowlift
	if self.DRAGGROUP >= 0 then
		local xo, yo = mx - self.X1, my - self.Y1
		self.X1, self.Y1 = mx, my
		for _, v in ipairs(self.Group[self.DRAGGROUP].id) do
			local p = pp[v]
			p.X, p.Y = p.X + xo, p.Y + yo
			p.sx, p.sy = p.X + self.ShadXoff * lift, p.Y + self.ShadYoff * lift
		end
	else
		local p = pp[self.dID]
		p.X, p.Y = mx + self.PoffX, my + self.PoffY
		p.sx, p.sy = p.X + self.ShadXoff * lift, p.Y + self.ShadYoff * lift
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing and the mouse inside the puzzle
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Order()
	local list = {}
	for t = 1, self.N do list[#list + 1] = t end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return self.depthOf[a] < self.depthOf[b] end)
	return list
end

-- the button inside a piece (or any clip) and its matrix
function G:BtnOf(c, M)
	local L = AN.FLib[c.lib]
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
		local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
		if ch and ch[1] == "btn" then
			local kid = c.kids[it[3]]
			if kid then return kid, TL.Mul(M, kid.mat or { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] }) end
		end
	end
end

function G:PieceM(M, t)
	local p = self.pp[t]
	return TL.Mul(M, rotM(p.Ang, p.X, p.Y))
end

function G:ViewerM(M)
	local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self.pz, "imageviewer", M)
	return m, k
end

-- the topmost button under the mouse in the puzzle: "viewer", button clip, matrix / "piece", t
function G:TopButton(M, x, y)
	local vm, viewer = self:ViewerM(M)
	if viewer then
		local L = AN.FLib[viewer.lib]
		local items = FL.Items(viewer)
		for i = #items, 1, -1 do
			local it = items[i]
			local ch = L.chars[it[2]]
			local kid = viewer.kids[it[3]]
			if ch and ch[1] == "btn" and kid then
				local bm = TL.Mul(vm, { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] })
				if FL.HitPoint(kid, bm, x, y) then return "viewer", it[1] end
			end
		end
	end
	if not self.pp then return nil end
	local order = self:Order()
	for i = #order, 1, -1 do
		local t = order[i]
		local btn, bm = self:BtnOf(self.pp[t].clip, self:PieceM(M, t))
		if btn and FL.HitPoint(btn, bm, x, y) then return "piece", t end
	end
	return nil
end

function G:DrawPuzzle(M, alpha, col)
	if not self.pz or not self.pp then return end
	self.mainM = M
	local order = self:Order()
	-- the shadows (duplicates of the pieces, coloured brown)
	if self.SHADOWSON then
		for _, t in ipairs(order) do
			local p = self.pp[t]
			FL.Draw(p.clip, TL.Mul(M, rotM(p.sAng, p.sx, p.sy)), alpha, SHADOW_COL)
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(order) do
		FL.Draw(self.pp[t].clip, self:PieceM(M, t), alpha, col)
	end
	-- imageviewer.swapDepths(5555): on top of the pieces
	local vm, viewer = self:ViewerM(M)
	if viewer then FL.Draw(viewer, vm, alpha, col) end
end

-- the rollOver / rollOut events of the buttons in the puzzle
function G:UpdateHover()
	if not self.pz or not self.pp or not self.mainM or not MG.x0 then return end
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local kind, a = self:TopButton(self.mainM, mx, my)
	local key = kind and (kind .. a) or nil
	if key == self.hoverKey then return end
	-- rollOut of the old one
	if self.hoverKind == "piece" then
		local h = self.pp[self.hoverA].hilite
		if h then h.visible = false end
	elseif self.hoverKind == "viewer" then
		self:ViewerButton(self.hoverA, false)
	end
	self.hoverKey, self.hoverKind, self.hoverA = key, kind, a
	-- rollOver of the new one
	if kind == "piece" then
		local h = self.pp[a].hilite
		if h then h.visible = true end
	elseif kind == "viewer" then
		self:ViewerButton(a, true)
	end
end

-- the picture in the corner: rolling over it slides it out, rolling off it slides it back
-- depth: the button's depth in the viewer clip. The small button on the peeking picture (depth 12)
-- has on(rollOver) { play(); }; the four big ones around the shown picture have
-- on(rollOver, rollOut, dragOut, dragOver) { gotoAndStop("off"); play(); }
function G:ViewerButton(depth, over)
	local viewer = FL.Child(self.pz, "imageviewer")
	if not viewer then return end
	if depth == 12 then
		if over then FL.Play(viewer) end
	elseif viewer.frame >= 15 and viewer.frame <= 18 then
		FL.GotoAndStop(viewer, "off")
		FL.Play(viewer)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	local min, sek = self.vars and self.vars.min or "00", self.vars and self.vars.sek or "00"
	return AN.L("g11_status", min .. ":" .. sek)
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.now = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.timeAcc = 0
	self.timState = "OFF"
	self.pz, self.pp = nil, nil
	self.hoverKey = nil
	self.vars = { min = "00", sek = "00" }
	self.puzzleName, self.puzzleSize = "nisserne", 30
	self.scoreString = "0"
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

function G:Step()
	self.now = self.now + MS
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	if self.pz then
		local viewer = FL.Child(self.pz, "imageviewer")
		if viewer then
			FL.Tick(viewer)
			if viewer.frame == 8 or viewer.frame == 18 then FL.Stop(viewer) end
			if viewer.frame == 27 then FL.GotoAndStop(viewer, "hidden") end
		end
	end
	if self.timState == "ON" then
		self.timeAcc = self.timeAcc + MS
		self.timTick = (self.timTick or 0) + 1
		if self.timTick % 5 == 0 then self:TimUpdate() end   -- the timer clip's 5th frame
	end
	if self.GAMEON and self.timState ~= "PAUSED" then self:Dragupdate() end
	-- the keys (onClipEvent keyDown)
	local space = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE)
	if space and not self.spaceWas and self.GAMEON and self.timState ~= "PAUSED" then self:Rotate() end
	self.spaceWas = space
	local p = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_P)
	if p and not self.pWas and self.GAMEON and hiddenOn() then self:TogglePause() end
	self.pWas = p
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(11, (self.score or 0) / 1000)
end

-- a mouse press on the stage while the puzzle is on
function G:Press()
	if self.timState == "PAUSED" then
		self:TogglePause()   -- the pause screen's big button
		return
	end
	if not self.pz or not self.mainM then return end
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	-- onClipEvent(mouseDown) first (it drops what you hold), then the button under the mouse
	if self.DRAGGING then self:Mclicked("") end
	local kind, a = self:TopButton(self.mainM, mx, my)
	if kind == "piece" then self:Mclicked(a) end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(11) return end
	local st = self
	local hidden = hiddenOn()
	-- the preview picture (hidden content): the jpg the menu tried to load
	local preview = FL.Child(self.root, "preview")
	local jlo = preview and FL.Child(preview, "JLo")
	if jlo then
		local pre = FL.Child(jlo, "preload")
		if pre then pre.visible = not hidden end
		jlo.drawFn = nil
		if hidden then
			local name = self.puzzleName
			jlo.drawFn = function(M, alpha)
				TL.Pic("g11/thumb_" .. name .. ".jpg", 0, 0, 365.5, 279, M, alpha)
			end
		end
	end
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if name == "scorestring" then return st.scoreString end
		if name == "txt_hint" then return AN.L("g11_t_hint") end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	if self.GAMEON and self.timState ~= "PAUSED" then self:Dragupdate() end
	FL.Draw(self.root, { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:UpdateHover()
	if self.hintT and self.pp and self.pp[self.hintPiece] then
		-- the piece that put itself in place lights up for a moment
		self.hintT = self.hintT - FrameTime()
		local h = self.pp[self.hintPiece].hilite
		if h then h.visible = self.hintT > 0 end
		if self.hintT <= 0 then self.hintT = nil end
	end

	local f = self.root.frame
	if f >= 18 and f <= 21 then
		-- the four pictures in the menu (invisible buttons over the names)
		for i, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self.root)) do
			if it[2] == 150 then
				local kid = self.root.kids[it[3]]
				local m = { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] }
				local btn, bm = FL.CharItem(kid, m, { [149] = true })
				if btn then
					local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(btn, bm, true)
					local idx = ({ [60] = 1, [62] = 2, [64] = 3, [66] = 4 })[it[1]]
					local name = PUZZLES[idx]
					local hot = UI.Button("g11_pz" .. idx, MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function()
						self:SelectPuzzleImage(name, SIZES[name])
					end, { hit = FL.HitFn(btn, bm) })
					if hot then
						AN.Box(MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), Color(255, 241, 207, 22), MG.S(8))
					end
				end
			elseif it[2] == 152 and f == 21 then
				local kid = self.root.kids[it[3]]
				local m = { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] }
				local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(kid, m, true)
				UI.Button("g11_start", MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function()
					FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "restart")
				end, { hit = FL.HitFn(kid, m) })
			end
		end
	elseif self.GAMEON or self.timState == "PAUSED" then
		UI.Button("g11_table", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), nil,
			{ silent = true, press = function() self:Press() end })
	elseif f >= 43 and f < 167 then
		UI.Button("g11_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(11)
end

AN.RegisterGame(11, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g12_kaalk:
-- Låge 12: Kæmpe Kålkamp
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Pyrus walks along the floor and shoots straight up at the big
-- bouncing cabbages; every hit cabbage splits into two smaller ones (the smallest just pop). Clear
-- all cabbages to finish the level - you get a bonus for your accuracy (2500 for 100 %). A cabbage
-- that touches Pyrus costs a life; 3 lives. The game code is the original's (an "asteroids" engine
-- turned into a Pang game), quirks included:
--   * only one gun of the three is mounted, and it fires once per key press
--   * the shield, the thrust and the black hole are still in the code but never used
--   * a cabbage that bounces off a wall is only drawn at the wall for that one frame; its real
--     position stays where it was (so it can wobble in a corner)
--   * the level screen continues by itself after a moment, even if you don't press anything
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g12_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 6000,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_12",
	howKey = "how_12",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 480, 290
local STEP = 1 / 25
local LIB = "g12"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local ASTROID_CID = { [0] = 29, 27, 23, 19, nil, 24, 20, 16 }
local DYING_END = { [29] = 59, [27] = 57, [23] = 56, [19] = 55, [24] = 57, [20] = 56, [16] = 55 }

-- onClipEvent(load) { _visible = false }: the arena's markers, the preloader, the shield, astroid7's hit shape
FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [190] = true, [185] = true, [54] = true, [6] = true }

-- the original's tables
local TURRET = { [1] = { angle = 6, fireRate = 2, vel = 8, power = 1 } }

	[0] = { energy = 1, weight = 1, minVel = 2, maxVel = 2, minRotVel = 2, maxRotVel = 4, spawn = { 1, 2 }, radius = 50, points = 250 },
	[1] = { energy = 1, weight = 1, minVel = 2, maxVel = 2, minRotVel = 1, maxRotVel = 2, spawn = { 2, 2 }, radius = 25, points = 100 },

local function levelList(l)
	local L = {
		{ 2 }, { 2, 2 }, { 1 }, { 1, 2 }, { 2, 1, 2 }, { 1, 1 }, { 6 }, { 6, 6 }, { 5 }, { 5, 6 },
		{ 6, 5, 6 }, { 5, 5 }, { 1, 1, 1 }, { 1, 5, 1 }, { 5, 1, 5 }, { 2, 2, 2, 2 }, { 2, 1, 1, 2 },
		{ 1, 1, 1, 1 }, { 1, 1, 1, 5 }, { 1, 5, 5, 1 }, { 1, 5, 5, 5 }, { 5, 5, 5, 5 }, { 3, 2, 1, 2, 3 },
		{ 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 }, { 5, 1, 5, 1, 5 }, { 7, 6, 5, 6, 7 },
	}
	if L[l] then return L[l] end
	if l < 999 then return { 5, 5, 5, 5, 5 } end
	return {}
end

local function rotM(deg, x, y, sx, sy)
	local a = math.rad(deg)
	local c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
	sx, sy = sx or 1, sy or sx or 1
	return { c * sx, s * sx, -s * sy, c * sy, x, y }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Arena() return FL.Child(self:Game(), "arena") end
function G:Marker(name)
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self:Arena())) do
		if it.nm == name then return it[8], it[9] end
	end
	return 0, 0
end
function G:Screen() return FL.Child(self:Game(), "levelcompletedscreen") end

	local sb = FL.Child(self:Game(), "statusbar")
	if sb then sb.vars.score = self.score sb.vars.lives = self.lives end
