-- a cabbage's shape: the circle its picture fills (hitTest(x, y, true) on the picture)
function G:AstroidRadius(a)
	local key = a.type
	self.radii = self.radii or {}
	if not self.radii[key] then
		local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(a.mc, I, true)
		self.radii[key] = x0 and ((x1 - x0) + (y1 - y0)) / 4 or ASTROID[key].radius
	end
	return self.radii[key]
end

function G:AstroidHitPoint(a, x, y)
	local r = self:AstroidRadius(a)
	local dx, dy = x - a.mx, y - a.my
	return dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Init()
	self.gameState = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.points = {}
	self.nextPoint = 1
	for t = 1, 35 do
		local p = FL.New(LIB, 89)
		p.x, p.y, p.s = -200, 0, 1
		self.points[t] = p
	end
	self.boundXmin, self.boundYmin = self:Marker("screen0")
	self.boundXmax, self.boundYmax = self:Marker("screen1")
	self.boundWidth = self.boundXmax - self.boundXmin
	self.shotAccuracyBonus = 1000
	self.shotAccuracyBonusPerfect = 2500
	self:InitShip()
	self:StartNewGame()
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	p.x, p.y = x, y
	p.s = math.max(55, math.min(140, val * 0.5)) / 100
	local h = FL.Child(p, "hilite")
	if h then FL.GotoAndStop(h, "off") end
	p.visible = true
	local ani = FL.Child(p, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
	FL.Play(p)
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 35 + 1
end

function G:InitShip()
	local ship = {
		mc = FL.New(LIB, 82),
		x = 0, y = 0, rot = 0, sx = 1, visible = true,
		vel = { x = 0, y = 0 }, acc = 0,
		hitpoints = { {}, {}, {}, {} },
		safeFrames = 0, state = 0,
		shield = { amount = SHIELD[0].max, max = SHIELD[0].max, engaged = false },
		engineVel = ENGINE[0].vel,
		turret = { type = 1, fireRate = TURRET[1].fireRate, vel = TURRET[1].vel, power = TURRET[1].power, lastShot = 0, bullets = {}, x = 0, y = 0 },
	}
	self.ship = ship
end

function G:ShipM(ship)
	return rotM(ship.rot, ship.x, ship.y, ship.sx)
end

function G:UpdateShip()
	local ship = self.ship
	if ship.state == 1 then
		local rad = math.rad(ship.rot)
		self.heroCos, self.heroSin = math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)
		ship.acc = ship.acc * 0.985
		ship.vel.x = ship.vel.x * 0.98
		ship.vel.y = ship.vel.y * 0.98
		ship.vel.x = ship.vel.x + ship.acc * self.heroCos
		ship.vel.y = ship.vel.y + ship.acc * self.heroSin
		ship.px = (ship.px or ship.x) + ship.vel.x
		ship.py = (ship.py or ship.y) + ship.vel.y
		local x0 = self:Marker("ship0")
		local x1 = self:Marker("ship1")
		if ship.px < x0 then ship.px = x0 elseif ship.px > x1 then ship.px = x1 end
		ship.x, ship.y = ship.px, ship.py
		local M = self:ShipM(ship)
		for t = 0, 3 do
			local m = FL.ChildMatrix(ship.mc, "hitpoint" .. t, M)
			if m then ship.hitpoints[t + 1].x, ship.hitpoints[t + 1].y = m[5], m[6] end
		end
		local _, tk = FL.ChildMatrix(ship.mc, "turret0", I)
		local tx = 20.25
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(ship.mc)) do if it.nm == "turret0" then tx = it[8] end end
		ship.turret.x, ship.turret.y = ship.x, ship.y - tx
		if self.shootRequest then
			self.shootRequest = false
			self:FireBullets()
		end
		ship.turret.lastShot = ship.turret.lastShot + 1
		-- shieldRequest is never set: the shield stays off
		ship.shield.engaged = false
		if ship.safeFrames > 0 then
			ship.safeFrames = ship.safeFrames - 1
			if ship.safeFrames % 2 == 0 then
				ship.visible = ship.safeFrames % 4 == 0
			end
		end
	end
	local body = FL.Child(ship.mc, "body")
	if body then
		if ship.vel.x == 0 and ship.vel.y == 0 then FL.GotoAndStop(body, "standing") else FL.GotoAndStop(body, "walking") end
	end
end

function G:RespawnShip()
	local ship = self.ship
	ship.vel.x, ship.vel.y, ship.acc = 0, 0, 0
	local _, y1 = self:Marker("ship1")
	ship.px, ship.py = 150, y1
	ship.x, ship.y = ship.px, ship.py
	ship.rot = -90
	ship.sx = 1
	FL.GotoAndStop(ship.mc, "normal")
	local body = FL.Child(ship.mc, "body")
	if body then FL.GotoAndStop(body, "standing") end
	ship.safeFrames = 50
	ship.state = 1
end

function G:ShipExplodeAniDone()
	local ship = self.ship
	ship.turret.type = 1
	ship.shield.amount = ship.shield.max
	self.lives = self.lives - 1
	if self.lives == 0 then
		self:GameOver()
	else
		self:RespawnShip()
	end
	self:SetStatus()
end

function G:IsOnScreen(x, y)
	return x > self.boundXmin and x < self.boundXmax and y > self.boundYmin and y < self.boundYmax
end

function G:UpdateBullets()
	local tur = self.ship.turret
	for b = #tur.bullets, 1, -1 do
		local bl = tur.bullets[b]
		if bl.state == 1 then
			bl.x, bl.y = bl.x + bl.vx, bl.y + bl.vy
			local mx, my = bl.x - bl.vx / 2, bl.y - bl.vy / 2
			if not self:IsOnScreen(bl.x, bl.y) then
				table.remove(tur.bullets, b)
			else
				for a = #self.astroids, 1, -1 do
					local ast = self.astroids[a]
					if ast.state == 1 and bl.state == 1 then
						if self:AstroidHitPoint(ast, bl.x, bl.y) or self:AstroidHitPoint(ast, mx, my) then
							-- the bullet has no weight (undefined counts as 0 in Flash 6): no push
							self:AstroidHit(a, bl.power)
							FL.GotoAndPlay(bl.mc, "dying")
							bl.state = 2
						end
					end
				end
			end
		elseif bl.state == 3 then
			table.remove(tur.bullets, b)
		end
	end
end

function G:FireBullets()
	local tur = self.ship.turret
	if tur.type > 0 and tur.fireRate <= tur.lastShot then
		MG.Sound("g12", "shoot")
		self.shotsFired = self.shotsFired + 1
		local bl = { mc = FL.New(LIB, BULLET_CID[tur.type]), x = tur.x, y = tur.y, state = 1, power = TURRET[tur.type].power }
		bl.vx, bl.vy = self.heroCos * tur.vel, self.heroSin * tur.vel
		bl.mc.ref = bl
		FL.GotoAndStop(bl.mc, "active")
		tur.lastShot = 0
		table.insert(tur.bullets, bl)
	end
end

function G:CheckKeys()
	local gs = self.gameState
	if gs == 2 or gs == 3 or gs == 4 or gs == 5 then
		local ship = self.ship
		if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then
			ship.vel.x = ship.engineVel
		elseif input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then
			ship.vel.x = -ship.engineVel
		else
			ship.vel.x = 0
		end
		if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LCONTROL) or input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RCONTROL) or input.IsKeyDown(KEY_C) then
			if self.shootOK then
				self.shootOK = false
				self.shootRequest = gs == 2
			end
		else
			self.shootOK = true
		end
		if gs == 4 then
			if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE) or input.IsKeyDown(KEY_ENTER) then
				local scr = self:Screen()
				if self.spaceOK and scr and scr.vars.continueOk then
					self.spaceOK = false
					FL.GotoAndPlay(scr, "animoff")
				end
			else
				self.spaceOK = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:InitAstroids()
	self.astroids = {}
	local list = levelList(self.level)
	local posStep = self.boundWidth / (#list + 1)
	local _, ay = self:Marker("astroids0")
	for i, tp in ipairs(list) do
		local posX = self.boundXmin + posStep * i
		self:SpawnAstroid(tp, posX, ay, (i - 1) % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1)
	end
end

function G:SpawnAstroid(tp, x, y, dir)
	local T = ASTROID[tp]
	local a = { type = tp, x = x, y = y, mc = FL.New(LIB, ASTROID_CID[tp]) }
	a.mc.astroidRef = a
	local speed = T.minVel + math.random() * (T.maxVel - T.minVel)
	a.vx = speed * dir * self.speedFactor
	a.vy = -speed * 4 * self.speedFactor
	a.rot = math.floor(math.random() * 360)
	local rv = T.minRotVel + math.random() * (T.maxRotVel - T.minRotVel)
	if math.random() < 0.5 then rv = -rv end
	a.rotVel = rv
	a.radius = T.radius
	a.points = T.points
	a.mx, a.my = x, y
	a.energy = T.energy
	a.weight = T.weight * self.speedFactor
	a.state = 1
	a.depth = 2000 + self.nextAstroidID
	self.nextAstroidID = self.nextAstroidID + 1
	table.insert(self.astroids, a)
end

function G:UpdateAstroids()
	local ship = self.ship
	for i = #self.astroids, 1, -1 do
		local a = self.astroids[i]
		if a.state == 1 then
			a.vy = a.vy + a.weight
			a.x, a.y = a.x + a.vx, a.y + a.vy
			a.rot = a.rot + a.rotVel
			a.mx, a.my = a.x, a.y
			if a.x < self.boundXmin + a.radius then
				a.vx = -a.vx
				a.mx = self.boundXmin + a.radius
			elseif a.x > self.boundXmax - a.radius then
				a.vx = -a.vx
				a.mx = self.boundXmax - a.radius
			end
			if a.y > self.boundYmax - a.radius then
				a.vy = -a.vy - a.weight
				a.my = self.boundYmax - a.radius
				local T = ASTROID[a.type]
				local rv = T.minRotVel + math.random() * (T.maxRotVel - T.minRotVel)
				if math.random() < 0.5 then rv = -rv end
				a.rotVel = rv
			end
			if ship.safeFrames == 0 and not ship.shield.engaged and ship.state == 1 then
				for h = 1, 4 do
					local heroHit = false
					if a.type == 3 then
						-- mc.hitTest(ship.mc.hitarea): the two boxes overlap
						local ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1 = FL.Bounds(a.mc, rotM(a.rot, a.mx, a.my), true)
						local hm, hk = FL.ChildMatrix(ship.mc, "hitarea", self:ShipM(ship))
						local bx0, by0, bx1, by1
						if hk then bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = FL.Bounds(hk, hm, true) end
						if ax0 and bx0 and ax0 <= bx1 and bx0 <= ax1 and ay0 <= by1 and by0 <= ay1 then heroHit = true end
					else
						local hp = ship.hitpoints[h]
						if hp.x and self:AstroidHitPoint(a, hp.x, hp.y) then heroHit = true end
					end
					if heroHit then
						ship.state = 3
						FL.GotoAndPlay(ship.mc, "explode")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:AstroidHit(id, power)
	local a = self.astroids[id]
	MG.Sound("g12", "shothit")
	self.shotsHit = self.shotsHit + 1
	a.energy = a.energy - power
	if a.energy <= 0 then self:KillAstroid(id) end
end

function G:KillAstroid(id)
	local a = self.astroids[id]
	MG.Sound("g12", "pop")
	a.state = 2
	FL.GotoAndPlay(a.mc, "dying")
	for s, tp in ipairs(ASTROID[a.type].spawn) do
		self:SpawnAstroid(tp, a.x, a.y, (s - 1) % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1)
	end
	self.score = self.score + a.points
	self:SetStatus()
	self:SetPoint(a.points, a.x, a.y)
end

function G:RemoveDeadAstroids()
	for i = #self.astroids, 1, -1 do
		if self.astroids[i].state == 3 then
			-- (the original removes "mc", which is nothing there, so the cabbage clip stays - empty by then)
			table.remove(self.astroids, i)
		end
	end
end

function G:MainLoop()
	local gs = self.gameState
	if gs == 2 then
		self:CheckKeys()
		self:UpdateShip()
		self:UpdateBullets()
		self:UpdateAstroids()
		self:RemoveDeadAstroids()
		self:CheckLevelComplete()
	elseif gs == 3 then
		self.waitCount = self.waitCount - 1
		if self.waitCount == 0 then self:ShowLevelCompletedScreen() end
		self:CheckKeys()
		self:UpdateShip()
		self:UpdateBullets()
	elseif gs == 4 then
		self:CheckKeys()
		self:UpdateShip()
		self:UpdateBullets()
	elseif gs == 5 then
		self.waitCount = self.waitCount - 1
		if self.waitCount == 0 then self.gameState = 2 end
		self:CheckKeys()
		self:UpdateShip()
		self:UpdateBullets()
	end
end

-- hint (5 seconds): an aim line straight up from the gun, and the cabbage a shot would hit is ringed
function G:CanHint() return self.gameState == 2 and self.ship ~= nil end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 5
	self.score = math.max(0, self.score - cost)
	self:SetStatus()
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 300, 60)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintT then return end
	self.hintT = self.hintT - FrameTime()
	if self.hintT <= 0 or self.gameState ~= 2 then self.hintT = nil return end
	local am = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "arena" })
	local tur = self.ship and self.ship.turret
	if not am or not tur then return end
	local a = math.min(1, self.hintT * 2)
	local dx, dy = self.heroCos or 0, self.heroSin or -1
	local hitA, hitT = nil, 700
	for _, c in ipairs(self.astroids or {}) do
		if c.state == 1 then
			local r = self:AstroidRadius(c)
			local px, py = c.mx - tur.x, c.my - tur.y
			local t = px * dx + py * dy
			if t > 0 then
				local ex, ey = px - dx * t, py - dy * t
				if ex * ex + ey * ey <= r * r and t < hitT then hitA, hitT = c, t - math.sqrt(math.max(0, r * r - ex * ex - ey * ey)) end
			end
		end
	end
	local x0, y0 = TL.Apply(am, tur.x, tur.y)
	local x1, y1 = TL.Apply(am, tur.x + dx * hitT, tur.y + dy * hitT)
	if y1 < 14 and y0 > 14 then   -- keep the arrow's head on the stage
		local k = (y0 - 14) / (y0 - y1)
		x1, y1 = x0 + (x1 - x0) * k, 14
	end
	MG.HintArrow(x0, y0 - 6, x1, y1, hitA and MG.HINT_GOOD or MG.HINT_GOLD, a * 0.85, 4)
	if hitA then
		local cx, cy = TL.Apply(am, hitA.mx, hitA.my)
		MG.HintRing(cx, cy, self:AstroidRadius(hitA) * math.abs(am[1]) + 6, MG.HINT_GOOD, a, 4)
	end
end

function G:StartNewGame()
	self.score = 0
	self.lives = 3
	self:SetStatus()
	self.nextAstroidID = 0
	self.leftovers = {}
	self:RespawnShip()
	self:StartLevel(1)
end

function G:StartLevel(lvl)
	self.level = lvl
	self.levelStartScore = self.score
	self.speedFactor = 0.5 + lvl * 0.015
	self:InitAstroids()
	self.shotsFired = 0
	self.shotsHit = 0
	self.waitCount = 25
	self.gameState = 5
end

function G:CheckLevelComplete()
	if #self.astroids == 0 and self.ship.state == 1 then self:LevelCompleted() end
end

function G:LevelCompleted()
	local ratio = self.shotsFired > 0 and self.shotsHit / self.shotsFired or 0
	self.shootAccuracy = math.Round(math.min(100, ratio * 100) * 100) / 100
	if self.shootAccuracy == 100 then
		self.shootAccuracyScore = self.shotAccuracyBonusPerfect
	else
		self.shootAccuracyScore = math.Round(ratio * self.shotAccuracyBonus)
	end
	self.waitCount = 25
	self.gameState = 3
end

function G:ShowLevelCompletedScreen()
	self.gameState = 4
	local scr = self:Screen()
	if scr then FL.Play(scr) end
end

-- the level screen's frame 23: the accuracy and the bonus
function G:LevelScreenStats(c)
	c.vars.txt_pct = math.floor(self.shootAccuracy)
	c.vars.txt_bonus = self.shootAccuracyScore
	self.score = self.score + self.shootAccuracyScore
	self:SetStatus()
	c.vars.continueOk = true
	-- "PERFEKT!" only shows at 100 %
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
		if it[2] == 223 then
			local k = c.kids[it[3]]
			if k then k.visible = self.shootAccuracy >= 100 end
		end
	end
	if self.shootAccuracy < 100 then AN.Speak("Godt") else AN.Speak("megetGodt") end
	AN.LevelScore(12, self.level, self.score - self.levelStartScore, { total = self.score })
end

function G:GameOver()
	self.vars.score = self.score
	FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "gameover")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g12_status", self.score or 0, self.lives or 3, self.level or 1)
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.lives = 3
	self.level = 1
	self.gameState = nil
	self.ship = nil
	self.astroids = {}
	self.leftovers = {}
	self.points = {}
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.radii = nil
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

function G:Step()
	FL.OnSound = function(c, id) if id == 213 then MG.Sound("g12", "s213") end end
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	if self.ship then FL.Tick(self.ship.mc) end
	for _, a in ipairs(self.astroids) do FL.Tick(a.mc) end
	for _, a in ipairs(self.leftovers) do FL.Tick(a.mc) end
	if self.ship then for _, b in ipairs(self.ship.turret.bullets) do FL.Tick(b.mc) end end
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.visible then FL.Tick(p) end end
	FL.OnSound = nil
	-- the game clip's enterFrame
	if self.gameState then self:MainLoop() end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(12, self.score or 0)
end

-- the clips made at run time, in depth order, drawn in the arena / the game clip
function G:UpdateExtras()
	local arena = self:Arena()
	local game = self:Game()
	if not arena or not game then return end
	local ex = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(self.leftovers) do ex[#ex + 1] = { c = a.mc, m = rotM(a.rot, a.mx, a.my), d = a.depth } end
	for _, a in ipairs(self.astroids) do ex[#ex + 1] = { c = a.mc, m = rotM(a.rot, a.mx, a.my), d = a.depth } end
	local ship = self.ship
	if ship and ship.visible then ex[#ex + 1] = { c = ship.mc, m = self:ShipM(ship), d = 4000 } end
	if ship then
		for i, b in ipairs(ship.turret.bullets) do ex[#ex + 1] = { c = b.mc, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, b.x, b.y }, d = 50000 + i } end
	end
	table.sort(ex, function(p, q) return p.d < q.d end)
	arena.extra = ex
	local pts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do
		if p.visible and p.x > -100 then pts[#pts + 1] = { c = p, m = { p.s, 0, 0, p.s, p.x, p.y } } end
	end
	game.extra = pts
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(12) return end
	local st = self
	self:UpdateExtras()
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if name == "txt_lvlcompletedaccuracy" then return AN.L("g12_t_accuracy") end
		if name == "txt_lvlcompletedbonus" then return AN.L("g12_t_bonus") end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, I)
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local f = self.root.frame
	-- the level screen's buttons (Videre, and the small one)
	local scr = self.gameState == 4 and self:Screen()
	if scr and scr.frame >= 23 and scr.frame < 63 then
		local gm = FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I)
		local sm = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "levelcompletedscreen", gm)
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(scr)) do
			if it[2] == 218 or it[2] == 230 then
				local k = scr.kids[it[3]]
				local bm = TL.Mul(sm, { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] })
				local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(k, bm, true)
				if x0 then
					UI.Button("g12_next" .. it[2], MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function()
						FL.GotoAndPlay(scr, "animoff")
					end, { hit = FL.HitFn(k, bm) })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if f >= 19 and f < 91 then
		UI.Button("g12_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(12)
end

-- (Duel split screen: two copies of the game run side by side; the clips' frame scripts
-- talk to the copy that is running right now)
function G:MakeCurrent() CUR = self end

AN.RegisterGame(12, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g13_brand:
-- Låge 13: Brandslukning
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Fires break out in the windows of the house; click a fire
-- to put it out with the hose. The faster you click it after it starts, the more points (10 to 26).
-- Every burning fire blackens the house a little each frame (the meter in the corner); when the
-- house is completely sooted, the game is over. The fires come faster and faster.
-- The game code is the original's (the same whack-a-mole engine as door 7), quirks included:
--   * the code is written for 26 windows on a 7 x 4 grid, but the house has 16, so a new fire only
--     starts when one of up to 20 random picks hits a window that exists and isn't burning
--   * the keyboard aim is set up but never moved (the key handler is empty)
--   * the "water left" bar and the extra sounds (whistle, tick, tock, buzz) are never used
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g13_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 700,       -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_13",
	howKey = "how_13",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 530, 390
local STEP = 1 / 25
local MS = 40
local LIB = "g13"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local NUM_ANIMALS = 26
local BUTTONS = { [129] = true }

local CUR

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the windows' own sound (a sound stream in the hole clip: the fire, the fire going down, the water)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stopStream(h)
	if h.snd and IsValid(h.snd.ch) then h.snd.ch:Stop() end
	h.snd = nil
end

local function playStream(h, name)
	stopStream(h)
	local v = (AN.Save.Get("vol_fx") or 85) / 100
	if v <= 0 or AN.SoundMode() == 2 then return end
	local token = {}
	h.snd = token
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/g13/" .. name .. ".mp3", "noplay", function(ch)
		if not IsValid(ch) then return end
		if h.snd ~= token or not CUR then ch:Stop() return end
		ch:SetVolume(v)
		ch:Play()
		token.ch = ch
	end)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [111] = true, [139] = true }
	local function hole(c) return c.holeRef end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 134, {
		[1] = function(c) stop(c) if hole(c) then stopStream(hole(c)) end end,
		[9] = function(c) if hole(c) then playStream(hole(c), "fire") end end,
		[37] = stop,
		[40] = function(c) if hole(c) then playStream(hole(c), "down") end end,
		[46] = stop,
		[47] = function(c)
			local x = FL.Child(c, "cross")
			if x then FL.Play(x) end
			if hole(c) then playStream(hole(c), "hit") end
		end,
		[53] = stop,
	})
	for _, cid in ipairs({ 115, 14, 154, 174, 20, 26, 55, 66, 71, 76 }) do
		FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, { [1] = stop })
	end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 133, { [35] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 166, { [23] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 127, { [24] = function(c) FL.GotoAndPlay(c, "loop") end })
	local hide = { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end }
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 9, hide)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 21, hide)
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 176, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,
		[13] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.hideMouse = true end end,
		[21] = function(c)
			if CUR then
				CUR.hideMouse = false
				for _, h in pairs(CUR.holes or {}) do stopStream(h) end
			end
			AN.Speak("GameOver")
		end,
		[99] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Game(), name) end
function G:GameM() return (FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I)) end

function G:Mouse()
	local sx, sy = MG.Mouse()
	local m = self:GameM()
	local det = m[1] * m[4] - m[2] * m[3]
	local x, y = sx - m[5], sy - m[6]
	return (m[4] * x - m[3] * y) / det, (-m[2] * x + m[1] * y) / det
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	if not p then p = { c = FL.New(LIB, 9) } self.points[self.nextPoint] = p end
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 10 + 1
	local s = math.max(55, math.min(140, val * 6.5)) / 100
	p.m = { s, 0, 0, s, x, y }
	p.c.visible = true
	FL.GotoAndPlay(p.c, 1)
	local ani = FL.Child(p.c, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Init()
	self.vars.score = 0
	self.level = 1
	self.points = {}
	self.nextPoint = 1
	self.state = "waitforgo"
	self.holes = {}
	self.lastLaunch = self.now
	self.numLaunched = 0
	self.baseAnimInterval = 100
	self.baseUpTime = 7000
	-- initializeAim: the aim is sent to window 16, which doesn't exist (setting _x to undefined does
	-- nothing in Flash), so it stays outside the stage
	self:StartLevel()
	self.initialized = true
end

function G:StartLevel()
	self.state = "gameon"
	for t = 0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1 do
		local mc = self:Clip("hole" .. t)
		if mc then
			local h = { mc = mc, id = t, state = "closed", sCount = 0, upTime = 0 }
			mc.holeRef = h
			self.holes[t] = h
		end
	end
	self.levAnimInterval = self.baseAnimInterval - self.level * 15
	self.levUpTime = self.baseUpTime - self.level * 15
	self.energy = 1000
end

function G:LaunchHole(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	FL.GotoAndPlay(h.mc, "open")
	h.state = "up"
	h.upTime = self.now
	self.numLaunched = self.numLaunched + 1
	self.levAnimInterval = self.baseAnimInterval - self.level * 15 - self.numLaunched * 6
	self.levUpTime = self.baseUpTime - self.level * 15 - self.numLaunched * 3
end

function G:CloseHole(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	FL.GotoAndPlay(h.mc, "down")
	h.state = "down"
end

function G:EndHole(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	FL.GotoAndStop(h.mc, "closed")
	h.state = "closed"
end

-- hint (5 seconds): the window that will catch fire next glows (picked in advance)
function G:CanHint() return self.initialized and self.state == "gameon" end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 5
	self.vars.score = math.max(0, self.vars.score - cost)
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 300, 60)
end
function G:HintPick()
	if self.hintT then
		self.hintT = self.hintT - STEP
		if self.hintT <= 0 then self.hintT, self.hintNext = nil, nil return end
	else
		self.hintNext = nil
		return
	end
	local cur = self.hintNext and self.holes[self.hintNext]
	if cur and cur.state == "closed" then return end
	local free = {}
	for t = 0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1 do
		local h = self.holes[t]
		if h and h.state == "closed" then free[#free + 1] = t end
	end
	self.hintNext = #free > 0 and free[math.random(#free)] or nil
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintNext or self.state ~= "gameon" then return end
	local _, _, x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "game", "hole" .. self.hintNext })
	if not x0 then return end
	-- (a closed window's clip is only its sill: the box covers the window above it)
	local cx = (x0 + x1) / 2
	MG.HintBox(cx - 30, y1 - 58, 60, 62, MG.HINT_GOLD, math.min(1, self.hintT * 2), 3)
end

function G:HoleClicked(id)
	local h = self.holes[id]
	if not h then return end
	FL.GotoAndPlay(h.mc, "hit")
	h.state = "hit"
	h.sCount = 0
	local p = self:Clip("mousePointerMc")
	local anim = p and FL.Child(p, "anim")
	if anim then FL.Play(anim) end
	local dt = self.now - h.upTime
	local pts = math.Round(math.max(0, (1000 - dt) / 60) + 10)
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "hole" .. id, I)
	self:SetPoint(pts, m[5], m[6] - 80)
	self.vars.score = self.vars.score + pts
end

function G:MainLoop()
	if not self.initialized or self.state == "waitforgo" then return end
	if self.state == "gameon" then
		local now = self.now
		if now - self.lastLaunch > self.levAnimInterval and math.random() > 0.964 then
			-- (hint: the window shown in advance catches fire next)
			local hn = self.hintNext and self.holes[self.hintNext]
			local tries = 20
			if hn and hn.state == "closed" then
				self:LaunchHole(self.hintNext)
				self.lastLaunch = now
				self.hintNext = nil
				tries = 0
			end
			-- up to 20 tries at a random window out of 26 (only 16 exist)
			for _ = 1, tries do
				local r = math.random(0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1)
				local h = self.holes[r]
				if h and h.state == "closed" then
					self:LaunchHole(r)
					self.lastLaunch = now
					break
				end
			end
		end
		self:HintPick()
		for t = 0, NUM_ANIMALS - 1 do
			local h = self.holes[t]
			if h and h.state ~= "closed" then
				if h.state == "up" then
					self.energy = self.energy - 1
					h.sCount = h.sCount + 1
					if now - h.upTime > self.levUpTime and math.random() > 0.9 then
						self:CloseHole(t)
						h.sCount = 0
					end
				elseif h.state == "down" then
					h.sCount = h.sCount + 1
					if h.sCount > 4 then self:EndHole(t) h.sCount = 0 end
				elseif h.state == "hit" then
					h.sCount = h.sCount + 1
					if h.sCount > 34 then self:EndHole(t) h.sCount = 0 end
				end
			end
		end
		-- the soot on the house, and the meter
		local bg = FL.Child(self.root, "bg")
		local sod = bg and FL.Child(bg, "sod")
		if sod then FL.GotoAndStop(sod, math.floor((1000 - self.energy) / 150) + 1) end
		if self.energy <= 0 then
			self.energy = 0
			self.state = "gameOver"
			self.stateCount = 0
		end
		self:SetMeter()
	elseif self.state == "gameOver" then
		self.stateCount = self.stateCount + 1
		if self.stateCount > 20 then
			self.state = "over"
			FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "gameover")
		end
	end
end

-- tube.daMask._xscale = energy / 10 (the mask is mirrored, so it shrinks towards its right edge)
function G:SetMeter()
	local tube = FL.Child(self.root, "tube")
	local mask = tube and FL.Child(tube, "daMask")
	if mask then mask.mat = { -self.energy / 1000, 0, 0, 1, 80.75, 0 } end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g13_status", self.vars and self.vars.score or 0, math.floor((self.energy or 1000) / 10))
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.now = 0
	self.initialized = false
	self.energy = 1000
	self.hideMouse = false
	self.vars = { score = 0 }
	self.points = {}
	self.holes = {}
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
end

function G:Close()
	for _, h in pairs(self.holes or {}) do stopStream(h) end
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
	self:ShowCursor(true)
end

function G:ShowCursor(show)
	local p = UI.root
	if IsValid(p) and p.SetCursor and self.cursorShown ~= show then
		p:SetCursor(show and "arrow" or "blank")
		self.cursorShown = show
	end
end

function G:Step()
	self.now = self.now + MS
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then FL.Tick(p.c) end end
	self:MainLoop()
	-- the hose follows the mouse while the mouse is hidden
	if self.hideMouse and MG.x0 and self:Game() then
		local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
		if mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H then
			local gx, gy = self:Mouse()
			local m, k = FL.ChildMatrix(self:Game(), "mousePointerMc", I)
			if k then k.mat = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], gx, gy } end
		end
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:ShowCursor(true)
	AN.FinishGame(13, self.vars.score or 0)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(13) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	if game then
		local extra = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.c.visible then extra[#extra + 1] = { c = p.c, m = p.m } end end
		game.extra = extra
	end
	local st = self
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		if name == "scoretxt" then return st.initialized and AN.L("g13_v_score", st.vars.score) or nil end
		return st.vars[name]
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, I)
	FL.VarHook = nil
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local inside = mx > 0 and mx < STAGE_W and my > 0 and my < STAGE_H
	self:ShowCursor(not (self.hideMouse and inside))
	-- the buttons in the windows (there while a fire burns, and as it goes down), in depth order
	if game and self.root.frame < 21 then
		local gm = self:GameM()
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(game)) do
			local id = it.nm and tonumber(string.match(it.nm, "^hole(%d+)$"))
			if id then
				local m, hole = FL.ChildMatrix(game, it.nm, gm)
				local btn, bm = FL.CharItem(hole, m, BUTTONS)
				local x0, y0, x1, y1
				if btn then x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(btn, bm, true) end
				if x0 then
					UI.Button("g13_hole" .. id, MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function() self:HoleClicked(id) end, { silent = true, hit = FL.HitFn(btn, bm) })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if self.root.frame >= 21 and self.root.frame < 97 then
		UI.Button("g13_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(13)
end

AN.RegisterGame(13, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g14_skubb:
-- Låge 14: Skubbespil (sliding puzzle)
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf + slide0-3.swf: the same four puzzles
-- (Gyldengrød 4x4, Pyrus 3x3, numbers 3x3 and 4x4), the same shuffle (100 random
-- moves while the drum plays), mouse or arrow keys, and the time is the score.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local G = {
	scoreType = "time",
	goal = 30,        -- original coolScore 30000 ms
	worst = 600,      -- original badScore 600000 ms
	descKey = "desc_14",
	howKey = "how_14",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 800, 600
-- the four puzzles in the order of the thumbnails (top to bottom)
local PUZZLES = {
	{ slide = 1, n = 3 },   -- Pyrus
	{ slide = 0, n = 4 },   -- Gyldengrød
	{ slide = 2, n = 3 },   -- numbers 3x3
	{ slide = 3, n = 4 },   -- numbers 4x4
}
local BOARD = { x = 201.5, y = 103.4, s = 400 }
-- element positions on the original 800 x 600 stage
local P = {
	desk = { 5.6, 242.8, 808 }, paper = { 133.2, 475.2, 146.4 }, branch = { -56.8, 2.4, 378.4 },
	thumbbg = { 282.4, 43.6, 100.8 }, thumbs = { 291.6, 53.2, 84.4 }, start = { 573.2, 480, 171.2 },
	medal = { 286, 176, 228.4 },
}

function G:Status()
	local pz = PUZZLES[self.choice or 2]
	return AN.L("g14_status", pz.n, pz.n, self.moves or 0)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.state = "menu"
	self.choice = self.choice or 2
	self.tiles = {}
	self.queue = {}
	self.keys = {}
end

local function img(name, p, alpha)
	MG.Img("g14/" .. name, p[1], p[2], p[3], nil, alpha)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Puzzle logic (same as the original)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Build()
	local pz = PUZZLES[self.choice]
	self.n = pz.n
	self.slide = pz.slide
	self.grid = {}           -- grid[x][y] = tile index or -1
	self.tiles = {}
	local n = self.n
	for x = 0, n - 1 do self.grid[x] = {} end
	local id = 0
	for y = 0, n - 1 do
		for x = 0, n - 1 do
			if not (x == n - 1 and y == n - 1) then
				id = id + 1
				self.tiles[id] = { home = { x, y }, pos = { x, y }, dx = x, dy = y }
				self.grid[x][y] = id
			end
		end
	end
	self.grid[n - 1][n - 1] = -1
	self.empty = { n - 1, n - 1 }
	self.hist = {}
	self.hintMoves = nil
end

-- tiles that can move into the empty spot: [1] below, [2] left, [3] above, [4] right of it
function G:Movable()
	local ex, ey = self.empty[1], self.empty[2]
	local n = self.n
	return {
		ey < n - 1 and self.grid[ex][ey + 1] or nil,
		ex > 0 and self.grid[ex - 1][ey] or nil,
		ey > 0 and self.grid[ex][ey - 1] or nil,
		ex < n - 1 and self.grid[ex + 1][ey] or nil,
	}
end

function G:CanMove(id)
	local t = self.tiles[id]
	local dx, dy = math.abs(t.pos[1] - self.empty[1]), math.abs(t.pos[2] - self.empty[2])
	return dx + dy == 1
end

-- move a tile into the empty spot. instant = no animation (shuffle)
function G:Move(id, instant)
	if not self:CanMove(id) then return false end
	local t = self.tiles[id]
	local ox, oy = t.pos[1], t.pos[2]
	self.grid[self.empty[1]][self.empty[2]] = id
	t.pos = { self.empty[1], self.empty[2] }
	self.grid[ox][oy] = -1
	self.empty = { ox, oy }
	-- the way back (for the hint): moving the same tile again undoes it, so the solution is this
	-- list of tiles backwards
	local h = self.hist
	if h then
		if h[#h] == id then
			h[#h] = nil
			if self.hintMoves and self.hintMoves > 0 then self.hintMoves = self.hintMoves - 1 end
		else
			h[#h + 1] = id
		end
	end
	if instant then
		t.dx, t.dy = t.pos[1], t.pos[2]
	else
		self.animating = id
		MG.Sound("g14", "slide")
	end
	return true
end

function G:Press(id)
	if self.state ~= "play" then return end
	if self.animating then
		self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = id
		return
	end
	if self:Move(id, false) then self.moves = (self.moves or 0) + 1 end
end

function G:Solved()
	for _, t in ipairs(self.tiles) do
		if t.pos[1] ~= t.home[1] or t.pos[2] ~= t.home[2] then return false end
	end
	return true
end

-- seed: the shuffle's random numbers (in a Duel split screen both players get the same shuffle)
function G:StartPuzzle(seed)
	seed = seed or math.random(1, 2000000000)
	self.state = "shuffle"
	-- the other player in a Duel split screen starts the same puzzle at the same time
	local other = self.partner
	if other and other.state == "menu" then
		other.choice = self.choice
		other:StartPuzzle(seed)
	end
	math.randomseed(seed)
	self.rolls = {}
	for i = 1, 200 do self.rolls[i] = math.random() end
	self.roll = 0
	self:Build()
	self.state = "shuffle"
	self.shufflesLeft = 100
	self.lastMove = nil
	self.shuffleAcc = 0
	self.queue = {}
	self.animating = nil
	self.moves = 0
	MG.Sound("g14", "drum", 0.8)
end

function G:ShuffleStep()
	local cands = {}
	for _, id in pairs(self:Movable()) do
		if id and id ~= -1 and id ~= self.lastMove then cands[#cands + 1] = id end
	end
	self.roll = self.roll % #self.rolls + 1
	local id = cands[math.floor(self.rolls[self.roll] * #cands) + 1]
	self:Move(id, true)
	self.lastMove = id
end

function G:Think(dt)
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
	if self.state == "shuffle" then
		-- one random move per original frame (25 fps)
		self.shuffleAcc = self.shuffleAcc + dt * 25
		while self.shuffleAcc >= 1 and self.shufflesLeft > 0 do
			self.shuffleAcc = self.shuffleAcc - 1
			self:ShuffleStep()
			self.shufflesLeft = self.shufflesLeft - 1
		end
		if self.shufflesLeft <= 0 then
			-- (very rarely the shuffle ends solved; then shuffle a bit more)
			if self:Solved() then self.shufflesLeft = 10 return end
			self.state = "play"
			self.t0 = RealTime()
		end
	elseif self.state == "play" then
		-- tile slide animation (original: x += (target - x) / 1.5 per frame)
		if self.animating then
			local t = self.tiles[self.animating]
			local f = 1 - (1 / 3) ^ (dt * 25)
			t.dx = t.dx + (t.pos[1] - t.dx) * f
			t.dy = t.dy + (t.pos[2] - t.dy) * f
			if math.abs(t.dx - t.pos[1]) < 0.01 and math.abs(t.dy - t.pos[2]) < 0.01 then
				t.dx, t.dy = t.pos[1], t.pos[2]
				self.animating = nil
				if self:Solved() then
					self:Done()
				elseif #self.queue > 0 then
					local id = table.remove(self.queue, 1)
					if self:Move(id, false) then self.moves = self.moves + 1 end
				end
			end
		end
		-- arrow keys move the tile next to the hole
		local map = { { KEY_UP, 1 }, { KEY_LEFT, 4 }, { KEY_DOWN, 3 }, { KEY_RIGHT, 2 } }
		for _, m in ipairs(map) do
			local down = input.IsKeyDown(m[1])
			if down and not self.keys[m[1]] then
				local id = self:Movable()[m[2]]
				if id and id ~= -1 then self:Press(id) end
			end
			self.keys[m[1]] = down
		end
	end
end

-- hint: arrows on the next 3 tiles to slide (numbered) on the way back to the solution
function G:CanHint() return self.state == "play" and self.hist and #self.hist > 0 and not self.animating end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintMoves = 3
	self.t0 = self.t0 - cost      -- the clock jumps 5 seconds
	MG.Pop("+" .. cost .. " s", false, 110, 70)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintMoves or self.hintMoves <= 0 or self.state ~= "play" or not self.hist then return end
	local n = self.n
	local ts = BOARD.s / n
	-- play the next moves on a copy of the board
	local pos, ex, ey = {}, self.empty[1], self.empty[2]
	for id, t in ipairs(self.tiles) do pos[id] = { t.pos[1], t.pos[2] } end
	for k = 1, math.min(self.hintMoves, #self.hist) do
		local id = self.hist[#self.hist - k + 1]
		local p = pos[id]
		local x0, y0 = BOARD.x + (p[1] + 0.5) * ts, BOARD.y + (p[2] + 0.5) * ts
		local x1, y1 = BOARD.x + (ex + 0.5) * ts, BOARD.y + (ey + 0.5) * ts
		local dx, dy = (x1 - x0) * 0.32, (y1 - y0) * 0.32
		local a = k == 1 and 1 or 0.7
		MG.HintArrow(x0 - dx * 0.4, y0 - dy * 0.4, x0 + dx * 1.2, y0 + dy * 1.2, MG.HINT_GOLD, a, ts * 0.09)
		MG.HintText(tostring(k), x0 - dx * 0.9, y0 - dy * 0.9 - (dx == 0 and 0 or ts * 0.18), MG.HINT_GOLD, ts * 0.18, a)
		pos[id], ex, ey = { ex, ey }, p[1], p[2]
	end
end

function G:Done()
	self.state = "done"
	self.time = RealTime() - self.t0
	self.doneAt = RealTime()
	self.saidDone = false
	MG.Sound("g14", "done")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Drawing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:DrawBoard(showSolved)
	local n = self.n
	local ts = BOARD.s / n
	-- frame and dark empty board
	AN.Box(MG.X(BOARD.x - 9), MG.Y(BOARD.y - 9), MG.S(BOARD.s + 18), MG.S(BOARD.s + 18), Color(250, 236, 200), MG.S(4))
	AN.Box(MG.X(BOARD.x - 4), MG.Y(BOARD.y - 4), MG.S(BOARD.s + 8), MG.S(BOARD.s + 8), Color(82, 52, 41), MG.S(2))
	local mat = AN.Mat(string.format("g14/slide%d.png", self.slide))
	for id, t in ipairs(self.tiles) do
		local x, y = BOARD.x + t.dx * ts, BOARD.y + t.dy * ts
		local hot = false
		-- (not in a Duel split screen: the two players share the mouse, so the keys only)
		if self.state == "play" and not self.partner then
			hot = UI.Button("tile" .. id, MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(ts), MG.S(ts), function() self:Press(id) end, { silent = true })
		end
		local u0, v0 = t.home[1] / n, t.home[2] / n
		surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 255)
		surface.SetMaterial(mat)
		local sx, sy, sw = AN.PX(MG.X(x)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y)), AN.SX(MG.S(ts))
		surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(sx, sy, sw, sw, u0, v0, u0 + 1 / n, v0 + 1 / n)
		-- bevel like the original tiles: light top/left, dark bottom/right
		local b = math.max(2, math.floor(sw * 0.035))
		surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, 110)
		surface.DrawRect(sx, sy, sw, b)
		surface.DrawRect(sx, sy, b, sw)
		surface.SetDrawColor(0, 0, 0, 120)
		surface.DrawRect(sx, sy + sw - b, sw, b)
		surface.DrawRect(sx + sw - b, sy, b, sw)
		if hot and self:CanMove(id) then
			surface.SetDrawColor(255, 215, 106, 60)
			surface.DrawRect(sx, sy, sw, sw)
		end
	end
	-- the missing corner piece appears when solved
	if showSolved then
		local x, y = BOARD.x + (n - 1) * ts, BOARD.y + (n - 1) * ts
		local a = math.Clamp((RealTime() - self.doneAt) / 0.5, 0, 1) * 255
		surface.SetDrawColor(255, 255, 255, a)
		surface.SetMaterial(mat)
		surface.DrawTexturedRectUV(AN.PX(MG.X(x)), AN.SY(MG.Y(y)), AN.SX(MG.S(ts)), AN.SX(MG.S(ts)), (n - 1) / n, (n - 1) / n, 1, 1)
	end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	-- the wood planks run horizontally, so the background is stretched to fill any width
	AN.Img("g14/wood.jpg", -AN.OX, -AN.OY, AN.VW + AN.OX * 2, AN.VH)

	if self.state == "menu" then
		img("branch.png", P.branch)
		img("desk.png", P.desk)
		img("paper.png", P.paper)
		img("thumbbg.png", P.thumbbg)
		img("thumbs.png", P.thumbs)
		-- thumbnail buttons
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local ty = 53.35 + ({ 0, 91, 181.8, 272.95 })[i]
			local hot = UI.Button("pz" .. i, MG.X(291.7), MG.Y(ty), MG.S(86), MG.S(86.9), function()
				self.choice = i
				if self.partner then self.partner.choice = i end
			end)
			if i == self.choice then
				AN.Outline(MG.X(289), MG.Y(ty - 1), MG.S(90), MG.S(89), C.gold, MG.S(3), MG.S(2.5))
			elseif hot then
				AN.Outline(MG.X(289), MG.Y(ty - 1), MG.S(90), MG.S(89), Color(255, 241, 207, 160), MG.S(3), MG.S(2))
			end
		end
		-- preview of the chosen puzzle
		local pz = PUZZLES[self.choice]
		AN.Box(MG.X(390), MG.Y(45), MG.S(380), MG.S(375), Color(184, 160, 128), MG.S(6))
		AN.Box(MG.X(415), MG.Y(62), MG.S(330), MG.S(330), Color(250, 236, 200), MG.S(2))
		MG.Img(string.format("g14/slide%d.png", pz.slide), 420, 67, 320, 320)
		AN.Text(pz.n .. " x " .. pz.n, "title", math.floor(MG.S(16)), MG.X(580), MG.Y(404), C.brown, 1, 1)
		-- Start sign
		local hot = UI.Button("start", MG.X(P.start[1]), MG.Y(P.start[2]), MG.S(P.start[3]), MG.S(90), function() self:StartPuzzle() end)
		if hot then AN.Glow(MG.X(P.start[1] + 85), MG.Y(P.start[2] + 45), MG.S(130), C.gold, 0.6) end
		MG.Img("g14/start_da.png", P.start[1], P.start[2] - (hot and 3 or 0), P.start[3])
	else
		self:DrawBoard(self.state == "done")
		self:HintDraw()
		MG.DrawPops()
		-- timer (top left, like the original)
		local t = 0
		if self.state == "play" then t = RealTime() - self.t0 elseif self.state == "done" then t = self.time end
		local ms = math.floor((t % 1) * 1000)
		local s = math.floor(t) % 60
		local m = math.floor(t / 60)
		local txt = string.format("%02d:%02d:%03d", m, s, ms)
		AN.Text(txt, "title", math.floor(MG.S(20)), MG.X(57) + 3, MG.Y(50) + 3, Color(60, 20, 4))
		AN.Text(txt, "title", math.floor(MG.S(20)), MG.X(57), MG.Y(50), C.cream)
		AN.Text(AN.L("g14_moves", self.moves or 0), "bold", math.floor(MG.S(11)), MG.X(57), MG.Y(80), C.wheat)

		if self.state == "done" then
			local k = math.Clamp((RealTime() - self.doneAt) / 0.4, 0, 1)
			local w = P.medal[3] * (0.6 + 0.4 * k)
			MG.Img("g14/medal.png", 400 - w / 2, P.medal[2] + (P.medal[3] - w) / 2, w, nil, 255 * k)
			if AN.LangCode() == "da" then
				MG.Img("g14/godt_shadow.png", 318.8, 355.6, 182.8, nil, 255 * k)
				MG.Img("g14/godt_da.png", 316.8, 352.8, 182.8, nil, 255 * k)
			else
				AN.Text(AN.L("g14_welldone"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(400) + 3, MG.Y(380) + 3, Color(60, 20, 4), 1, 1, 255 * k)
				AN.Text(AN.L("g14_welldone"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(400), MG.Y(380), C.cream, 1, 1, 255 * k)
			end
			if not self.saidDone then
				self.saidDone = true
				AN.Speak("gameover")
			end
			if RealTime() - self.doneAt > 2.5 then
				self.state = "finished"
				AN.FinishGame(14, self.time)
			end
		end
	end

	MG.Chrome(14)
end

AN.RegisterGame(14, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g15_rotte:
-- Låge 15: Flyvende Rotter
-- Rebuilt from the original game.swf. A rat falls from the attic ceiling; click to make the nisse swing
-- his club. Hit it at the right moment and it flies across the attic (the water spouts from the holes in
-- the floor lift it up again). Land past the line and you can register the distance or try again.
-- Same numbers as the original: 24 steps a second, gravity 1.95, the hit window is 35 around the club,
-- and the distance is 1.5 cm per unit flown. The rat's arms, legs and head swing with the original
-- little limb physics.
local UI, C, MG, TL = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG, AN.TL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
for _, f in ipairs({ "g15_world", "g15_anim", "g15_look", "g15_pos", "g15_sign", "g15_follow", "g15_start" }) do
	include(DIR .. f .. ".lua")
end
local W, A, LOOK, P = AN.G15World, AN.G15Anim, AN.G15Look.look, AN.G15Pos
local SIGN, FOLLOW, START = AN.G15Sign, AN.G15Follow, AN.G15Start

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 4500,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_15",
	howKey = "how_15",
}

-- the visible window of the original (the game sprite sits at -2.1, 97.9 in it before panning)
local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 546, 396
local VIEW_X, VIEW_Y = -2.1, 97.9
local STEP = 1 / 24
local GRAVITY = 1.95
local START_REF = { 299.5, -130.35 }
local GROUND_Y = 269.05
local GROUND_OFF = -11
local HIT_Y = 198.3            -- hitAnim._y
local HIT_POS = { 304.2, 198.3 }
local MIN_DIST = 1362.25
local MONSTER = { 100.05, 199.35 }
local LOOK_AT = { 93.25, -8.35 }
local SHADOW = { 1.33, 2.62, 272.1 }
local SIGN_Y = 265.35
local FOLLOW_Y0 = -75.1
local PAN_OFFSET = 340
local RAT_SCALE = 1.11
local PIX = 20

-- the water spouts (crater = x, y, sx, sy of the crater clip; fish = the spout clip next to it)
local CRATERS = {
	{ 2.07, 1.00, -215.25, 232.80 },
	{ 1.44, 0.99, 794.40, 256.95, fish = { "fishB", 785.55, 272.60 } },
	{ 1.52, 1.57, 1674.70, 264.65, fish = { "fishA", 1682.15, 273.40 } },
	{ 1.61, 1.90, 2182.80, 267.70, fish = { "fishB", 2177.30, 273.50 } },
}
-- the "blow" area of a crater: shape bounds (x0, y0, x1, y1) through the blow clip's matrix
local BLOW = { -15.15, -126.3, 11.55, 110.65, sx = 0.74, sy = 0.28, tx = -1.35, ty = -54.6 }

-- the rat: body parts (picture, x, y, base rotation) in draw order, and the limbs with physics
local PARTS = {
	{ "leg2", 5.75, 10.45, -24.8, limb = "leg2" },
	{ "leg1", -7.1, 11.7, 0, limb = "leg1" },
	{ "body", 0.25, 11.2, 0 },
	{ "arm1", -6.9, -5.85, 0, limb = "arm1" },
	{ "head", -0.35, -9.45, 0, limb = "head" },
	{ "body2", 0, 0, 0 },
	{ "arm2", 7.5, -6.1, 0, limb = "arm2" },
}
local LIMBS = {
	arm2 = { angleOffset = 90, fMult = 0.35, airFriction = 0.06, friction = 0.12, graMult = 0.6 },
	arm1 = { angleOffset = -90, fMult = 0.3, airFriction = 0.06, friction = 0.12, graMult = 0.6 },
	leg2 = { angleOffset = 90, fMult = 0.2, airFriction = 0.06, friction = 0.12, graMult = 0.6 },
	leg1 = { angleOffset = 90, fMult = 0.3, airFriction = 0.06, friction = 0.12, graMult = 0.6 },
	head = { angleOffset = 0, fMult = 1.3, airFriction = 0.0001, friction = 0.12, graMult = 0.6 },
}
-- the rat's outline (for the original hitTest between the rat and a spout)
local RAT_BOX = { -20, -29.3, 23, 15 }

local SIGN_LABEL = { animon = 4, animoff = 73, animonWon = 85, animoffWon = 153 }
local SIGN_STOPS = { [34] = true, [83] = true, [150] = true, [160] = true }

local rad = math.rad

function G:Status()
	if self.best and self.best > 0 then
		return AN.L("g15_status_best", self.best)
	end
	return AN.L("g15_status")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Open(args)
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.started = false        -- the start sign is shown first
	self.best = 0
	self.hintThrow, self.hintCostTotal = nil, 0
	MG.ResetPops()
	-- game.init()
	self.state = "none"
	self.sCount = 0
	self.aState = "none"
	self.panning = false
	self.panPos = -124            -- -this._x (the game sprite starts at 124 in the original)
	self.score = 0
	self.rat = { x = 296.95, y = -251.45, vx = 0, vy = 0, rot = 0, rotVel = 0, visible = true }
	self.monF, self.monPlaying = 3, false   -- idle
	self.lookF = 1
	self.hitF, self.hitPlaying = 1, false
	self.signF, self.signPlaying, self.signX = 1, false, 402.1
	self.followF, self.followX, self.followY, self.followArrow, self.followTxt = 55, 733.25, FOLLOW_Y0, 2, ""
	self.shadowVisible, self.shadowX = false, -213.05
	self.fish = {}
	for i, c in ipairs(CRATERS) do
		if c.fish then self.fish[i] = { f = 1, playing = false, last = -10 } end
	end
	self.limbs = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(PARTS) do
		if p.limb then
			self.limbs[p.limb] = { rot = p[4], rotVel = 0, active = true, ease = 0, old = nil, oldMove = { 0, 0 }, part = p }
		end
	end
end

-- the rat's matrix in the game sprite
function G:RatMatrix()
	local r = self.rat
	local c, s = math.cos(rad(r.rot)) * RAT_SCALE, math.sin(rad(r.rot)) * RAT_SCALE
	return { c, s, -s, c, r.x, r.y }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game.loop()
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Loop()
	self.sCount = self.sCount + 1
	local st = self.state
	local r = self.rat
	if st == "none" then
		self.state = "makeAst"
		self.sCount = 0
	elseif st == "makeAst" then
		if self.sCount == 2 then
			r.x, r.y = START_REF[1], START_REF[2]
			self.aState = "fall"
			-- (the original asks "math.random()" in lower case, which Flash 6 reads as 0: it always falls at 4)
			r.vx, r.vy = 0, 4
			r.rotVel = (math.random() - 0.5) * 12
			self.state = "ast"
			self:MonsterGoto(4, true)    -- gotowait
			self.soundDone = false
		end
	elseif st == "ast" then
		self:DoAstronaut()
	elseif st == "inTheHole" then
		if self.sCount > 20 then
			self.state = "makeAst"
			self.sCount = 0
		end
	elseif st == "landed" then
		if self.sCount == 5 then self:MonsterGoto(3, false) end
		if self.sCount > 40 then
			self.state = "makeAst"
			self.sCount = 0
			self:SignGoto(SIGN_LABEL.animoff)
			r.x, r.y = START_REF[1], START_REF[2] - math.random(0, 5)
		end
	elseif st == "landedwon" then
		if self.sCount == 5 then self:MonsterGoto(3, false) end
	end
	if self.panning then
		local targ = r.x - PAN_OFFSET
		self.panPos = self.panPos + (targ - self.panPos) / 4.9
	end
end

function G:DoAstronaut()
	local r = self.rat
	if self.aState == "fall" then
		r.y = r.y + r.vy
		r.rot = r.rot + r.rotVel
		if r.y > GROUND_Y + 40 then
			self.state = "inTheHole"
			self.sCount = 0
			AN.Speak("rotter_ikkeramt")
		end
		self.lookF = math.max(1, math.Round(r.y))
	elseif self.aState == "fly" then
		local blow = self:CheckCraterBlows()
		self:SetFollowSign()
		r.vx = r.vx * 0.998
		r.vy = (r.vy + GRAVITY - blow) * 0.998
		r.x = r.x + r.vx
		r.y = r.y + r.vy
		r.rot = r.rot + r.rotVel
		self.shadowVisible = true
		self.shadowX = r.x
		local ground = GROUND_Y + GROUND_OFF
		if not self.soundDone and r.y + 2 * r.vy > ground then
			self.soundDone = true
			MG.Sound("g15", math.random() > 0.5 and "bounce1" or "bounce2")
		end
		if r.y > ground then
			self.soundDone = false
			if math.abs(r.vx) + math.abs(r.vy) > 8 then
				r.y = ground - 1
				r.vx = r.vx * 0.51
				r.vy = r.vy * -0.51
				r.vx = r.vx + r.rotVel * 0.1
				r.rotVel = r.vx * 0.5
			else
				r.y = ground
				if r.x > MIN_DIST then
					self.state = "landedwon"
					self.sCount = 0
					self:ShowSign("Won")
				else
					self.state = "landed"
					self.sCount = 0
					self:ShowSign("")
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:ShowSign(str)
	local r = self.rat
	self.score = math.Round(100 * ((r.x - START_REF[1]) * 0.3) / PIX)
	self:SignGoto(SIGN_LABEL["animon" .. str])
	self.signX = r.x
	self.distTxt = AN.L("g15_dist", self.score)
	if str == "Won" then self.best = math.max(self.best, self.score) end
end

function G:SetFollowSign()
	local r = self.rat
	local f = math.min(80, math.max(1, math.Round(r.y - FOLLOW_Y0) + 15))
	local meters
	if f < 50 then
		self.followF = f
		self.followX = r.x
		self.followY = math.max(FOLLOW_Y0, r.y)
		meters = math.Round((GROUND_Y - r.y) * 0.3 / PIX)
		self.followTxt = AN.L("g15_height", meters)
		local slope = r.vx ~= 0 and r.vy / r.vx or 0
		self.followArrow = slope < -0.3 and 1 or (slope < 0.3 and 2 or 3)
	end
	if f < 3 and meters and self.lastMeter ~= meters then MG.Sound("g15", "tick", 0.5) end
	self.lastMeter = meters
end

-- ast.hitTest(blow): the bounding boxes of the rat and the spout overlap
function G:CheckCraterBlows()
	local r = self.rat
	local m = self:RatMatrix()
	local x0, y0, x1, y1 = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
	for _, c in ipairs({ { RAT_BOX[1], RAT_BOX[2] }, { RAT_BOX[3], RAT_BOX[2] }, { RAT_BOX[1], RAT_BOX[4] }, { RAT_BOX[3], RAT_BOX[4] } }) do
		local px, py = TL.Apply(m, c[1], c[2])
		x0, y0, x1, y1 = math.min(x0, px), math.min(y0, py), math.max(x1, px), math.max(y1, py)
	end
	for i, c in ipairs(CRATERS) do
		local bx0 = c[3] + c[1] * (BLOW.tx + BLOW.sx * BLOW[1])
		local bx1 = c[3] + c[1] * (BLOW.tx + BLOW.sx * BLOW[3])
		local by0 = c[4] + c[2] * (BLOW.ty + BLOW.sy * BLOW[2])
		local by1 = c[4] + c[2] * (BLOW.ty + BLOW.sy * BLOW[4])
		if x1 > bx0 and x0 < bx1 and y1 > by0 and y0 < by1 then
			local dist = math.max(0, GROUND_Y - 20 - r.y)
			local force = math.max(0, 250 - dist) / 250
			force = force ^ 4 * 25
			r.rotVel = r.rotVel - (c[3] - r.x) * 0.16
			local fi = self.fish[i]
			if fi and RealTime() - fi.last > 0.5 then
				fi.f, fi.playing = 6, true
				fi.last = RealTime()
			end
			return force
		end
	end
	return 0
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the nisse (monster clip)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:MonsterGoto(f, play)
	self.monF, self.monPlaying = f, play
	self:MonsterScript(f)
end

function G:MonsterScript(f)
	if f == 3 or f == 10 then
		self.monPlaying = false
	elseif f == 20 then
		MG.Sound("g15", "swing", 0.8)
	elseif f == 29 then
		self:AtHitFrame()
	elseif f == 44 then
		if not self.hitIt then self:MonsterGoto(10, false) end
	elseif f == 53 then
		self:MonsterGoto(10, false)
	end
end

function G:AtHitFrame()
	local r = self.rat
	local size = 35
	local d = r.y - HIT_Y
	local ad = math.abs(d)
	if ad < size and self.aState == "fall" and self.state == "ast" then
		self.aState = "fly"
		r.vx = (6.5 + (size - ad) / size * 6.5) * 3.2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 9
		r.vy = (-3.5 + d * 0.35) * 4.1 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 8
		self.panning = true
		self.hitF, self.hitPlaying = 2, true
		self.hitIt = true
		AN.Speak("rotter_ramt")
	else
		self.hitIt = false
	end
end

function G:MonsterClicked()
	if not self.started then return end
	if self.monF >= 10 and self.monF <= 19 then
		self:MonsterGoto(20, true)    -- swing
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the sign
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:SignGoto(f)
	self.signF, self.signPlaying = f, true
	self:SignScript(f)
end

function G:SignScript(f)
	if f == 28 or f == 122 then MG.Sound("g15", "sign", 0.7) end
	if f == 128 then AN.Speak("gameover") end
	if SIGN_STOPS[f] or f == 1 then self.signPlaying = false end
end

function G:TryAgain()
	self.state = "makeAst"
	self.sCount = 0
	self:SignGoto(SIGN_LABEL.animoff)
	self.rat.x, self.rat.y = START_REF[1], START_REF[2] - math.random(0, 5)
	self.soundDone = false
end

function G:MoveOn()
	self:Finish()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the limbs (the original "dangle" helper on each arm, leg and the head)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Limbs()
	local m = self:RatMatrix()
	local pr = self.rat.rot
	for name, L in pairs(self.limbs) do
		local cfg = LIMBS[name]
		local p = L.part
		local wx, wy = TL.Apply(m, p[2], p[3])
		local gx, gy = wx - self.panPos, wy     -- the global position (the camera moves too)
		if not L.old then
			L.old = { gx, gy }
		else
			local mvx, mvy = gx - L.old[1], gy - L.old[2]
			if not L.active then
				if mvx ~= 0 and mvy ~= 0 then L.active = true end
				L.old = { gx, gy }
			else
				if math.abs(mvx) + math.abs(mvy) > 60 then
					L.old = { gx, gy }
				else
					local a = rad(cfg.angleOffset + L.rot + pr)
					local ox, oy = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
					local accx, accy = mvx - L.oldMove[1], mvy - L.oldMove[2]
					L.old = { gx, gy }
					L.oldMove = { mvx, mvy }
					local accTorque = ox * accx + oy * accy
					local graTorque = -(oy * 10)
					local b = rad(0 + L.rot - pr)
					local pvx, pvy = math.cos(b) * 20, math.sin(b) * 20
					local airFric = (-mvy) * pvx + mvx * pvy
					L.rotVel = L.rotVel + graTorque * cfg.graMult + accTorque * cfg.fMult + airFric * cfg.airFriction * 0.23
					L.rotVel = L.rotVel * (1 - cfg.friction)
					L.rot = L.rot + L.rotVel
					if math.abs(L.rotVel) < 0.2 then
						L.ease = L.ease + 1
						if L.ease > 10 then L.active = false; L.ease = 0 end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Step()
	if not self.started then return end
	self:Loop()
	self:Limbs()
	if self.monPlaying then
		local f = self.monF + 1
		if f > #A.nisse.all then f = 1 end
		self:MonsterGoto(f, true)
	end
	if self.hitPlaying then
		self.hitF = self.hitF + 1
		if self.hitF > #A.hit.all then self.hitF = 1; self.hitPlaying = false end
	end
	if self.signPlaying then
		self:SignGoto(self.signF + 1)
		if self.signF >= 160 then self.signPlaying = false end
	end
	for _, fi in pairs(self.fish) do
		if fi.playing then
			fi.f = fi.f + 1
			if fi.f == 7 then MG.Sound("g15", "spout", 0.5) end
			if fi.f > 9 then fi.f = 1; fi.playing = false end
		end
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

-- hint (one throw): the club glows while the rat falls, and "NOW!" flashes at the moment to click
-- (the swing takes 9 steps to reach the rat, and it falls 4 a step). The cost comes off the result.
function G:CanHint() return self.started and (self.state == "ast" or self.state == "makeAst") and self.aState ~= "fly" and not self.hintThrow end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintThrow = true
	self.hintCostTotal = (self.hintCostTotal or 0) + cost
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 300, 60)
end
function G:HintDraw(ox, oy)
	if not self.hintThrow then return end
	if self.aState == "fly" or self.state == "inTheHole" then self.hintThrow = nil return end
	if self.state ~= "ast" then return end
	local hx, hy = HIT_POS[1] + ox, HIT_POS[2] + oy
	local d = (self.rat.y + 4 * 9) - HIT_Y
	if math.abs(d) <= 6 then
		MG.HintRing(hx, hy, 34, MG.HINT_GOOD, 1, 5)
		MG.HintText(AN.L("g15_hint_now"), hx, hy - 60, MG.HINT_GOOD, 30)
	elseif d < 0 then
		MG.HintRing(hx, hy, 34, MG.HINT_GOLD, 0.5, 3)
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(15, math.max(0, (self.score or 0) - (self.hintCostTotal or 0)))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing (the game sprite's coordinates -> the window)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)

alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g16_kaerl:
-- Låge 16: Kærlighedsflugten
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf: a Pac-Man in Rigsarkivet. Bertramsen eats all the
-- pebernødder while four ladies chase him; a garlic makes them scared for a while so he can catch
-- them (200, 400, 800, 1600). A bonus thing shows up under the ladies' room now and then. 3 lives.
-- The game code is the original's (the same engine as door 9), quirks included:
--   * only one of the ladies really hunts (along the shortest way between the crossings); one of
--     the others sometimes turns back, the rest go at random
--   * a lady sent home goes into "back in the room" mode as soon as she reaches the room's column
--     anywhere in the maze (the check tests the column twice and never the row)
--   * the lives counter shows one less than you have
-- Hidden content: the game's own background loops (normal, scared, going home) and intro
-- jingles, which are in the file but never played.
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g16_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 5000,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_16",
	howKey = "how_16",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 467, 600
local STEP = 1 / 25
local LIB = "g16"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local NBX, NBY = 28, 31
local GHOST_CID = { [0] = 273, 259, 243, 229 }

local CUR

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the maze (fillGrid): 0 = way without a dot, 2 = dot, 3 = big dot; everything else is wall
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local MAZE = {
	[1] = "1-12:2 15-26:2", [2] = "1 6 12 15 21 26:2", [3] = "6 12 15 21:2 1 26:3", [4] = "1 6 12 15 21 26:2",
	[5] = "1-26:2", [6] = "1 6 9 18 21 26:2", [7] = "1 6 9 18 21 26:2",
	[8] = "1-6:2 9-12:2 15-18:2 21-26:2", [9] = "6 21:2 12 15:0", [10] = "6 21:2 12 15:0",
	[11] = "6 21:2 9-18:0", [12] = "6 21:2 9 18:0", [13] = "6 21:2 9 18:0",
	[14] = "0-5:0 6:2 7-9:0 18-20:0 21:2 22-27:0", [15] = "6 21:2 9 18:0", [16] = "6 21:2 9 18:0",
	[17] = "6 21:2 9-18:0", [18] = "6 21:2 9 18:0", [19] = "6 21:2 9 18:0",
	[20] = "1-12:2 15-26:2", [21] = "1 6 12 15 21 26:2", [22] = "1 6 12 15 21 26:2",
	[23] = "2 3 6-12:2 15-21:2 24 25:2 13 14:0 1 26:3", [24] = "3 6 9 18 21 24:2", [25] = "3 6 9 18 21 24:2",
	[26] = "1-6:2 9-12:2 15-18:2 21-26:2", [27] = "1 12 15 26:2", [28] = "1 12 15 26:2", [29] = "1-26:2",
}

local function parseMaze()
	local t = {}
	for y, spec in pairs(MAZE) do
		-- groups like "1 6 12:2" (cells, then the type after the colon)
		for group in string.gmatch(spec, "[%d%- ]+:%d") do
			local cells, tp = string.match(group, "([%d%- ]+):(%d)")
			for c in string.gmatch(cells, "[%d%-]+") do
				local a, b = string.match(c, "(%d+)%-(%d+)")
				a, b = tonumber(a or c), tonumber(b or c)
				for x = a, b do t[x .. "_" .. y] = tonumber(tp) end
			end
		end
	end
	return t
end

-- Number(x) on a path step: "" counts as 0, nothing as NaN (no move)
local function num(v)
	if v == nil then return nil end
	if v == "" then return 0 end
	return tonumber(v)
end

local function split(path)
	local t = {}
	for part in string.gmatch(path .. "_", "([^_]*)_") do t[#t + 1] = part end
	-- "a_b_".split("_") -> { "a", "b", "" }
	return t
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame scripts
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [206] = true, [306] = true, [298] = true }   -- hit areas, grid marks, preloader
	for _, cid in ipairs({ 141, 17, 46, 57, 62, 67, 194, 207, 229, 243, 259, 273, 291, 316, 320, 328, 333 }) do

end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- helpers
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end
function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self:Game(), name) end

local function itemPos(parent, name)
	local m = FL.ChildMatrix(parent, name, I)
	return m and m[5] or 0, m and m[6] or 0
end

local function vec(x, y) return { x = x or 0, y = y or 0 } end

function G:Attach(cid, depth, x, y, sx, sy)
	local e = { c = FL.New(LIB, cid), m = { sx or 1, 0, 0, sy or sx or 1, x or 0, y or 0 }, depth = depth }
	self.arenaStuff[#self.arenaStuff + 1] = e
	return e
end

function G:Detach(e)
	for i = #self.arenaStuff, 1, -1 do if self.arenaStuff[i] == e then table.remove(self.arenaStuff, i) end end
end

local function anim(o) return FL.Child(o.mc, "anim") end
