-- picking a beetle up / letting go (the beetle's button)
function G:Pickup(i, gx, gy)
	local s = self.scarabs[i]
	s.state = "dragging"
	local h = self.holes[s.holeId]
	if h then h.filled = false end
	s.loosening = false
	if self.lastLoose == i then self:LooseSound(false) end
	s.scale = 1.2
	s.x, s.y = gx, gy
	MG.Sound("g20", "pickup")
	self.drag = i
	UI.BeginDrag({ release = function() self:Drop(i) end })
end

function G:Drop(i)
	local s = self.scarabs[i]
	self.drag = nil
	if not s or s.state ~= "dragging" then return end
	MG.Sound("g20", "drop")
	s.scale = 1
	s.jx, s.jy = 0, 0
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local gx, gy = mx - GAME_X, my
	local correct = false
	local holeM = self:HoleMatrices()
	for h = 1, #self.holes do
		local hole = self.holes[h]
		local m = holeM[h]
		if not hole.filled and m then
			local im = inv(m)
			local lx, ly = TL.Apply(im, gx, gy)
			if lx >= HOLE_HIT[1] and lx <= HOLE_HIT[3] and ly >= HOLE_HIT[2] and ly <= HOLE_HIT[4] then
				correct = s.char == hole.char
				if correct then
					s.state = "locked"
					hole.filled = true
					s.mcRot, s.rotation = 270, 270
					s.holeId = h
					s.scale = 0.95
					s.x, s.y = m[5], m[6]
					s.body = "stand"
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not correct then
		s.state = "free"
	end
end

-- the holes' matrices in game coordinates (from the letter holder's frame)
function G:HoleMatrices()
	local out = {}
	local fr = AN.G20Letters.frames[#self.curword]
	for _, it in ipairs(fr or {}) do
		local _, inst = slotName(it[1])
		local n = tonumber(string.match(inst or "", "l(%d+)"))
		if n then out[n] = { it[2], it[3], it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7] } end
	end
	return out
end

function G:Step()
	self.tick = self.tick + 1
	self.clock = self.clock + STEP
	if self.fadeF < 18 then self.fadeF = self.fadeF + 1 end
	if self.gameState == "playgame" then
		self:MoveAllScarabs()
		self:MoveAllShadows()
		self:ScarabDirection()
		self:ScarabEscape()
		self:GameStatus()
		self.timeLeft = self.timeLeft - 1
		if self.timeLeft < 0 then
			self.gameState = "gameover"
			self:TimeRanOut()
		else
			local secs = math.floor(self.timeLeft / 25)
			if tostring(secs) ~= self.txt.txttime then
				self.txt.txttime = tostring(secs)
				if secs < 4 then MG.Sound("g20", "beep") end
			end
		end
	end
	if self.showscore < self.score then
		if self.showscore < self.score - 5 then self.showscore = self.showscore + 3 else self.showscore = self.showscore + 1 end
		self.txt.txtscore = tostring(self.showscore)
	end
	if self.autoAt and self.clock >= self.autoAt then self:Finish() end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
	-- startDrag(true): the beetle's middle follows the mouse
	if self.drag and MG.k then
		local s = self.scarabs[self.drag]
		if s then
			local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
			s.x, s.y = mx - GAME_X + (s.jx or 0), my + (s.jy or 0)
		end
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self.autoAt = nil
	self:WalkSound(false)
	self:LooseSound(false)
	AN.FinishGame(20, self.score)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pic(name, m, alpha)
	local r = P[name]
	if r then TL.Pic("g20/" .. name .. ".png", r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], m, alpha) end
end

-- a beetle: body (standing or crawling, legs and eyes moving on their own), its letter
function G:DrawScarab(s, gameM)
	local m = TL.Mul(gameM, rotM(s.mcRot, s.x, s.y, s.scale))
	local age = self.tick - (s.born or 0)
	local body = s.body == "stand" and 1 or 12
	TL.Draw(AN.G20Scarab, s.kind, {
		slot = function(name, bm)
			local base = slotName(name)
			local tl = base == "body1" and AN.G20Body1 or AN.G20Body2
			local eyes = base == "body1" and AN.G20Eyes1 or AN.G20Eyes2
			TL.Draw(tl, body, {
				slot = function(n2, lm)
					local b2 = slotName(n2)
					if b2 == "legA" then TL.Draw(AN.G20LegA, age % 9 + 1, nil, lm)
					elseif b2 == "legB" then TL.Draw(AN.G20LegB, age % 5 + 1, nil, lm)
					elseif b2 == "eyes" then
						local n = #eyes.frames
						TL.Draw(eyes, age % n + 1, nil, lm)
					end
				end,
			}, bm)
		end,
		value = function() return nil end,
	}, m)
	-- the letter, turned with the beetle (the "char" text field)
	local e = AN.G20Scarab.chars.e73
	local tm = TL.Mul(m, { 0, 1, -1, 0, 16.45, -32.5 })
	local cx, cy = TL.Apply(tm, e[3] + e[5] / 2, e[4] + e[6] / 2)
	TL.Text(s.char or "", "title", e[7] * 0.82, cx, cy, tm, Color(e[9], e[10], e[11]))
end

function G:DrawGame(gm)
	-- the engine clip: the shadows
	local em = TL.Mul(gm, { 1, 0, 0, 1, ENGINE[1], ENGINE[2] })
	for _, s in ipairs(self.scarabs) do
		pic("shadow", TL.Mul(em, rotM(s.shRot or 0, s.shX or s.x, s.shY or s.y, s.scale)), 0.3)
	end
	-- the type case with its holes
	local n = #self.curword
	TL.Draw(AN.G20Letters, n, {
		slot = function(name, hm)
			local _, inst = slotName(name)
			local h = self.holes[tonumber(string.match(inst or "", "l(%d+)")) or 0]
			TL.Draw(AN.G20Hole, 1, { value = function() return h and h.displayChar or "" end }, hm)
		end,
	}, gm)
	-- the beetles, on top
	for _, s in ipairs(self.scarabs) do self:DrawScarab(s, gm) end
	-- their buttons (the topmost beetle under the mouse wins)
	if self.gameState == "playgame" and not self.drag then
		UI.Button("g20_table", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), nil, { silent = true, press = function()
			local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
			for i = #self.scarabs, 1, -1 do
				local s = self.scarabs[i]
				local bm = TL.Mul(TL.Mul(gm, rotM(s.mcRot, s.x, s.y, s.scale)), { 0, 0.78, -1.01, 0, -9.85, -0.25 })
				local im = inv(bm)
				if im then
					local lx, ly = TL.Apply(im, mx, my)
					local r = P.hit43
					if lx >= r[1] and lx <= r[1] + r[3] and ly >= r[2] and ly <= r[2] + r[4] then
						self:Pickup(i, mx - GAME_X, my)
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end })
	end
end

function G:DrawMessages(mm)
	if self.msgFrame == 1 then return end
	local en = AN.LangCode() ~= "da"
	TL.Draw(AN.G20Msg, self.msgFrame, {
		slot = function(name, bm)
			local base = slotName(name)
			local shape, fn
			if base == "btnNext" then
				shape = en and "btn108_notext" or "btn108"
				fn = function() self:NextLevelClick() end
			elseif base == "btnAgain" then
				shape, fn = "btn110", function() self:RestartGameClick() end
			elseif base == "btnContinue" then
				shape, fn = "btn115", function() self:Finish() end
			elseif base == "btnDone" then
				shape, fn = "btn110", function() self:Finish() end
			end
			if not shape then return end
			local r = P[shape]
			local hot = false
			-- the button: its plank's box, through its matrix
			local xs, ys = {}, {}
			for _, c in ipairs({ { r[1], r[2] }, { r[1] + r[3], r[2] }, { r[1], r[2] + r[4] }, { r[1] + r[3], r[2] + r[4] } }) do
				local x, y = TL.Apply(bm, c[1], c[2])
				xs[#xs + 1], ys[#ys + 1] = x, y
			end
			local x0, y0 = math.min(unpack(xs)), math.min(unpack(ys))
			local x1, y1 = math.max(unpack(xs)), math.max(unpack(ys))
			hot = UI.Button("g20_" .. base, MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), fn, { silent = true })
			local sm = bm
			if hot then sm = TL.Mul(bm, { 1.04, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0 }) end
			pic(shape, sm)
			if base == "btnNext" and en then
				local col = Color(255, 236, 200)
				local ax, ay = TL.Apply(sm, -14, -30)
				TL.Text(AN.L("g20_next1"), "title", 44, ax, ay, sm, col, 1, 200)
				ax, ay = TL.Apply(sm, -2, 12)
				TL.Text(AN.L("g20_next2"), "title", 44, ax, ay, sm, col, 1, 200)
				ax, ay = TL.Apply(sm, 50, 46)
				TL.Text(AN.L("g20_next3"), "title", 17, ax, ay, sm, col, 1, 120)
			end
		end,
	}, mm)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	TL.Draw(AN.G20Root, 1, {
		slot = function(name, m)
			local base = slotName(name)
			if base == "game" then self:DrawGame(m) self:HintDraw(m)
			elseif base == "messages" then self:DrawMessages(m)
			elseif base == "fade" then
				if self.fadeF < 18 then TL.Draw(AN.G20Fade, self.fadeF, nil, m) end
			end
		end,
		value = function(var) return self.txt[var] end,
	})
	MG.DrawPops()
	MG.Chrome(20)
end

G.levels = #DIFF   -- every word is a level
AN.RegisterGame(20, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g21_nisse:
-- Låge 21: Nissespor
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Four tiles with half footprints on every edge; drag them
-- together into a square so the prints and colours match, and turn the last tile you picked up
-- with the space bar. Same rules as the original game clip: a 2 x 2 puzzle, tiles snap to a
-- neighbour within 50 pixels, a join counts when both halves have the same kind of print and
-- are opposite halves, and the game ends when there are 4 joins. The score is the time.
-- The background can be dragged too (it moves the whole table with the tiles, like the original).
local UI, MG, TL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g21_pos.lua")
include(DIR .. "g21_anim.lua")
include(DIR .. "g21_root.lua")
include(DIR .. "g21_sign.lua")
local P, A, ROOT, SIGN = AN.G21Pos, AN.G21Anim, AN.G21Root, AN.G21Sign

local G = {
	scoreType = "time",
	goal = 30,        -- the original coolScore (30000 ms, from the CD's gamelist.txt)
	worst = 600,      -- the original badScore (600000 ms, from the CD's gamelist.txt)
	descKey = "desc_21",
	howKey = "how_21",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 600, 400
local STEP = 1 / 25
local X_SIZE, Y_SIZE = 2, 2            -- gameType 1
local SNAP = 50
local ROT_FRAMES = 10
local SIGN_POS = { 272.9, 359.1 }      -- the "Godt klaret!" clip on the stage
local OVER_FRAMES = 78                 -- "game over" (frame 19) to the gameOver call (frame 97)
local TYPES = { [0] = "a", "b", "c", "d" }
-- the four edge clips s0..s3 inside a tile
local SIDE_M = {
	[0] = { 0.98, 0, 0, 0.98, 0, -39.7 },
	[1] = { 0, 0.98, -0.98, 0, 39.2, 0 },
	[2] = { -0.98, 0, 0, -0.98, 0, 39.2 },
	[3] = { 0, -0.98, 0.98, 0, -39.2, 0 },
}
local HALF = 40                        -- the tile's button: a square from -40 to 39.95
local BSIZE = 79.95 + 1                -- bricks[0].mc._width + 1
-- the background button inside the table clip (shape 74 through its matrix)
local BG_HIT = { 349.75 - 452.2 * 1.625, 214.35 - 243.55 * 1.863, 349.75 + 452.2 * 1.625, 214.35 + 243.55 * 1.863 }
-- the 16 wood tiles of the table clip
local TILES = {
	{ 1, 1, -8.55, -15.05 }, { -1, 1, -737.5, -15.05 }, { -1, 1, 721.45, -15.05 }, { 1, -1, -8.55, 442.95 },
	{ -1, -1, -737.5, 442.95 }, { -1, -1, 721.45, 442.95 }, { 1, -1, -8.55, -475.05 }, { -1, -1, -737.5, -475.05 },
	{ -1, -1, 721.45, -475.05 }, { 1, 1, 1445.35, -14.95 }, { 1, -1, 1445.35, 443.05 }, { 1, -1, 1445.35, -474.95 },
	{ 1, 1, -8.55, 901.85 }, { -1, 1, -737.5, 901.85 }, { -1, 1, 721.45, 901.85 }, { 1, 1, 1445.35, 901.75 },
}

local function pic(name, m, alpha)
	local r = P[name]
	if r then TL.Pic("g21/" .. name .. ".png", r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], m, alpha) end
end

local function rotM(deg, x, y)
	local a = math.rad(deg)
	local c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
	return { c, s, -s, c, x, y }
end

local function padFix(v)
	return string.format("%02d", v)
end

local function scoreToTime(ms)
	local min = math.floor(ms / 1000 / 60)
	local sek = math.floor(ms / 1000 - min * 60)
	local thous = math.floor(ms - min * 60000 - sek * 1000)
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%03d", min, sek, thous)
end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g21_status", self.connections or 0, self.required or 4)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.state = "brandnew"
	self.connections = 0
	self.required = (X_SIZE - 1) * Y_SIZE + (Y_SIZE - 1) * X_SIZE
	self.rotating = false
	self.rotCount = 1
	self.selected = nil
	self.dragging = false
	self.draggedID = nil
	self.drag = nil
	self.mainX, self.mainY = 0, 0
	self.shadowX, self.shadowY, self.shadowRot = -1000, 0, 0
	self.playingTime = 0
	self.txt = { hourTxt = "00", minTxt = "00", secTxt = "00", mSecTxt = "00" }
	self.bricks = {}
	self.signF = nil         -- the "Godt klaret!" clip (frame 1 = hidden)
	self.overF = nil         -- frames shown of the "Spil Slut!" board
	self.spaceWas = true
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game controller
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:NewBrick(id, xt, yt)
	local b = { id = id, xID = xt, yID = yt, x = 0, y = 0, rot = 0, mcRot = 0, depth = 200 + id, lineF = 1, sides = {}, mcs = {} }
	for t = 0, 3 do
		b.sides[t] = { type = -1, state = 0, connected = 0, brickID = -1, sideID = -1, mc = t }
		b.mcs[t] = { label = nil, blink = false }
	end
	return b
end

function G:SetLabel(brickID, sideID, type, dir)
	local s = self.bricks[brickID].sides[sideID]
	s.state, s.type, s["end"] = 1, type, dir
	if s.mc then self.bricks[brickID].mcs[s.mc].label = TYPES[type] .. (dir and "1" or "2") end
end

function G:MakeNabo(b1, s1, b2, s2)
	local type = math.random(0, 3)
	local dir = math.random() > 0.5
	self:SetLabel(b1, s1, type, dir)
	self:SetLabel(b2, s2, type, not dir)
end

function G:MakeRandomEdge(b, s)
	local type = math.random(0, 3)
	local dir = math.random() > 0.5
	self:SetLabel(b, s, type, dir)
end

function G:InitGame()
	self.dragging = false
	self.shadowX = -1000
	self.startTime = RealTime()
	local bricks = self.bricks
	local id = 0
	for yt = 0, Y_SIZE - 1 do
		for xt = 0, X_SIZE - 1 do
			bricks[id] = self:NewBrick(id, xt, yt)
			id = id + 1
		end
	end
	self.nb = id
	local t = 0
	for yt = 0, Y_SIZE - 1 do
		for xt = 0, X_SIZE - 1 do
			bricks[t].x = 100 + xt * BSIZE
			bricks[t].y = 100 + yt * BSIZE
			t = t + 1
		end
	end
	t = 0
	for yt = 0, Y_SIZE - 1 do
		for xt = 0, X_SIZE - 1 do
			if xt == 0 then
				self:MakeRandomEdge(t, 3)
				self:MakeNabo(t, 1, t + 1, 3)
			elseif xt == X_SIZE - 1 then
				self:MakeRandomEdge(t, 1)
			else
				self:MakeNabo(t, 1, t + 1, 3)
			end
			if yt == 0 then
				self:MakeRandomEdge(t, 0)
				self:MakeNabo(t, 2, t + X_SIZE, 0)
			elseif yt == Y_SIZE - 1 then
				self:MakeRandomEdge(t, 2)
			else
				self:MakeNabo(t, 2, t + X_SIZE, 0)
			end
			t = t + 1
		end
	end
	-- scatter and turn them (replaceThem / rotateThem)
	t = 0
	for yt = 0, Y_SIZE - 1 do
		for xt = 0, X_SIZE - 1 do
			local b = bricks[t]
			b.x = 70 + math.random() * 450
			b.y = 70 + math.random() * 250
			if math.random() > 0.8 then
				self:RotateBrick(t)
				b.mcRot = b.rot * 90
				if math.random() > 0.65 then
					self:RotateBrick(t)
					b.mcRot = b.rot * 90
					if math.random() > 0.4 then
						self:RotateBrick(t)
						b.mcRot = b.rot * 90
					end
				end
			end
			for s = 0, 3 do b.mcs[s].blink = false end
			t = t + 1
		end
	end
end

function G:Loop()
	local st = self.state
	if st == "brandnew" then
		self.state = "LOADINGGAME"
	elseif st == "LOADINGGAME" then
		self:InitGame()
		self.state = "LOADINGLEVEL"
	elseif st == "LOADINGLEVEL" then
		self.state = "READY"
	elseif st == "READY" then
		self.state = "RUNNING"
	elseif st == "RUNNING" then
		self:Draw()
	end
end

function G:Draw()
	if self.state == "RUNNING" then self:UpdateTimeDisp() end
	if self.dragging then
		local b = self.bricks[self.draggedID]
		self.shadowX, self.shadowY = b.x, b.y
	end
	if self.rotating then
		self.rotCount = self.rotCount + 1
		local b = self.bricks[self.selected]
		if b then
			b.mcRot = b.mcRot + 90 / ROT_FRAMES
			b.lineF = math.min(b.rot * 10 + self.rotCount, 41)
		end
		self.shadowRot = self.shadowRot + 90 / ROT_FRAMES
		if self.rotCount > ROT_FRAMES then
			self.rotating = false
			self.rotCount = 1
			if b then self:RotateBrick(self.selected) end
		end
	end
end

function G:UpdateTimeDisp()
	self.playingTime = RealTime() - self.startTime
	local pt = self.playingTime
	local ms = math.floor(pt % 1 * 100)
	local rest = math.floor(pt)
	local seconds = rest % 60
	rest = math.floor((rest - seconds) / 60)
	local minutes = rest % 60
	rest = math.floor((rest - minutes) / 60)
	local hours = rest % 24
	self.txt.mSecTxt = padFix(ms)
	self.txt.secTxt = padFix(seconds)
	self.txt.minTxt = padFix(minutes)
	self.txt.hourTxt = padFix(hours)
end

-- a tile is pressed (klikket) / let go (sluppet)
function G:Klikket(id, mx, my)
	if self.rotating then return end
	local b = self.bricks[id]
	MG.Sound("g21", "lift")
	-- swapDepths(1000): the tile that was on top takes this one's place
	for _, o in pairs(self.bricks) do
		if o ~= b and o.depth == 1000 then o.depth = b.depth end
	end
	b.depth = 1000
	self:RemoveAllConnections(id)
	self.dragging = true
	self.draggedID = id
	self.selected = id
	self.drag = { kind = "brick", id = id, dx = b.x - mx, dy = b.y - my }
	UI.BeginDrag({ release = function() self:Sluppet(id) end })
end

function G:Sluppet(id)
	self.dragging = false
	self.drag = nil
	self.shadowX = -10000
	MG.Sound("g21", "place")
	self:CheckPlacement(id)
end

function G:CheckPlacement(id)
	local bricks = self.bricks
	local off = { [0] = { 0, -BSIZE }, { BSIZE, 0 }, { 0, BSIZE }, { -BSIZE, 0 } }
	local me = bricks[id]
	local pos = {}
	for t = 0, 3 do pos[t] = { off[t][1] + me.x, off[t][2] + me.y } end
	local closestDist, closestID, closestDir = 1000, -99, -99
	local nabo, naboDir = {}, {}
	for t = 0, self.nb - 1 do
		if t ~= id then
			local o = bricks[t]
			local d = math.abs(me.x - o.x) + math.abs(me.y - o.y)
			if d < 2 * (BSIZE + SNAP) then
				for k = 0, 3 do
					d = math.abs(pos[k][1] - o.x) + math.abs(pos[k][2] - o.y)
					if d < SNAP then
						nabo[#nabo + 1] = t
						naboDir[#naboDir + 1] = k
						if d < closestDist then
							closestDist, closestID, closestDir = d, t, k
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if closestID >= 0 then
		me.x = bricks[closestID].x - off[closestDir][1]
		me.y = bricks[closestID].y - off[closestDir][2]
		for i = 1, #nabo do
			local negDir = naboDir[i] + 2
			if negDir > 3 then negDir = negDir - 4 end
			local dragSide = me.sides[naboDir[i]]
			local snapSide = bricks[nabo[i]].sides[negDir]
			local typeMatch = dragSide.type == snapSide.type
			local endMatch = dragSide["end"] ~= snapSide["end"]
			if dragSide.type < 0 or snapSide.type < 0 then typeMatch = false end
			if typeMatch and endMatch then
				self:SetConnection(id, naboDir[i], nabo[i], negDir)
			end
		end
	end
	if self.connections >= self.required then
		self.timeTotal = math.floor(self.playingTime * 1000 + 0.5)
		self.state = "GAMEOVER"
		self.score = self.timeTotal
		self.signF = 2
		MG.Sound("g21", "sign")
	end
end

function G:StartRotatingBrick()
	self.rotating = true
	MG.Sound("g21", "rotate")
	if self.selected and self.bricks[self.selected] then self:RemoveAllConnections(self.selected) end
end

function G:RotateBrick(id)
	local b = self.bricks[id]
	if not b then return end
	b.rot = b.rot + 1
	if b.rot > 3 then b.rot = b.rot - 4 end
	local s = b.sides
	local tmp = { type = s[3].type, e = s[3]["end"], state = s[3].state }
	for t = 2, 0, -1 do
		s[t + 1].type, s[t + 1]["end"], s[t + 1].state = s[t].type, s[t]["end"], s[t].state
	end
	s[0].type, s[0]["end"], s[0].state = tmp.type, tmp.e, tmp.state
	for t = 0, 3 do
		local mcNum = t - b.rot
		if mcNum < 0 then mcNum = mcNum + 4 end
		s[t].mc = mcNum
	end
	if not self.dragging then self:CheckPlacement(id) end
end

function G:SetConnection(id, mySide, naboID, naboSide)
	local b = self.bricks[id]
	local s = b.sides[mySide]
	if s.connected == 1 then self:RemoveConnection(id, mySide) end
	s.connected, s.brickID, s.sideID = 1, naboID, naboSide
	if s.mc then b.mcs[s.mc].blink = true end
	local o = self.bricks[naboID].sides[naboSide]
	o.connected, o.brickID, o.sideID = 1, id, mySide
	if o.mc then self.bricks[naboID].mcs[o.mc].blink = true end
	self.connections = self.connections + 1
end

function G:RemoveConnection(id, sideID)
	local b = self.bricks[id]
	local s = b.sides[sideID]
	s.connected = 0
	if s.mc then b.mcs[s.mc].blink = false end
	local nb = self.bricks[s.brickID]
	if nb then
		local o = nb.sides[s.sideID]
		if o then
			o.connected = 0
			if o.mc then nb.mcs[o.mc].blink = false end
		end
	end
	self.connections = self.connections - 1
end

function G:RemoveAllConnections(id)
	local b = self.bricks[id]
	for t = 0, 3 do
		if b.sides[t].connected == 1 then self:RemoveConnection(id, t) end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- frame loop
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Step()
	if not self.overF then self:Loop() end
	-- the "Godt klaret!" clip; on its frame 51 the root goes to "game over"
	if self.signF and not self.overF then
		self.signF = self.signF + 1
		if self.signF >= 51 then self:GameOverBoard() end
	end
	if self.overF then
		self.overF = self.overF + 1
		if self.overF >= OVER_FRAMES then self:Finish() end
	end
end

function G:GameOverBoard()
	if self.overF then return end
	self.overF = 0
	self.drag = nil
	UI.drag = nil
	AN.Speak("gameover")
end

-- the mouse in the table clip's coordinates
function G:MainMouse()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	return mx - self.mainX, (my - self.mainY) / 1.003
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
	-- startDrag: the dragged tile / table follows the mouse
	if self.drag and MG.k then
		if self.drag.kind == "brick" then
			local b = self.bricks[self.drag.id]
			local mx, my = self:MainMouse()
			b.x, b.y = mx + self.drag.dx, my + self.drag.dy
		else
			local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
			self.mainX, self.mainY = mx + self.drag.dx, my + self.drag.dy
		end
	end
	-- the space bar turns the selected tile (onClipEvent keyDown)
	local down = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE)
	if down and not self.spaceWas and not self.overF and self.state ~= "brandnew" and self.state ~= "LOADINGGAME" then
		self:StartRotatingBrick()
	end
	self.spaceWas = down
end

function G:Press(sx, sy)
	if self.overF or not self.bricks[0] then return end
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local ix, iy = self:MainMouse()
	-- the topmost tile under the mouse
	local order = {}
	for _, b in pairs(self.bricks) do order[#order + 1] = b end
	table.sort(order, function(a, b) return a.depth > b.depth end)
	for _, b in ipairs(order) do
		local a = math.rad(-b.mcRot)
		local dx, dy = ix - b.x, iy - b.y
		local lx, ly = dx * math.cos(a) - dy * math.sin(a), dx * math.sin(a) + dy * math.cos(a)
		if lx >= -HALF and lx <= 39.95 and ly >= -HALF and ly <= 39.95 then
			self:Klikket(b.id, ix, iy)
			return
		end
	end
	-- the table itself
	if ix >= BG_HIT[1] and ix <= BG_HIT[3] and iy >= BG_HIT[2] and iy <= BG_HIT[4] then
		self.drag = { kind = "main", dx = self.mainX - mx, dy = self.mainY - my }
		UI.BeginDrag({ release = function() self.drag = nil end })
	end
end

-- hint (6 seconds): where one tile goes - a box at its place next to the tile that is best joined
-- up so far, an arrow there, and how many times to turn it (space). +5 seconds on the clock.
function G:HintTarget()
	local bricks = self.bricks
	if not bricks[0] then return nil end
	local function conns(b) local n = 0 for k = 0, 3 do if b.sides[k].connected == 1 then n = n + 1 end end return n end
	local anchor
	for t = 0, self.nb - 1 do
		local b = bricks[t]
		if not anchor or conns(b) > conns(anchor) then anchor = b end
	end
	local k = anchor.rot
	local function place(b)
		local dx, dy = b.xID - anchor.xID, b.yID - anchor.yID
		for _ = 1, k do dx, dy = -dy, dx end
		return anchor.x + dx * BSIZE, anchor.y + dy * BSIZE
	end
	local best
	for t = 0, self.nb - 1 do
		local b = bricks[t]
		if b ~= anchor then
			local tx, ty = place(b)
			local done = math.abs(b.x - tx) < 2 and math.abs(b.y - ty) < 2 and b.rot == anchor.rot
			if not done and (not best or conns(b) < conns(best.b)) then best = { b = b, x = tx, y = ty, turns = (anchor.rot - b.rot) % 4 } end
		end
	end
	return best
end
function G:CanHint() return self.state == "RUNNING" and not self.overF and not self.signF and not self.dragging and self:HintTarget() ~= nil end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 6
	self.startTime = self.startTime - cost   -- the clock jumps 5 seconds
	MG.Pop("+" .. cost .. " s", false, 300, 40)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintT or not self.lastMainM then return end
	self.hintT = self.hintT - FrameTime()
	if self.hintT <= 0 or self.state ~= "RUNNING" or self.overF then self.hintT = nil return end
	local h = self:HintTarget()
	if not h then self.hintT = nil return end
	local a = math.min(1, self.hintT * 2)
	local m = self.lastMainM
	local tx, ty = TL.Apply(m, h.x, h.y)
	local bx, by = TL.Apply(m, h.b.x, h.b.y)
	local half = BSIZE / 2 * math.abs(m[1])
	MG.HintBox(tx - half, ty - half, half * 2, half * 2, MG.HINT_GOLD, a, 3)
	local d = math.sqrt((tx - bx) ^ 2 + (ty - by) ^ 2)
	if d > half * 1.2 then
		local ux, uy = (tx - bx) / d, (ty - by) / d
		MG.HintArrow(bx + ux * half * 0.4, by + uy * half * 0.4, tx - ux * half * 0.6, ty - uy * half * 0.6, MG.HINT_GOLD, a, 6)
	end
	if h.turns > 0 then
		MG.HintText(AN.L("g21_hint_turn", h.turns), bx, by - half - 12, MG.HINT_GOLD, 16, a)
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(21, (self.score or 0) / 1000)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:DrawBrick(b, main)
	local m = TL.Mul(main, rotM(b.mcRot, b.x, b.y))
	pic("brick", m)
	TL.CellM(A.line, A.line.all[b.lineF] or 1, TL.Mul(m, { 0.98, 0, 0, 0.98, 0, 0 }))
	for k = 0, 3 do
		local mc = b.mcs[k]
		if mc.label then pic(mc.label .. (mc.blink and "_on" or "_off"), TL.Mul(m, SIDE_M[k])) end
	end
end

function G:DrawMain(m)
	m = { m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5] + self.mainX, m[6] + self.mainY }
	self.lastMainM = m
	for _, t in ipairs(TILES) do
		pic("tile", TL.Mul(m, { t[1], 0, 0, t[2], t[3], t[4] }))
	end
	if not self.bricks[0] then return end
	local order = {}
	for _, b in pairs(self.bricks) do order[#order + 1] = b end
	table.sort(order, function(a, b) return a.depth < b.depth end)
	for _, b in ipairs(order) do
		if b.depth == 1000 and self.shadowX > -900 then
			pic("shadow", TL.Mul(m, TL.Mul({ 1, 0, 0, 1, self.shadowX, self.shadowY }, rotM(self.shadowRot, 3.5, 3.55))))
		end
		self:DrawBrick(b, m)
	end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	local frame = self.overF and 19 or 12
	local scoreStr = scoreToTime(self.score or 0)
	TL.Draw(ROOT, frame, {
		slot = function(name, m)
			if name == "main" then
				self:DrawMain(m)
			elseif name == "endsign" and self.signF and self.signF >= 3 then
				TL.Draw(SIGN, math.min(self.signF, 66), {}, m)
			end
		end,
		value = function(var)
			if var == "scoreString" then return scoreStr end
			return self.txt[var]
		end,
	})

	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()

	if self.overF then
		if self.overF > 20 then
			AN.Text(AN.L("g03_click"), "black", math.floor(MG.S(11)), MG.X(300), MG.Y(330), Color(255, 241, 207, 210), 1)
		end
		UI.Button("g21_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() self:Finish() end, { silent = true })
	else
		UI.Button("g21_table", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), nil,
			{ silent = true, press = function(x, y) self:Press(x, y) end })
	end

	MG.Chrome(21)
end

AN.RegisterGame(21, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g22_gokin:
-- Låge 22: Gok i Nødden
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Andersen sits in the middle; now and then a club comes
-- up on one side of him, and you have to click it before it hits him on the head. The faster you
-- click, the more points (800 minus the frames waited, squared). Every hit makes him 10 years
-- "younger" - he starts at 40, and under 10 the game is over. The game also ends when the time bar
-- is full (50 seconds), which gives up to 1000 points more. The clubs come faster and faster.
-- The game code is the original's, quirks included:
--   * clicking when no club is up is meant to cost 100, 200, 300 ... points, but the sign is wrong,
--     so it ADDS them (the number that pops up still says minus) - and the 7th click in a row
--     knocks Andersen out
--   * the speed meter is placed above the stage, out of sight
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g22_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 15000,     -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_22",
	howKey = "how_22",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 520, 420
local STEP = 1 / 25
local LIB = "g22"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }

-- onClipEvent(load) { _visible = false }: the preloader
FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [108] = true }

local CUR

local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) stop(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,    -- the preloader: everything is loaded
		[12] = function(c)
			stop(c)
			if CUR then
				CUR:MainLoad()      -- the main clip's onClipEvent(load)
				CUR:StartNewGame()
			end
		end,
		[23] = function(c) AN.Speak("GameOver") FL.Play(c) end,
		[100] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 202, {   -- Andersen
		[1] = function(c) FL.GotoAndPlay(c, "idle") end,
		[34] = stop,
		[44] = function(c) FL.Play(c) end,
		[80] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.allowNewHits = true end FL.GotoAndStop(c, "idle") end,
		[126] = function(c) if CUR then CUR.allowNewHits = true end FL.GotoAndStop(c, "idle") end,
		[152] = stop,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 219, {   -- a club
		[1] = stop,
		[2] = function(c) FL.Play(c) end,
		[11] = stop,
		[38] = function()
			MG.Sound("g22", "miss")   -- the club's own sound (a sound stream from here to frame 55)
			if not AN.IsSpeaking() then AN.Speak("Skidt") end
		end,
		[55] = stop,
		[66] = stop,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 106, {   -- a points number
		[25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end,
		[50] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 244, { [1] = function(c) if CUR then c.vars.scoretxt = CUR.score end end })
	for cid, f in pairs({ [15] = 1, [44] = 1, [55] = 1, [60] = 1, [65] = 1, [131] = 1, [191] = 24, [197] = 11, [200] = 24, [201] = 24, [227] = 5 }) do
		FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, { [f] = stop })
	end
end

function G:Main() return FL.Child(self.root, "main") end
function G:Ob(i) return FL.Child(self.root, "ob" .. i) end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g22_status", self.score or 0, self.curAge or 40)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code (the "main" clip)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:MainLoad()
	self.points = {}
	for t = 1, 35 do
		local p = FL.New(LIB, 106)
		p.x, p.y = -300, 0
		self.points[t] = p
	end
	self.nextPoint = 1
	self.objs = {}
	self.numObjs = 2
	self.gameState = "none"
	self.mainCount = 0
	self.score = 0
	self.gameStartTime = self.ms
	self.gameTimeMax = 50000
	self.gameTimeCur = 0
	self.timeToDrop = 0
	self.gtFraction = 0
	self.lastSpawnTime = 0
	self.bonusScore = 0
	self.blindClicks = 0
	self.numActObjs = 0
	self.allowNewHits = true
	self.curAge = 40
	self.vars.ageTxt = AN.L("g22_age", self.curAge)
	if not self.speedArr then
		self.avSpeed = 20
		self.speedArr = { 30, 30, 30, 30, 30 }
	end
	for t = 0, self.numObjs - 1 do
		self.objs[t] = { anim = 0, obType = 0, wasSeen = false, startTime = 0, aCount = 0, waitFrames = 0, mc = self:Ob(t),
			timerActive = false, timerCount = 0 }
	end
end

function G:StartNewGame()
	self.score = 0
	self.bonusScore = 0
	self.hintLeft, self.hintNext = nil, nil
	self.gameState = "game"
	local ch = FL.Child(self.root, "char")
	if ch then FL.GotoAndPlay(ch, 1) end
end

-- the clubs' own timers (their onClipEvent(enterFrame))
function G:StartTimer(o) o.timerActive = true o.timerCount = 0 end
function G:EndTimer(o)
	if not o.timerActive then return end
	o.timerActive = false
	self:AddSpeedVal(o.timerCount)
end
function G:TimerLoop(o)
	if o.timerActive then o.timerCount = o.timerCount + 1 end
end

function G:AddSpeedVal(v)
	if #self.speedArr >= 10 then table.remove(self.speedArr, 1) end
	table.insert(self.speedArr, v)
	local s = 0
	for _, x in ipairs(self.speedArr) do s = s + x end
	self.avSpeed = s / #self.speedArr
end

local function an(o) return o.mc and FL.Child(o.mc, "an") end

function G:EndAllObAnims()
	for t = 0, self.numObjs - 1 do
		local o = self.objs[t]
		if o.anim == 1 then
			o.anim = 0
			local a = an(o)
			if a then FL.GotoAndPlay(a, "exit") end
		end
	end
end

-- hint: a "!" shows where each of the next 3 clubs will come up, just before it does
function G:CanHint() return self.gameState == "game" and self.allowNewHits ~= false end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintLeft = (self.hintLeft or 0) + 3
	self.bonusScore = self.bonusScore - cost
	self:SetScore()
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 260, 80)
end
function G:HintPick()
	if not self.hintLeft or self.hintLeft <= 0 or self.gameState ~= "game" then self.hintNext = nil return end
	local cur = self.hintNext and self.objs[self.hintNext]
	if cur and cur.anim == 0 then return end
	local free = {}
	for t = 0, self.numObjs - 1 do if self.objs[t].anim == 0 then free[#free + 1] = t end end
	self.hintNext = #free > 0 and free[math.random(#free)] or nil
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintNext or self.gameState ~= "game" then return end
	local m = FL.PathClip(self.root, { "ob" .. self.hintNext })
	if not m then return end
	-- (the clubs come in from outside the stage: the mark sits at that edge)
	local x = math.Clamp(m[5], 50, STAGE_W - 50)
	MG.HintRing(x, m[6], 34, MG.HINT_BAD, 1, 5)
	MG.HintText("!", x, m[6], MG.HINT_BAD, 40)
end

function G:ObClicked(id, mx, my)
	local o = self.objs[id]
	self:EndTimer(o)
	local a = an(o)
	if a then FL.GotoAndPlay(a, "vanish") end
	o.anim = 0
	local t = o.timerCount * o.timerCount
	local pts = math.max(0, math.Round(800 - t))
	self:SetPoint(pts, mx, my)
	self.bonusScore = self.bonusScore + pts
	local ch = FL.Child(self.root, "char")
	if ch then FL.GotoAndStop(ch, "idle") end
end

function G:ObFired(id)
	if self.gameState ~= "game" then return end
	local o = self.objs[id]
	o.anim = 0
	local a = an(o)
	if a then FL.GotoAndPlay(a, "shoot") end
	local ch = FL.Child(self.root, "char")
	if ch then FL.GotoAndPlay(ch, "d" .. o.obType .. "_" .. id) end
	o.timerCount = o.timerCount + 10
	self:EndTimer(o)
	self.curAge = self.curAge - 10
	self.vars.ageTxt = AN.L("g22_age", self.curAge)
	if self.curAge < 10 then
		self.gameState = "gameover"
		self.mainCount = 0
		self.allowNewHits = false
		self:EndAllObAnims()
	end
end

function G:RestartOb(id)
	local o = self.objs[id]
	o.waitFrames = math.Round(self.avSpeed + 5 + math.random() * 8)
	o.anim = 1
	o.wasSeen = false
	o.startTime = self.gameTimeCur
	o.obType = 0
	if o.mc then FL.GotoAndStop(o.mc, "club") end
end

function G:GameLoop()
	self.gameTimeCur = self.ms - self.gameStartTime
	self.gtFraction = self.gameTimeCur / self.gameTimeMax
	if self.gtFraction == 0 then self.gtFraction = 0.000001 end
	local bar = FL.Child(self.root, "bar")
	if bar then
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self.root)) do
			if it.nm == "bar" then bar.mat = { self.gtFraction, it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] } end
		end
	end
	self.timeToDrop = (1 / (0.45 + self.gtFraction * 0.7)) * 2250 - 1500
	if self.gameTimeCur >= self.gameTimeMax then
		self.gameState = "gameover"
		self.mainCount = 0
		self.allowNewHits = false
		self:EndAllObAnims()
	end
	local n = 0
	for t = 0, self.numObjs - 1 do
		local o = self.objs[t]
		if o.anim == 0 then
			if self.allowNewHits then
				o.aCount = o.aCount + 1
				if o.aCount > 10 and self.gameTimeCur - self.lastSpawnTime > 300 then
					local extra = (self.gameTimeCur - self.lastSpawnTime) / 500000
					if math.random() > 0.985 - extra then
						-- (hint: the club shown in advance is the one that comes)
						local tt = t
						local hn = self.hintNext and self.objs[self.hintNext]
						if hn and hn.anim == 0 then
							tt = self.hintNext
							self.hintNext = nil
							self.hintLeft = self.hintLeft - 1
						end
						self:RestartOb(tt)
						self.objs[tt].anim = 1
					end
				end
			end
		elseif o.anim == 1 then
			n = n + 1
			local a = an(o)
			if a then FL.GotoAndPlay(a, "enter") end
			o.anim = 2
			o.aCount = 0
			self:StartTimer(o)
			self.lastSpawnTime = self.gameTimeCur
		elseif o.anim == 2 then
			n = n + 1
			o.aCount = o.aCount + 1
			if not o.wasSeen and math.random() > 0.65 then
				o.wasSeen = true
				local ch = FL.Child(self.root, "char")
				if ch then FL.GotoAndStop(ch, "look" .. math.random(1, 2) .. "_" .. t) end
			end
			if self.gameTimeCur - o.startTime > self.timeToDrop then self:ObFired(t) end
		else
			o.aCount = 0
		end
	end
	self.numActObjs = n
end

function G:SetScore()
	self.score = math.max(0, math.Round(self.gtFraction * 1000) + math.Round(self.bonusScore))
	self.vars.scoreTxt = "score: " .. self.score
end

-- onClipEvent(mouseDown) of the main clip
function G:MouseDown(mx, my)
	if self.gameState ~= "game" then return end
	if self.numActObjs == 0 then
		self.blindClicks = self.blindClicks + 1
		local tmp = -100 * self.blindClicks
		self:SetPoint(tmp, mx, my)
		self.bonusScore = self.bonusScore - tmp     -- (minus a minus: the penalty is added)
		if self.blindClicks > 6 then
			local ch = FL.Child(self.root, "char")
			if ch then FL.GotoAndPlay(ch, "blindclickdeath") end
			self.gameState = "gameover"
			self.mainCount = 0
			self:EndAllObAnims()
			self.blindClicks = 0
		end
	else
		self.blindClicks = 0
	end
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	-- (_xmouse / _ymouse of the main clip)
	local mm = FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "main", I) or I
	p.x, p.y = x - mm[5], y - mm[6]
	p.visible = true
	FL.GotoAndPlay(p, val >= 0 and "pos" or "neg")
	local ani = FL.Child(p, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = tostring(val) end
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 35 + 1
end

function G:MainEnterFrame()
	self.mainCount = self.mainCount + 1
	if self.gameState == "game" then
		self:HintPick()
		self:GameLoop()
		self:SetScore()
	elseif self.gameState == "gameover" then
		if self.mainCount > 25 then
			self.mainCount = 0
			self.gameState = "done"
			self.root.vars.score = self.score
			FL.GotoAndStop(self.root, "gameover")
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.ms = 0
	self.vars = {}
	self.points = {}
	self.objs = {}
	self.gameState = nil
	self.score = 0
	self.curAge = 40
	self.speedArr = nil
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	self.root.vars = self.vars
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

function G:Step()
	self.ms = self.ms + 40
	FL.OnSound = function(c, id) MG.Sound("g22", "s" .. id) end
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.visible then FL.Tick(p) end end
	FL.OnSound = nil
	if self:Main() and self.objs[0] then
		for t = 0, self.numObjs - 1 do self:TimerLoop(self.objs[t]) end
		self:MainEnterFrame()
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(22, math.max(0, self.score or 0))
end

-- the club buttons (in "an" of ob0 / ob1) and their stage matrices
function G:ClubButtons()
	local out = {}
	for t = 0, 1 do
		local ob = self:Ob(t)
		local om = ob and FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "ob" .. t, I)
		local a = ob and FL.Child(ob, "an")
		local am = a and FL.ChildMatrix(ob, "an", om)
		if a and am then
			local k, m = FL.CharItem(a, am, { [211] = true })
			if k then out[#out + 1] = { id = t, k = k, m = m } end
		end
	end
	return out
end

function G:Press()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	-- onClipEvent(mouseDown) first, then the button under the mouse
	self:MouseDown(mx, my)
	if self.gameState ~= "game" then return end
	for _, b in ipairs(self:ClubButtons()) do
		if FL.HitPoint(b.k, b.m, mx, my) then
			self:ObClicked(b.id, mx, my)
			if not AN.IsSpeaking() and math.random() < 0.3 then AN.Speak("Godt") end
			return
		end
	end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(22) return end
	local main = self:Main()
	if main then
		local ex = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do
			if p.visible and p.x > -200 then ex[#ex + 1] = { c = p, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, p.x, p.y } } end
		end
		main.extra = ex
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, I)
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local f = self.root.frame
	if main and self.gameState == "game" then
		UI.Button("g22_stage", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), nil, { silent = true, press = function() self:Press() end })
	end
	if f >= 23 and f < 100 then
		-- "Videre" on the game over sign
		local k, m = FL.CharItem(self.root, I, { [242] = true })
		if not k then
			for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self.root)) do
				local kid = self.root.kids[it[3]]
				if kid and kid.kind == "spr" then
					k, m = FL.CharItem(kid, TL.Mul(I, kid.mat or { it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] }), { [242] = true })
					if k then break end
				end
			end
		end
		if k then
			local x0, y0, x1, y1 = FL.Bounds(k, m, true)
			if x0 then
				UI.Button("g22_next", MG.X(x0), MG.Y(y0), MG.S(x1 - x0), MG.S(y1 - y0), function() self:Finish() end, { hit = FL.HitFn(k, m) })
			end
		end
	end
	MG.Chrome(22)
end

AN.RegisterGame(22, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g23_flytt:
-- Låge 23: Flyttefis
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf. Things come down the conveyor belt in the middle - books,
-- lamps, papyrus rolls and pens - and you drag each one over to its box (Bøger, Lamper, Papyrus,
-- Pen). The right box gives points (30-80); the wrong box, missing a box, or letting the thing
-- fall off the belt breaks one of the four little boxes in the corner. When all four are gone, the
-- game is over. The belt runs faster every 10 seconds.
-- The game code is the original's (a Halloween game with bats, pumpkins, snakes and spiders,
-- redrawn), quirks included:
--   * you can only hold a thing for 1.5 seconds - then it is dropped where the mouse is
--   * a thing held still stays put; letting go anywhere outside a box costs a box
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g23_fl.lua")

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 4000,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_23",
	howKey = "how_23",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 480, 290
local STEP = 1 / 25
local LIB = "g23"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }

-- onClipEvent(load) { _visible = false }: the preloader
FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [128] = true }

local CUR

local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[2] = function(c) stop(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "gameon") end,   -- the preloader: everything is loaded
		[20] = function(c) AN.Speak("GameOverIngenLiv") FL.Play(c) end,
		[98] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 160, { [2] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Init() end end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 10, { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 153, { [6] = stop, [21] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 159, { [23] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 162, { [6] = stop })
	for _, cid in ipairs({ 9, 15, 44, 55, 60, 65 }) do FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, { [1] = stop }) end
end

function G:Game() return FL.Child(self.root, "game") end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g23_status", self.score or 0, 4 - (self.nextMinipot or 0))
end

-- the game clip's matrix, and the mouse in its coordinates (_xmouse / _ymouse)
function G:GameM() return FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I) or I end
function G:GameMouse()
	local mx, my = MG.Mouse()
	local m = self:GameM()
	return mx - m[5], my - m[6]
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- sounds: the game's sound module ("background" sounds loop until stopped)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:PlayAmbient()
	if self.ambient then return end
	self.ambient = "loading"
	if AN.SoundMode() == 2 then return end
	local v = (AN.Save.Get("vol_fx") or 85) / 100
	if v <= 0 then return end
	local me = self
	sound.PlayFile("sound/alletidersnisse/g23/ambient_sound.mp3", "noplay noblock", function(ch)
		if not IsValid(ch) then return end
		if CUR ~= me or me.ambient ~= "loading" then ch:Stop() return end
		ch:EnableLooping(true)
		ch:SetVolume(v)
		ch:Play()
		me.ambient = ch
	end)
end
function G:StopAmbient()
	local ch = self.ambient
	if ch and ch ~= "loading" and IsValid(ch) then ch:Stop() end
	self.ambient = nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code (the "game" clip)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local POTS = {
	[0] = { kind = "snake", x = 88, y = 43, radius = 70 },
	{ kind = "spider", x = 61, y = 167, radius = 70 },
	{ kind = "pumpkin", x = 385, y = 42, radius = 70 },
	{ kind = "bat", x = 428, y = 153, radius = 70 },
}
local ENEMIES = {
	[0] = { kind = "bat", points = 30, cid = 117 },
	{ kind = "pumpkin", points = 80, cid = 123 },
	{ kind = "snake", points = 40, cid = 126 },
	{ kind = "spider", points = 50, cid = 120 },
}

local function dist(x1, y1, x2, y2) return math.sqrt((x1 - x2) ^ 2 + (y1 - y2) ^ 2) end

function G:Init()
	self:PlayAmbient()
	self.score = 0
	self.root.vars.score = 0
	self:SetScoreTxt()
	self.points = {}
	for t = 1, 35 do
		local p = FL.New(LIB, 10)
		p.x, p.y, p.s = -200, -200, 1
		self.points[t] = p
	end
	self.nextPoint = 1
	self.enemies = {}
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local E = ENEMIES[i]
		self.enemies[i] = { kind = E.kind, points = E.points, radius = 30, x = 1000, y = 1000, mc = FL.New(LIB, E.cid), mx = 0, my = 0, depth = 4000 + i }
	end
	self.state = "gameon"
	self.enemyInPlay = false
	self.currentEnemy = nil
	self.mouseIsDown = false
	self.startTime = self.ms
	self.totalTime = 1500
	self.velocity = 1
	self.velocityIncTime = self.ms
	self.velocityIncTimeout = 10000
	self.nextMinipot = 0
end

function G:SetScoreTxt()
	-- _level0.txt_statusbarScore is never loaded: undefined + score is just the score
	local g = self:Game()
	if g then g.vars.scoreTxt = tostring(self.score) end
end

function G:PointWithinPot(i, x, y)
	local p = POTS[i]
	return dist(p.x, p.y, x, y) < p.radius
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y, hilite)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	p.x, p.y = x, y
	local h = FL.Child(p, "hilite")
	if h then FL.GotoAndStop(h, hilite and "on" or "off") end
	p.visible = true
	local ani = FL.Child(p, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
	FL.Play(p)
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 35 + 1
	if not AN.IsSpeaking() then AN.Speak("Godt") end
end

function G:LoseBox()
	self.nextMinipot = self.nextMinipot + 1
	MG.Sound("g23", "Xylophone")
	local mp = FL.Child(self.root, "minipot_" .. self.nextMinipot)
	if mp then FL.GotoAndPlay(mp, "killed") end
	if self.nextMinipot == 4 then
		self.state = "no_more_pots"
	else
		AN.Speak("Skidt")
	end
end

function G:SetEnemyPos(e, x, y)
	e.x, e.y = x, y
	e.mx, e.my = x, y
end

function G:MainLoop()
	local st = self.state
	if st == "gameon" then
		if self.ms - self.velocityIncTime > self.velocityIncTimeout then
			self.velocityIncTime = self.ms
			self.velocity = math.min(10, self.velocity + 1)
		end
		local e = self.currentEnemy
		if self.enemyInPlay then
			if not self.mouseIsDown then
				e.y = e.y + self.velocity
				e.my = e.y
				if e.y > 300 then
					self.enemyInPlay = false
					e.y, e.my = 1000, 1000
					self:LoseBox()
				end
			end
		else
			e = self.enemies[math.Round(math.random() * 3)]
			self.currentEnemy = e
			self:SetEnemyPos(e, 240, 0)
			self.enemyInPlay = true
		end
		if self.mouseIsDown and self.ms - self.startTime > self.totalTime then self:DropItem() end
	elseif st == "no_more_pots" then
		self:StopAmbient()
		self.state = "game over"
		FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "gameover")
	end
end

function G:DropItem()
	if not self.mouseIsDown then return end
	self.mouseIsDown = false
	local e = self.currentEnemy
	self:SetEnemyPos(e, 1000, 1000)
	local mx, my = self:GameMouse()
	local target = -1
	for i = 0, 3 do if self:PointWithinPot(i, mx, my) then target = i end end
	if target > -1 and e.kind == POTS[target].kind then
		self.score = self.score + e.points
		self.root.vars.score = self.score
		MG.Sound("g23", "splash")
		self:SetPoint(e.points, mx, my, true)
	else
		self:LoseBox()
	end
	self:SetScoreTxt()
	self.enemyInPlay = false
end

-- hint (10 seconds): the right box for the thing on the belt (or in your hand) lights up, with an
-- arrow from the thing to it
function G:CanHint() return self.state == "gameon" end
function G:Hint(cost)
	self.hintT = 10
	self.score = math.max(0, self.score - cost)
	self.root.vars.score = self.score
	self:SetScoreTxt()
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 240, 60)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	if not self.hintT then return end
	self.hintT = self.hintT - FrameTime()
	if self.hintT <= 0 or self.state ~= "gameon" then self.hintT = nil return end
	local e = self.currentEnemy
	if not e or not self.enemyInPlay then return end
	local gm = self:GameM()
	local a = math.min(1, self.hintT * 2)
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local p = POTS[i]
		if p.kind == e.kind then
			local px, py = TL.Apply(gm, p.x, p.y)
			MG.HintRing(px, py, 52, MG.HINT_GOOD, a, 5)
			local ex, ey = TL.Apply(gm, e.mx, e.my)
			local d = math.sqrt((px - ex) ^ 2 + (py - ey) ^ 2)
			if d > 90 then
				local ux, uy = (px - ex) / d, (py - ey) / d
				MG.HintArrow(ex + ux * 34, ey + uy * 34, px - ux * 58, py - uy * 58, MG.HINT_GOOD, a * 0.85, 6)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- onClipEvent(mouseDown) / (mouseMove) / (mouseUp)
function G:MouseDown()
	local e = self.currentEnemy
	if not e then return end
	local mx, my = self:GameMouse()
	if dist(e.x, e.y, mx, my) < e.radius then
		self.mouseIsDown = true
		self.startTime = self.ms
	end
end
function G:MouseMove()
	if not self.mouseIsDown then return end
	local mx, my = self:GameMouse()
	self:SetEnemyPos(self.currentEnemy, mx, my)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the screen
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.ms = 0
	self.points = {}
	self.enemies = {}
	self.state = nil
	self.score = 0
	self.nextMinipot = 0
	self.ambient = nil
	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
end

function G:Close()
	self:StopAmbient()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

function G:Step()
	self.ms = self.ms + 40
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.visible then FL.Tick(p) end end
	for _, e in pairs(self.enemies) do FL.Tick(e.mc) end
	if self.mouseIsDown then self:MouseMove() end
	if self:Game() and self.state then self:MainLoop() end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	self:StopAmbient()
	AN.FinishGame(23, self.score or 0)
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(23) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	if game then
		local ex = {}
		for i = 0, 3 do
			local e = self.enemies[i]
			if e then ex[#ex + 1] = { c = e.mc, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, e.mx, e.my }, d = e.depth } end
		end
		for i, p in ipairs(self.points) do
			if p.visible and p.x > -150 then ex[#ex + 1] = { c = p, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, p.x, p.y }, d = 10000 + i } end
		end
		table.sort(ex, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
		game.extra = ex
		if self.state == "gameon" then
			UI.Button("g23_stage", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), nil, { silent = true, press = function()
				self:MouseDown()
				UI.drag = { release = function() self:DropItem() end }
			end })
		end
	end
	FL.Draw(self.root, I)
	self:HintDraw()
	MG.DrawPops()
	local f = self.root.frame
	if f >= 20 and f < 97 then
		UI.Button("g23_skip", MG.X(0), MG.Y(0), MG.S(STAGE_W), MG.S(STAGE_H), function() FL.GotoAndPlay(self.root, "skip") end, { silent = true })
	end
	MG.Chrome(23)
end

AN.RegisterGame(23, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/g24_pynte:
-- Låge 24: Pyntekassen
-- Rebuilt from the original loader.swf (in the CD's "spil 01" folder - the calendar's list has the
-- folders of door 1 and door 24 swapped). A match-3 game: click two neighbouring Christmas
-- ornaments to swap them; three or more of a kind in a row disappear and new ones fall in. A swap
-- that makes no row is swapped back. Each level needs a number of good moves (20 + 2 per level);
-- the bar at the bottom is the time you have for your next good move - if it runs out, the game
-- is over. Longer rows, several rows at once and chain reactions give bonus points, and from level
-- 2 and 5 there are more kinds of ornament.
-- The game code is the original's ("SugarRush"), quirks included:
--   * the time bar only resets on a good move, so bad swaps eat your time
--   * the score counts up 6 points a frame towards the real score
--   * the swap sound is played on "_level.efx", which doesn't exist, so it is never heard
--   * the 35 point numbers flash "000" in the top left corner when a level starts
local UI, MG, TL, FL = AN.UI, AN.MG, AN.TL, AN.FL
local DIR = (GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/"
include(DIR .. "g24_fl.lua")
FL.ImgSwap["g24/fl/s297.png"] = { en = "g24/fl/s297_en.png" }   -- "Næste Level ...fortsæt" is part of the picture
-- the bonus banners' words are pictures too: "På en række" (a black outline and a picture per
-- letter: in English the whole "In a row" is in the outline's picture) and "Række" in "MULTI Række"
FL.ImgSwap["g24/fl/s357.png"] = { en = "g24/fl/s357_en.png" }
for i = 358, 365 do FL.ImgSwap["g24/fl/t" .. i .. ".png"] = { en = "g24/fl/blank_en.png" } end
FL.ImgSwap["g24/fl/s378.png"] = { en = "g24/fl/s378_en.png" }
FL.ImgSwap["g24/fl/t379.png"] = { en = "g24/fl/t379_en.png" }

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 9000,      -- the original coolScore
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "desc_24",
	howKey = "how_24",
}

local STAGE_W, STAGE_H = 495, 398
local STEP = 1 / 25
local LIB = "g24"
local I = { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 }
local TILE_CID = { [0] = 215, 212, 209, 206, 203, 200, 197 }

-- onClipEvent(load) { _visible = false }: the preloader
FL.LoadHidden[LIB] = { [256] = true }

local CUR

local function stop(c) FL.Stop(c) end

local function setupActions()
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 0, {
		[4] = function(c) FL.GotoAndStop(c, "initgame") end,    -- the preloader: everything is loaded
		[10] = stop,
		[20] = function(c) if CUR then CUR:InitGame() end FL.Play(c) end,
		[21] = function() local ld = CUR and CUR:Clip("leveldone") if ld and ld.vars.ison then FL.GotoAndPlay(ld, "animoff") end end,
		[28] = function(c)
			stop(c)
			local g = CUR and CUR:Game()
			if g then g.visible = true end
			c.vars.scoreTxt = "0"
		end,
		[36] = function() AN.Speak("gameovertidenloebud") end,
		[110] = function(c) stop(c) if CUR then CUR:Finish() end end,
	})
	-- the quality window: its button is hidden (showButton = false); the plank at the bottom opens it
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 251, {
		[1] = function(c)
			stop(c)
			for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
				if it[2] == 233 and c.kids[it[3]] then c.kids[it[3]].visible = false end
			end
		end,
		[2] = function(c)
			stop(c)
			-- the radio buttons: r1 = LOW, r2 = MEDIUM, r3 = HIGH; their dots start hidden, and the
			-- current quality's one is only marked active (so its dot never shows)
			local names = { [9] = "LOW", [14] = "MEDIUM", [19] = "HIGH" }
			for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
				local k = c.kids[it[3]]
				if k and names[it[1]] then
					k.quality = names[it[1]]
					k.vars.isActive = CUR and CUR.quality == k.quality or false
					local dot = FL.Child(k, "dot")
					if dot then dot.visible = false end
				end
			end
		end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 246, { [1] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 294, { [1] = function(c) stop(c) c.visible = false end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 303, {   -- "Level slut!"
		[1] = function(c) c.vars.ison = false stop(c) end,
		[2] = function(c) c.vars.ison = true end,
		[9] = function(c) stop(c) AN.Speak("HuskeSpillet_LevelSlut") end,
		[10] = function(c) c.vars.ison = false end,
		[17] = function() if CUR then FL.GotoAndStop(CUR.root, "initgame") end end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 309, {   -- out of time
		[1] = stop,
		[30] = function() if CUR then FL.GotoAndPlay(CUR.root, "gameover") end end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 315, {   -- pause
		[1] = function(c) stop(c) c.vars.ison = false end,
		[2] = function(c)
			c.vars.saveState = CUR and CUR.gameState
			if CUR then CUR.gameState = "paused" end
			c.vars.ison = true
		end,
		[9] = function(c) c.vars.isOnAndDone = true stop(c) end,
		[10] = function(c) c.vars.isPlaying = true c.vars.ison = false end,
		[17] = function(c)
			c.vars.isPlaying = false
			if CUR and c.vars.saveState and c.vars.saveState ~= "" then CUR.gameState = c.vars.saveState end
		end,
	})
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 372, { [1] = stop, [21] = function(c) c.vars.current = 0 end })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 153, { [25] = function(c) c.visible = false FL.GotoAndStop(c, 1) end })
	for _, cid in ipairs({ 123, 261, 340, 355, 381 }) do FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, { [1] = stop }) end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 321, { [1] = stop, [2] = stop })
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 282, { [2] = stop })
	local efx = {}
	for _, f in ipairs({ 1, 8, 15, 24, 37, 51, 64, 77, 91, 104, 117, 133 }) do efx[f] = stop end
	FL.SetActions(LIB, 273, efx)
	-- the ornaments: def / glow / selected / active (it grows a little) / animoff
	for _, cid in pairs(TILE_CID) do
		FL.SetActions(LIB, cid, {
			[1] = function(c) stop(c) c.gfxMode = "back" end,
			[10] = function(c) c.gfxMode = "grow" c.gfxCount = 0 end,
			[25] = function(c) c.visible = false stop(c) end,
			[27] = stop,
		})
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- hint: two ornaments that make a row when swapped wiggle (ringed, with arrows) until you move
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:FindMove()
	local F = self.field
	if not F then return nil end
	local function t(x, y) return F[x] and F[x][y] and F[x][y].typ end
	local function run(x, y, a, b)
		local c = t(x, y)
		local n, i = 1, 1
		while t(x + a * i, y + b * i) == c do n, i = n + 1, i + 1 end
		i = 1
		while t(x - a * i, y - b * i) == c do n, i = n + 1, i + 1 end
		return n
	end
	local found = {}
	for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
		for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
			for _, d in ipairs({ { 1, 0 }, { 0, 1 } }) do
				local x2, y2 = x + d[1], y + d[2]
				if F[x2] and F[x2][y2] and F[x][y] then
					F[x][y].typ, F[x2][y2].typ = F[x2][y2].typ, F[x][y].typ
					local ok = run(x, y, 1, 0) >= 3 or run(x, y, 0, 1) >= 3 or run(x2, y2, 1, 0) >= 3 or run(x2, y2, 0, 1) >= 3
					F[x][y].typ, F[x2][y2].typ = F[x2][y2].typ, F[x][y].typ
					if ok then found[#found + 1] = { x, y, x2, y2 } end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return #found > 0 and found[math.random(#found)] or nil
end
function G:CanHint() return self.gameState == "waitInput" and not self.hintMove and self:FindMove() ~= nil end
function G:Hint(cost)
	local mv = self:FindMove()
	if not mv then return false end
	self.hintMove = mv
	local v = self.vars
	v.targetScore = math.max(0, v.targetScore - cost)
	v.score = math.min(v.score, v.targetScore)
	v.scoreTxt = v.score
	MG.Pop("-" .. cost, false, 120, 40)
end
function G:HintDraw()
	local mv = self.hintMove
	if not mv then return end
	if self.gameState ~= "waitInput" then self.hintMove = nil return end
	local gm = FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", { 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0 })
	if not gm then return end
	local sx, sy = self:StartRef()
	local ts = self.tileSize
	local wig = math.sin(RealTime() * 18) * 2.5
	local ax, ay = TL.Apply(gm, sx + mv[1] * ts, sy + mv[2] * ts)
	local bx, by = TL.Apply(gm, sx + mv[3] * ts, sy + mv[4] * ts)
	local dx, dy = (bx - ax) / ts, (by - ay) / ts
	MG.HintRing(ax + dy * wig, ay + dx * wig, ts * 0.55, MG.HINT_GOLD, 1, 3)
	MG.HintRing(bx - dy * wig, by - dx * wig, ts * 0.55, MG.HINT_GOLD, 1, 3)
	local mx, my = (ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2
	MG.HintArrow(mx - dx * 4, my - dy * 4, mx + dx * 12, my + dy * 12, MG.HINT_GOLD, 1, 4)
	MG.HintArrow(mx + dx * 4, my + dy * 4, mx - dx * 12, my - dy * 12, MG.HINT_GOLD, 1, 4)
end

function G:Clip(name) return FL.Child(self.root, name) end
function G:Game() return self:Clip("game") end

function G:PlayEfx(lbl)
	local e = self:Clip("efx")
	if not e then return end
	FL.GotoAndPlay(e, lbl)
	local fx = FL.Child(e, "fxmc")
	if fx then FL.GotoAndPlay(fx, 2) end
end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("g24_status", self.vars.targetScore or 0, self.vars.level or 1)
end

local function rnd(n) return math.floor(math.random() * n) end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the original game code (the "game" clip)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:InitGame()
	local v = self.vars
	self.mainState = "rungame"
	self:InitPoints()
	self.xSize, self.ySize, self.tileSize = 8, 8, 34
	self.hiliteDelay = 10
	self.moveCount = 0
	self.moveFramCount = 0
	self.fallGeneration = 0
	local lev1 = math.min(8, v.level / 2)
	local lev2 = math.max(0, v.level / 2 - 8)
	self.numFramesPrMove = math.max(50, 500 - lev1 * 50 - lev2 / 3 * 10)
	if v.level < 2 then self.nbTypes = 5 elseif v.level < 5 then self.nbTypes = 6 else self.nbTypes = 7 end
	self.numMovesPrLevel = math.Round(20 + v.level * 2)
	self.gameState = "makeLevel"
	self.selected = {}
	local g = self:Game()
	if g then FL.GotoAndStop(g, "on") end
	self.endIt = false
	self.field = {}
	self.tiles = {}
	self.nTiles = 0
end

function G:StartRef()
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self:Game())) do
		if it.nm == "startRef" then return it[8], it[9] end
	end
	return 36.2, 119.8
end

function G:InitPoints()
	self.points = {}
	for t = 1, 35 do
		local p = FL.New(LIB, 153)
		p.x, p.y = 0, 0
		self.points[t] = p
	end
	self.nextPoint = 1
end

function G:SetPoint(val, x, y)
	local p = self.points[self.nextPoint]
	p.x, p.y = x, y
	p.visible = true
	local ani = FL.Child(p, "ani")
	if ani then ani.vars.txt = val end
	FL.Play(p)
	self.nextPoint = self.nextPoint % 35 + 1
end

function G:UpdateGui()
	local v = self.vars
	v.levelTxt = v.level
	v.movesTxt = math.max(0, self.numMovesPrLevel - self.moveCount)
	if v.score < v.targetScore then
		v.score = v.score + 6
		self:PlayEfx("scorecount")
		if v.score > v.targetScore then v.score = v.targetScore end
	end
	v.scoreTxt = v.score
	local g = self:Game()
	local bar = g and FL.Child(g, "bar")
	if bar then
		for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(g)) do
			if it.nm == "bar" then bar.mat = { self.moveFramCount / self.numFramesPrMove * it[4], it[5], it[6], it[7], it[8], it[9] } end
		end
	end
end

function G:Cell(x, y) return self.field[x] and self.field[x][y] end

function G:AttachTypeMC(tile, id, pos)
	local old = tile.mc
	local c = FL.New(LIB, TILE_CID[tile.typ])
	c.x, c.y = old and old.x or nil, old and old.y or nil
	c.velY = 0
	c.pos = { x = pos.x, y = pos.y }
	c.id = id
	c.gfxScale = 100
	tile.mc = c
end

function G:BuildNewLevel()
	local sx, sy = self:StartRef()
	self.field = {}
	self.tiles = {}
	self.buttons = {}
	local n = 0
	for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
		self.field[x] = {}
		for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
			n = n + 1
			local t = rnd(self.nbTypes)
			-- (the cell's button: its own id tracks which ornament is in the cell)
			local b = { id = n, pos = { x = x, y = y }, x = sx + x * self.tileSize, y = sy + y * self.tileSize }
			self.buttons[n] = b
			self.field[x][y] = { typ = t, newTyp = t, xFlag = false, yFlag = false, mc = b }
		end
	end
	for t = 1, 25 do
		if self:CheckForMatch(0) then
			for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
				for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
					local f = self.field[x][y]
					if f.xFlag or f.yFlag then
						local tp = rnd(self.nbTypes)
						f.typ, f.newTyp = tp, tp
					end
				end
			end
		else
			break
		end
	end
	n = 0
	for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
		for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
			n = n + 1
			local tile = { targPos = { x = x, y = y }, typ = self.field[x][y].typ, moveState = 0 }
			self.tiles[n] = tile
			self:AttachTypeMC(tile, n, { x = x, y = y })
			tile.targetX = sx + x * self.tileSize
			tile.targetY = sy + y * self.tileSize
			tile.mc.x = tile.targetX
			tile.mc.y = 450
		end
	end
	self.nTiles = n
end

function G:ResetFlags()
	for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
		for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
			local f = self.field[x] and self.field[x][y]
			if f then f.xFlag, f.yFlag = false, false end
		end
	end
end

function G:AddMove()
	if self.gameState == "makeLevel" or self.fallGeneration > 1 then return end
	if not self.moveCountLocked then
		self.moveCount = self.moveCount + 1
		self.moveCountLocked = true
	end
	if self.moveCount >= self.numMovesPrLevel then self.endIt = true end
end

function G:CheckInARowBonus(val)
	if val <= 3 then return end
	local b = self:Clip("inarowBonus")
	if not b then return end
	if (b.vars.current or 0) < val then
		b.vars.current = val
		FL.GotoAndPlay(b, "on")
		b.vars.txt = val
	end
end

function G:CheckForMatch(pointVal)
	local found = false
	local rows = 0
	self:ResetFlags()
	self.matches = {}
	self.moveCountLocked = false
	local F = self.field
	for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
		for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
			local org = F[x][y].newTyp
			if x < self.xSize - 2 and not F[x][y].xFlag then
				local same = 1
				for k = x + 1, self.xSize - 1 do
					if F[k][y].newTyp == org then same = same + 1 else break end
				end
				if same > 2 then
					found = true
					rows = rows + 1
					self:AddMove()
					self:CheckInARowBonus(same)
					pointVal = 10 * self.fallGeneration * (same - 2) * rows
					for k = x, x + same - 1 do
						F[k][y].xFlag = true
						table.insert(self.matches, { x = k, y = y, points = pointVal, id = F[k][y].mc.id })
					end
				end
			end
			if y < self.ySize - 2 and not F[x][y].yFlag then
				local same = 1
				for k = y + 1, self.ySize - 1 do
					if F[x][k].newTyp == org then same = same + 1 else break end
				end
				if same > 2 then
					found = true
					rows = rows + 1
					self:AddMove()
					self:CheckInARowBonus(same)
					pointVal = 10 * self.fallGeneration * (same - 2) * rows
					for k = y, y + same - 1 do
						F[x][k].yFlag = true
						table.insert(self.matches, { x = x, y = k, points = pointVal, id = F[x][k].mc.id })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if rows > 1 then
		local b = self:Clip("multiRowBonus")
		if b then FL.GotoAndPlay(b, "on") b.vars.txt = "MULTI" end
	end
	return found
end

function G:GiveMatchPoints()
	local sx, sy = self:StartRef()
	for _, m in ipairs(self.matches) do
		self:SetPoint(m.points, sx + m.x * self.tileSize, sy + m.y * self.tileSize)
		local t = self.tiles[m.id]
		if t then FL.GotoAndStop(t.mc, "glow") end
		self.moveAccumPoints = self.moveAccumPoints + m.points
	end
end

function G:AnimTiles(kind)
	local sx, sy = self:StartRef()
	local any = false
	for i = 1, self.nTiles do
		local t = self.tiles[i]
		if t.moveState == 1 then
			any = true
			local c = t.mc
			local tx, ty = sx + c.pos.x * self.tileSize, sy + c.pos.y * self.tileSize
			if kind == "gravity" then
				c.velY = (c.velY or 0) + 2.7 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4
				c.y = c.y + c.velY
				if c.y > ty then
					if self.playLand then
						self.playLand = false
						self:PlayEfx("land")
					end
					c.y = ty
					c.velY = c.velY * -0.5
				end
				local d = math.abs(c.x - tx) + math.abs(c.y - ty)
				if d < 2 and math.abs(c.velY) < 4.5 then
					c.x, c.y = tx, ty
					t.moveState = 0
					c.velY = 0
				end
			else
				c.x = c.x + (tx - c.x) / 3
				c.y = c.y + (ty - c.y) / 3
				if math.abs(c.x - tx) + math.abs(c.y - ty) < 2 then
					c.x, c.y = tx, ty
					t.moveState = 0
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return any
end

function G:LevelAnimTiles()
	self:PlayEfx("swoosh")
	local moving = 0
	local busy = false
	for i = 1, self.nTiles do
		local t = self.tiles[i]
		if t.moveState == 10 then
			moving = moving + 1
			busy = true
			local c = t.mc
			c.x = c.x + (t.targetX - c.x) / 2
			c.y = c.y + (t.targetY - c.y) / 2
			if math.abs(c.x - t.targetX) + math.abs(c.y - t.targetY) < 5 then
				c.x, c.y = t.targetX, t.targetY
				t.moveState = 0
			end
		end
	end
	-- (tiles.length is 65: index 0 is empty)
	local len = self.nTiles + 1
	if moving == 0 then
		if self.nextTile <= len then
			busy = true
			if self.tiles[self.nextTile] then self.tiles[self.nextTile].moveState = 10 end
			self.nextTile = self.nextTile + 1
		end
	elseif moving < 10 then
		busy = true
		if self.nextTile <= len then
			if self.tiles[self.nextTile] then self.tiles[self.nextTile].moveState = 10 end
			self.nextTile = self.nextTile + 1
		end
	else
		busy = true
	end
	return busy
end

function G:Loop()
	self:UpdateGui()
	local st = self.gameState
	local F = self.field
	if st == "makeLevel" then
		self:BuildNewLevel()
		self.gameState = "makeLevelAnim"
		self.nextTile = 0
	elseif st == "makeLevelAnim" then
		if not self:LevelAnimTiles() then
			self.gameState = "resetInput"
			self.vars.scoreTxt = "0"
		end
	elseif st == "clearLevel" then
		self.counter = self.counter + 1
		local c = self.counter
		if self.tiles[c] then FL.GotoAndPlay(self.tiles[c].mc, "animOff") end
		self:PlayEfx("click2")
		if self.tiles[c + 8] then FL.GotoAndStop(self.tiles[c + 8].mc, "def") end
		if self.tiles[c + 12] then FL.GotoAndStop(self.tiles[c + 12].mc, "glow") end
		if c > self.nTiles + 1 then self.gameState = "changeLevelInit" end
	elseif st == "changeLevelInit" then
		-- the level is done: into its own highscore list, and the run's score so far is saved
		local total = self.vars.targetScore or 0
		AN.LevelScore(24, self.vars.level, total - (self.levelStartScore or 0), { total = total })
		self.levelStartScore = total
		self.vars.level = self.vars.level + 1
		local ld = self:Clip("leveldone")
		if ld then FL.GotoAndPlay(ld, "animon") end
		local g = self:Game()
		if g then g.visible = false end
		self.gameState = "wait"
	elseif st == "resetInput" then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local s = self.selected[i]
			if s and self.tiles[s.id] then FL.GotoAndStop(self.tiles[s.id].mc, "def") end
		end
		self.selected = {}
		self:ResetFlags()
		self.gameState = "waitInput"
		self.counter = 0
		if self.endIt then self.gameState = "clearLevel" end
	elseif st == "waitInput" then
		self.moveFramCount = self.moveFramCount + 1
		if self.moveFramCount > self.numFramesPrMove then
			self.gameState = "timeRanOut"
			self.counter = 0
		end
	elseif st == "checkMove" then
		local a, b = self.selected[1].pos, self.selected[2].pos
		local f1, f2 = F[a.x][a.y], F[b.x][b.y]
		f1.newTyp = f2.typ
		f2.newTyp = f1.typ
		f1.mc.id, f2.mc.id = f2.mc.id, f1.mc.id
		self.fallGeneration = 1
		self.moveAccumPoints = 0
		if self:CheckForMatch(50) then
			self.fallGeneration = self.fallGeneration + 1
			f1.typ, f2.typ = f1.newTyp, f2.newTyp
			for _, p in ipairs({ { f1, a }, { f2, b } }) do
				local t = self.tiles[p[1].mc.id]
				t.moveState = 1
				t.mc.pos.x, t.mc.pos.y = p[2].x, p[2].y
			end
			self.moveFramCount = 0
			self.gameState = "moveAnim"
			self:PlayEfx("goodmove")
		else
			self.gameState = "resetInput"
			f1.newTyp, f2.newTyp = f1.typ, f2.typ
			f1.mc.id, f2.mc.id = f2.mc.id, f1.mc.id
			self:PlayEfx("badmove")
		end
	elseif st == "moveAnim" then
		self.counter = self.counter + 1
		-- (counter 1: _level.efx.playEfx("swap") - no such clip)
		if not self:AnimTiles() then
			local s = self.selected[1]
			if s and self.tiles[s.id] then FL.GotoAndStop(self.tiles[s.id].mc, "def") end
			self.gameState = "fillHilite"
			self.counter = 0
		end
	elseif st == "removeMatches" then
		self.counter = self.counter + 1
		for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
			for y = 0, self.ySize - 1 do
				local f = F[x][y]
				local id = f.mc.id
				if f.xFlag or f.yFlag then
					if self.counter == 1 then
						FL.GotoAndPlay(self.tiles[id].mc, "animoff")
					elseif self.counter == 10 then
						f.xFlag, f.yFlag = true, false
						local t = self.tiles[id]
						t.typ = rnd(self.nbTypes)
						self:AttachTypeMC(t, id, { x = x, y = y })
						t.mc.visible = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if self.counter == 10 then
			self.counter = 0
			self.gameState = "fillIn"
		end
	elseif st == "fillIn" then
		self:PlayEfx("fill")
		local sx, sy = self:StartRef()
		for x = 0, self.xSize - 1 do
			local removed, drop = {}, {}
			local lowest = -1
			for y = self.ySize - 1, 0, -1 do
				if F[x][y].xFlag and lowest == -1 then lowest = y end
				if lowest >= 0 then
					local id = F[x][y].mc.id
					if F[x][y].xFlag then
						table.insert(removed, id)
						self.tiles[id].mc.y = sy - #removed * self.tileSize
						self.tiles[id].mc.visible = true
					else
						table.insert(drop, id)
					end
				end
			end
			for _, id in ipairs(removed) do table.insert(drop, id) end
			for y = lowest, 0, -1 do
				local id = table.remove(drop, 1)
				F[x][y].mc.id = id
				F[x][y].typ = self.tiles[id].typ
				F[x][y].newTyp = self.tiles[id].typ
				self.tiles[id].mc.pos.x, self.tiles[id].mc.pos.y = x, y
				self.tiles[id].moveState = 1
			end
		end
		self.gameState = "fillAnim"
		self.playLand = true
		self.counter = 0
	elseif st == "fillAnim" then
		if not self:AnimTiles("gravity") then
			if self:CheckForMatch(50) then
				local rb = self:Clip("rushBonus")
				if rb then
					FL.GotoAndPlay(rb, "on")
					local fg = self.fallGeneration
					if fg == 2 then rb.vars.txt = "DOBBELT" elseif fg == 3 then rb.vars.txt = "TRIPLE" elseif fg > 3 then rb.vars.txt = "MEGA" end
				end
				self.fallGeneration = self.fallGeneration + 1
				self.gameState = "fillHilite"
				self.counter = 0
			else
				local tm = self:Clip("thisMoveTotal")
				if tm then tm.vars.txt = self.moveAccumPoints FL.GotoAndPlay(tm, "on") end
				self.vars.targetScore = self.vars.targetScore + self.moveAccumPoints
				local p = self.moveAccumPoints
				if not AN.IsSpeaking() then
					if p >= 500 then AN.Speak("megetGodt")
					elseif p > 90 then AN.Speak("Godt")
					elseif p > 30 then AN.Speak("Pyntekasse_Bonus03") end
				end
				self.moveAccumPoints = 0
				self.gameState = "resetInput"
				self.counter = 0
			end
		end
	elseif st == "fillHilite" then
		self.counter = self.counter + 1
		if self.counter == 1 then
			self:GiveMatchPoints()
			self:PlayEfx("remove")
		elseif self.counter > self.hiliteDelay then
			self.gameState = "removeMatches"
			self.counter = 0
		end
	elseif st == "timeRanOut" then
		local tr = self:Clip("timeRanOut")
		if tr then FL.GotoAndPlay(tr, "animon") end
		self.gameState = "gameDone"
	end
end

-- a cell's button: rollOver / rollOut / release
function G:TileMouseAction(kind, b)
	local id, pos = b.id, b.pos
	local t = self.tiles[id]
	if not t then return end
	local sel1 = self.selected[1]
	if kind == "over" then
		if (not sel1 or id ~= sel1.id) and self.gameState == "waitInput" then
			self:PlayEfx("click2")
			FL.GotoAndStop(t.mc, "active")
		end
	elseif kind == "out" then
		if (not sel1 or id ~= sel1.id) and self.gameState == "waitInput" then FL.GotoAndStop(t.mc, "def") end
	elseif kind == "release" and self.gameState == "waitInput" then
		local s = { id = id, pos = { x = pos.x, y = pos.y } }
		if #self.selected == 0 then
			self:PlayEfx("click1")
			table.insert(self.selected, s)
			for _, d in ipairs({ { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }) do
				local f = self:Cell(pos.x + d[1], pos.y + d[2])
				if f then f.xFlag = 1 end
			end
			FL.GotoAndStop(t.mc, "selected")
		elseif #self.selected == 1 then
			local f = self:Cell(pos.x, pos.y)
			if f and f.xFlag == 1 then
				self.gameState = "checkMove"
				table.insert(self.selected, s)
			else
				self:PlayEfx("badmove")
				self.gameState = "resetInput"
			end
		end
	end
end

-- the pause button
function G:PausePressed()
	local help, pg = self:Clip("help"), self:Clip("pausegfx")
	if not help then return end
	local hv = help.vars
	if not hv.ison and hv.isPlaying ~= true then
		if pg then FL.Play(pg) end
		FL.Play(help)
	elseif hv.isOnAndDone and hv.isPlaying ~= true then
		hv.isOnAndDone = false
		if pg then FL.Play(pg) end
		FL.Play(help)
	end
	self:PlayEfx("click2")
end

function G:Open(args)
	setupActions()
	CUR = self
	self.finished = false
	self.acc = 0
	self.vars = { level = 1, score = 0, targetScore = 0, scoreTxt = 0 }
	self.levelStartScore = 0
	self.points = {}
	self.tiles = {}
	self.nTiles = 0
	self.buttons = {}
	self.selected = {}
	self.mainState = "none"

	self.hoverId = nil

	self.root = FL.New(LIB, 0)
	self.root.vars = self.vars
end

function G:Close()
	if CUR == self then CUR = nil end
end

local function tickGfx(c)
	if not c.gfxMode then return end
	if c.gfxMode == "back" then
		if math.abs(c.gfxScale - 100) < 1 then
			c.gfxScale = 100
			c.gfxMode = nil
		else
			c.gfxScale = c.gfxScale + (100 - c.gfxScale) / 2
		end
	else
		c.gfxCount = c.gfxCount + 1
		if c.gfxCount < 5 then c.gfxScale = c.gfxScale + (112 - c.gfxScale) / 2 else c.gfxScale = 112 end
	end
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(c)) do
		if it.nm == "gfx" and c.kids[it[3]] then
			local s = c.gfxScale / 100
			c.kids[it[3]].mat = { s, 0, 0, s, it[8], it[9] }
		end
	end
end

function G:Step()
	FL.OnSound = function(c, id) MG.Sound("g24", "s" .. id) end
	FL.Tick(self.root)
	for i = 1, self.nTiles do
		local t = self.tiles[i]
		if t and t.mc then FL.Tick(t.mc) tickGfx(t.mc) end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(self.points) do if p.visible then FL.Tick(p) end end
	-- the main clip's enterFrame
	if self.mainState == "rungame" and self:Game() then self:Loop() end
	FL.OnSound = nil
end

function G:Think(dt)
	if not self.root then return end
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Finish()
	if self.finished then return end
	self.finished = true
	AN.FinishGame(24, math.max(self.vars.score or 0, self.vars.targetScore or 0))
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(STAGE_W, STAGE_H)
	if not self.root then MG.Chrome(24) return end
	local game = self:Game()
	local gm = game and FL.ChildMatrix(self.root, "game", I)

		local ex = {}
		for i = 1, self.nTiles do

			if t and t.mc and t.mc.x then ex[#ex + 1] = { c = t.mc, m = { 1, 0, 0, 1, t.mc.x, t.mc.y } } end

		game.extra = ex
	end
	-- texts like "_parent.txt" / "txt" in the bonus clips: the nearest clip up the tree that has it
	FL.VarHook = function(c, var)
		local name = string.lower(string.match(var, "([%w_]+)$") or var)
		local cur = c.parent
		while cur do
			for k, v in pairs(cur.vars or {}) do if string.lower(k) == name then return v end end
			cur = cur.parent

	FL.Draw(self.root, I)

	-- the cells' buttons (later ones on top): hover and click

		for i = self.nTiles, 1, -1 do

		if hover and self.gameState then

	if hover ~= self.hoverB then

		if hover then self:TileMouseAction("over", hover) end
	end
	-- the root's buttons: pause (318), "Fortsæt" in the level screen (301), skip on game over (383)
	local f = self.root.frame
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self.root)) do
		local k = self.root.kids[it[3]]
		if k then

	-- the quality window
	local qw, qm
	for _, it in ipairs(FL.Items(self.root)) do

		if it[2] == 252 and qw then

		end

	if qw and qw.frame == 2 then

			local k = qw.kids[it[3]]

									for _, it3 in ipairs(FL.Items(qw)) do

	end
	MG.Chrome(24)
