alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/h01_carvi:
-- Halloween: Græskarskæring (pumpkin carving). A face is drawn on the pumpkin in dotted lines;
-- steer the knife with the arrow keys and hold Space to cut along them. Every bit of the line
-- scores, a whole shape falling out scores extra, and cutting beside the line scratches the
-- pumpkin and costs points. When the face is done the candle is lit and the next pumpkin comes.
-- 90 seconds.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local SU = AN.Summer
local N = 201
local W, H = 960, 720
local STEP = 1 / 60
local A = "carve/"
include((GM or GAMEMODE).FolderName .. "/gamemode/games/data/h201_shapes.lua")
local SHAPES = AN.CarveShapes

local ROUND = 90
-- the pumpkin's picture (600 x 500) and the face's middle
local PX, PY = 180, 100
local FX, FY = 480, 350
-- the pumpkin's body, for "is the knife on the pumpkin"
local BCX, BCY, BRX, BRY = 480, 380, 270, 200

local DIFF = {
	{ tol = 20, speed = 250, eyes = { "tri", "round" }, noses = { false, "tri" }, mouths = { "smile", "o" } },
	{ tol = 14, speed = 250, eyes = { "tri", "round", "slant", "moon" }, noses = { "tri", "round", "heart" }, mouths = { "smile", "teeth", "zigzag" } },
	{ tol = 9, speed = 260, eyes = { "star", "moon", "slant", "tri" }, noses = { "heart", "tri", "round" }, mouths = { "teeth", "zigzag" } },
}
local PTS_DOT, PTS_SHAPE, PTS_FACE, PTS_CLEAN, PTS_SCRATCH = 1, 40, 100, 50, 10

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 2000,
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "su_carving",
}

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("hw_carve_status", self.done or 0, self.score or 0)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.diff = SU.Diff()
	self.D = DIFF[self.diff]
	self.acc, self.t = 0, 0
	self.left = ROUND
	self.score = 0
	self.done = 0
	self.finished, self.overAt = false, nil
	self.kx, self.ky = FX, FY + 40
	self.pops = {}
	self.falling = {}
	self.cutSnd = 0
	self:NewPumpkin()
	self.slide = 0          -- the new pumpkin rolls in from the right
end
function G:Close() end

local function pick(list) return list[math.random(#list)] end

function G:NewPumpkin()
	local D = self.D
	local shapes = {}
	local function add(id, x, y)
		local s = SHAPES[id]
		local dots = {}
		for i = 1, #s.dots, 2 do dots[#dots + 1] = { x = FX + x + s.dots[i], y = FY + y + s.dots[i + 1] } end
		shapes[#shapes + 1] = { id = id, x = FX + x, y = FY + y, dots = dots, left = #dots }
	end
	local eye = pick(D.eyes)
	local l, r = "eye_" .. eye, "eye_" .. eye
	if eye == "slant" then l, r = "eye_slant_l", "eye_slant_r" end
	if eye == "moon" then l, r = "eye_moon", "eye_moon_r" end
	add(l, -105, -60)
	add(r, 105, -60)
	local nose = pick(D.noses)
	if nose then add("nose_" .. nose, 0, 20) end
	add("mouth_" .. pick(D.mouths), 0, 112)
	self.shapes = shapes
	self.scratches = {}
	self.state = "carve"
	self.stateT = 0
	self.slide = 1
end

-- is the knife tip near the line of a shape still being cut (or on a hole already cut)?
function G:NearLine(x, y, r)
	local r2 = r * r
	for _, s in ipairs(self.shapes) do
		if not s.out then
			for _, d in ipairs(s.dots) do
				local dx, dy = d.x - x, d.y - y
				if dx * dx + dy * dy <= r2 then return true end
			end
		else
			local S = SHAPES[s.id]
			if math.abs(x - s.x) < S.w / 2 and math.abs(y - s.y) < S.h / 2 then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function G:Cut(moved)
	local tol = self.D.tol
	local t2 = tol * tol
	local got = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(self.shapes) do
		if not s.out then
			for _, d in ipairs(s.dots) do
				if not d.cut then
					local dx, dy = d.x - self.kx, d.y - self.ky
					if dx * dx + dy * dy <= t2 then
						d.cut = true
						s.left = s.left - 1
						got = got + 1
					end
				end
			end
			if s.left <= 0 then self:ShapeOut(s) end
		end
	end
	if got > 0 then
		self.score = self.score + got * PTS_DOT
		if self.t >= self.cutSnd then
			MG.Sound("g08", "zipper", 0.35)
			self.cutSnd = self.t + 0.35
		end
		return
	end
	-- beside the line: a scratch (only while the knife moves over the pumpkin)
	if not moved then return end
	local ex, ey = (self.kx - BCX) / BRX, (self.ky - BCY) / BRY
	if ex * ex + ey * ey > 1 then return end
	if self:NearLine(self.kx, self.ky, tol + 6) then return end
	if self.lastScratch and self.t - self.lastScratch < 0.3 then return end
	self.lastScratch = self.t
	self.scratches[#self.scratches + 1] = { x = self.kx, y = self.ky, r = math.random(-40, 40) }
	self.score = math.max(0, self.score - PTS_SCRATCH)
	self:Pop("-" .. PTS_SCRATCH, self.kx, self.ky - 30, Color(255, 90, 60))
	MG.Sound("g06", "error", 0.5)
end

function G:ShapeOut(s)
	s.out = true
	self.score = self.score + PTS_SHAPE
	self:Pop("+" .. PTS_SHAPE, s.x, s.y, Color(255, 220, 90))
	self.falling[#self.falling + 1] = { id = s.id, x = s.x, y = s.y, vx = math.random(-60, 60), vy = -120, rot = 0, vr = math.random(-200, 200) }
	MG.Sound("g11", "placegood", 0.7)
	for _, o in ipairs(self.shapes) do if not o.out then return end end
	-- the whole face: light the candle
	local bonus = PTS_FACE + (#self.scratches == 0 and PTS_CLEAN or 0)
	self.score = self.score + bonus
	self.done = self.done + 1
	self.state = "lit"
	self.stateT = 0
	self.clean = #self.scratches == 0
	MG.Sound("ui", "triangel")
	if self.clean and self.done % 3 == 0 then AN.Speak("megetgodt") end
end

function G:Pop(text, x, y, col)
	self.pops[#self.pops + 1] = { text = text, x = x, y = y, t = self.t, col = col }
end

function G:Over()
	if self.overAt then return end
	self.overAt = self.t
	MG.Sound("g14", "done")
end

function G:Step()
	self.t = self.t + STEP
	-- the falling pieces
	for i = #self.falling, 1, -1 do
		local f = self.falling[i]
		f.vy = f.vy + 900 * STEP
		f.x, f.y = f.x + f.vx * STEP, f.y + f.vy * STEP
		f.rot = f.rot + f.vr * STEP
		if f.y > H + 100 then table.remove(self.falling, i) end
	end
	if self.overAt then
		if self.t - self.overAt > 2.4 and not self.finished then
			self.finished = true
			AN.FinishGame(N, self.score)
		end
		return
	end
	self.left = self.left - STEP
	if self.left <= 0 then self.left = 0 self:Over() return end
	self.slide = math.max(0, self.slide - STEP * 2.2)
	self.stateT = self.stateT + STEP
	if self.state == "lit" then
		if self.stateT > 1.6 then self.state = "away" self.stateT = 0 end
	elseif self.state == "away" then
		if self.stateT > 0.45 then self:NewPumpkin() end
	end
	-- the knife
	local dx, dy = 0, 0
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then dx = dx - 1 end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then dx = dx + 1 end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_UP) then dy = dy - 1 end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_DOWN) then dy = dy + 1 end
	local moved = dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0
	if moved then
		local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		local sp = self.D.speed * STEP
		self.kx = math.Clamp(self.kx + dx / l * sp, 60, W - 60)
		self.ky = math.Clamp(self.ky + dy / l * sp, 120, H - 40)
	end
	self.cutting = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE)
	if self.cutting and self.state == "carve" and self.slide <= 0 then self:Cut(moved) end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pic(name, x, y, w, h, alpha)
	AN.Img(A .. name, MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), alpha)
end
local WHITE = Color(255, 255, 255)
local GOLD = Color(255, 214, 90)
local DOT = Color(60, 24, 6)
local CUT = Color(40, 12, 2)

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(W, H)
	-- the room (wider than the stage, for wide screens)
	pic("room.jpg", -240, 0, W + 480, H)
	-- Gyldenkål watches with his lantern
	local gh = 300
	AN.Img("halloween/gyld_lantern.png", MG.X(W - 150), MG.Y(590 - gh), MG.S(gh * 490 / 785), MG.S(gh))
	-- the candle on the table
	pic("candle.png", 70, 500, 40, 70)
	AN.Glow(MG.X(90), MG.Y(506), MG.S(70 + 6 * math.sin(self.t * 9)), Color(255, 200, 90), 0.35)

	-- the pumpkin (rolling in, or away when done)
	local off = 0
	if self.slide > 0 then off = self.slide * self.slide * 700 end
	if self.state == "away" then off = -(self.stateT / 0.45) ^ 2 * 800 end
	local function X(x) return MG.X(x + off) end
	AN.Img(A .. "pumpkin.png", X(PX), MG.Y(PY), MG.S(600), MG.S(500))
	-- the scratches
	for _, s in ipairs(self.scratches) do
		AN.ImgRotated(A .. "scratch.png", X(s.x), MG.Y(s.y), MG.S(40), MG.S(12), s.r)
	end
	-- the shapes: holes cut out, dotted lines still to cut
	local lit = self.state == "lit" or self.state == "away"
	local flick = 0.85 + 0.15 * math.sin(self.t * 13) * math.sin(self.t * 7)
	for _, s in ipairs(self.shapes) do
		local S = SHAPES[s.id]
		if s.out then
			AN.Img(A .. (lit and "lit_" or "hole_") .. s.id .. ".png", X(s.x - S.ox), MG.Y(s.y - S.oy), MG.S(S.w), MG.S(S.h), lit and 255 * flick or 255)
		else
			local ds = MG.S(5)
			local cs = MG.S(7)
			for i, d in ipairs(s.dots) do
				if d.cut then
					AN.Box(X(d.x) - cs / 2, MG.Y(d.y) - cs / 2, cs, cs, CUT)
				elseif i % 2 == 1 then
					AN.Box(X(d.x) - ds / 2, MG.Y(d.y) - ds / 2, ds, ds, DOT)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if lit then
		AN.Glow(X(FX), MG.Y(FY + 30), MG.S(260), Color(255, 190, 60), 0.35 * flick)
	end
	-- the pieces falling out
	for _, f in ipairs(self.falling) do
		local S = SHAPES[f.id]
		AN.ImgRotated(A .. "piece_" .. f.id .. ".png", MG.X(f.x + off), MG.Y(f.y), MG.S(S.w), MG.S(S.h), f.rot)
	end
	-- the knife (its tip at the point), with the reach it cuts in
	if not self.overAt then
		local tol = self.D.tol
		AN.Outline(MG.X(self.kx - tol), MG.Y(self.ky - tol), MG.S(tol * 2), MG.S(tol * 2), Color(255, 255, 255, self.cutting and 200 or 90), MG.S(tol), MG.S(2))
		local dip = self.cutting and 8 or 0
		AN.Img(A .. "knife.png", MG.X(self.kx - 20), MG.Y(self.ky - 148 + dip), MG.S(40), MG.S(150))
	end
	-- the points
	for i = #self.pops, 1, -1 do
		local p = self.pops[i]
		local age = self.t - p.t
		if age > 1 then table.remove(self.pops, i) else
			local c = p.col
			AN.Text(p.text, "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(p.x), MG.Y(p.y - age * 40), Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, 255 * (1 - age)), 1, 1)

	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_time", secs), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2 - 200), MG.Y(38), secs <= 10 and Color(255, 120, 80) or WHITE, 1, 1)
	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_carve_count", self.done), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(38), WHITE, 1, 1)

		AN.Box(MG.X(W / 2 - 300), MG.Y(H * 0.3), MG.S(600), MG.S(150), Color(30, 10, 40, 220 * a), MG.S(30))

AN.RegisterGame(N, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/h02_ghost:
-- Halloween: Spøgelsesjagt (ghost hunt). The hall of the haunted house is dark; steer the
-- flashlight with the arrow keys. The ghosts can only be seen in the light (in the dark only their
-- eyes glimmer): keep the light on one until it is caught. Quick catches score more. Bats hang
-- in the hall: shine on one and it flaps around, and every ghost you were catching gets away.
-- 90 seconds.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local SU = AN.Summer
local N = 202
local W, H = 960, 720
local STEP = 1 / 60
local A = "ghost/"
local ROUND = 90
local GW, GH = 100, 117           -- a ghost's size
local X0, X1, Y0, Y1 = 70, 890, 110, 520   -- where the ghosts float

local DIFF = {
	{ R = 165, catch = 0.8, wander = 30, flee = 0, maxG = 2, bats = 1, eyes = 110, life = 14, dark = 230 },
	{ R = 150, catch = 1.1, wander = 50, flee = 80, maxG = 3, bats = 2, eyes = 90, life = 12, dark = 240 },
	{ R = 135, catch = 1.3, wander = 75, flee = 150, maxG = 3, bats = 4, eyes = 70, life = 10, dark = 248 },
}
-- where the bats hang (stage units: the beam above the hall, the frames, the clock)
local HANGS = { { 150, 48 }, { 300, 48 }, { 520, 48 }, { 700, 48 }, { 860, 48 }, { 215, 130 }, { 455, 290 }, { 695, 190 } }
local PTS_GHOST, PTS_QUICK, PTS_BAT = 100, 60, 20
local DARK = Color(6, 2, 12)

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 2500,
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "su_ghosts",
}

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("hw_ghost_status", self.caught or 0, self.score or 0)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.diff = SU.Diff()
	self.D = DIFF[self.diff]
	self.acc, self.t = 0, 0
	self.left = ROUND
	self.score, self.caught = 0, 0
	self.finished, self.overAt = false, nil
	self.bx, self.by = W / 2, H - 150
	self.ghosts, self.puffs, self.pops = {}, {}, {}
	self.spawnAt = 0.8
	self.bats = {}
	local free = {}
	for i = 1, #HANGS do free[i] = i end
	for i = 1, self.D.bats do
		local k = table.remove(free, math.random(#free))
		self.bats[i] = { hang = k, x = HANGS[k][1], y = HANGS[k][2], state = "hang", lit = 0 }
	end
end
function G:Close() end

function G:Pop(text, x, y, col)
	self.pops[#self.pops + 1] = { text = text, x = x, y = y, t = self.t, col = col }
end

function G:Spawn()
	-- somewhere away from the light
	local x, y
	for _ = 1, 12 do
		x, y = math.random(X0, X1), math.random(Y0, Y1)
		if (x - self.bx) ^ 2 + (y - self.by) ^ 2 > (self.D.R * 1.8) ^ 2 then break end
	end
	local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	self.ghosts[#self.ghosts + 1] = { x = x, y = y, vx = math.cos(a), vy = math.sin(a), ph = math.random() * 6, age = 0, fade = 0, catch = 0 }
	MG.Sound("g08", "whoosh", 0.35)
end

function G:Over()
	if self.overAt then return end
	self.overAt = self.t
	MG.Sound("g14", "done")
end

function G:Step()
	self.t = self.t + STEP
	for i = #self.puffs, 1, -1 do
		if self.t - self.puffs[i].t > 0.7 then table.remove(self.puffs, i) end
	end
	if self.overAt then
		if self.t - self.overAt > 2.4 and not self.finished then
			self.finished = true
			AN.FinishGame(N, self.score)
		end
		return
	end
	self.left = self.left - STEP
	if self.left <= 0 then self.left = 0 self:Over() return end
	local D = self.D
	-- the flashlight
	local dx, dy = 0, 0
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then dx = dx - 1 end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then dx = dx + 1 end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_UP) then dy = dy - 1 end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_DOWN) then dy = dy + 1 end
	if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 then
		local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		self.bx = math.Clamp(self.bx + dx / l * 380 * STEP, 30, W - 30)
		self.by = math.Clamp(self.by + dy / l * 380 * STEP, 40, H - 60)
	end
	-- new ghosts
	if #self.ghosts < D.maxG and self.t >= self.spawnAt then
		self:Spawn()
		self.spawnAt = self.t + 1.2
	end
	local R = D.R
	for i = #self.ghosts, 1, -1 do
		local g = self.ghosts[i]
		g.age = g.age + STEP
		g.fade = g.leaving and math.max(0, g.fade - STEP * 1.5) or math.min(1, g.fade + STEP * 1.5)
		local ddx, ddy = g.x - self.bx, g.y - self.by
		local d = math.sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy)
		local inLight = d < R * 0.7 and g.fade > 0.5 and not g.leaving
		g.lit = d < R + 30
		-- drifting about, and away from the light
		g.ph = g.ph + STEP
		local sp = D.wander
		local vx, vy = g.vx * sp, g.vy * sp
		if g.lit and D.flee > 0 and d > 1 then
			local f = D.flee * (1 - math.min(1, g.catch * 0.6))
			vx, vy = vx + ddx / d * f, vy + ddy / d * f
		end
		g.x = g.x + vx * STEP + math.cos(g.ph * 1.3) * 18 * STEP
		g.y = g.y + vy * STEP + math.sin(g.ph * 2.1) * 26 * STEP
		if g.x < X0 then g.x, g.vx = X0, math.abs(g.vx) elseif g.x > X1 then g.x, g.vx = X1, -math.abs(g.vx) end
		if g.y < Y0 then g.y, g.vy = Y0, math.abs(g.vy) elseif g.y > Y1 then g.y, g.vy = Y1, -math.abs(g.vy) end
		if math.random() < STEP * 0.4 then
			local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			g.vx, g.vy = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
		end
		-- catching
		if inLight then
			g.catch = g.catch + STEP / D.catch
			if g.catch >= 1 then
				local pts = PTS_GHOST + math.max(0, math.floor(PTS_QUICK - g.age * 6))
				self.score = self.score + pts
				self.caught = self.caught + 1
				self:Pop("+" .. pts, g.x, g.y - 40, Color(200, 255, 160))
				self.puffs[#self.puffs + 1] = { x = g.x, y = g.y, t = self.t }
				MG.Sound("g16", "eat_ghost", 0.8)
				table.remove(self.ghosts, i)
				self.spawnAt = math.max(self.spawnAt, self.t + 0.6)
				if self.caught % 10 == 0 then AN.Speak("megetgodt") end
			end
		else
			g.catch = math.max(0, g.catch - STEP * 0.5)
		end
		if g.ghostGone then table.remove(self.ghosts, i) end
		-- a ghost that has floated about for long enough goes away (and another comes)
		if g.age > D.life and not g.leaving and g.catch <= 0 then g.leaving = true end
		if g.leaving and g.fade <= 0 then g.ghostGone = true end
	end
	-- the bats
	for _, b in ipairs(self.bats) do
		if b.state == "hang" then
			local near = (b.x - self.bx) ^ 2 + (b.y + 20 - self.by) ^ 2 < 60 * 60
			b.lit = near and b.lit + STEP or 0
			if b.lit > 0.25 and self.t > 1.5 then self:Startle(b) end
		else
			b.ft = b.ft + STEP
			b.x = b.x + b.vx * STEP
			b.y = b.y + math.sin(b.ft * 6) * 120 * STEP + b.vy * STEP
			if b.x < 40 or b.x > W - 40 then b.vx = -b.vx end
			if b.y < 60 or b.y > H - 140 then b.vy = -b.vy end
			if b.ft > 2.6 then
				-- back to a free hanging place
				local used = {}
				for _, o in ipairs(self.bats) do if o ~= b and o.state == "hang" then used[o.hang] = true end end
				local k
				repeat k = math.random(#HANGS) until not used[k]
				b.hang, b.x, b.y, b.state, b.lit = k, HANGS[k][1], HANGS[k][2], "hang", 0
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:Startle(b)
	b.state = "fly"
	b.ft = 0
	b.vx = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * math.random(260, 360)
	b.vy = math.random(80, 160)
	self.score = math.max(0, self.score - PTS_BAT)
	self:Pop("-" .. PTS_BAT, b.x, b.y + 50, Color(255, 110, 80))
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do g.catch = 0 end
	MG.Sound("g01", "enemyflying", 0.7)
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

	-- the catching rings
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do

			AN.Box(MG.X(g.x) - w / 2, MG.Y(g.y + GH / 2 + 4), w * math.min(1, g.catch), MG.S(10), Color(160, 255, 120), MG.S(5))
		end
	end
	-- caught: a puff
	for _, p in ipairs(self.puffs) do
		local k = (self.t - p.t) / 0.7
		local s = 80 + 80 * k
		AN.Img(A .. "puff.png", MG.X(p.x - s / 2), MG.Y(p.y - s / 2), MG.S(s), MG.S(s), 255 * (1 - k))
	end
	-- the flying bats (black against everything)
	for _, b in ipairs(self.bats) do
		if b.state == "fly" then
			local up = math.floor(b.ft * 12) % 2 == 0
			AN.Img(A .. (up and "bat_up.png" or "bat_down.png"), MG.X(b.x - 60), MG.Y(b.y - 35), MG.S(120), MG.S(70))

	-- the points
	for i = #self.pops, 1, -1 do

		local age = self.t - p.t
		if age > 1 then table.remove(self.pops, i) else
			local c = p.col
			AN.Text(p.text, "title", math.floor(MG.S(32)), MG.X(p.x), MG.Y(p.y - age * 40), Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, 255 * (1 - age)), 1, 1)
		end

	-- the top bar
	AN.Box(MG.X(W / 2 - 300), MG.Y(14), MG.S(600), MG.S(48), Color(30, 10, 40, 210), MG.S(24))

	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_time", secs), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2 - 200), MG.Y(38), secs <= 10 and Color(255, 120, 80) or WHITE, 1, 1)
	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_ghost_count", self.caught), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(38), WHITE, 1, 1)
	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_points", self.score), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2 + 200), MG.Y(38), GOLD, 1, 1)

		AN.Text(AN.L("su_result") .. ": " .. self.score, "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H * 0.3 + 108), Color(255, 214, 64, 255 * a), 1, 1)

alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/h03_trick:
-- Halloween: Slik eller ballade (trick or treat). Pyrus walks down the street with his pumpkin
-- bucket: left and right to walk, up to jump, Space to ring the doorbell in front of a door.
-- Most doors give candy, some give a fright (Pyrus stands shaking for a moment), and some
-- nobody opens. The big kids walk the street the other way: jump over them, or they steal
-- some of your candy. 90 seconds; every piece of candy is 10 points.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local SU = AN.Summer
local N = 203
local W, H = 960, 720
local STEP = 1 / 60
local A = "trick/"
local ROUND = 90
local GY = 600                 -- the pavement
local HOUSE, GAPX = 360, 420   -- a house's width, and from one house to the next
local PH = 170                 -- Pyrus' height
local PW = PH * 514 / 768
local WALK, JUMP, GRAV = 270, 1050, 2200
local PER_CANDY = 10

local DIFF = {
	{ kidEvery = 7, kidSpeed = 120, fright = 0.12, both = false },
	{ kidEvery = 5, kidSpeed = 160, fright = 0.22, both = false },
	{ kidEvery = 3.6, kidSpeed = 200, fright = 0.3, both = true },
}
local KIDS = {
	{ img = "kid_devil.png", w = 342, h = 621, dh = 175 },
	{ img = "kid_witch.png", w = 440, h = 810, dh = 190 },
}

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 2000,
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "su_trickortreat",
}

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("hw_trick_status", self.candy or 0, (self.candy or 0) * PER_CANDY)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.diff = SU.Diff()
	self.D = DIFF[self.diff]
	self.acc, self.t = 0, 0
	self.left = ROUND
	self.candy = 0
	self.finished, self.overAt = false, nil
	self.px, self.py, self.vy = 120, GY, 0
	self.face = 1
	self.stun = 0
	self.houses = {}
	self.kids = {}
	self.fly = {}
	self.pops = {}
	self.kidAt = 3
	self.kprev = {}
	self.cam = 0
	self.shake = 0
end
function G:Close() end

-- house i (from 0): made the first time it is needed
function G:House(i)
	local h = self.houses[i]
	if h then return h end
	local r = math.random()
	local D = self.D
	h = {
		x = 160 + i * GAPX,
		look = math.random(4),
		jack = math.random() < 0.5,
		state = "closed",
		-- what's behind the door
		out = r < 0.1 and "empty" or (r < 0.1 + D.fright and "fright" or "candy"),
		n = math.random(2, 5),
	}
	h.door = h.x + 180
	self.houses[i] = h
	return h
end

function G:Pressed(k)
	local down = input.IsKeyDown(k)
	local was = self.kprev[k]
	self.kprev[k] = down
	return down and not was
end

function G:Pop(text, x, y, col)
	self.pops[#self.pops + 1] = { text = text, x = x, y = y, t = self.t, col = col or Color(255, 220, 90) }
end

function G:Over()
	if self.overAt then return end
	self.overAt = self.t
	MG.Sound("g14", "done")
end

function G:Step()
	self.t = self.t + STEP
	for i = #self.fly, 1, -1 do
		local f = self.fly[i]
		f.k = f.k + STEP / 0.6
		if f.k >= 1 then table.remove(self.fly, i) end
	end
	if self.overAt then
		if self.t - self.overAt > 2.4 and not self.finished then
			self.finished = true
			AN.FinishGame(N, self.candy * PER_CANDY)
		end
		return
	end
	self.left = self.left - STEP
	if self.left <= 0 then self.left = 0 self:Over() return end
	local D = self.D
	self.shake = math.max(0, self.shake - STEP)
	-- Pyrus
	local onGround = self.py >= GY
	local ring = self:Pressed(KEY_SPACE)
	local jump = self:Pressed(KEY_UP)
	if self.stun > 0 then
		self.stun = self.stun - STEP
	else
		local dx = 0
		if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then dx = dx - 1 end
		if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then dx = dx + 1 end
		if dx ~= 0 then self.face = dx end
		self.walking = dx ~= 0 and onGround
		self.px = math.max(40, self.px + dx * WALK * STEP)
		if jump and onGround then
			self.vy = -JUMP
			MG.Sound("g01", "jump", 0.5)
		end
	end
	if not onGround or self.vy < 0 then
		self.vy = self.vy + GRAV * STEP
		self.py = self.py + self.vy * STEP
		if self.py >= GY then self.py, self.vy = GY, 0 end
	end
	self.cam = math.max(0, self.px - 300)
	-- the doors
	local first = math.max(0, math.floor((self.cam - 200) / GAPX))
	for i = first, first + 4 do
		local h = self:House(i)
		if h.state == "closed" and ring and onGround and self.stun <= 0 and math.abs(self.px - h.door) < 50 then
			h.state, h.st = "ringing", 0
			ring = false
			MG.Sound("g08", "ding", 0.8)
		elseif h.state == "ringing" then
			h.st = h.st + STEP
			if h.st > 0.55 then
				h.st = 0
				if h.out == "empty" then
					h.state = "done"
					self:Pop(AN.L("hw_trick_empty"), h.door, GY - 240, Color(200, 190, 220))
					MG.Sound("g04", "nomatch", 0.6)
				else
					h.state = "open"
					if h.out == "candy" then
						MG.Sound("g19", "door", 0.6)
					else
						MG.Sound("g10", "witchdie", 0.8)
						self.stun = 1.4
						self.shake = 0.5
						self.vy = -420
						self.py = math.min(self.py, GY - 1)
						self:Pop(AN.L("hw_trick_boo"), h.door, GY - 300, Color(255, 120, 80))
					end
				end
			end
		elseif h.state == "open" then
			h.st = h.st + STEP
			if h.out == "candy" and not h.given and h.st > 0.35 then
				h.given = true
				self.candy = self.candy + h.n
				for c = 1, h.n do
					self.fly[#self.fly + 1] = { x = h.door, y = GY - 80, k = -0.12 * (c - 1), img = "candy" .. math.random(3) .. ".png" }
				end
				self:Pop("+" .. h.n * PER_CANDY, h.door, GY - 220)
				MG.Sound("g01", "pickup", 0.7)
			end
			if h.st > 1.3 then h.state = "done" end
		end
	end
	-- the big kids
	if self.t >= self.kidAt then
		self.kidAt = self.t + D.kidEvery * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
		local fromLeft = D.both and math.random() < 0.3 and self.cam > 200
		local k = KIDS[math.random(#KIDS)]
		self.kids[#self.kids + 1] = {
			k = k, dir = fromLeft and 1 or -1,
			x = fromLeft and (self.cam - 120) or (self.cam + W + 120),
			speed = D.kidSpeed * (0.85 + math.random() * 0.3), ph = math.random() * 6,
		}
	end
	for i = #self.kids, 1, -1 do
		local k = self.kids[i]
		k.x = k.x + k.dir * k.speed * STEP * (k.stole and 2 or 1)
		k.ph = k.ph + STEP
		-- bumping into Pyrus (not when he is over their heads)
		if not k.stole and math.abs(k.x - self.px) < 48 and self.py > GY - 100 then
			k.stole = true
			k.dir = (k.x > self.px) and 1 or -1
			local take = math.min(2, self.candy)
			self.candy = self.candy - take
			if take > 0 then
				self:Pop("-" .. take * PER_CANDY, self.px, GY - 220, Color(255, 110, 80))
				MG.Sound("g17", "steal", 0.8)
			else
				MG.Sound("g01", "giggle", 0.8)
			end
			self.stun = math.max(self.stun, 0.5)
			self.vy = -380
			self.py = math.min(self.py, GY - 1)
		end
		if k.x < self.cam - 400 or k.x > self.cam + W + 400 then table.remove(self.kids, i) end
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

AN.RegisterGame(N, G)
-- Halloween: Spøgelseslabyrinten (the haunted maze). A dark maze, seen by the light of Pyrus'
-- lantern. Collect the keys and get out through the door before the ghost catches you; candy on
-- the way scores extra. Every maze is a bit bigger and the ghost a bit quicker; from the third
-- maze there are two ghosts. Three lives.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local SU = AN.Summer
local N = 204
local W, H = 960, 720
local STEP = 1 / 60
local A = "maze/"
local TOP = 76                  -- the maze is drawn below the top bar

local DIFF = {
	{ cols = 9, rows = 6, light = 3.3, ghost = 1.7, more = 0.15, keys = 2, rnd = 0.2, sense = 4 },
	{ cols = 11, rows = 7, light = 2.7, ghost = 2.1, more = 0.2, keys = 3, rnd = 0.1, sense = 5 },
	{ cols = 13, rows = 8, light = 2.1, ghost = 2.5, more = 0.25, keys = 3, rnd = 0.05, sense = 6 },
}
local SPEED = 4.6               -- Pyrus: cells a second
local PTS_KEY, PTS_CANDY, PTS_EXIT = 50, 20, 300
local DIRS = { { 0, -1, "N" }, { 1, 0, "E" }, { 0, 1, "S" }, { -1, 0, "W" } }
local OPP = { N = "S", S = "N", E = "W", W = "E" }
local DARK = Color(6, 2, 12)

local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 2000,
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "su_maze",
}

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("hw_maze_status", self.level or 1, self.score or 0)
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.diff = SU.Diff()
	self.D = DIFF[self.diff]
	self.acc, self.t = 0, 0
	self.score = 0
	self.lives = 3
	self.level = 0
	self.finished, self.overAt = false, nil
	self.pops = {}
	self.kprev = {}
	self:NewMaze()
end
function G:Close() end

local function cid(x, y) return y * 1000 + x end

function G:NewMaze()
	self.level = self.level + 1
	local D = self.D
	local grow = math.min(4, math.floor((self.level - 1) / 2))
	local cols, rows = D.cols + grow, D.rows + math.floor(grow / 2)
	self.cols, self.rows = cols, rows
	-- the maze: a random walk that knocks down walls (every cell can be reached)
	local walls = {}
	for y = 0, rows - 1 do
		for x = 0, cols - 1 do walls[cid(x, y)] = { N = true, E = true, S = true, W = true } end
	end
	local seen, stack = { [cid(0, 0)] = true }, { { 0, 0 } }
	while #stack > 0 do
		local c = stack[#stack]
		local opts = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
			local nx, ny = c[1] + d[1], c[2] + d[2]
			if nx >= 0 and ny >= 0 and nx < cols and ny < rows and not seen[cid(nx, ny)] then opts[#opts + 1] = d end
		end
		if #opts == 0 then
			table.remove(stack)
		else
			local d = opts[math.random(#opts)]
			local nx, ny = c[1] + d[1], c[2] + d[2]
			walls[cid(c[1], c[2])][d[3]] = false
			walls[cid(nx, ny)][OPP[d[3]]] = false
			seen[cid(nx, ny)] = true
			stack[#stack + 1] = { nx, ny }
		end
	end
	-- a few extra openings, so there is more than one way round the ghost
	for _ = 1, math.floor(cols * rows * 0.14) do
		local x, y = math.random(0, cols - 2), math.random(0, rows - 1)
		walls[cid(x, y)].E = false
		walls[cid(x + 1, y)].W = false
	end
	self.walls = walls
	-- where things are: Pyrus top left, the door bottom right, keys in far dead ends
	self.start = { 0, 0 }
	self.exit = { cols - 1, rows - 1 }
	local dist = self:Dist(0, 0)
	local cells = {}
	for y = 0, rows - 1 do
		for x = 0, cols - 1 do
			local w = walls[cid(x, y)]
			local open = (w.N and 0 or 1) + (w.E and 0 or 1) + (w.S and 0 or 1) + (w.W and 0 or 1)
			if not (x == 0 and y == 0) and not (x == cols - 1 and y == rows - 1) then
				cells[#cells + 1] = { x, y, d = dist[cid(x, y)] or 0, dead = open == 1, r = math.random() }
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(cells, function(a, b)
		local sa = a.d + (a.dead and 6 or 0) + a.r * 4
		local sb = b.d + (b.dead and 6 or 0) + b.r * 4
		return sa > sb
	end)
	self.keys = {}
	local used = {}
	local quarter = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
		if #self.keys >= D.keys then break end
		-- spread the keys: not two in the same part of the maze
		local q = (c[1] < cols / 2 and 0 or 1) + (c[2] < rows / 2 and 0 or 2)
		if not quarter[q] then
			quarter[q] = true
			self.keys[#self.keys + 1] = { x = c[1], y = c[2] }
			used[cid(c[1], c[2])] = true
		end
	end
	self.candy = {}
	for i = 1, math.floor(cols * rows / 9) do
		local c = cells[math.random(#cells)]
		if not used[cid(c[1], c[2])] then
			used[cid(c[1], c[2])] = true
			self.candy[#self.candy + 1] = { x = c[1], y = c[2], img = "trick/candy" .. math.random(3) .. ".png" }
		end
	end
	self.got = 0
	self.flashes = 1
	-- the drawing size
	self.cell = math.floor(math.min((W - 40) / cols, (H - TOP - 20) / rows))
	self.ox = (W - cols * self.cell) / 2
	self.oy = TOP + (H - TOP - 10 - rows * self.cell) / 2
	self:Reset()
	self.banner = self.t
	MG.Sound("g16", "level_intro", 0.6)
end

-- Pyrus and the ghosts back to their places
function G:Reset()
	local D = self.D
	self.p = { x = self.start[1], y = self.start[2], fx = self.start[1], fy = self.start[2], tx = nil, k = 0, face = 1 }
	self.ghosts = {}
	local n = self.level >= 3 and 2 or 1
	local corners = { { self.cols - 1, self.rows - 1 }, { self.cols - 1, 0 }, { 0, self.rows - 1 } }
	for i = 1, n do
		local c = corners[i]
		self.ghosts[i] = { x = c[1], y = c[2], fx = c[1], fy = c[2], k = 0, wait = 2.5 + i, speed = D.ghost + D.more * (self.level - 1) - (i - 1) * 0.3 }
	end
	self.safe = 1.5
end

-- how many steps from a cell to every other one
function G:Dist(x0, y0)
	local dist = { [cid(x0, y0)] = 0 }
	local q, h = { { x0, y0 } }, 1
	while q[h] do
		local c = q[h]
		h = h + 1
		local w = self.walls[cid(c[1], c[2])]
		for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
			if not w[d[3]] then
				local nx, ny = c[1] + d[1], c[2] + d[2]
				local id = cid(nx, ny)
				if not dist[id] then
					dist[id] = dist[cid(c[1], c[2])] + 1
					q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return dist
end

function G:Open_(x, y, dname) return not self.walls[cid(x, y)][dname] end

function G:Pop(text, x, y, col)
	self.pops[#self.pops + 1] = { text = text, x = x, y = y, t = self.t, col = col or Color(255, 220, 90) }
end

function G:Over()
	if self.overAt then return end
	self.overAt = self.t
	MG.Sound("g14", "done")
end

function G:Step()
	self.t = self.t + STEP
	if self.overAt then
		if self.t - self.overAt > 2.4 and not self.finished then
			self.finished = true
			AN.FinishGame(N, self.score)
		end
		return
	end
	-- caught: a short pause, then back to the start
	if self.caughtAt then
		if self.t - self.caughtAt > 1.4 then
			self.caughtAt = nil
			if self.lives <= 0 then self:Over() return end
			self:Reset()
		end
		return
	end
	if self.doneAt then
		if self.t - self.doneAt > 1.6 then
			self.doneAt = nil
			self:NewMaze()
		end
		return
	end
	local D = self.D
	self.safe = math.max(0, self.safe - STEP)
	-- Space: the lantern flares up once a maze, and the ghosts flee for a while
	local sp = input.IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE)
	if sp and not self.kprev.sp and self.flashes > 0 then
		self.flashes = self.flashes - 1
		self.flashAt = self.t
		for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do g.scared = 3.5 end
		MG.Sound("g19", "lightswitch", 0.8)
		MG.Sound("g16", "scared_loop", 0.5)
	end
	self.kprev.sp = sp
	-- Pyrus: from cell to cell
	local p = self.p
	local want
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_UP) then want = DIRS[1] end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_DOWN) then want = DIRS[3] end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_LEFT) then want = DIRS[4] end
	if input.IsKeyDown(KEY_RIGHT) then want = DIRS[2] end
	-- (a key held, or a tap not yet used: the tap is kept a moment, so a turn can be pressed early)
	if want then p.want = want p.wantT = self.t end
	if p.want and self.t - (p.wantT or 0) > 0.2 then p.want = nil end
	if p.tx then
		p.k = p.k + SPEED * STEP
		-- turning back halfway
		if p.want and p.want[1] == p.x - p.tx and p.want[2] == p.y - p.ty then
			p.x, p.tx, p.y, p.ty = p.tx, p.x, p.ty, p.y
			p.k = 1 - p.k
		end
		if p.k >= 1 then
			p.x, p.y, p.tx, p.ty, p.k = p.tx, p.ty, nil, nil, 0
			self:Arrive()
		end
	end
	if not p.tx and p.want then
		local d = p.want
		if self:Open_(p.x, p.y, d[3]) then
			p.tx, p.ty, p.k = p.x + d[1], p.y + d[2], 0
			if d[1] ~= 0 then p.face = d[1] end
			p.want = nil
		end
	end
	if p.tx then
		p.fx, p.fy = p.x + (p.tx - p.x) * p.k, p.y + (p.ty - p.y) * p.k
	else
		p.fx, p.fy = p.x, p.y
	end
	-- the ghosts: along the corridors towards Pyrus
	local dist
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do
		if g.wait > 0 then
			g.wait = g.wait - STEP
		else
			if not g.tx then
				dist = dist or self:Dist(p.x, p.y)
				local best, bd = nil, math.huge
				local w = self.walls[cid(g.x, g.y)]
				local opts = {}
				for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
					if not w[d[3]] then
						local nd = dist[cid(g.x + d[1], g.y + d[2])] or 999
						opts[#opts + 1] = d
						if nd < bd then best, bd = d, nd end
					end
				end
				-- too far away to sense Pyrus: it floats about (not straight back the way it came)
				local here = dist[cid(g.x, g.y)] or 999
				if g.scared and g.scared > 0 then
					-- fleeing: the way that leads furthest from Pyrus
					local bv = -1
					for _, d in ipairs(opts) do
						local nd = dist[cid(g.x + d[1], g.y + d[2])] or 0
						if nd > bv then best, bv = d, nd end
					end
				elseif here > D.sense or math.random() < D.rnd then
					local fwd = {}
					for _, d in ipairs(opts) do
						if not (g.lx and g.lx == g.x + d[1] and g.ly == g.y + d[2]) then fwd[#fwd + 1] = d end
					end
					if #fwd == 0 then fwd = opts end
					best = fwd[math.random(#fwd)]
				end
				g.lx, g.ly = g.x, g.y
				if best then g.tx, g.ty, g.k = g.x + best[1], g.y + best[2], 0 end
			end
			if g.scared then g.scared = g.scared - STEP if g.scared <= 0 then g.scared = nil end end
			if g.tx then
				g.k = g.k + g.speed * (g.scared and 0.8 or 1) * STEP
				if g.k >= 1 then g.x, g.y, g.tx, g.ty, g.k = g.tx, g.ty, nil, nil, 0 end
			end
		end
		if g.tx then g.fx, g.fy = g.x + (g.tx - g.x) * g.k, g.y + (g.ty - g.y) * g.k else g.fx, g.fy = g.x, g.y end
		if self.safe <= 0 and not g.scared and (g.fx - p.fx) ^ 2 + (g.fy - p.fy) ^ 2 < 0.45 then
			self.lives = self.lives - 1
			self.caughtAt = self.t
			MG.Sound("g16", "pac_die", 0.8)
			return
		end
	end
end

-- Pyrus has come to a cell: keys, candy, the door
function G:Arrive()
	local p = self.p
	for i = #self.keys, 1, -1 do
		local k = self.keys[i]
		if k.x == p.x and k.y == p.y then
			table.remove(self.keys, i)
			self.got = self.got + 1
			self.score = self.score + PTS_KEY
			self:Pop("+" .. PTS_KEY, p.x, p.y)
			MG.Sound("g19", "pickup", 0.8)
			if #self.keys == 0 then MG.Sound("g04", "level", 0.7) end
		end
	end
	for i = #self.candy, 1, -1 do
		local c = self.candy[i]
		if c.x == p.x and c.y == p.y then
			table.remove(self.candy, i)
			self.score = self.score + PTS_CANDY
			self:Pop("+" .. PTS_CANDY, p.x, p.y)
			MG.Sound("g01", "pickup", 0.6)
		end
	end
	if #self.keys == 0 and p.x == self.exit[1] and p.y == self.exit[2] then
		self.score = self.score + PTS_EXIT
		self:Pop("+" .. PTS_EXIT, p.x, p.y, Color(160, 255, 140))
		self.doneAt = self.t
		MG.Sound("g01", "levelcomplete", 0.8)
		if self.level % 2 == 0 then AN.Speak("megetgodt") end
	end
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(W, H)
	local D = self.D
	local cs, ox, oy = self.cell, self.ox, self.oy
	local function CX(x) return ox + (x + 0.5) * cs end
	local function CY(y) return oy + (y + 0.5) * cs end
	AN.Box(MG.X(-600), MG.Y(-600), MG.S(W + 1200), MG.S(H + 1200), Color(24, 16, 30))
	-- the floor
	for y = 0, self.rows - 1 do
		for x = 0, self.cols - 1 do
			AN.Img(A .. "floor.png", MG.X(ox + x * cs), MG.Y(oy + y * cs), MG.S(cs), MG.S(cs))
		end
	end
	-- the walls
	local t = math.max(4, cs * 0.12)
	for y = 0, self.rows - 1 do
		for x = 0, self.cols - 1 do
			local w = self.walls[cid(x, y)]
			local x0, y0 = ox + x * cs, oy + y * cs
			if w.N then AN.Box(MG.X(x0 - t / 2), MG.Y(y0 - t / 2), MG.S(cs + t), MG.S(t), WALL) end
			if w.W then AN.Box(MG.X(x0 - t / 2), MG.Y(y0 - t / 2), MG.S(t), MG.S(cs + t), WALL) end
			if y == self.rows - 1 and w.S then AN.Box(MG.X(x0 - t / 2), MG.Y(y0 + cs - t / 2), MG.S(cs + t), MG.S(t), WALL) end
			if x == self.cols - 1 and w.E then AN.Box(MG.X(x0 + cs - t / 2), MG.Y(y0 - t / 2), MG.S(t), MG.S(cs + t), WALL) end
		end
	end
	-- the door out, the keys, the candy
	local open = #self.keys == 0
	local ew = cs * 0.7
	AN.Img(A .. (open and "exit_open.png" or "exit_locked.png"), MG.X(CX(self.exit[1]) - ew / 2), MG.Y(CY(self.exit[2]) - ew * 1.25 / 2), MG.S(ew), MG.S(ew * 1.25))
	local bob = math.sin(self.t * 4) * cs * 0.04
	for _, k in ipairs(self.keys) do
		AN.Img(A .. "key.png", MG.X(CX(k.x) - cs * 0.32), MG.Y(CY(k.y) - cs * 0.16 + bob), MG.S(cs * 0.64), MG.S(cs * 0.32))
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(self.candy) do

	end
	-- Pyrus
	local p = self.p
	local ph = cs * 0.95
	local pw = ph * 514 / 768
	local blink = self.safe > 0 and math.floor(self.t * 10) % 2 == 0
	if not blink then
		local hop = p.tx and math.abs(math.sin(p.k * math.pi)) * cs * 0.06 or 0
		SU.Img("halloween/pyrus_cape.png", MG.X(CX(p.fx) - pw / 2), MG.Y(CY(p.fy) - ph / 2 - hop), MG.S(pw), MG.S(ph), p.face < 0)
	end
	-- the ghosts
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do
		local gh = cs * 0.95
		local gw = gh * 120 / 140
		local a = g.wait > 0 and 120 or 235
		AN.Img(g.scared and "ghost/ghost_scared.png" or "ghost/ghost.png", MG.X(CX(g.fx) - gw / 2), MG.Y(CY(g.fy) - gh / 2 + math.sin(self.t * 3) * cs * 0.05), MG.S(gw), MG.S(gh), a)
	end
	-- the darkness round the lantern
	local R = D.light * cs
	local size = 4 * R
	local lx, ly = CX(p.fx), CY(p.fy)
	local x0, y0 = MG.X(lx - size / 2), MG.Y(ly - size / 2)
	local S = MG.S(size)
	local flick = 1 + math.sin(self.t * 11) * 0.02
	S = S * flick
	x0, y0 = MG.X(lx) - S / 2, MG.Y(ly) - S / 2
	AN.Img("ghost/dark.png", x0, y0, S, S, 246)
	local dk = Color(DARK.r, DARK.g, DARK.b, 246)

	end
	-- in the dark: the ghosts' eyes, the keys glint, the door when it's open
	for _, g in ipairs(self.ghosts) do

	end
	for i, k in ipairs(self.keys) do

	-- the points
	for i = #self.pops, 1, -1 do

		end
	end
	-- the top bar: the maze, keys, lives, points
	AN.Box(MG.X(W / 2 - 360), MG.Y(14), MG.S(720), MG.S(48), Color(30, 10, 40, 220), MG.S(24))
	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_maze_level", self.level), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2 - 270), MG.Y(38), WHITE, 1, 1)
	local total = self.got + #self.keys
	for i = 1, total do
		AN.Img(A .. "key.png", MG.X(W / 2 - 170 + (i - 1) * 46), MG.Y(28), MG.S(40), MG.S(20), i <= self.got and 255 or 70)
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		AN.Img("trick/jack.png", MG.X(W / 2 + 36 + (i - 1) * 40), MG.Y(22), MG.S(35), MG.S(30), i <= self.lives and 255 or 50)
	end
	AN.Text(AN.L("hw_points", self.score), "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(W / 2 + 260), MG.Y(38), GOLD, 1, 1)
	if not (AN.VS and AN.VS.Split and AN.VS.Split.on) then
		AN.Text(AN.L(self.flashes > 0 and "hw_maze_keys" or "hw_maze_keys2"), "bold", math.floor(MG.S(16)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H - 14), Color(255, 240, 210, 170), 1, 1)
	end
	-- messages
	local msg
	if self.caughtAt then msg = AN.L(self.lives > 0 and "hw_maze_caught" or "hw_maze_over")
	elseif self.doneAt then msg = AN.L("hw_maze_out")
	elseif self.banner and self.t - self.banner < 1.8 then msg = AN.L("hw_maze_level", self.level) .. (#self.keys > 0 and ("  ·  " .. AN.L("hw_maze_find", #self.keys)) or "") end
	if msg then
		AN.Box(MG.X(W / 2 - 320), MG.Y(H / 2 - 40), MG.S(640), MG.S(80), Color(30, 10, 40, 220), MG.S(30))
		AN.Text(msg, "title", math.floor(MG.S(34)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H / 2), WHITE, 1, 1)
	end
	if self.overAt then
		local a = math.Clamp((self.t - self.overAt) * 2, 0, 1)
		AN.Box(MG.X(W / 2 - 300), MG.Y(H * 0.3), MG.S(600), MG.S(150), Color(30, 10, 40, 220 * a), MG.S(30))
		AN.Text(AN.L("hw_maze_over"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(44)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H * 0.3 + 50), Color(255, 255, 255, 255 * a), 1, 1)
		AN.Text(AN.L("su_result") .. ": " .. self.score, "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H * 0.3 + 108), Color(255, 214, 64, 255 * a), 1, 1)
	end
	MG.Chrome(N)
end

function G:Status()
	return AN.L("su_status", math.floor((self.dist or 0) / 10), self.shells or 0, self.lives or 3)
end

function G:Score()
	return math.floor((self.dist or 0) / 10) + (self.shells or 0) * 25
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.diff = SU.Diff()
	self.D = DIFF[self.diff]
	self.phase = "pick"
	self.surfer = self.surfer or 1
	self.kprev = {}
	self.acc = 0
	self.t = 0
	self.dist, self.off = 0, 0
	self.speed = 0
	self.dir = 0
	self.lives, self.power, self.shells = 3, 3, 0
	self.objs = {}
	self.foam = {}
	self.spawnAcc = 0
	self.crash, self.inv, self.fly, self.bumpT, self.boost = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	self.chaser = nil
	self.chaserAt = self.D.chaser and (self.D.chaser * 10 + math.random(0, 1500)) or nil
	self.finished = false
	self.overAt = nil
	self.msg = nil
	-- a few things in view at the start
	for i = 1, 6 do self:Spawn(H * 0.75 + i * 140) end
end

function G:Close() end

-- the key was just pressed
function G:Pressed(k)
	local down = input.IsKeyDown(k)
	local was = self.kprev[k]
	self.kprev[k] = down
	return down and not was
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the sea
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pickKind(far)
	local total = 0
	for _, k in ipairs(KIND_LIST) do
		if not k.far or far >= k.far then total = total + k.weight end
	end
	local r = math.random() * total
	for _, k in ipairs(KIND_LIST) do
		if not k.far or far >= k.far then
			r = r - k.weight
			if r <= 0 then return k end
		end
	end
	return KIND_LIST[1]
end

-- something new at a screen depth (y from the top of the view); x anywhere around the view
function G:Spawn(sy)
	local k = pickKind(self.dist / 10)
	local x = self.off + math.random() * (W * 1.7) - W * 0.35
	local y = self.dist + sy
	-- not on top of something else
	for _, o in ipairs(self.objs) do
		if math.abs(o.x - x) < (o.k.hw + k.hw + 30) and math.abs(o.y - y) < (o.k.hh + k.hh + 40) then return end
	end
	self.objs[#self.objs + 1] = { k = k, x = x, y = y, ph = math.random() * 6 }
end

function G:Hit(o)
	local k = o.k
	if k.hit == "shell" then
		self.shells = self.shells + 1
		MG.Pop("+25", true, o.x - self.off, o.y - self.dist - 30)
		MG.Sound("g01", "pickup")
		o.dead = true
	elseif k.hit == "heart" then
		self.lives = math.min(5, self.lives + 1)
		MG.Sound("g19", "pickup")
		o.dead = true
	elseif k.hit == "bolt" then
		self.power = math.min(5, self.power + 1)
		MG.Sound("g19", "mineralpickup")
		o.dead = true
	elseif k.hit == "jump" then
		if self.fly <= 0 then self.fly = 1.4 MG.Sound("g01", "jump") end
		if self.chaser then self.chaser.stuck = 2.5 end
	elseif self.fly > 0 or self.crash > 0 then
		return
	elseif k.hit == "slow" then
		if self.inv <= 0 then
			if self.speed > 1.5 then MG.Sound("g07", "bag", 0.7) end
			self.speed = math.min(self.speed, 1.2) self.boost = 0
		end
	elseif k.hit == "bump" then
		if self.inv <= 0 and self.bumpT <= 0 then
			self.dir = ({ 1, 2, 4, 5 })[math.random(4)]
			self.bumpT = 0.7
			MG.Sound("g01", "bounce")
		end
	elseif k.hit == "crash" then
		if self.inv > 0 then return end
		self:Crash()
	end
end

function G:Crash()
	self.lives = self.lives - 1
	self.crash = 1.3
	self.speed = 0
	self.boost = 0
	MG.Sound("g07", "splash-short")
	MG.Sound("g18", "thump1", 0.8)
	AN.Speak("MisterLiv")
	if self.lives <= 0 then self:Over() end
end

function G:Over()
	if self.overAt then return end
	self.lives = math.max(0, self.lives)
	self.overAt = self.t
	self.phase = "over"
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- one step (1/60 s)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Step()
	self.t = self.t + STEP
	if self.phase == "pick" then
		if self:Pressed(KEY_LEFT) then self.surfer = 1 end
		if self:Pressed(KEY_RIGHT) then self.surfer = 2 end
		if self:Pressed(KEY_SPACE) or self:Pressed(KEY_DOWN) then self:Go() end
		return
	end
	if self.phase == "over" then
		if self.t - self.overAt > 2 and not self.finished then
			self.finished = true
			AN.FinishGame(101, self:Score())
		end
		return
	end
	-- timers
	self.crash = math.max(0, self.crash - STEP)
	self.fly = math.max(0, self.fly - STEP)
	self.bumpT = math.max(0, self.bumpT - STEP)
	if self.crash > 0 then
		if self.crash <= STEP then
			-- back on the board, standing still, a moment safe
			self.dir = 0
			self.inv = 2.2
		end
		self:Move(0)
		return
	end
	self.inv = math.max(0, self.inv - STEP)
	-- the keys
	local L, R = self:Pressed(KEY_LEFT), self:Pressed(KEY_RIGHT)
	local Dn, Up, Sp = self:Pressed(KEY_DOWN), self:Pressed(KEY_UP), self:Pressed(KEY_SPACE)
	if self.bumpT <= 0 then
		if L then self.dir = self.dir == 0 and 2 or math.max(1, self.dir - 1) end
		if R then self.dir = self.dir == 0 and 4 or math.min(5, self.dir + 1) end
		if Dn then self.dir = 3 end
	end
	if Up and self.boost <= 0 then self.dir = 0 self.speed = 0 end
	if Sp and self.power > 0 and self.boost <= 0 and self.dir ~= 0 then
		self.power = self.power - 1
		self.boost = 4
		MG.Sound("g19", "warpactive", 0.7)
		if self.dir == 0 then self.dir = 3 end
	end
	-- speed: up to the difficulty's (it goes up a little the farther you get), double while boosting
	local base = self.D.speed + math.min(1.6, self.dist / 10 / 2500)
	if self.dir == 0 then
		self.speed = 0
	else
		if self.speed < 1 then self.speed = 1 end
		local want = base * (self.boost > 0 and 1.9 or 1)
		if self.speed < want then self.speed = math.min(want, self.speed * 1.02 + 0.02) end
		if self.speed > want then self.speed = math.max(want, self.speed - 0.08) end
	end
	self.boost = math.max(0, self.boost - STEP)
	self:Move(self.speed)
	-- foam behind the board
	if self.speed > 0.5 and math.floor(self.t * 60) % 4 == 0 then
		self.foam[#self.foam + 1] = { x = self.off + W / 2, y = self.dist + PY + 18, t = self.t }
	end
	-- hits
	if self.overAt then return end
	local px, py = self.off + W / 2, self.dist + PY + 20
	for _, o in ipairs(self.objs) do
		local k = o.k
		local cy = o.y + (k.oy or 0)
		if not o.dead and math.abs(px - o.x) < k.hw and math.abs(py - cy) < k.hh then
			self:Hit(o)
			if self.crash > 0 or self.overAt then break end
		end
	end
	self:UpdateChaser()
end

-- move along (and make the sea ahead)
function G:Move(sp)
	local d = DIRS[self.dir] or DIRS[3]
	local moved = sp * (1 - math.abs(d.dx) * 0.25)
	self.dist = self.dist + moved
	self.off = self.off + sp * d.dx
	self.spawnAcc = self.spawnAcc + moved
	while self.spawnAcc >= 46 do
		self.spawnAcc = self.spawnAcc - 46
		if math.random() < self.D.fill then self:Spawn(H + 60 + math.random() * 120) end
	end
	-- forget what is behind
	local keep = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(self.objs) do
		if not o.dead and o.y > self.dist - 200 then keep[#keep + 1] = o end
	end
	self.objs = keep
	local f = {}
	for _, x in ipairs(self.foam) do if self.t - x.t < 0.9 then f[#f + 1] = x end end
	self.foam = f
end

-- the chaser on Normal and Hard
function G:UpdateChaser()
	if not self.chaserAt then return end
	local c = self.chaser
	if not c then
		if self.dist >= self.chaserAt then
			local id = CHASER_LIST[math.random(#CHASER_LIST)]
			self.chaser = { id = id, def = CHASERS[id], x = self.off + W / 2, y = self.dist - 160, stuck = 0, t0 = self.t }
			self.msg = { text = AN.L("su_chased", AN.L("su_chaser_" .. id)), t = self.t }
			MG.Sound("g16", "whistle_2")
		end
		return
	end
	local def = c.def
	if c.stuck > 0 then
		c.stuck = c.stuck - STEP
		-- left far behind: it gives up for a while
		if c.y < self.dist - 260 then
			self.chaser = nil
			self.chaserAt = self.dist + 1500 + math.random(0, 1500)
		end
		return
	end
	local base = self.D.speed + math.min(1.6, self.dist / 10 / 2500)
	local tx, ty = self.off + W / 2, self.dist + PY
	if ty - c.y > 4 then c.y = c.y + base * def.speed + (ty - c.y > 400 and 2 or 0) end
	if c.x < tx - 2 then c.x = c.x + def.side elseif c.x > tx + 2 then c.x = c.x - def.side end
	-- caught you
	if self.fly <= 0 and self.crash <= 0 and math.abs(c.x - tx) < 46 and math.abs(c.y + 30 - ty) < 40 then
		self.lives = 0
		self.caught = true
		MG.Sound("g07", "splash-long")
		MG.Sound("g18", "thump2")
		self:Over()
		return
	end
	-- the crab and the serpent get stuck on rocks and things
	if def.stuck then
		for _, o in ipairs(self.objs) do
			if o.k.hit == "crash" and math.abs(c.x - o.x) < o.k.hw + 20 and math.abs(c.y + 40 - (o.y + (o.k.oy or 0))) < o.k.hh + 10 then
				c.stuck = 3
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function G:Go()
	self.phase = "play"
	self.dir = 3
	self.speed = 1
	self.inv = 1
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- drawing (stage units; the sea fills the whole view)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pic(name, cx, cy, w, h, alpha)
	AN.Img(A .. name .. ".png", MG.X(cx - w / 2), MG.Y(cy - h / 2), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), alpha)
end
local function rot(path, cx, cy, w, h, deg, alpha)
	AN.ImgRotated(path, MG.X(cx), MG.Y(cy), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), deg, alpha)
end

function G:DrawSurfer(cx, cy, s, idx, dir, alpha, lying)
	local sf = SURFERS[idx]
	local d = DIRS[dir] or DIRS[3]
	-- the board, then the surfer standing on it, leaning into the turn
	rot(A .. sf.board .. ".png", cx, cy + 8 * s, 44 * 0.85 * s, 130 * 0.85 * s, d.rot, alpha)
	local h = sf.h * s
	local w = h * sf.iw / sf.ih
	if lying then
		rot(sf.img, cx + 8 * s, cy + 6 * s, w, h, 80, alpha)
	else
		local lean = -d.dx * 14
		if dir == 0 then lean = 0 end
		rot(sf.img, cx - math.sin(math.rad(lean)) * h * 0.4, cy - h * 0.42, w, h, lean, alpha)
	end
end

function G:Paint()
	MG.Stage(W, H)
	-- the sea, as far as the view goes
	local vx0 = (0 - MG.x0) / MG.k - 40
	local vx1 = (AN.VW - MG.x0) / MG.k + 40
	local vy0 = (-AN.OY - MG.y0) / MG.k - 40
	local vy1 = (AN.VH - AN.OY - MG.y0) / MG.k + 40
	AN.Box(MG.X(vx0), MG.Y(vy0), MG.S(vx1 - vx0), MG.S(vy1 - vy0), Color(46, 168, 214))
	AN.VGrad(MG.X(vx0), MG.Y(vy0), MG.S(vx1 - vx0), MG.S(vy1 - vy0), Color(20, 110, 170), 0, 110)
	local T = 256
	local ox = -((self.off % T) + T) % T
	local oy = -((self.dist % T) + T) % T
	for ty = vy0 - T + (oy - vy0) % T, vy1, T do
		for tx = vx0 - T + (ox - vx0) % T, vx1, T do
			AN.Img(A .. "ripples.png", MG.X(tx), MG.Y(ty), MG.S(T), MG.S(T))
		end
	end
	-- foam trail
	for _, f in ipairs(self.foam) do
		local a = 1 - (self.t - f.t) / 0.9
		pic("foam", f.x - self.off, f.y - self.dist, 44 * (1 + (1 - a) * 0.6), 44 * (1 + (1 - a) * 0.6), 200 * a)
	end
	-- everything in the sea and the surfer, in depth order
	local list = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(self.objs) do
		local sy = o.y - self.dist
		if sy > vy0 - 200 and sy < vy1 + 200 then list[#list + 1] = { y = o.y + (o.k.oy or 0), o = o } end
	end
	list[#list + 1] = { y = self.dist + PY + 20, me = true }
	if self.chaser and not self.chaser.def.flies then list[#list + 1] = { y = self.chaser.y + 40, ch = true } end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.y < b.y end)
	for _, it in ipairs(list) do
		if it.o then
			local o, k = it.o, it.o.k
			local bob = (k.hit == "shell" or k.hit == "heart" or k.hit == "bolt" or k.hit == "bump") and math.sin(self.t * 3 + o.ph) * 3 or 0
			pic(k.img, o.x - self.off, o.y - self.dist + bob, k.w, k.h)
		elseif it.me then
			self:PaintMe()
		elseif it.ch then
			self:PaintChaser()
		end
	end
	if self.chaser and self.chaser.def.flies then self:PaintChaser() end
	MG.DrawPops()
	self:PaintHud(vx0, vx1, vy0)
	MG.Chrome(101)
end

function G:PaintMe()
	local cx, cy = W / 2, PY
	if self.phase == "pick" then return end
	if self.crash > 0 then
		pic("splash", cx, cy + 6, 120, 80)
		self:DrawSurfer(cx, cy, 1, self.surfer, 3, 255, true)
		return
	end
	local s = 1
	if self.fly > 0 then
		local f = 1 - self.fly / 1.4
		local hgt = math.sin(f * math.pi)
		s = 1 + 0.35 * hgt
		pic("shadow", cx, cy + 18, 70 * (1 - hgt * 0.3), 20, 255)
		cy = cy - hgt * 40
	end
	local alpha = (self.inv > 0 and math.floor(self.t * 10) % 2 == 0) and 110 or 255
	self:DrawSurfer(cx, cy, s, self.surfer, self.dir, alpha)
end

function G:PaintChaser()
	local c = self.chaser
	local def = c.def
	local fr = math.floor(self.t * (def.flies and 6 or 5)) % 2
	local x, y = c.x - self.off, c.y - self.dist
	if def.flies then
		pic("shadow", x, y + 60, 90, 24)
		y = y - 20 + math.sin(self.t * 4) * 6
	end
	pic(def.img .. fr, x, y, def.w, def.h, c.stuck > 0 and 200 or 255)
end

local WHITE = Color(255, 255, 255)
local DARK = Color(10, 50, 80)
function G:PaintHud(vx0, vx1, vy0)
	-- top bar of the stage: hearts, metres, bolts, shells
	local top = math.max(vy0 + 40, 16)
	local cx = W / 2
	AN.Box(MG.X(cx - 330), MG.Y(top - 8), MG.S(660), MG.S(52), Color(10, 50, 80, 150), MG.S(26))
	AN.Text(AN.L("su_m", math.floor(self.dist / 10)), "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(cx), MG.Y(top + 18), WHITE, 1, 1)
	for i = 1, math.min(5, math.max(3, self.lives)) do
		pic(i <= self.lives and "hud_heart" or "hud_heart0", cx - 110 - (i - 1) * 34, top + 18, 30, 28)
	end
	for i = 1, math.min(5, math.max(3, self.power)) do
		pic(i <= self.power and "hud_bolt" or "hud_bolt0", cx + 110 + (i - 1) * 30, top + 18, 24, 30)
	end
	-- shells (left of the bar)
	pic("shell", cx - 300, top + 16, 30, 28)
	AN.Text("x " .. self.shells, "title", math.floor(MG.S(24)), MG.X(cx - 280), MG.Y(top + 18), WHITE, 0, 1)
	-- the chaser's warning
	if self.msg and self.t - self.msg.t < 3 then
		local a = math.Clamp((3 - (self.t - self.msg.t)) * 2, 0, 1)
		AN.Text(self.msg.text, "title", math.floor(MG.S(34)), MG.X(cx) + 3, MG.Y(H * 0.62) + 3, Color(10, 40, 60, 200 * a), 1, 1)
		AN.Text(self.msg.text, "title", math.floor(MG.S(34)), MG.X(cx), MG.Y(H * 0.62), Color(255, 214, 64, 255 * a), 1, 1)
	end
	if self.boost > 0 then
		pic("hud_bolt", cx + 50, PY - 60, 24 + math.sin(self.t * 20) * 3, 30)
	end
	if self.phase == "pick" then self:PaintPick() end
	if self.phase == "over" then
		local a = math.Clamp((self.t - self.overAt) * 2, 0, 1)
		AN.Box(MG.X(cx - 300), MG.Y(H * 0.45), MG.S(600), MG.S(150), Color(10, 50, 80, 200 * a), MG.S(30))
		AN.Text(self.caught and self.chaser and AN.L("su_caught", AN.L("su_chaser_" .. self.chaser.id)) or AN.L("su_gameover"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(46)), MG.X(cx), MG.Y(H * 0.45 + 50), Color(255, 255, 255, 255 * a), 1, 1)
		AN.Text(AN.L("su_result") .. ": " .. self:Score(), "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(cx), MG.Y(H * 0.45 + 108), Color(255, 214, 64, 255 * a), 1, 1)
	end
end

-- picking the surfer before the start
function G:PaintPick()
	local cx = W / 2
	AN.Text(AN.L("su_pick"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(48)), MG.X(cx) + 3, MG.Y(130) + 3, DARK, 1, 1)
	AN.Text(AN.L("su_pick"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(48)), MG.X(cx), MG.Y(130), WHITE, 1, 1)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local x = cx + (i == 1 and -130 or 130)
		local sel = self.surfer == i
		local y = 330 + (sel and math.sin(self.t * 6) * 6 or 0)
		local hot = UI.Button("surf_pick" .. i, MG.X(x - 80), MG.Y(200), MG.S(160), MG.S(200), function()
			if self.surfer == i then self:Go() else self.surfer = i end
		end)
		if sel then AN.Glow(MG.X(x), MG.Y(300), MG.S(110), Color(255, 240, 180), 0.7) end
		self:DrawSurfer(x, y, sel and 1.5 or 1.25, i, 3, (sel or hot) and 255 or 170)
	end
	AN.Box(MG.X(cx - 330), MG.Y(470), MG.S(660), MG.S(50), Color(10, 50, 80, 170), MG.S(25))
	AN.Text(AN.L("su_pick_keys"), "bold", math.floor(MG.S(20)), MG.X(cx), MG.Y(495), WHITE, 1, 1)
end

AN.RegisterGame(101, G)
alletidersnisse/gamemode/games/s02_icecr:
-- Summer: Is-tårnet (the ice cream tower). Pyrus runs the ice cream cart; kids (and now and then a
-- dachshund) come up with an order in a speech bubble: a cone, cup or dog bowl, scoops stacked in a
-- tower in the right order, maybe a topping on top. Build it and serve it before they run out of
-- patience. Played with the keyboard (left/right picks, Space adds, Down takes the last off, Ctrl or
-- Up serves) or the mouse. Three angry customers, or the time running out, ends the round.
local UI, C, MG = AN.UI, AN.Col, AN.MG
local SU = AN.Summer
local G = {
	scoreType = "score",
	goal = 1800,
	worst = 0,
	descKey = "su_icecream",
}
local W, H = 960, 720
local STEP = 1 / 60
local A = "is/"
local TOP = 470                 -- the counter top
local TOWER_X = 690

-- what's in the freezer row, left to right
local ITEMS = {
	{ id = "cone", kind = "box", img = "cone", w = 64, h = 96, top = 8 },
	{ id = "cup", kind = "box", img = "cup", w = 76, h = 60, top = 10 },
	{ id = "bowl", kind = "box", img = "bowl", w = 88, h = 44, top = 10 },
	{ id = "jordbaer", kind = "scoop", img = "s_jordbaer", col = Color(244, 143, 177) },
	{ id = "choko", kind = "scoop", img = "s_choko", col = Color(122, 74, 42) },
	{ id = "vanilje", kind = "scoop", img = "s_vanilje", col = Color(251, 240, 200) },
	{ id = "pistacie", kind = "scoop", img = "s_pistacie", col = Color(168, 212, 138) },
	{ id = "lakrids", kind = "scoop", img = "s_lakrids", col = Color(46, 42, 44) },
	{ id = "guf", kind = "top", img = "t_guf", w = 64, h = 44 },
	{ id = "flodebolle", kind = "top", img = "t_flodebolle", w = 56, h = 54 },
	{ id = "krymmel", kind = "top", img = "t_krymmel", w = 64, h = 30 },
	{ id = "syltetoj", kind = "top", img = "t_syltetoj", w = 64, h = 40 },
}
local BYID = {}
for i, it in ipairs(ITEMS) do it.i = i BYID[it.id] = it end
local SCOOPS = { "jordbaer", "choko", "vanilje", "pistacie", "lakrids" }
local TOPS = { "guf", "flodebolle", "krymmel", "syltetoj" }

local DIFF = {
	{ scoops = { 1, 2 }, top = 0.3, slots = 1, patience = 38, arrive = 2.0 },
	{ scoops = { 2, 4 }, top = 0.6, slots = 2, patience = 30, arrive = 1.6 },
	{ scoops = { 3, 6 }, top = 0.85, slots = 3, patience = 24, arrive = 1.2 },
}
local ROUND = 120
local LOOKS = {
	{ img = "sommer/boy_shirt.png", w = 342, h = 512, dh = 250, show = 0.62 },
	{ img = "sommer/boy_swim.png", w = 340, h = 512, dh = 250, show = 0.62 },
	{ img = "sommer/girl_dress.png", w = 440, h = 512, dh = 230, show = 0.6 },
	{ img = "sommer/girl_swim.png", w = 440, h = 512, dh = 230, show = 0.6 },
}
local DOG = { img = "sommer/dog.png", w = 588, h = 512, dh = 150, show = 0.72, dog = true }
-- where the customers stand (front first)
local SLOTS = { { x = 300, s = 1 }, { x = 170, s = 0.88 }, { x = 60, s = 0.78 } }

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Status()
	return AN.L("su_ice_status", self.score or 0, self.served or 0, math.max(0, math.ceil(ROUND - (self.time or 0))))
end

function G:Open(args)
	self.diff = SU.Diff()
	self.D = DIFF[self.diff]
	self.phase = "play"
	self.kprev = {}
	self.acc, self.t, self.time = 0, 0, 0
	self.score, self.served, self.strikes = 0, 0, 0
	self.sel = 1
	self.build = {}
	self.queue = {}
	self.leaving = {}
	self.nextArrive = 0.5
	self.finished, self.overAt = false, nil
	self.flash = nil
end
function G:Close() end

function G:Pressed(k)
	local down = input.IsKeyDown(k)
	local was = self.kprev[k]
	self.kprev[k] = down
	return down and not was
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- orders
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:NewCustomer()
	local c = { t0 = self.t, x = -200 }
	if math.random() < 0.15 then
		c.look = DOG
		c.order = { "bowl" }
		for i = 1, math.random(1, 2) do c.order[#c.order + 1] = ({ "vanilje", "jordbaer" })[math.random(2)] end
	else
		c.look = LOOKS[math.random(#LOOKS)]
		c.order = { math.random() < 0.6 and "cone" or "cup" }
		local lo, hi = self.D.scoops[1], self.D.scoops[2]
		for i = 1, math.random(lo, hi) do c.order[#c.order + 1] = SCOOPS[math.random(#SCOOPS)] end
		if math.random() < self.D.top then c.order[#c.order + 1] = TOPS[math.random(#TOPS)] end
	end
	c.patience = self.D.patience + 3 * #c.order
	c.left = c.patience
	self.queue[#self.queue + 1] = c
end

-- add the chosen item to the tower (container first, scoops, one topping last)
function G:Add(i)
	local it = ITEMS[i]
	local b = self.build
	local last = b[#b] and BYID[b[#b]]
	if it.kind == "box" then
		if #b > 0 then return self:Buzz() end
	else
		if #b == 0 then return self:Buzz() end
		if last.kind == "top" then return self:Buzz() end
		if #b >= 9 then return self:Buzz() end
	end
	b[#b + 1] = it.id
	self.bump = self.t
	MG.Sound(it.kind == "scoop" and "g01" or "g21", it.kind == "scoop" and "pop" or "place", 0.7)
end
function G:Undo()
	if #self.build > 0 then table.remove(self.build) MG.Sound("g11", "lift", 0.6) end
end
function G:Buzz()
	self.flash = { t = self.t, bad = true }
	MG.Sound("g06", "error", 0.6)
end

function G:Serve()
	local c = self.queue[1]
	if not c or #self.build == 0 then return self:Buzz() end
	local ok = #self.build == #c.order
	if ok then for i = 1, #c.order do if self.build[i] ~= c.order[i] then ok = false break end end end
	if ok then
		local pts = 30 + 15 * #c.order + math.floor(40 * math.Clamp(c.left / c.patience, 0, 1))
		self.score = self.score + pts
		self.served = self.served + 1
		MG.Pop("+" .. pts, true, SLOTS[1].x, TOP - 190)
		c.happy = true
		if math.random() < 0.35 then AN.Speak(({ "megetgodt", "godt" })[math.random(2)]) end
	else
		self.score = math.max(0, self.score - 20)
		MG.Pop("-20", false, SLOTS[1].x, TOP - 190)
		c.happy = false
		self.strikes = self.strikes + 1
		AN.Speak("skidt")
	end
	table.remove(self.queue, 1)
	c.leaveAt = self.t
	c.leftFrom = c.x
	if ok then MG.Sound("ui", "point") MG.Sound("g19", "cash", 0.7) else MG.Sound("tv2", "wrong") end
	self.leaving[#self.leaving + 1] = c
	self.build = {}
	self.flash = { t = self.t, bad = not ok }
	if self.strikes >= 3 then self:Over() end
end

function G:Over()
	if self.overAt then return end
	self.overAt = self.t
	self.phase = "over"
	MG.Sound("g14", "done")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function G:Step()
	self.t = self.t + STEP
	if self.phase == "over" then
		if self.t - self.overAt > 2.2 and not self.finished then
			self.finished = true
			AN.FinishGame(102, self.score)
		end
		return
	end
	self.time = self.time + STEP
	if self.time >= ROUND then return self:Over() end
	-- keys
	if self:Pressed(KEY_LEFT) then self.sel = (self.sel - 2) % #ITEMS + 1 end
	if self:Pressed(KEY_RIGHT) then self.sel = self.sel % #ITEMS + 1 end
	if self:Pressed(KEY_SPACE) then self:Add(self.sel) end
	if self:Pressed(KEY_DOWN) then self:Undo() end
	local serve = self:Pressed(KEY_LCONTROL)
	if self:Pressed(KEY_RCONTROL) then serve = true end
	if self:Pressed(KEY_UP) then serve = true end
	if serve then self:Serve() end
	-- customers come and wait
	if #self.queue < self.D.slots then
		self.nextArrive = self.nextArrive - STEP
		if self.nextArrive <= 0 then
			self:NewCustomer()
			MG.Sound("g08", "pling", 0.6)
			self.nextArrive = self.D.arrive + math.random() * 1.5
		end
	end
	for i = #self.queue, 1, -1 do
		local c = self.queue[i]
		c.left = c.left - STEP
		if c.left <= 0 then
			-- gave up waiting
			table.remove(self.queue, i)
			c.happy = false
			c.angry = true
			c.leaveAt = self.t
			c.leftFrom = c.x
			self.leaving[#self.leaving + 1] = c
			self.strikes = self.strikes + 1
			MG.Sound("g02", "buzz")
			if i == 1 then self.build = {} end
			if self.strikes >= 3 then self:Over() end
		end
	end
	-- walking to their places
	for i, c in ipairs(self.queue) do
		local tx = SLOTS[i].x
		c.x = c.x + (tx - c.x) * math.min(1, STEP * 6)
	end
	local keep = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(self.leaving) do
		if self.t - c.leaveAt < 1.5 then keep[#keep + 1] = c end
	end
	self.leaving = keep
end

function G:Think(dt)
	self.acc = self.acc + math.min(dt, 0.25)
	while self.acc >= STEP do
		self.acc = self.acc - STEP
		self:Step()
	end
end

-- drawing
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pic(name, x, y, w, h, alpha)
	AN.Img(A .. name .. ".png", MG.X(x), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), alpha)
end
local WHITE = Color(255, 255, 255)
local INK = Color(26, 58, 84)

-- a tower: container on the base line, scoops stacked, topping on top (x = centre)
local function tower(list, x, base, s, wob, t)
	if #list == 0 then return end
	local box = BYID[list[1]]
	local bw, bh = box.w * s, box.h * s
	pic(box.img, x - bw / 2, base - bh, bw, bh)
	local y = base - bh + box.top * s
	for i = 2, #list do
		local it = BYID[list[i]]
		local sway = wob and math.sin(t * 3 + i * 0.7) * (i - 1) * 1.2 * s or 0
		if it.kind == "scoop" then
			local w, h = 72 * s, 56 * s
			pic(it.img, x - w / 2 + sway, y - h + 14 * s, w, h)
			y = y - 34 * s
		else
			local w, h = it.w * s, it.h * s
			pic(it.img, x - w / 2 + sway, y - h + (it.id == "syltetoj" and 22 or (it.id == "krymmel" and 18 or 10)) * s, w, h)
		end
	end
end

function G:DrawCustomer(c, x, s, alpha)
	local L = c.look
	local h = L.dh * s
	local w = h * L.w / L.h
	local bob = math.sin(self.t * 2 + (c.t0 or 0)) * 2
	local y = TOP - h * L.show + bob
	if c.angry and c.leaveAt then y = y + math.min(1, (self.t - c.leaveAt)) * 20 end
	AN.Img(L.img, MG.X(x - w / 2), MG.Y(y), MG.S(w), MG.S(h), alpha)
end

	-- the beach behind, filling the view

	-- Pyrus behind the cart, on the right

	-- the freezer row: what you can add

	AN.Text(AN.L("su_ice_keys"), "bold", math.floor(MG.S(15)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(TOP + 186), INK, 1, 1)
	-- the orders: a bubble beside the first customer, a patience bar over everyone's head
	for i, c in ipairs(self.queue) do

			local s = math.min(0.75, (bh2 - 26) / (110 + 34 * (#c.order - 1)))

	AN.Text(AN.L("su_ice_pts", self.score), "title", math.floor(MG.S(28)), MG.X(W / 2 + 60), MG.Y(38), Color(255, 214, 64), 1, 1)

	if self.phase == "over" then
		local a = math.Clamp((self.t - self.overAt) * 2, 0, 1)

		AN.Text(self.strikes >= 3 and AN.L("su_ice_angry") or AN.L("su_ice_closed"), "title", math.floor(MG.S(44)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H * 0.3 + 50), Color(255, 255, 255, 255 * a), 1, 1)
		AN.Text(AN.L("su_result") .. ": " .. self.score, "title", math.floor(MG.S(30)), MG.X(W / 2), MG.Y(H * 0.3 + 108), Color(255, 214, 64, 255 * a), 1, 1)
